drama_dialogue1000001.ch: 暮仙州天降暴雨，渭河水势大涨，似有超凡之人现世。
drama_dialogue1000001.en: Rain pours in Mu Xian and the water of the Wei rises. Someone extraordinary seems to have appeared.

drama_dialogue10001.ch: 妖兽扰乱人间秩序，血腥如浪潮般来袭，人魔开始重出地狱！
drama_dialogue10001.en: Monsters run amok. Blood floods over the land. Demons walk the earth once again!

drama_dialogue10003.ch: 轮回大道已被打乱，世间将会万劫不复，只有你能重振天道！
drama_dialogue10003.en: The Great Path of Reincarnation is broken. The world is in ruins. Only you can restore the Heavenly Path!

drama_dialogue10004.ch: 啊？可我还什么都不会呢！
drama_dialogue10004.en: Huh? But I can't do anything yet!

drama_dialogue10005.ch: 无妨无妨，吾将几本功法赐予你，以汝之天资，定可成大业！
drama_dialogue10005.en: No problem. I will teach you some Martial Arts. You will accomplish great things, I am sure!

drama_dialogue10007.ch: 你先加入一个宗门，开始修道之路！为师这有些丹药和一个宝物--双鱼佩，此物可拯救你于危难之中，务必要好好珍惜！
drama_dialogue10007.en: First join a Sect and begin the Path of Cultivation! I have some Elixirs and a treasure here— the Bagua Jade—that will get you out of trouble. Take good care of them!

drama_dialogue10008.ch: 这里是{SchoolName}，你想加入本宗门吗？
drama_dialogue10008.en: This is the {SchoolName} Sect. Do you want to join?

drama_dialogue10009.ch: 欢迎加入本宗门！你现在可以进入宗门领地了！
drama_dialogue10009.en: Welcome to the Sect! You can now enter sect territory.

drama_dialogue1001001.ch: 何罗鱼明明已然死去多时……这股庞大而狂暴的气息又会属于谁……
drama_dialogue1001001.en: Leviathan has been dead for a long time... Then who's the master of such a violent breath...?

drama_dialogue1001002.ch: 难道，他竟然能离开冥界？
drama_dialogue1001002.en: Could it be... he actually left the underworld?

drama_dialogue1001003.ch: 精卫，你怎么跑出来了！我建木没出事吧！
drama_dialogue1001003.en: What are you doing here, Jingwei? Is everything fine with my Tree Vault?

drama_dialogue1001004.ch: 不，不可能……我父亲曾说，八荒与冥界自有禁制隔绝……
drama_dialogue1001004.en: No, impossible... My father said no one could escape the underworld...

drama_dialogue1001005.ch: 那么，除他之外，就只剩下那家伙了！
drama_dialogue1001005.en: So, there's only one possibility left!

drama_dialogue1001007.ch: 我猜想，出现在渭水中的，大概就是何罗鱼的主人——冰夷。此位女修士为高深莫测，怕是刚闭关结束。
drama_dialogue1001007.en: The one who appeared in the Wei River might be Leviathan's unfathomable mistress—Bingyi. She has probably finished her cultivation.

drama_dialogue1001009.ch: 相传此女锱铢必较，一旦遇上，恐怕她会因为何罗鱼之死而刁难你我，咱们可一定不要轻易招惹于她！
drama_dialogue1001009.en: She's said to be very stingy and will probably make trouble for us because of Leviathan's death. We must be careful!

drama_dialogue1002001.ch: （暮仙州突然出现一股强大的气场，其中必有缘故，是否要前去一探？）
drama_dialogue1002001.en: (A powerful aura suddenly appears in Mu Xian. Check it out?)

drama_dialogue1003001.ch: 没想到，本仙女闭关不过千年，东海竟已化作桑田，实在令人倍感惆怅。
drama_dialogue1003001.en: I've cultivated for merely a thousand years, yet the East Sea is no more. How melancholy.

drama_dialogue1003002.ch: 我养在东海里那条长满触须的肥鱼……可惜了，本来留着出关后下酒的，没想到我还没来得及吃，它就不见了……
drama_dialogue1003002.en: I was going to make a dish out of that fat to go with some wine. Who'd have thought it's already gone...?

drama_dialogue1003003.ch: 嗯？怎么有一股肥鱼的香气！
drama_dialogue1003003.en: Huh? Isn't that the smell of my fat fish?

drama_dialogue1003005.ch: 哦？这么巧？偷鱼毛贼自己送来门来了？
drama_dialogue1003005.en: Oh, what a coincidence. The fish thief is delivered to my door!

drama_dialogue1003007.ch: 区区修仙者，竟敢毁我食材……呃，难道东海也是你填的？
drama_dialogue1003007.en: How dare you ruin my dish... Hmm, you didn't happen to fill up the East Sea as well, did you?

drama_dialogue1003101.ch: 嗯，敢在本仙女面前如此强硬，你也算是勇气可嘉……不过嘛……
drama_dialogue1003101.en: Your courage to play tough is admirable... However...

drama_dialogue1003102.ch: 夺鱼之仇不共戴天！今日，不是你死，就是我活！
drama_dialogue1003102.en: This world isn't big enough for both of us! Today, it's either you or me!

drama_dialogue1003104.ch: 咳咳，但你也不用过于紧张，本仙女格局之大，自然不至于欺压你等修仙之人，这名声传出去也不好听。
drama_dialogue1003104.en: Ahem, don't be nervous, I won't bully a weakling like you. That will bring dishonor to my name.

drama_dialogue1003105.ch: 这样吧，我仅用一成功力与你交手，你若能胜过我，此事便一笔勾销，如何？
drama_dialogue1003105.en: I'm going to use one-tenth of my strength. And I'll forgive you if you win. What do you think?

drama_dialogue1003203.en: Never heard of the name before.

drama_dialogue1003205.ch: 哼，事到如今，你竟然还想推脱，我看就是你干的好事！
drama_dialogue1003205.en: Are you trying to shrug it off? Obviously, YOU are the culprit!

drama_dialogue1003206.ch: 夺鱼之仇不共戴天！今日，不是你死，就是我活！
drama_dialogue1003206.en: This world isn't big enough for both of us! Today, it's either you or me!

drama_dialogue1003208.ch: 咳咳，但你也不用过于紧张，本仙女格局之大，自然不至于欺压你等修仙之人，这名声传出去也不好听。
drama_dialogue1003208.en: Ahem, don't be nervous, I won't bully a weakling like you. That will bring dishonor to my name.

drama_dialogue1003209.ch: 这样吧，我仅用一成功力与你交手，你若能胜过我，此事便一笔勾销，如何？
drama_dialogue1003209.en: I'm going to use one-tenth of my strength. And I'll forgive you if you win. What do you think?

drama_dialogue1004001.ch: 小家伙确实有两下子，想必是吸收了那肥鱼的精华……
drama_dialogue1004001.en: Not bad, little guy. You must have absorbed the essence of my fish...

drama_dialogue1004002.ch: 可恶，我一口都没吃上，真是越想越不甘心呐！
drama_dialogue1004002.en: Ugh! Can't believe I even didn't take a bite of it!

drama_dialogue1004003.ch: 得想办法把若川那个小妮子再骗出来一次才行……
drama_dialogue1004003.en: I have to find a way to lure Ruochuan out again...

drama_dialogue1004005.ch: 什么？吃了我的鱼这就想跑？
drama_dialogue1004005.en: You think you can just walk away after eating my fish?

drama_dialogue1004007.ch: 也罢，本仙女向来说一不二，便不再与你纠缠了。
drama_dialogue1004007.en: Never mind. I always keep my word. Be gone, now.

drama_dialogue1004008.ch: 不过，如此实力的修仙者倒也有趣，若你再与我交手，我或许有好东西给你。当然，我也会使用更强的力量。
drama_dialogue1004008.en: To be honest, I'm interested in powerful cultivators like you. You'll get a reward if you challenge me again. But of course, I'll call forth more power.

drama_dialogue1004102.ch: 这有本被水泡烂的小册子，我也读不懂，就送你好了。
drama_dialogue1004102.en: Here's a water-soaked book that I can't comprehend. Take it. It is yours now.

drama_dialogue1004201.ch: 嗯，我必须承认你是个值得尊重的对手，我要开始认真了。
drama_dialogue1004201.en: You are a respectable opponent. I've got to be more serious.

drama_dialogue1004202.ch: 这颗药你可要拿好，万一下次被我打残，你还能自己吃了续命，哼！
drama_dialogue1004202.en: Take this elixir. It will save your life the next time we fight.

drama_dialogue1004401.ch: 咳……一定是我太饿了，所以没劲跟你打……你可别得意，等我的本尊出关，必一巴掌将你拍飞！什么？你以为我就是本尊，呵呵呵，我只是偷跑出来吃东西的分魂罢了，嘿嘿。
drama_dialogue1004401.en: Cough... I must be too hungry... But don't get too proud. What you fought against was merely an infused spirit I sent to fetch food. When I finish my cultivation, I'll easily crush you with my real body!

drama_dialogue1004402.ch: 让本仙女翻翻储物戒里还剩点啥……
drama_dialogue1004402.en: Let me see what's left there in my ring...

drama_dialogue1004403.ch: 喔，我都快把这些玩意忘了……这是好多年前，一只小白兔孝敬本仙女的，反正本仙女也不吃素，你拿去吃好了，慢走不送！
drama_dialogue1004403.en: Ha, I almost forgot about this... A white rabbit gave it to me as a tribute many years ago. I don't like veggies, so you can take it.

drama_dialogue1005001.ch: 就这点实力，可惜了一条大补之鱼啊。
drama_dialogue1005001.en: Is that all you've got? What a waste of my fish.

drama_dialogue1006001.ch: 嗯？又想来跟本仙女你死我活了？
drama_dialogue1006001.en: Huh? Are you here to challenge me again?

drama_dialogue1006002.ch: 你可要想清楚，本仙女每多使一成的功力，你便快一分败在本仙女裙下……
drama_dialogue1006002.en: Just to be clear, the more power I call forth, the faster you'll lose...

drama_dialogue1006003.ch: 这回我可不会放水，觉悟吧！
drama_dialogue1006003.en: It won't be that easy this time! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue1006004.ch: 这回我可不会放水，觉悟吧！
drama_dialogue1006004.en: It won't be that easy this time! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue1006005.ch: 这回我可不会放水，觉悟吧！
drama_dialogue1006005.en: It won't be that easy this time! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue1007004.ch: 本仙女实在是太久没有遇到这样的对手了……
drama_dialogue1007004.en: I haven't met an opponent like this for too long...

drama_dialogue1007005.ch: 等我把你冷冻起来，下回闭关结束，就吃你！
drama_dialogue1007005.en: I'll encase you in ice and make you a dish when I'm done with my cultivation!

drama_dialogue1007006.ch: （冰夷通体光芒大放，气势比之前还要强上十倍）
drama_dialogue1007006.en: (Bingyi unleashes a blinding light, her aura is 10 times stronger than before)

drama_dialogue1200001.ch: 是日，天朗气清，宗门众人在宗主的率领下登上飞舟。
drama_dialogue1200001.en: It's day, the weather is good, and all of the Sect board the Flying Canoe, led by the Sect Leader.

drama_dialogue1200002.ch: 只听一声巨响，飞舟缓缓升空，穿行于云层间，仿佛受到了天道的感召。
drama_dialogue1200002.en: There is a loud rumble, and the Flying Canoe rises slowly into the sky. It travels among the clouds, like it has been inspired by the Heavenly Path.

drama_dialogue1200011.ch: 片刻后，飞舟抵达了定岳方位，宗门众人使用携带的资源建立了崭新的宗门。
drama_dialogue1200011.en: A short while later, the Flying Canoe arrives at its destination. The Sect members use the resources they carried to establish a new Sect.

drama_dialogue1200021.ch: 在宗主的号令之下，全宗弟子集中力量，短短数日便将一艘雄伟壮观的飞舟建造而成。
drama_dialogue1200021.en: Under orders from the Sect Leader, all the disciples focus their efforts on building a majestic Flying Canoe in the short span of a few days.

drama_dialogue1220001.ch: 竹林中放置着一座巨大的食槽，食槽边上有三个被灵力封锁的巨坛。你凑近观望，发现坛子上分别写着“灵米”、“灵糠”、“灵泉”，似乎里面装着对应不同动物的饲料。
drama_dialogue1220001.en: A huge food trough has been placed in the bamboo forest. Beside the trough are three huge altars with energy sealed in them. You look closer and see that the altars have the words "Holy Rice," "Holy Bran," and "Holy Spring" written on them. They seem to contain feed for different animals.

drama_dialogue1220011.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵米”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的谷物从中喷洒而出，大片的山鸡从四面八方向食槽飞来！
drama_dialogue1220011.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Spirit Rice" on it. Grains thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of mountain chickens fly to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220021.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵米”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的谷物从中喷洒而出，大片的山鸡从四面八方向食槽飞来！
drama_dialogue1220021.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Spirit Rice" on it. Grains thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of mountain chickens fly to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220031.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵糠”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的谷壳从中喷洒而出，大片的山猪从四面八方向食槽冲来！
drama_dialogue1220031.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Spirit Bran" on it. Grain husks thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of mountain pigs rush to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220041.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵糠”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的谷壳从中喷洒而出，大片的山猪从四面八方向食槽冲来！
drama_dialogue1220041.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Spirit Bran" on it. Grain husks thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of mountain pigs rush to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220051.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Spirit Bran" on it. Grain husks thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of mountain pigs rush to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220061.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵泉”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的露水从中喷洒而出，大片的竹妖从四面八方向食槽奔来！
drama_dialogue1220061.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Holy Spring" on it. Water thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of Bambuki rush to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220071.ch: 你催动灵力，打开了贴着“灵泉”字样的坛子，随着一股灵气浓郁的露水从中喷洒而出，大片的竹妖从四面八方向食槽奔来！
drama_dialogue1220071.en: You circulate your energy and open the altar with "Holy Spring" on it. Water thick with Qi burst out of it, and a large number of Bambuki rush to the trough from all over!

drama_dialogue1220101.ch: 眼前是一个长满灵果的树，树上结满了<r>红里透绿</r>的灵果。
drama_dialogue1220101.en: In front of you is a tree full of Spiritual Fruit that are <r>Mythic and Uncommon</r> Spiritual Fruit.

drama_dialogue1220111.ch: 你摘得满满一筐灵果，用宗门发下的符咒将其运了回去。就在这时，一大群灵长类动物飞身而来，将你团团围住。
drama_dialogue1220111.en: You pick a full basket of Spiritual Fruit, and use the sect charm to carry them back. At this moment, a large group of spirit-type animals rush at your and surround you.

drama_dialogue1220121.ch: 你摘得满满一筐灵果，用宗门发下的符咒将其运了回去。就在这时，一大群灵长类动物飞身而来，将你团团围住。
drama_dialogue1220121.en: You pick a full basket of Spiritual Fruit, and use the sect charm to carry them back. At this moment, a large group of spirit-type animals rush at your and surround you.

drama_dialogue1220131.ch: 你在树上狠狠砍了一下，无数灵果掉落而下，装满了一筐，你祭出符咒，将筐运回了宗门。就在这时，你发现一大群植物正怨毒地凝视着你。
drama_dialogue1220131.en: You chop hard at the tree and countless Spiritual Fruit fall from the tree, filling a basket. You use a charm to carry them back to the sect. At this moment, you discover a large group of plants staring at you in resentment.

drama_dialogue1220401.ch: 面前的大锅热气扑面，四周似乎有着几坛调料，要如何操作呢……
drama_dialogue1220401.en: The hot pot in front of me seems to be surrounded by several jars of spices. How does it work...?

drama_dialogue1220411.ch: 正在你添加调料之际，一群妖物循着香气跑了过来，显然想要优先尝一尝汤品的咸淡。
drama_dialogue1220411.en: While you are adding seasonings, a group of monsters run over, drawn by the aroma. They seem to want first dibs on testing the saltiness of the soup.

drama_dialogue1220421.ch: 你舀起一勺饴蜜倒入锅中，周围十分安静，无事发生。
drama_dialogue1220421.en: You scoop up a spoonful of syrupy honey and pour it into the pot. Nothing happens.

drama_dialogue1220431.en: While you are adding seasonings, a group of monsters run over, drawn by the aroma. They seem to want first dibs on testing the saltiness of the soup.

drama_dialogue1220481.en: You toss a piece of ginger and pepper into the pot. Nothing happens.

drama_dialogue1230001.ch: 宗门中的任务大厅会在每个月发布新的任务。
drama_dialogue1230001.en: The Mission Hall in the sect will have new missions every month.

drama_dialogue1230002.ch: 长老及以上职位者除了能够领取任务外，还能依据堂口划分，给弟子分配任务，未接到任务的弟子则会根据自己的需要主动接取任务。
drama_dialogue1230002.en: Elders and higher positions can claim and also assign missions to disciples depending on the branch division. Disciples who have not received missions can take the initiative to claim missions according to their needs.

drama_dialogue1230003.ch: 完成宗门任务是宗门发展壮大的重要途径，千里之行始于足下，宗门若想长久，还请不要轻视这一点一滴的积累。
drama_dialogue1230003.en: The completion of sect missions is an important way to develop and grow the sect. A journey of a thousand miles starts with a single step. If the sect wishes to flourish, small steps should not be overlooked.

drama_dialogue1230011.ch: 八荒山海中宗门资源十分匮乏，因此各大宗门间必须通过残酷的竞争来争夺资源的获取权。
drama_dialogue1230011.en: Resources available to the sects in the world are scarce, so each sect must compete for the right to obtain resources through fierce competition.

drama_dialogue1230012.ch: 你可以在任务大厅领取掠夺任务来一次性获得资源，若想长久稳定地增加资源产量，则必须在议事大厅中发起并成功占领区域内的资源点。
drama_dialogue1230012.en: You can claim looting missions in the Mission Hall to obtain resources. If you want to increase resource production at a steady place over time, you must start and successfully occupy resource points in the territory area in the Council Hall.

drama_dialogue1230013.ch: 无论如何行事，此类行为都有可能招致其他宗门的仇恨，在行事前可务必要慎重考虑。
drama_dialogue1230013.en: Regardless of how you act, these actions may incur the wrath of other sects, so be sure to think carefully before you act.

drama_dialogue1230021.ch: 当宗门的人数和名誉达到一定要求后，就可以在宗门大厅内消耗灵石扩张宗门领地。
drama_dialogue1230021.en: When the sect population and prestige meets certain requirements, you can expand your sect territory by using Spirit Stones in the Sect Hall.

drama_dialogue1230022.ch: 领地扩张不仅是宗门强盛的象征，更会带来许多实际利益，但同时也意味着维持宗门的消耗增加，如何取舍还要看宗主的决定。
drama_dialogue1230022.en: Territory expansion is not just a symbol of the sect's strength. It also brings many practical benefits. However, it also means the cost of maintaining the sect increases, so the choice to expand depends on the Sect Leader.

drama_dialogue1230031.ch: 在宗门中达到一定职位后，便可获得权限前往议事大厅调配弟子。
drama_dialogue1230031.en: After reaching a certain position in the sect, you are granted access to the Council Hall to deploy disciples.

drama_dialogue1230032.ch: 通过浏览宗门成员、查看弟子，长老以上的宗门高层可以分配弟子的职级与堂口。
drama_dialogue1230032.en: Elders and higher positions can allocate disciples to ranks and divisions through browsing the sect members and viewing disciples.

drama_dialogue1230041.ch: 通过完成宗门任务，每个宗门成员都可以为发展宗门献出自己的力量、提高宗门的属性。
drama_dialogue1230041.en: By completing sect missions, each sect member can contribute their own strength to the development of the sect and increase sect attributes.

drama_dialogue1230042.ch: 宗门也会在获得属性增加的同时，提升完成任务弟子的宗门贡献，实现个人与集体的双赢。
drama_dialogue1230042.en: The sect receives an increase in attributes and also increase the sect contribution of disciples who complete missions, reaching a win-win situation for both the group and the individual.

drama_dialogue1230051.ch: 首先，弟子需要通过漫长的宗门晋升，成为大长老，接着，要达成晋升宗主的条件，走到这一步已算尽了人事。
drama_dialogue1230051.en: First, the disciple has to undergo a long sect promotion process to become a Grand Elder. Then, they have to meet the requirements to be promoted to Sect Leader. It is a grand endeavor to have come so far.

drama_dialogue1230052.ch: 之后，宗门传承便会觉醒并观察该大长老一段时间，如果宗门传承对此人满意，便会择机出现并考验此人，这一步乃看天意。
drama_dialogue1230052.en: Later, the Sect Tradition will be awakened to observe the Grand Elder for a period of time, and if the Sect Tradition is satisfied with the person, it will choose to appear and test them. This step is up to the will of the gods.

drama_dialogue1230053.ch: 最终，此人需通过宗门传承的试炼，一旦通过，便可晋升宗主，登临宗门巅峰。
drama_dialogue1230053.en: Last, the person will have to pass the trial of the Sect Tradition. The person is promoted to Sect Leader if they pass, and reach the highest position within the sect.

drama_dialogue1230061.ch: 首先，只有下个区域没有上宗，即本部为宗门总部的情况，才能发起宗门迁移。
drama_dialogue1230061.en: First, the sect relocation can only happen if the next area has no higher-ranked sect, where the headquarters are the sect headquarters.

drama_dialogue1230062.ch: 宗门迁移需要宗主前往议事大厅进行发起，经历建造飞舟、领取定岳旗选择目标地点、进行搬迁三个步骤，最终将宗门搬迁至下个区域。
drama_dialogue1230062.en: A sect relocation must be started by a Sect Leader in the Council Hall. Three steps must be followed: Building a Flying Canoe, obtaining a Relocation Flag and selecting a target location, and finally relocating the sect to the area.

drama_dialogue1230071.ch: 不同职位之人在宗门中有着不同方式获取贡献，身为弟子，只要领取宗门任务并顺利完成，即可得到贡献。
drama_dialogue1230071.en: Different positions in the sect have different ways of obtaining contributions. As a disciple, contributions can only be obtained from claiming sect missions and completing them successfully.

drama_dialogue1230072.ch: 而成为长老后，需要将自己所属堂口的任务分配给下属弟子，以此获得贡献。
drama_dialogue1230072.en: After becoming an Elder, you have to assign the missions of your own division to your subordinate disciples to obtain contributions.

drama_dialogue1230073.ch: 若是能做到大长老之高位，则需分配所属各个堂口的长老、弟子，使得各堂口协调运转，高效完成任务。
drama_dialogue1230073.en: If you reach the position of Grand Elder, you need to assign the Elders and disciples to the various divisions you belong to so that each division can work together and complete missions efficiently.

drama_dialogue1230074.ch: 总之，在其位谋其政，只要完成对应身份的职责，宗门便必然不会亏待于你。
drama_dialogue1230074.en: In short, the position is embroiled in politics, and the sect will treat you well if you fulfill the duties of your position.

drama_dialogue1230081.ch: 宗主前往议事大厅内，可以在宗门领地的管理中对其他宗门发起宣战，一经宣战，下个月本宗就将进攻目标宗门。
drama_dialogue1230081.en: The Sect Leader can go to the Council Hall and declare war against another sect in the management of the sect territory. Once war is declared, the sect will attack the target sect the following month.

drama_dialogue1230091.ch: 宗门战略将会改变宗门的运转方式和宗门众人的行为策略，恰当地应用与改变宗门战略将会使宗门的发展更加顺畅。
drama_dialogue1230091.en: Sect strategy changes the way the sect operates and the behavior of the sect members. Applying and changing strategies in the right way will smoothen the development of the sect.

drama_dialogue1230101.ch: 混沌初开，道生阴阳，从八荒山海诞生之日起，道便始终存在，只是其过于缥缈，常人难以企及。
drama_dialogue1230101.en: Chaos began, and birthed Yin and Yang. From the birth of the world exists the Tao, but it is too unfathomable for ordinary people to reach.

drama_dialogue1230102.ch: 只有极个别天骄之人，或悟性极佳天资绝世、或历经奇缘大有际遇，在各种条件下领悟了一种道，从而凝结道种，化为道心。
drama_dialogue1230102.en: Only a few people with heaven-worthy greatness, insightful enlightenment, or through a great encounter of miraculous fate, under various conditions, comprehended a Tao, and thus condensed a Taoist Seed that grows into Taoist Mind.

drama_dialogue1230103.ch: 道心者，便是天骄之人对大道的信念，是其自我对修真问道的思想精髓，有了道心，人在突破时便可逆天改命，一举飞跃。
drama_dialogue1230103.en: Taoist Mind is the belief of the person in the Tao, and the essence of their thoughts cultivate the Tao. With the Taoist Mind, the person can rewrite destiny during breakthrough, and bound to greater heights.

drama_dialogue1230111.ch: 宗门主修功法是宗门在一定时期内鼓励全宗弟子研习修炼的功法类型，自然而然它将成为全宗的主流功法类型。
drama_dialogue1230111.en: The main sect martial arts is a type of martial arts that the sect encourages the disciples to study and cultivate within a certain period of time. It naturally becomes the main martial arts type of the sect.

drama_dialogue1230112.ch: 宗主可以在藏经阁内选择宗门主修功法，该功法一旦改变，会在宗门在下一次置换功法时生效，使藏经阁内出现改变后类型的功法。
drama_dialogue1230112.en: The Sect Leader can select the main martial arts in the Manual Library. Once the martial arts is changed, it will take effect when the sect next replaces the martial art, and the Manual Library will display the changed martial art.

drama_dialogue1230113.ch: 若想要获得本宗目前没有的功法类型，则需要发动对其他宗门的灭宗战，通过抹灭其他宗门来获取对方所拥有的功法类型。
drama_dialogue1230113.en: If you want to obtain a martial art the sect does not currently own, you will need to stat a sect annihilation war against another clan to wipe them out and obtain the martial arts they own.

drama_dialogue1230121.ch: 在宗门的聚宝仙楼中，可以换取到宗门对应资质的灵果。
drama_dialogue1230121.en: You can exchange the corresponding sect resources for Spiritual Fruit in the sect's Treasure Pavilion.

drama_dialogue1230122.ch: 如果想要获得宗门没有的灵果，则需要借助神兽的奇妙能力，将不想要的灵果给予神兽化灵，神兽便能凝结出你所需求的指定资质灵果。
drama_dialogue1230122.en: If you want to obtain a Spiritual Fruit the sect does not own, you will need to use the magnificent powers of the Guardian. Give unwanted Spiritual Fruit to the Guardian to transform it, and the Guardian can form the specific Spiritual Fruit you need.

drama_dialogue1230131.ch: 若要领悟宗门绝学，只需在修为抵达境界后期瓶颈准备突破时，前往宗门内的灵阁中进行突破即可。
drama_dialogue1230131.en: If you want to comprehend the Sect's ultimate teachings, you will need to go to the Spirit Pavilion to Breakthrough when your cultivation has reached Realm Bottleneck and you are ready to Breakthrough.

drama_dialogue1230141.ch: 聚宝仙楼是宗门中放置宝贝的地方，弟子使用宗门贡献便可在此换得修行所需的物品。
drama_dialogue1230141.en: The Treasure Pavilion is where the Sect places all its treasures. Disciples can use Sect Contribution to exchange for items they need for cultivation.

drama_dialogue1230142.ch: 每过一定时间，聚宝仙楼便会消耗宗门的资源进行物品置换，所消耗的资源越多，其换来的物品便会越好。
drama_dialogue1230142.en: After a certain period of time, the Treasure Pavilion will use up Sect resources to exchange items, and the more resources used, the better the items exchanged.

drama_dialogue1230151.ch: 拥有极高天资或奇佳造化等之人是为天骄。
drama_dialogue1230151.en: Those with very great talents or extraordinary luck are called the Heaven-chosen.

drama_dialogue1230152.ch: 天骄拥有道心，对天道自有其独特的理解与追求，在其突破境界时可领悟逆天改命，乃人中龙凤也。
drama_dialogue1230152.en: The Heaven-chosen have their own understanding and pursuit of the Heavenly Tao, and when they Breakthrough Realms, they can gain insight that would Rewrite Destiny. They are giants among men.

drama_dialogue1230161.ch: 在宗门的任务大厅中，可以接取到掠夺资源的任务，执行该任务便能从他人处掠夺资源，但此举有相应的代价，一定要三思而行。
drama_dialogue1230161.en: In the Mission Hall of the Sect, you can accept missions like looting resources where you loot resources from others, but there is a corresponding price to pay for this action so think twice before you do it.

drama_dialogue1230171.ch: 宗主可以议事大厅的宗门战略中，向本区域的其他宗门进行宣战，宣战需要消耗灵石资源，并且会降低宗门名誉，以及宗主的声望。
drama_dialogue1230171.en: The Sect Leader can declare war on other Sects in the area in the Council Hall. Declaring war was a high resource cost, and will decrease the Sect's Prestige as well as Reputation.

drama_dialogue1230181.ch: 向其他宗门发动宗门战，并将其占领为分舵，即可获得其宗门的所有主修功法，获得之后可在本宗的藏经阁中更改主修功法，更改后将在下次刷新功法时生效。
drama_dialogue1230181.en: If you start a Sect battle with another Sect, occupy them, and make them a Branch, you obtain all the Main Martial Arts. After obtaining them, you can change the Main Martial Arts in your Sect's Manual Library, and the change takes effect the next time the Martial Arts are refreshed.

drama_dialogue1230191.ch: 持道心者，在凝种值达到上限后，便会衍化出道种。
drama_dialogue1230191.en: Those with the Tao Mind will develop a Wayborne Seed when their Seed Condensation reaches the upper limit.

drama_dialogue1230192.ch: 修仙者可将心中的道种授于他人，获得了道种的修仙者便会成为人杰。
drama_dialogue1230192.en: The Cultivator can grant the Taoist Seed to others, and the Cultivator who receives the Taoist Seed will become an Illustrious One.

drama_dialogue1230193.ch: 当人杰心中的道种蜕变为道心后，修仙者便可成为天骄。
drama_dialogue1230193.en: When the Taoist Seed in an Illustrious One turns into a Taoist Mind and the Cultivator can become a Heaven-chosen.

drama_dialogue1300001.ch: 你接到弟子后没走多远，前面竟出现两只妖怪横在路上等候，它们正盯着你身后的新人弟子。你带着的弟子都不会道法，此情此状不由让他们十分惊恐。
drama_dialogue1300001.en: You did not walk far after receiving your disciples when two monsters appear on the road, waiting. They stare at the new disciples behind you. The disciples are not versed in the Tao and this situation is terrifying to them.

drama_dialogue1300002.ch: 你出手攻击大妖，没想到小妖就逃了……
drama_dialogue1300002.en: You attack the big monster, but the small one escapes...

drama_dialogue1300003.ch: 你攻击小妖，没想到大妖竟然会逃走！
drama_dialogue1300003.en: You attack the small monster, but the big one gets away!

drama_dialogue1300004.ch: 你攻击小妖，小妖本来想逃，但是大妖舍命保护，小妖竟然回过头来合力夹攻你……
drama_dialogue1300004.en: You attack the small monster and it tries to escape, but the big monster sacrifices its life to protect it. The small monster comes back to join forces, and they attack you from both sides...

drama_dialogue1300020.ch: 你将这些朝气蓬勃的弟子接走，准备前往宗门。可是途中遇见一棵巨大的果树，上面一个个都是晶莹的果实。你带的新人都极盼吃一点解渴充饥，但你却有点怀疑上面你果实会不会有毒……
drama_dialogue1300020.en: You pick up this group of energetic disciples and travel to the Sect. However, on your way there, you encounter a huge fruit tree with sparkling and translucent fruit. The newcomers you are leading are eager to quench their thirst and hunger but you are a little suspicious that the fruit above you may be poisonous...

drama_dialogue1300021.ch: 你和大家一起进食了，片刻之后浑身清凉，感觉无比舒服
drama_dialogue1300021.en: You eat with everyone else and after a while, your body cools and you feel incredibly comfortable.

drama_dialogue1300022.ch: 你吃下果实，没想到果实当真有毒，大家一起昏睡，直到十天后才醒来
drama_dialogue1300022.en: You eat the fruit, and it really is poisonous. Everyone falls unconscious and only wake up ten days later.

drama_dialogue1300023.ch: 你没允许大家进食果子，反而带着这些新进门人急急前往宗门。可他们因为太饿，有部分竟然倒下了，你急忙运动真力施展术法将他们救醒。
drama_dialogue1300023.en: You don't allow anyone to eat the fruit, but hurry the newcomers to the Sect instead. However, some of them collapse due to hunger. You hurriedly use your true power to cast a spell and wake them up.

drama_dialogue1300024.ch: 你没允许大家进食果子，你跟他们赶紧前往，所幸一路无事。
drama_dialogue1300024.en: You don't allow anyone to eat the fruit. You hurry them along and fortunately, the journey is uneventful.

drama_dialogue1300040.ch: 你正在进行长老交代的采草任务，忽然一只怪模怪样的大鸟从天而降，将你手上双桂草叼去大把……
drama_dialogue1300040.en: You are carrying out a mission given by the Elder to pick herbs when an odd monster with odd eyes, a huge bird, drops from the sky, grabbing a big bunch of the Osmanthus from your hands with its mouth...

drama_dialogue1300041.ch: 你伸手急抓，一下子从怪鸟嘴中抢回一些双桂草
drama_dialogue1300041.en: You reach out to snatch back some of the Osmanthus from the monster bird's beak.

drama_dialogue1300042.ch: 你急步追赶怪鸟，竟发现了怪鸟巢穴，还在里面找到大量双桂草。
drama_dialogue1300042.en: You rush to catch up with the Monster Bird, and find its nest. You also find a lot of Osmanthus inside.

drama_dialogue1300043.ch: 你发现怪鸟巢穴及双桂草，可是怪鸟为了保护巢穴竟不要命的向你疾扑而来与你大战一场。
drama_dialogue1300043.en: You find the nest of the monster bird and the Osmanthus, but the monster bird is desperate to protect the nest. It swoops down and fights you.

drama_dialogue1300044.ch: 你击退怪鸟之后，从鸟巢中获得了足量的双桂草。
drama_dialogue1300044.en: You get a good amount of Osmanthus from the nest after you defeat the monster bird.

drama_dialogue1300060.ch: 你面前走来一人，他看了看你，摸出十棵双桂草，声称要将之卖給你，并要价3000灵石……
drama_dialogue1300060.en: A man comes in front of you. He looks at you, shows you ten Osmanthus bundles, and asks for 3,000 Spirit Stones for them...

drama_dialogue1300061.ch: 你将灵石交给他之后，这人果然从怀中摸出一大扎双桂草交给你。
drama_dialogue1300061.en: You hand the man Spirit Stones and he really takes out a large bundle of Osmanthus.

drama_dialogue1300062.ch: 他收了你的灵石，竟然夹腿就跑……
drama_dialogue1300062.en: He takes your Spirit Stones but runs away...

drama_dialogue1300063.ch: 你揍了这个骗子一顿，将骗走的灵石全部追了回来。
drama_dialogue1300063.en: You beat up the liar and recover all the Spirit Stone he cheated you of.

drama_dialogue1300064.ch: 无聊骗子，追之徒然浪费时间……
drama_dialogue1300064.en: What a boring liar. Chasing him is a waste of time...

drama_dialogue1300065.ch: 这人笑了笑，就这样走了。
drama_dialogue1300065.en: The person laughs and walks away just like that.

drama_dialogue1300066.ch: 这个人笑了笑，临走前还往你手中塞了3个双桂草，这才慢慢离开了。
drama_dialogue1300066.en: The person smiles, and before he leaves, he stuffs 3 Osmanthus bundles in your hands, then leaves slowly.

drama_dialogue1300080.ch: 你经过一棵树，恰好一颗果子朝你落下，这果子颇为古怪，你要……
drama_dialogue1300080.en: You pass by a tree and a fruit happens to fall towards you. This fruit is quite odd. You want...

drama_dialogue1300081.ch: 你接住了果子，果子瞬间化为一滩毒液，腐蚀你手掌，让你受了轻伤。
drama_dialogue1300081.en: You catch the fruit, and the it instantly turns into a puddle of poisonous liquid that corrodes your palm, leaving you with a minor injury.

drama_dialogue1300082.ch: 你接住了果子，果子随即化为轻烟钻入你的口鼻，你觉得浑身舒畅，经脉之间不断生出气力。
drama_dialogue1300082.en: You catch the fruit, and it then turns into a light smoke which goes into your mouth and nose. You feel comfortable, and your meridians keep producing power.

drama_dialogue1300083.ch: 果子落地随即溃烂冒出黑烟聚成一只妖兽。那只妖兽猛的向你扑来……
drama_dialogue1300083.en: The fruit falls to the ground and then breaks into black smoke that gathers into a monster. The monster lunges at you...

drama_dialogue1300084.ch: 果子落地，竟立即发芽生长，里面生出气筋，抽走了你身上浊气，让你生出气力。
drama_dialogue1300084.en: The fruit falls to the ground and immediately sprouted and grew. Qi tendons grew inside, drawing away the turbid Qi from your body and allowing you to produce Qi.

drama_dialogue1300085.ch: 果子落地，竟然生根发芽，结出小果，那赫然就是一枚六品道心果！
drama_dialogue1300085.en: The fruit falls to the ground and unexpectedly sprouts roots and grows small fruits that are clearly G6 Skill Fruit.

drama_dialogue1300086.ch: 你消灭妖物，并从其遗骸之中发现几枚可堪使用的材料。
drama_dialogue1300086.en: You destroy the monster and find some usable materials in its remains.

drama_dialogue1300100.ch: 你前往指定地点，发现一个妖怪失足堕崖，只用一手攀住山壁。这妖怪一看就觉得穷凶极恶，但它却请你相救……
drama_dialogue1300100.en: You go to the specified place and find a monsters that has lost its footing and fallen off the cliff, and is only using one hand to hang to the mountain wall. This demon looks vicious at first glance, but it asks you to save it...

drama_dialogue1300101.ch: 你将妖怪拉上来，它却伸爪给抓伤了你，随后还奋起对你发起攻击。
drama_dialogue1300101.en: You pull the monster up, but it reaches out its claws to scratch you, and then rises up to attack you.

drama_dialogue1300102.ch: 你将妖怪拉上来，它果然奋起攻击你……
drama_dialogue1300102.en: You pull the monster up, and sure enough, it rises up to attack you...

drama_dialogue1300103.ch: 妖怪全身化去，只剩余一枚内丹……
drama_dialogue1300103.en: The monster's body melts away, leaving just one Orb...

drama_dialogue1300104.en: You kick the monster off the mountain.

drama_dialogue1300105.ch: 你要将妖怪踢下山去，岂它另外一手却抓住了你的脚，挣扎中的妖怪跌了下去，却留下了它手上的灵果在你脚上。
drama_dialogue1300105.en: You kick the monster down the mountain, but its other hand grabs your foot. The struggling monster falls but leaves the Spiritual Fruit in its hand on your foot.

drama_dialogue1300106.ch: 你击败妖怪，可没想它上来之际，竟然抓伤了你……
drama_dialogue1300106.en: You defeat the monster, but did not expect it to scratch you when it came up...

drama_dialogue1300120.ch: 你将宗门间的书信送达对方宗门。
drama_dialogue1300120.en: You send the inter-Sect letter to the other Sect.

drama_dialogue1300121.ch: 你在送信的途中，遇见敌人拦路，他要没收你的书信
drama_dialogue1300121.en: While delivering the letter, you meet an enemy blocking the way. He wants to confiscate your letter.

drama_dialogue1300122.ch: 这人败于你手，他怀中摸出三封劫来的书信，交到你手……
drama_dialogue1300122.en: This person loses to you. He takes out three letters he's robbed from people and hands them to you...

drama_dialogue1300123.ch: 此人败于你手，不过他竟然放出火焰烧毁你的书信……
drama_dialogue1300123.en: This person was defeated by you, but he sends out a flame to burn your letter...

drama_dialogue1300124.ch: 你耗尽精力摆脱此人之后安然将信件送到宗门……
drama_dialogue1300124.en: You use up all your Stamina to get rid of him and safely deliver the letters to the Sect...

drama_dialogue1300125.ch: 你闪身离开，顺利摆脱此人。
drama_dialogue1300125.en: You dash away and break away from the person without any problem.

drama_dialogue1300140.ch: 你送信途中，迷失在一处山中，你身重雾障，处在半梦半醒之间，周围还徘徊大量妖怪……
drama_dialogue1300140.en: While delivering the letter, you get lost on a mountain. You are in a foggy place, half asleep, half awake, and surrounded by a lot of monsters...

drama_dialogue1300141.en: You rush towards the monsters and fight them...

drama_dialogue1300142.ch: 你打开宝箱之后同时醒觉，终于又回到送信途中……
drama_dialogue1300142.en: You open the chest and wake up. Finally back on your way to deliver the letter...

drama_dialogue1300143.en: You rush to the demon and fight...

drama_dialogue1300144.ch: 你刚取胜，突然就跌落妖巢，一只巨兽爬了起来一把将你捏成齑粉。
drama_dialogue1300144.en: You suddenly fall down to the monster nest just as you win, and a giant beast climbs up and squeezes you to bits.

drama_dialogue1300145.ch: 你终于醒觉，同时惊出一身冷汗。
drama_dialogue1300145.en: You finally wake up, and break out in a cold sweat.

drama_dialogue1300146.ch: 不能受雾障所困，必须马上醒觉！
drama_dialogue1300146.en: You can't be trapped by the fog! You must wake up now!

drama_dialogue1300147.ch: 你抽出利锥猛扎大腿，让你惊出了一身冷汗……
drama_dialogue1300147.en: You pull out a sharp awl and stab your thigh, making you break out in a cold sweat...

drama_dialogue1300148.ch: 利锥扎落大腿，一阵剧痛让你惊醒过来……
drama_dialogue1300148.en: A sharp awl sticks into your thigh, and a sharp pain makes you wake up...

drama_dialogue1300149.ch: 一滴露水落在你额头，你感觉全身清凉，舒服无比，睁开眼来，还发现面前悬着灵果两枚
drama_dialogue1300149.en: A drop of dew falls on your forehead. You feel cool and comfortable beyond measure. You open your eyes and find two Spiritual Fruit hanging in front of you.

drama_dialogue1300150.ch: 你费尽精神让自己抽离梦境，醒来后全身虚脱，无法行动。一只小动物看你动弹不得，还乘机从你怀中叼了小东西若干。
drama_dialogue1300150.en: You struggle to pull yourself out of the dream world and wake up deflated and unable to move. A small animal sees that you could not move and takes the opportunity to carry a number of small things from your arms away in its mouth.

drama_dialogue1300160.ch: 你遇见一只药灵，他说自己背后贴了一张符纸很不舒服，想请你帮忙将之撕下，你打算……
drama_dialogue1300160.en: You meet a Mushroom Man who says he is uncomfortable with a talisman paper stuck to his back, and wants to ask you to help tear it off, you plan to...

drama_dialogue1300161.ch: 你将符纸撕下后，药灵十分感激，他将自己身上积攒的东西交送给你。
drama_dialogue1300161.en: You tear off the talisman paper and the Mushroom Man is very grateful. He will give you what he has accumulated.

drama_dialogue1300162.ch: 你撕下了药灵背后的符纸，里面生出一个孔洞，喷出激荡气息。药灵被气息所推就此飞走。那股气息同时冲入你体内，助你荡去身上污浊，你的修为亦因此有所增长。
drama_dialogue1300162.en: You tear off the talisman paper on the back of the Mushroom Man. A hole has appeared inside, spewing out Breath. The Mushroom Man is pushed by the Breath and flies away. The Breath rushes into your body helping you remove impurities.

drama_dialogue1300163.ch: 药灵勃然大怒，出手攻击你。
drama_dialogue1300163.en: The Mushroom Man is furious and attacks you.

drama_dialogue1300164.ch: 所幸它背后有符纸压制，实力受损，你击败它后，药灵仓促逃去，留下满地药材，其中还有几枚丹药。
drama_dialogue1300164.en: Fortunately, it is suppressed by the talisman paper on its back, and its strength was damaged. After you defeat it, the Mushroom Man flees hastily, leaving the ground full of herbs and even a few elixirs.

drama_dialogue1300165.ch: 药灵似乎被符纸压制，一下趴倒在地，随即化为灰烬，你发现尘埃之中还埋有几个药材。
drama_dialogue1300165.en: The Mushroom Man seems to be suppressed by the talisman paper and falls to the ground at once, then turns into ashes. You find some herbs buried in the dust.

drama_dialogue1300180.ch: 你看见一枚古怪种子自己钻入泥土，然后迅速发芽，你觉得十分古怪……
drama_dialogue1300180.en: You see an odd seed burrow itself into the soil and then quickly sprout, which you find very odd...

drama_dialogue1300181.ch: 你摘下枝叶，发现竟是药草。
drama_dialogue1300181.en: You pick the branch and find that it is actually a medicinal herb.

drama_dialogue1300182.ch: 你摘下枝叶，发现上面全是杂草……
drama_dialogue1300182.en: You pluck the branch and find that it is full of weeds...

drama_dialogue1300183.ch: 你将植物拔起，岂知竟拔出了一只妖怪来……
drama_dialogue1300183.en: You plucked up the plant, but you don't know that you've pulled out a monster...

drama_dialogue1300184.ch: 你一拔之下，竟然抽出了一只妖怪……
drama_dialogue1300184.en: You plucked it, but you pulled out a monster...

drama_dialogue1300185.ch: 莫非近来修为大进，乃至将此妖物打成了飞灰？
drama_dialogue1300185.en: Have you perhaps recently improved your cultivation, and beat even these demonic ones into dust?

drama_dialogue1300186.ch: 你消灭妖物，并从其遗骸之中发现几枚可堪使用的材料。
drama_dialogue1300186.en: You destroy the monster and find some usable materials in its remains.

drama_dialogue1300200.ch: 你前往巢穴的途中，地上突然开裂，升起一块怪石，横在路心。
drama_dialogue1300200.en: On your way to the nest, the ground suddenly cracked, rising a strange stone across the center of the road.

drama_dialogue1300201.ch: 你绕开之后继续前行，所幸无事发生。
drama_dialogue1300201.en: You go around and then continue on, but fortunately nothing happens.

drama_dialogue1300202.ch: 你绕开之后继续前行，可那块怪石竟然突然裂开，喷出岩浆，将你溅伤。
drama_dialogue1300202.en: After you go around and continue on, but the strange stone suddenly cracks, spewing lava, and damaging you with the splash.

drama_dialogue1300203.ch: 你才踏前一步，没想到石头炸裂，冲出一只石灵，气势汹汹的冲向你……
drama_dialogue1300203.en: You have just taken a step forward, but you don't expect the stone to explode and a stone Spirit rushes out, rushing at you aggressively...

drama_dialogue1300204.ch: 你才踏前一步，没想到石头裂开，陷落一穴，里面竟然就是妖怪巢穴！
drama_dialogue1300204.en: You have just taken a step forward when the stone unexpectedly cracks and you fall into a cave which is actually a monster's lair!

drama_dialogue1300205.ch: 石灵被你击败后，随即化为灰烬，你从地上的拾得一些物品。
drama_dialogue1300205.en: You defeat the stone spirit and it turns to ashes. You pick up some items from the ground.

drama_dialogue1300206.ch: 群妖被消灭后，你从地上的拾得一些物品。
drama_dialogue1300206.en: The group of monsters are destroyed and you pick up some items from the ground.

drama_dialogue1300220.ch: 你面前出现一个道人，他说可以偷偷杀死妖巢里面的妖怪，不过你要给他3000灵石，作为报酬……
drama_dialogue1300220.en: A Cultivator appears in front of you. He says he can secretly kill the sneaky one in the monster nest, but you have to give him 3,000 Spirit Stones as payment...

drama_dialogue1300221.ch: 道人取了你的灵石，没过多久竟然带来一个妖怪首级，说前方妖巢大怪已死。
drama_dialogue1300221.en: The Cultivator takes your Spirit Stones. Soon, he brings a monster head, and says the big monster of the nest ahead is dead.

drama_dialogue1300222.ch: 你刚到妖怪巢穴，发现里面妖怪已经散去，洞中空无一物。
drama_dialogue1300222.en: You arrive at the monster nest and find that the monsters inside have dispersed and the cave is empty.

drama_dialogue1300223.ch: 看起来道人有点不忿，但也不敢正面与你起冲突，他离开了。
drama_dialogue1300223.en: Looks like the Cultivator is a little indignant, but also doesn't dare to clash with you head-on. He leaves.

drama_dialogue1300224.ch: 道人不忿，还使用法宝对你进行攻击，你没料此人敢犯你虎威……
drama_dialogue1300224.en: The Cultivator is upset and also uses an Artifact to attack you. You did not expect this person to dare challenge your might...

drama_dialogue1300225.ch: 你将道人击败，他取出宝物对你苦苦求饶……
drama_dialogue1300225.en: You defeat the Cultivator. He takes out the Artifact and begs you bitterly for mercy...

drama_dialogue1300226.ch: 呵，宵小之徒，何必与他一般见识？
drama_dialogue1300226.en: Heh, a disciple of thieves! Why bother with him?

drama_dialogue1300240.ch: 你前往剿灭怪物的途中，误入一处装饰古怪的洞府，你准备……
drama_dialogue1300240.en: You go to eliminate the monster, and on your way there, you mistakenly enter a weirdly decorated cave. You prepare to...

drama_dialogue1300241.ch: 你进入之后发现里面竟是妖怪巢穴，周围的妖怪马上察觉你的存在并过来围攻你。
drama_dialogue1300241.en: You enter and find that it is actually a monster lair. The surrounding monsters immediately sense your presence and come to surround you.

drama_dialogue1300242.ch: 你进入之后，马上遭到群妖的围攻……
drama_dialogue1300242.en: You enter and find yourself immediately surrounded by a group of monsters...

drama_dialogue1300243.ch: 你才将群妖驱赶开去，立时就被一个阵法困住，还受了伤……
drama_dialogue1300243.en: You have just driven the group of monsters away when you are immediately trapped by an array and are injured...

drama_dialogue1300245.ch: 你离开之际，发现洞府之中浊气充斥，你沾染一丝，顿时呕出体内积聚污秽。
drama_dialogue1300245.en: You leave and find that the cave is filled with turbid Qi. You are slightly tainted and immediately vomit out the filth that built up in your body.

drama_dialogue1300246.ch: 你将群妖杀退，发现洞中颇有几件当前可堪使用的材料。
drama_dialogue1300246.en: You destroy the group of monsters and discover some useable materials in the cave.

drama_dialogue1300260.ch: 你前往剿灭怪物的途中，突然十分疲倦，你知道已遭妖怪暗算，于是马上提振真气，恢复精神，可接下来你要怎么办？
drama_dialogue1300260.en: You go to eliminate the monster, but on your way there, you are suddenly very tired. You know that the monster has been assassinated, so you boost the true Qi right away and recover energy. What do you want to do next?

drama_dialogue1300261.en: You turn and flee, and leave peacefully.

drama_dialogue1300262.ch: 你转身逃离，里面却扑出一只妖怪伸出利爪将你抓伤，所幸最后还是侥幸逃离。
drama_dialogue1300262.en: You try to escape, but the monster stretches out sharp claws to grab you, scratching and injuring you. Fortunately, you manage to escape in the wolds

drama_dialogue1300263.ch: 你周围立即出现大量妖怪围攻于你……
drama_dialogue1300263.en: A large number of monsters immediately appear and surround you...

drama_dialogue1300264.ch: 你周围出现大量妖怪，他们一窝蜂的朝你攻来……
drama_dialogue1300264.en: A large number of demons appear around you, and they swarm towards you...

drama_dialogue1300280.ch: 你察觉到一名外门弟子正在跟随你，你要……
drama_dialogue1300280.en: You sense an outer disciple following you. You will...

drama_dialogue1300281.ch: 你用道法将其困住，却发现只是长老派来送丹药给你的弟子。
drama_dialogue1300281.en: You trap him with your Tao only to find that it is a disciple sent by the elders to deliver elixirs to you.

drama_dialogue1300282.ch: 对手被你困住，实力大减，可他还是朝你出手。
drama_dialogue1300282.en: The opponent is trapped by you and his strength is greatly reduced, but he still strikes at you.

drama_dialogue1300283.ch: 你喝问之下，这人立时失措，马上对你出手。
drama_dialogue1300283.en: When you shout and ask, the person is immediately at a loss and strikes at you right away.

drama_dialogue1300284.ch: 你喝问之下，这人立时失措，马上对你出手。
drama_dialogue1300284.en: When you shout and ask, the person is immediately at a loss and strikes at you right away.

drama_dialogue1300285.ch: 你打败此人后，对他进行搜身，取走身上的宝物。
drama_dialogue1300285.en: After you defeat the person, you search him and take Treasures from him.

drama_dialogue1300286.ch: 你击败此人，识破其身份，果然便是宗门内奸。
drama_dialogue1300286.en: You defeat this person and find out his identity. They are indeed a traitor of the Sect.

drama_dialogue1300287.ch: 你击败此人，识破其身份，果然便是宗门内奸。
drama_dialogue1300287.en: You defeat this person and find out his identity. They are indeed a traitor of the Sect.

drama_dialogue1300300.ch: 你发现一名可疑弟子，你要……
drama_dialogue1300300.en: You discover a suspicious disciple. You will...

drama_dialogue1300301.ch: 你一路跟踪，去到一处荒僻地方，没想到另有二人埋伏，三人同时出手围攻于你。
drama_dialogue1300301.en: You follow them all the way to a place in the middle of nowhere. To your surprise, two people ambush you, and all three attack you at the same time.

drama_dialogue1300302.ch: 你一路跟踪，可对方并不是奸细。
drama_dialogue1300302.en: You follow them all the way but the person is not a spy.

drama_dialogue1300303.ch: 你上前套问，此人觉得行藏败露，对你出手……
drama_dialogue1300303.en: You go up to ask questions, and the person feels that their hideout has been exposed, so they attack you...

drama_dialogue1300304.ch: 你击败此人后，这家伙向你献宝求饶。而你则将其带回宗门处置。
drama_dialogue1300304.en: After you defeat this person, they offer you treasure and begs for mercy, and you take them back to the Sect to punish them.

drama_dialogue1300305.ch: 你上前套问却发现对方不是奸细。
drama_dialogue1300305.en: You go up to ask, and find that the person is not a spy.

drama_dialogue1300306.ch: 你击败之后发现对手果真便是奸细，如此以来总算不负长老所托。
drama_dialogue1300306.en: After defeating your opponent, you find out that they are really a spy, and so you live up to the Elder's expectations.

drama_dialogue1300320.ch: 你遇见犯规弟子，不过他表示一只妖怪导致他长久滞留，他定要杀死妖怪才愿意跟你回去。
drama_dialogue1300320.en: You meet the offending disciple. He says that a monster has caused him to stay for a long time, and he must kill the monster before he returns with you.

drama_dialogue1300321.ch: 这名弟子将妖怪的位置告诉你……
drama_dialogue1300321.en: The disciple tells you the monster's location...

drama_dialogue1300322.ch: 这名弟子将妖怪的位置告诉你……
drama_dialogue1300322.en: The disciple tells you the monster's location...

drama_dialogue1300323.ch: 这名弟子无奈之下跟随你回去……
drama_dialogue1300323.en: The disciple has no choice but to return with you...

drama_dialogue1300324.ch: 你击败了妖怪，在其身上颇有所获，而那名弟子亦信守承诺随你回归。
drama_dialogue1300324.en: You defeat the monster and find some stuff on it. The disciple keeps their promise and returns with you.

drama_dialogue1300325.ch: 你击败了妖怪，在其身上颇有所获，而那名弟子亦信守承诺随你回归。
drama_dialogue1300325.en: You defeat the monster and find some stuff on it. The disciple keeps their promise and returns with you.

drama_dialogue1300340.ch: 一名犯规弟子久闻你威名，竟然朝你走来，希望向你挑战……
drama_dialogue1300340.en: The offending disciple has heard of you and actually walks to you hoping to challenge you...

drama_dialogue1300341.ch: 你打败了他，可他竟然不服，还要再战一场，他打算请出他善于分身化形的大哥“钧天龙神”与你一战……
drama_dialogue1300341.en: You defeat him but he refuses to admit his loss and wants another fight. He plans to invite his elder brother "Greatsky Dragon God" to fight with you...

drama_dialogue1300342.ch: “钧天龙神”出现在你面前，它，是一条青蛇……
drama_dialogue1300342.en: "Greatsky Dragon God" appears in front of you. It's a blue-green serpent...

drama_dialogue1300343.ch: “钧天龙神”败于你手，蠕动着逃跑了，它表示：这事还没完。而这名犯规弟子果然心悦诚服，随你回归。
drama_dialogue1300343.en: “Greatsky Dragon God” is defeated by you and it flees with a wriggle. It says: This is not over. The offender disciple submits willingly and returns with you.

drama_dialogue1300344.ch: 这小子修为不高，但身法却一等一的好，他一去如风，眨眼就消失了。
drama_dialogue1300344.en: This child's cultivation is not high but they possess excellent motion skills. He moves like the wind and disappears in the blink of an eye.

drama_dialogue1300345.ch: 他心悦诚服的与你回去。
drama_dialogue1300345.en: He is satisfied and returns with you.

drama_dialogue1300346.ch: 这人宗门身法十分厉害，竟一下子在你面前消失了……
drama_dialogue1300346.en: This person's Sect motion skills are very powerful and he actually disappears from right in front of you.

drama_dialogue1300360.ch: 一名弟子遭到妖怪围攻，倒地不起，周围还重重围住许多妖怪。眼看不敌，你要……
drama_dialogue1300360.en: A disciple is surrounded by monsters and has fallen but cannot get up, still heavily surrounded by monsters. Seeing that you are no match for them, you...

drama_dialogue1300361.en: You rush toward the group of monsters...

drama_dialogue1300362.ch: 你挺身而出，显出凛凛威风，这些妖怪受到震慑，竟然逃去不少……
drama_dialogue1300362.en: You step forward and exude great authority. The monsters are deterred and quite a large number actually flee...

drama_dialogue1300363.en: You succeed in rescuing the disciple.

drama_dialogue1300364.ch: 妖怪发现你的偷偷营救这名弟子，竟然群起而攻。
drama_dialogue1300364.en: The monsters discover you trying to sneakily rescue the disciple and actually attack in a group.

drama_dialogue1300365.ch: 你击退妖怪，你救下了这名弟子。
drama_dialogue1300365.en: You drive away the monster and save this disciple.

drama_dialogue1300366.ch: 你击退妖怪，你救下了这名弟子。
drama_dialogue1300366.en: You drive away the monster and save this disciple.

drama_dialogue1300367.ch: 你击退妖怪，你救下了这名弟子。
drama_dialogue1300367.en: You drive away the monster and save this disciple.

drama_dialogue1300380.ch: 你找到了这名弟子，他正在坐功，但神情十分难过，看来已经走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue1300380.en: You find this disciple and he is sitting in meditation but he looks very sad. It seems he has misguidedly focused on hallucinations that arise during meditation, resulting in Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue1300381.ch: 那个人已经慢慢变好，他感激为之护法，赠你薄礼。
drama_dialogue1300381.en: The person is slowly getting better. He thanks you for the protection and gives you a small gift.

drama_dialogue1300382.ch: 你协助他稳定内息，没想到自己体内气血也被他扰乱，费了九牛二虎之力这才救下了他。
drama_dialogue1300382.en: You help him stabilize his inner breath. You are surprised to find that your internal Qi and blood are disturbed by him, and it takes tremendous strength to save him.

drama_dialogue1300383.ch: 他越来越难受，最后失去理智，竟暴起出手攻向你！
drama_dialogue1300383.en: He finds it more and more unbearable, until he loses his mind in the end and attacks you.

drama_dialogue1300384.ch: 你打败他后，终于恢复正常。
drama_dialogue1300384.en: You defeat him and he finally returns to normal.

drama_dialogue1300385.ch: 他样子越来越难看，一跃而起与你战斗。
drama_dialogue1300385.en: He looks worse and worse, and he leaps up to fight with you.

drama_dialogue1300386.ch: 打败他后后终于复原，而且他还吐出一颗凝珠。
drama_dialogue1300386.en: He recovers after you defeat him, and he spits out a pearl.

drama_dialogue1300400.ch: 你找到失陷的弟子，他正被对手挟持，同门危在旦夕，你要……
drama_dialogue1300400.en: You find the lost disciple. He is being held hostage by his opponent and his fellow disciples are in danger. You will...

drama_dialogue1300401.ch: 对方拿到灵石，将人放了。
drama_dialogue1300401.en: The opponent receives the Spirit Stones and releases the hostage.

drama_dialogue1300402.ch: 对方拿到了灵石，却还要在再加。
drama_dialogue1300402.en: The opponent receives the Spirit Stones but want more.

drama_dialogue1300403.ch: 对方拿到灵石，将人放了。
drama_dialogue1300403.en: The opponent receives the Spirit Stones and releases the hostage.

drama_dialogue1300404.ch: 哼，得寸进尺！难道我便奈何你不得？！
drama_dialogue1300404.en: Hmph! Give him an inch, and he'll want a mile! Must I deal with you?!

drama_dialogue1300405.ch: 你将此人击败，救回了这名弟子。
drama_dialogue1300405.en: You defeat the person and save the disciple.

drama_dialogue1300420.ch: 你找到了受伤的弟子，他躺在地上奄奄一息，不过看来都是新伤，还能救回，只不过这一切似乎颇有蹊跷……
drama_dialogue1300420.en: You find the injured disciple. He is lying on the ground dying, but it looks like new wounds and he can be saved. However, it all seems a little fishy...

drama_dialogue1300421.ch: 你急忙上前救助弟子，旁边一人突然扑出袭击。
drama_dialogue1300421.en: You hurry forward to save the disciple, and someone suddenly ambushes you from the side.

drama_dialogue1300422.ch: 此人败于你手，立即捧出自己的宝物递到你面前死命求饶。
drama_dialogue1300422.en: You defeat the person and they immediately take out their artifact and offer it to you, begging for mercy.

drama_dialogue1300423.ch: 你急忙上前救助弟子，结果旁边突然闪出一人。
drama_dialogue1300423.en: You hurry forward to save the disciple, and a person appears suddenly beside you.

drama_dialogue1300424.ch: 偷袭者乘虚而入，出手打伤了你，这才从容遁去。
drama_dialogue1300424.en: The attacker takes advantage of the situation and wounds you,then disappears.

drama_dialogue1300425.ch: 你专心查看附近，揪出了一个暗中窥伺之人，他则对你苦苦求饶……
drama_dialogue1300425.en: You focus and check your surroundings, and spot a person snooping in the dark. He begs you for mercy...

drama_dialogue1300426.ch: 你饶过此人，他献出一些丹药这才离开
drama_dialogue1300426.en: You spare him, and he offers you some elixirs before leaving.

drama_dialogue1300427.ch: 伤我同门，这可饶你不得！
drama_dialogue1300427.en: You hurt my fellow disciple! I cannot forgive you!

drama_dialogue1300429.ch: 弟子伤势渐重，必须尽快救治。就在此时，一人突然闪出，对你发射暗器法宝，受了轻伤。
drama_dialogue1300429.en: The disciple's injuries are getting serious and must be treated soon. Just then, a person suddenly appears and fires an assassination artifact at you. You suffer light injuries.

drama_dialogue1300440.ch: 你找到失踪弟子时，他被妖怪使法迷住，已浑浑噩噩，而妖怪一看见你就即刻朝你扑来……
drama_dialogue1300440.en: When you find the missing disciple, he is charmed by the monster and is muddled. The monster lunges at you as soon as it sees you.

drama_dialogue1300441.ch: 你打败妖怪后，周围忽然出现了道心果与灵石分放左右，你打算……
drama_dialogue1300441.en: You defeat the monster and Skill Fruit and Spirit Stones suddenly appear around you, left and right. You plan to...

drama_dialogue1300442.ch: 哦？说是心想事成倒不为过了。
drama_dialogue1300442.en: Oh? Is this not having one's wishes come true?

drama_dialogue1300443.ch: 那只被你击败倒地的妖怪乘你权衡之际竟爬了起来再次扑向你……
drama_dialogue1300443.en: The defeated monster that fell to the ground takes advantage of your imbalance to rise up and pounce at you again...

drama_dialogue1300444.ch: 你拿到了你想要的东西，并救回了失踪弟子。
drama_dialogue1300444.en: You take the thing you want and save the missing disciple.

drama_dialogue1300445.ch: 你拿到了你想要的东西，并救回了失踪弟子。
drama_dialogue1300445.en: You take the thing you want and save the missing disciple.

drama_dialogue1300446.ch: 你击败倒地的妖怪，并救回了弟子。
drama_dialogue1300446.en: You bring the monster to its knees and save the disciple.

drama_dialogue1300460.ch: 你找到了一名勘察洞天的弟子，但他竟希望留在洞天不回宗门……
drama_dialogue1300460.en: You find a disciple surveying the cave, but he wants to stay in the cave and not return to the Sect...

drama_dialogue1300461.ch: 你正要将此人带走，可他心生不服，竟然奋起反击……
drama_dialogue1300461.en: You want to take this person away but he is not convinced and actually fights back...

drama_dialogue1300462.ch: 此人根本不愿离开，一言不合之下，竟对你出手。
drama_dialogue1300462.en: This person simply does not want to leave. He disagrees and actually attacks you.

drama_dialogue1300463.ch: 你劝说之下，这名弟子终于肯回归宗门。
drama_dialogue1300463.en: You persuade the disciple and he is finally willing to return to the Sect.

drama_dialogue1300464.ch: 你好言相劝，但他不甚愿意回归宗门。拖拉纠缠之下，抓落你身上部分琐碎物品。
drama_dialogue1300464.en: You talk nicely, but he is not very willing to return to the Sect. You drag him along and nag, and he grabs some trivial items from you.

drama_dialogue1300465.ch: 你将之击败，然后把他带回了宗门。
drama_dialogue1300465.en: You defeat him and bring him back to the Sect.

drama_dialogue1300466.ch: 你将之击败，然后把他带回了宗门。
drama_dialogue1300466.en: You defeat him and bring him back to the Sect.

drama_dialogue1300480.ch: 山贼知道你的介入，将会大大不利于山贼营地。他们的头领献上宝物，希望你能饶他一命
drama_dialogue1300480.en: The bandits know that your intervention will be ruinous to their camp. Their leader offers his artifact in the hope that you will spare his life.

drama_dialogue1300481.en: Hmph, I will spare your life this time!

drama_dialogue1300482.ch: 这个山贼首领突然暴起，向你疾扑而来……
drama_dialogue1300482.en: The leader of the mountain bandits suddenly rises up and lunges at you...

drama_dialogue1300483.ch: 你已将这些贼人打败，可匪首竟并不降服……
drama_dialogue1300483.en: You have already defeated these bandits but their leader would rather die than surrender...

drama_dialogue1300484.en: I will spare you this time!

drama_dialogue1300485.ch: 这个山贼首领突然暴起，摇身一变，竟然成了一只妖怪，他向你疾扑而来……
drama_dialogue1300485.en: This leader of the mountain bandits suddenly rises up and transforms into a monster. He lunges at you...

drama_dialogue1300486.ch: 这个山贼不敌你手，果然多行不义必自毙。
drama_dialogue1300486.en: The bandit is no match for you. Indeed, persisting in evil brings about self-destruction.

drama_dialogue1300500.ch: 最近山贼竟训练血傀对付宗门，你赶到时已经有数名弟子死于血傀之手，而那只血傀看见你来，以为你要不利于他，猛地朝你发出攻势。
drama_dialogue1300500.en: The mountain bandits have been training blood puppets to deal with the Sect recently. When you arrive, several disciples have already died at the hands of the blood puppet. When the blood puppet see you coming, he thinks you will be a cause of disadvantage for him and he attacks you fiercely.

drama_dialogue1300501.ch: 傀儡被你击败后，竟然暂时恢复几分灵智，他说自己遭贼人控制才行此凶恶之事，希望你能饶他一命……
drama_dialogue1300501.en: The puppet is defeated by you but temporarily regains some spiritual wisdom. He says he is only doing evil deeds because he is being controlled by the bandits, and hopes you can spare his life...

drama_dialogue1300502.ch: 傀儡十分感激你饶过了它，竟取出宝物赠送给你。
drama_dialogue1300502.en: The puppet is very grateful to you for sparing it, and even takes out an artifact to offer it to you as a gift.

drama_dialogue1300503.ch: 血傀乘你不备竟突然运功自爆。你反应极快，迅速闪开，可惜仍被炸伤……
drama_dialogue1300503.en: While you are unprepared, the blood puppet suddenly explodes. You react quickly and dodge, but you are still injured by the explosion...

drama_dialogue1300504.ch: 抱歉。今日饶你，难保日后你不会再次丧失神智，沦为傀儡，被有心人利用……
drama_dialogue1300504.en: Sorry. If I spare you today, there is no guarantee that you will not lose your mind again and become a puppet in the future, to be used by someone...

drama_dialogue1300505.ch: 血傀的主人突然出现，傀儡竟再次陷入混乱，猛地向你扑来……
drama_dialogue1300505.en: The blood puppet's master suddenly appears, and the puppet falls into confusion once more and lunges at you...

drama_dialogue1300507.ch: 你击败了血傀与其主人，总算解决这边的危局。
drama_dialogue1300507.en: You defeat the blood puppet and its master, and finally resolve the danger here.

drama_dialogue1300520.ch: 一只傀儡主动找到你，不过他自知入魔已深，恐怕难以恢复，此来他想请你出手将他杀死……
drama_dialogue1300520.en: A blood puppets comes looking for you of his own volition. He knows that his Qi Deviation is deep and is afraid that it will be difficult to recover so he wants to ask you to kill him...

drama_dialogue1300521.ch: 血傀闭上了双眼，看来他终于解脱了……
drama_dialogue1300521.en: The blood puppet closes his eyes. It looks like he is finally free...

drama_dialogue1300522.ch: 血傀闭上了双眼，他得到了解脱。你从他身上得到了一些药材
drama_dialogue1300522.en: The blood puppet closes his eyes. He is free. You obtain some herbs from his corpse.

drama_dialogue1300523.ch: 你将此人体内魔障强行引出，魔障瞬间化为实体，朝你出手……
drama_dialogue1300523.en: You forcefully draw the Deviation from the body and it instantly turns into a physical form that attacks you...

drama_dialogue1300524.ch: 你成功将这名弟子净化还原，不过该名弟子根基已毁，不能继续修炼，所幸他也无法危害无辜……
drama_dialogue1300524.en: You succeeded in purifying and restoring this Disciple. However, the disciple's foundation has been destroyed and he cannot continue cultivation. Fortunately, he cannot harm the innocent either...

drama_dialogue1300525.ch: 血傀净化失败，血傀入魔太深，你已无法将其还原净化。
drama_dialogue1300525.en: The blood puppet purification fails. The blood puppet's Qi Deviation is too deep and you can no longer purify and restore it.

drama_dialogue1300540.ch: 一个神秘人突然现身，他不准你带走血傀，并出手将血傀炼化，指挥它朝你出手……
drama_dialogue1300540.en: A mysterious person appears suddenly and does not allow you to take the blood puppet away. He strikes and refines the blood puppet, and commands it to strike at you...

drama_dialogue1300541.ch: 来人与血傀均败于你手，你要……
drama_dialogue1300541.en: You defeat this person along with the blood puppet. You will...

drama_dialogue1300542.ch: 你将此人与血傀一并斩杀……
drama_dialogue1300542.en: You kill this person and the blood puppet...

drama_dialogue1300543.ch: 你将此人连同血傀一并斩杀，对方临死反扑，竟使法对你种下诅咒……
drama_dialogue1300543.en: You kill this person along with the blood puppet and in his death throes, he casts a curse on you...

drama_dialogue1300544.ch: 你将血傀毁掉，然后将人放了
drama_dialogue1300544.en: You destroy the blood puppet and release the hostage

drama_dialogue1300545.ch: 你感受到周围怨念激荡，逐渐凝成实体，竟是日前你斩杀的血傀主人来寻仇
drama_dialogue1300545.en: You feel resentment rise about you and condense into a real body—it is the master of the blood puppet you killed a few days ago, here to seek revenge

drama_dialogue1300600.ch: 前方妖气四溢，相信便是妖巢所在。贸然进入必有一番恶战
drama_dialogue1300600.en: The evil aura permeates the place ahead. It's believed that it's where the monster nest is. Rushing in would lead to a fierce battle.

drama_dialogue1300601.ch: 你探明了妖物巢穴，并对之进行一番清剿，完成了宗门委托。
drama_dialogue1300601.en: You have discovered the monster nest. You do some cleansing, completing the Sect request.

drama_dialogue1300602.ch: 前方妖气四溢，相信便是妖巢所在。贸然进入必有一番恶战

drama_dialogue1300687.en: The thieving Disciple returns to normal after being defeated by you, and the Sect's Treasure Department comes to discuss things with you and reclaims the Sect's treasures.

drama_dialogue1300688.ch: 前方传来嗷嗷怪叫，练功失控的窃宝弟子怪模怪样的匍匐在前。失控弟子狂性大发，只怕不易应付，你要……
drama_dialogue1300688.en: A loud, strange wailing comes from ahead. The thieving Disciple whose cultivation has gone out of control is crawling in a grotesque way. The Disciple who has lost control is in a frenzy, and will not be easy to deal with. You will...

drama_dialogue1300689.ch: 窃宝弟子被你击败后恢复原状，而门中贮宝堂亦前来接洽，重新收回宗门宝物。
drama_dialogue1300689.en: The thieving Disciple returns to normal after being defeated by you, and the Sect's Treasure Department comes to discuss things with you and reclaims the Sect's treasures.

drama_dialogue1300690.ch: 前方便是贮宝堂所指骚扰灵矿的怪群，你要上前将其歼灭么？
drama_dialogue1300690.en: Up ahead is the group of harassing monsters that the Sect's Treasure Department has complained about. Do you want to go wipe them out?

drama_dialogue1300691.ch: 群妖被你一阵扫荡，尽都覆灭。而你也顺利完成了贮宝堂委托的任务。
drama_dialogue1300691.en: The group of monsters is destroyed by you. You have successfully completed the Mission entrusted to you by the Treasure Department.

drama_dialogue1300692.ch: 前方便是贮宝堂所指骚扰灵矿的怪群，你要上前将其歼灭么？
drama_dialogue1300692.en: Up ahead is the group of harassing monsters that the Sect's Treasure Department has complained about. Do you want to go wipe them out?

drama_dialogue1300693.ch: 群妖被你一阵扫荡，尽都覆灭。而你也顺利完成了贮宝堂委托的任务。
drama_dialogue1300693.en: The group of monsters is destroyed by you. You have successfully completed the Mission entrusted to you by the Treasure Department.

drama_dialogue1300694.en: Up ahead is the group of harassing monsters that the Sect's Treasure Department has complained about. Do you want to go wipe them out?

drama_dialogue1300695.ch: 群妖被你一阵扫荡，尽都覆灭。而你也顺利完成了贮宝堂委托的任务。
drama_dialogue1300695.en: The group of monsters is destroyed by you. You have successfully completed the Mission entrusted to you by the Treasure Department.

drama_dialogue1300696.ch: 前方便是贮宝堂所指骚扰灵矿的怪群，你要上前将其歼灭么？
drama_dialogue1300696.en: Up ahead is the group of harassing monsters that the Sect's Treasure Department has complained about. Do you want to go wipe them out?

drama_dialogue1300697.ch: 群妖被你一阵扫荡，尽都覆灭。而你也顺利完成了贮宝堂委托的任务。
drama_dialogue1300697.en: The group of monsters is destroyed by you. You have successfully completed the Mission entrusted to you by the Treasure Department.

drama_dialogue1300698.ch: 前方便是贮宝堂所指骚扰灵矿的怪群，你要上前将其歼灭么？
drama_dialogue1300698.en: Up ahead is the group of harassing monsters that the Sect's Treasure Department has complained about. Do you want to go wipe them out?

drama_dialogue1300699.ch: 群妖被你一阵扫荡，尽都覆灭。而你也顺利完成了贮宝堂委托的任务。
drama_dialogue1300699.en: The group of monsters is destroyed by you. You have successfully completed the Mission entrusted to you by the Treasure Department.

drama_dialogue1302000.ch: 这里是宗门发布任务的地方，你可以从这边接取任务替宗门出力获得声望与宗门贡献。
drama_dialogue1302000.en: This is where the Sect issues Missions. You can accept Missions here and work for the Sect to obtain Reputation and Sect Contribution.

drama_dialogue1302001.ch: 宗主要我嘱托于你，执行任务时，未必能够一帆风顺，请你务必小心在意！这里有丹药数枚，遇到危险，或能帮你渡过难关，也请收下吧。
drama_dialogue1302001.en: The Sect Leader wants me to entrust you with this. Things won't always go smoothly when you carry out the Mission, so be careful! Here are some Elixirs. They might help you survive if you encounter danger, so please take them.

drama_dialogue1302010.ch: 我早知你会行经此处。面前乃是宗门圣兽。宗门会发布相应信息让门人共同照料神兽。你若有心，不妨留意任务大厅之中有关神兽的任务。
drama_dialogue1302010.en: I knew you would be traveling through here. In front of you is the Sect Guardian. The Sect will issue the relevant information to the disciples to take care of the Guardian together. If you are interested, you can take note of the Guardian-related Missions in the Mission Hall.

drama_dialogue1302011.ch: 宗门往日屡遭危难，多得神兽助力，才一次次渡过难关。因此照料神兽乃是门人应该共同担待的责任。
drama_dialogue1302011.en: The Sect has suffered many disasters but were able to overcome them thanks to the help of the Guardian. This is why taking care of the Guardian is a shared responsibility among disciples.

drama_dialogue1302020.ch: 宗门中大部分秘籍都在藏经阁中收藏，你为宗门出力，对宗门有贡献，宗门也不会吝惜秘传绝学，一应都可倾囊相授。
drama_dialogue1302020.en: Most of the Manuals in the Sect are in the Manual Library. Work hard for the Sect and contribute to it, and the Sect will be generous with their secret knowledge. All can be taught and passed on.

drama_dialogue1302021.ch: 既然来到，不妨挑选一些合用秘籍。门中前辈对你颇为欣赏，曾特别吩咐，若在藏经阁中购买秘籍，可以给你优惠。
drama_dialogue1302021.en: Since you're here, why don't you pick out some suitable Manuals? The seniors in the Sect favor you and have given special instructions that you can enjoy some privileges when buying Manuals in the Manual Library.

drama_dialogue1302030.ch: 你来到此处，可是身体有何不适？这里是宗门疗伤院，可以恢复体力灵力并除去身上负面气运。
drama_dialogue1302030.en: Are you here because you don't feel well? This is the Sect Hospital. You can recover your Vitality and Energy here, and also remove negative Destiny.

drama_dialogue1302031.ch: 今日既然来到，亦是一场机缘，我给你稍微恢复体力灵力。一个人总得精神饱满，才容易克服迎面而来的难关。
drama_dialogue1302031.en: Coming here today is a an opportunity. I will recover a little Vitality and Energy for you. One has to be well rested to easily overcome the difficulties that come your way.

drama_dialogue1302040.ch: 你打开了灵阁主人，没想到这里面的主人是小师妹！
drama_dialogue1302040.en: You've opened the Spirit Pavilion! I didn't expect to see that the master of this place is you, Junior!

drama_dialogue1302041.ch: 小师妹发现了你，移形换影一般移动到你身后挡住了出口，她将你推进灵阁中，让你在里面进行短时闭关。小师妹对你关照有加，你竟在阵中获得额外修为的增进！
drama_dialogue1302041.en: The Junior discovers your presence and moves quickly behind you to block the exit. She pushes you into the Spirit Pavilion and closes you in there for a short while. Your Junior takes good care of you, and you obtained extra cultivation in the Pavilion!

drama_dialogue1302042.ch: 哼哼，长老吩咐，我管治灵阁，若日后你希望在宗门闭关，增进修为，不妨过来灵阁这边！
drama_dialogue1302042.en: The Elder instructed that I oversee the Spirit Pavilion. If you wish to cultivate in the Sect and improve your cultivation, you can come to the Spirit Pavilion!

drama_dialogue1302050.ch: 此处乃是宗门灵阁，你可在此处进行境界突破。宗门之中进行突破，能够生成特殊逆天改命。例如这样。
drama_dialogue1302050.en: This is the Sect's Spirit Pavilion. You can go through Realm Breakthrough here. Breakthroughs in the Sect can generate special Rewrite Destiny. Like this.

drama_dialogue1302051.ch: 随着小师妹玉手一挥，你只觉浑身生出精力。
drama_dialogue1302051.en: The Junior waves a hand and you feel your Stamina increasing.

drama_dialogue1302052.ch: 这便是我在突破时获得的特殊逆天改命“甘霖广泽”。同样，你在此处进行突破亦能获得宗门特有的各种逆天改命效果。
drama_dialogue1302052.en: This is the special Rewrite Destiny I obtained from my Breakthrough, Downpour Pool. Likewise, you can also obtain various unique Sect Rewrite Destiny effects when you have a Breakthrough here.

drama_dialogue1302060.ch: 你果然来这了。宗门议事大厅，乃宗主长老在处决宗门要事的地方，一向不允外门弟子进入参与决策讨论的。
drama_dialogue1302060.en: You actually came here. The main hall of the sect is where the sect master and elders discuss and make decisions, and it has always been forbidden for outer disciples to participate in the decision-making process.

drama_dialogue1302061.ch: 不过我看你资质甚好，相信假以时日必能于宗门中升任要职，进入议事大厅处理要事。
drama_dialogue1302061.en: But I see that you have good qualifications. I believe that you will be able to ascend to an important position in the Sect in time, and enter the Council Hall to deal with important matters.

drama_dialogue1302062.ch: 这是我新悟的妙法，入不得高人法眼，不过对你亦有补益，希望能对你前程起到帮助。
drama_dialogue1302062.en: This is my technique from new Insight. It is nothing to brag about, but it is useful to you and I hope that it can help you in the future.

drama_dialogue1302070.ch: 这里是宗门聚宝仙楼，里面所售丹药颇为珍贵，因此不能随意使用。当然，若你对宗门付出贡献，宗门亦绝不吝惜这些丹药的。
drama_dialogue1302070.en: This is the Sect's Treasure Pavilion. All the Elixirs in there are precious so you cannot use them as you please. Of course, if you contribute to the Sect, the Sect will be generous with these Elixirs.

drama_dialogue1302071.ch: 说起这个，这是我不久前向仙楼管事讨教而炼制的几味丹药，这便送你吧。
drama_dialogue1302071.en: Speaking of which, I recently asked the Pavilion steward to teach me, and I made some Elixirs. You can have this.

drama_dialogue1302080.ch: 长老，宗主要我跟您说明，今日请您在任务大厅上分配弟子进行各式任务。
drama_dialogue1302080.en: Elder, the Sect Leader has told me to tell you to assign Disciples to the various Missions in the Mission Hall today.

drama_dialogue1302090.ch: 恭喜您升任长老，我宗议事大厅允许长老宗主入内进行门中各样管理。你能在此查看宗门概况、宗门大事，亦可调配弟子，对大阵进行修复等管理事务。
drama_dialogue1302090.en: Congratulations on being promoted to Elder. The Council Hall allows Elder Sect Leaders to enter and manage various Sect matters. You can view the Sect's overall situation, Sect events, redeploy Disciples, repair the Array, and other management matters.

drama_dialogue1302091.ch: 当然许多重要决策也在大厅中决定执行，包括领地一切事务，以及宗门迁移。
drama_dialogue1302091.en: Of course, many important decisions are also made in the Council Hall, including all territory matters, as well as Sect relocation.

drama_dialogue1302100.ch: 啊！原来涂山一族所说之人便是你……
drama_dialogue1302100.en: Ah! So you are the one the Tushan Clan mentioned...

drama_dialogue1302101.ch: 近日天象变异，使得灵物出世，八荒宗门出现诸多怪象。涂山族人与我有旧，托我将此元神记忆作为礼物送给你。
drama_dialogue1302101.en: There have been changes in the skies recently, and Spiritual Items have appeared in the world while the Sects of the world have seen many strange signs. The Tushan Clan and I have a long relationship, so they have entrusted me to give you this dying soul's memory as a gift.

drama_dialogue1302102.ch: 涂山族人还千叮万嘱，当此革故鼎新之际，<r>此物唯有于宗门内使用才能生出奇效。</r>他还说，你昔日曾获得此物，当能从容驾驭。
drama_dialogue1302102.en: The Tushan Clan also repeatedly implored that in this time of discarding the old and introducing the new, <r>this is the only way to use it in the Sect to make a difference.</r>He also said that you have obtained this item in the past so you should be able to handle this with ease.

drama_dialogue1302103.ch: 而今礼物送到你手，总算不负友人所托。
drama_dialogue1302103.en: The gift has now been delivered to your hands, and I have finally fulfilled my friend's request.

drama_dialogue1304501.ch: 龙主，大事不好。自打您将青鳞池作了一番修缮之后，一只钦原蜂妖竟屡屡前来吸纳池中灵气。现在钦原还在宗门附近徘徊。
drama_dialogue1304501.en: A crisis has arisen, Dragon King. Since you had the Greenscale Spring repaired, a Qin Yuan bee has repeatedly come to absorb Qi from it. The Qin Yuan is wandering around the Sect as we speak.

drama_dialogue1304502.ch: 依属下推测，钦原乃是觊觎雏龙体内灵气，因此想要通过尾针扎破雏龙吸取龙血，以增自己修为。
drama_dialogue1304502.en: If I may be so bold, I believe that the Qin Yuan craves the energy from young dragons and that it satisfies this by stabbing into young dragons with its tail thorn to suck the blood from them and strengthen itself.

drama_dialogue1304503.ch: 钦原十分贪婪，已经吸走灵池大量灵气。我宗青鳞池一向为龙族浸泡休养的地方，断不能让这只妖物无故盘踞。
drama_dialogue1304503.en: The Qin Yuan is an ravenous beast, and has already taken most of the Qi from our pool. The Greenscale Spring of our Sect has always been a place where dragons could recover their strength, and we cannot allow a beast like this to wantonly occupy us.

drama_dialogue1304506.ch: 就在日前，我率群弟子驱赶该妖，只是钦原乃八荒古兽，绝非等闲，我等修为浅薄，只能将该妖赶出青鳞池，当前妖物仍在宗门附近徘徊，因此属下想请龙主亲自出手驱逐钦原！
drama_dialogue1304506.en: Just recently I led a team of disciples to drive out the monster, but so ancient and abnormal is it that, with our meager abilities, we could only drive it away from the Greenscale Spring. It wanders still nearby the Sect, and I humbly ask you to go and expel it for us, my lord!

drama_dialogue1304507.ch: 钦原乃八荒古兽，并不容易对付，你要对其进行攻击么？
drama_dialogue1304507.en: The Qin Yuan is an ancient monster and will not be easy to handle. Will you go forth and battle it?

drama_dialogue1304508.ch: 拜见龙主大人。想必龙主已将钦原击败？啊，言归正传，属下此来乃是为了将一本宗门秘录交达龙主大人手中的。
drama_dialogue1304508.en: Greetings, my lord. I imagine you have defeated the Qin Yuan by now? Well, in any case, I have come to humbly present you with secret records of the Sect.

drama_dialogue1304513.ch: 此物原为历任龙主保管，其本身沾有青鳞池灵气，与之互有联系。所以青鳞池荒废，册子亦会自行封印隐藏。龙主近日重新修缮青鳞池，此册果然重见天日。我宗秘史总算不致失传。
drama_dialogue1304513.en: This has been protected by dragon kings throughout the ages. It is imbued with Greenscale Spring Qi and bears a connection with the spring. If the spring were to be abandoned, then this text would too seal itself and vanish. Now that you have restored the Greenscale Spring, my lord, this text has once again seen the light of day. The secret history of our Sect will not be lost to time.

drama_dialogue1304530.ch: 龙主大人将青鳞池修缮一番，真乃我宗幸事。不过……不过属下还有一事相告。
drama_dialogue1304530.en: It has truly been a blessing for our Sect that you have restored the Greenscale Spring. Only... Only there is something else I must tell you.

drama_dialogue1304531.ch: 日前青鳞池被钦原大肆吸纳灵气，导致池水浑浊不堪。依属下浅见，我们不妨找来一份玄黄母气来恢复青鳞池。
drama_dialogue1304531.en: In recent days, the theft of Qi from the Greenscale Spring by a Qin Yuan has left the spring unbearably muddy. If I may be so bold, I suggest we seek out Cosmos Essence to restore the spring.

drama_dialogue1304532.ch: 玄黄母气乃八荒天材地宝，不易觅得。说来惭愧，属下几番寻找依然无功，百般无奈下，还是只得请龙主大人设法将之找来。
drama_dialogue1304532.en: Cosmos Essence is a Heaven and Earth Treasure and finding it is no easy task. I am ashamed to say it, but my several attempts to do so have ended in failure, and with no other alternative, I must humbly ask you to help us find it, my lord.

drama_dialogue1304533.ch: 龙主大人，您已将玄黄母气带回来了么？
drama_dialogue1304533.en: My lord, were you able to procure Cosmos Essence?

drama_dialogue1304534.ch: 如此一来，青鳞池不日就能恢复往昔灵气了。
drama_dialogue1304534.en: In that case, the Greenscale Spring will be restored to its former glory in a matter of days.

drama_dialogue1304535.ch: 龙主大人，属下方才见青鳞池附近紫气缭绕，过去一看，竟然发现另一本被封印的宗门秘录，请宗主收下此物。
drama_dialogue1304535.en: My lord, just now I saw a purple cloud around the Greenscale Spring, and when I went to investigate, I found yet another secret record of the Sect that had been sealed. I present it to you now.

drama_dialogue1304560.ch: 龙主大人，属下收到我宗附近百姓求援，希望我宗出手驱赶一只蜂妖。
drama_dialogue1304560.en: My lord, I have received a request for aid from the people near our Sect. They want us to drive away a monster bee for them.

drama_dialogue1304561.ch: 属下已查明，为祸附近城镇的乃是日前那只钦原。这一切起因都是因为妖物觊觎我宗灵池之妙，以致牵连附近百姓。属下修为低微，还得请龙主大人出手，再度将钦原逐走！
drama_dialogue1304561.en: I've managed to find out that the monster causing trouble in the nearby town is the Qin Yuan. All this is a result of the monster's longing for the wonders of our Sect's great spring, and now the common folk nearby have been drawn into it. My skills being what they are, I must ask you again to drive away the Qin Yuan, my lord!

drama_dialogue1304562.ch: 看来是因为龙主大人您修好了池子所以跟屁龙心中高兴……所以……所以要去揍钦原一顿……属下以为钦原一直徘徊宗门附近，也要再次出手教训驱逐才是，而且难得跟屁龙这么有兴致，就请大人再去一趟吧！
drama_dialogue1304562.en: It seems your restoration of the pond has made the Following Dragons very happy, my lord... So... So, if the Qin Yuan is defeated once... I feel it will still keep wandering around the nearby area. It might be better to go out and teach it one more lesson. After all, it's not often you see the Following Dragons this happy. I ask that you go out once again, my lord!

drama_dialogue1304563.ch: 钦原乃八荒古兽，并不容易对付，你要对其进行攻击么？
drama_dialogue1304563.en: The Qin Yuan is an ancient monster and will not be easy to handle. Will you go forth and battle it?

drama_dialogue1304564.ch: 龙主大人凯旋归来，原是一喜。但除此以外还有一个好消息想要相告宗主。
drama_dialogue1304564.en: Your triumphant return is a cause for celebration in itself, my lord, but I have yet more good news to report.

drama_dialogue1304565.ch: 宗主请看，随着青鳞池逐渐恢复昔日样貌，又有一本宗门秘史重见天日，还请龙主收下！
drama_dialogue1304565.en: My lord, yet another secret history text from our Sect has resurfaced in the wake of the Greenscale Spring's restoration. I present it to you now!

drama_dialogue1304590.ch: 禀告龙主，随着青鳞池日益恢复，灵气渐强。钦原却依然盘踞我宗附近，属下推测，此妖必欲占我宗灵池而后快。
drama_dialogue1304590.en: My lord, the Qi has gotten stronger and stronger with the restoration of the Greenscale Spring. The Qin Yuan has still taken over nearby our Sect. I fear it will soon act on its desire to take over our spring.

drama_dialogue1304591.ch: 我宗灵池神妙非凡，招惹妖物，原非怪事。但是钦原两番驱逐仍然纠缠不休，还伤害周边百姓，实属罪大恶极……不得已，属下请龙主大人出手将之击杀。
drama_dialogue1304591.en: Our Sect's energy spring is like no other, and it is no wonder it attracts monsters. All the same, it is a terrible crime for the Qin Yuan to continue tormenting us and hurting the people around us after it has twice been driven away... I fear I have no choice but to ask you to slay it once and for all, my lord.

drama_dialogue1304592.ch: 唔……不过依属下观察，钦原仿佛因为曾经得到青鳞池灵气滋养，实力似乎变强不少，此行还请宗主小心！
drama_dialogue1304592.en: Hm... Though according to my investigation, the Qin Yuan's strength has grown in no small amount with all the Qi it has absorbed from the Greenscale Spring. Please take care, my lord!

drama_dialogue1304593.ch: 唔……不过依属下观察，钦原仿佛因为曾经得到青鳞池灵气滋养，实力似乎变强不少，此行还请宗主小心！
drama_dialogue1304593.en: Hm... Though according to my investigation, the Qin Yuan's strength has grown in no small amount with all the Qi it has absorbed from the Greenscale Spring. Please take care, my lord!

drama_dialogue1304594.ch: 钦原乃八荒古兽，并不容易对付，你要对其进行攻击么？
drama_dialogue1304594.en: The Qin Yuan is an ancient monster and will not be easy to handle. Will you go forth and battle it?

drama_dialogue1304595.ch: 龙主大人请看，又是一本宗门秘史！想必宗主已将钦原击杀，附近百姓知道我宗高手铲除为祸妖物，因此对我宗称赞不已！
drama_dialogue1304595.en: My lord, look! Another secret history text from our Sect! I imagine you have already exterminated the Qin Yuan. The people of this area know our Sect is more than capable of expelling demons, and there is no end to their praise for us!

drama_dialogue1304596.ch: 此次龙主击杀钦原，立下大功，一扫我宗往日颓风。属下相信宗门重新振兴，指日可待！
drama_dialogue1304596.en: The Qin Yuan is no more thanks to you, my lord. You have swiftly put an end to the degenerate past of our Sect. I have every confidence that our reinvigoration is only a matter of time.

drama_dialogue1304620.ch: 属下拜见宗主！此处乃是我宗跟屁虫最爱栖息的地方。依属下愚见，我们可以利用宗门资源<r>升级</r>青鳞池。池子经过升级，可以让跟屁虫浸泡时生出非比寻常的<r>特殊效果</r>。
drama_dialogue1304620.en: Greetings, Sect Leader! This place is a favored dwelling for the Little Clingy Bugs of our Sect. It is my humble opinion that we can make use of the Sect's resources to <r>upgrade</r> the Greenscale Spring. Once it is upgraded, the Little Clingy Bugs will be able to gain unique <r>Special Effects</r> by bathing in it.

drama_dialogue1304621.ch: 往日门中的前辈还跟属下提到，青鳞池修缮到一定级别后，对跟屁虫有神奇效果。若龙主身边带有跟屁虫，不妨常常带来此处与它多作<r>互动</r>。以这青鳞池的神奇功效，相信假以时日，就会让跟屁虫<r>蜕变成龙</r>，翱翔八荒。
drama_dialogue1304621.en: My seniors used to tell me that once the Greenscale Spring is upgraded to a certain level, it will have magical effects on the Little Clingy Bugs. If you have a Little Clingy Bug with you, my lord, why not bring it here and have it <r>interact</r> with the spring. I am sure that the effects of the Greenscale Spring will one day allow the Little Clingy Bug to <r>transform into a dragon</r> and soar across the land.

drama_dialogue1304622.ch: 对了，想龙主日后为宗门奔波，必会遇到危险，这是属下一点心意，请龙主收下。唉，属下说得多了，这便先告退了。
drama_dialogue1304622.en: Oh, right. I thought, my lord, that all your errands for the Sect might lead you into danger at some point. This is a small something I thought you could use, if you'd like it. Oh no, I'm talking too much. I'll leave you alone now.

drama_dialogue1304650.ch: 拜见龙主！恭喜龙主！龙主的小伙伴已经成功化形了。这真是天底下一等一的福缘造化啊！
drama_dialogue1304650.en: Many congratulations, my lord! Many congratulations! Your little companions have successfully changed form. As good a stroke of fortune as one could possibly hope for in this world!

drama_dialogue1304651.ch: 请龙主听属下细细说来，跟屁龙成功化形之后能够与宗主您精气血气配合，使龙主您变化出真龙形态。具体来说，龙主你可以在战斗之中积攒力量，到达一定程度后，通过发动神通化为此特殊形态。而真龙形态还分为赤龙、黄龙及青龙三种状态，可以互相转化。属下以为真龙三形各有长处优势，俱都十分玄妙，龙主还需要亲自细细体会。
drama_dialogue1304651.en: Allow me to explain in detail, my lord. Once a Following Dragon has successfully changed shape, it will be able to bond with your blood and spirit, after which you will transform into a true dragon. To be precise, once you accumulate a certain amount of power in battle, you can use your Ultimate Skill to take this special form. There are three true dragon forms that can mutually transform: The Crimson Dragon, the Yellow Dragon, and the Azure Dragon. I believe that each has their own marvels, but so mysterious are they, my lord, that you will have to experience them for yourself.

drama_dialogue1304652.ch: （<r>在界面左下角的境界按钮上方</r>新增控制赤龙、青龙及黄龙三种合体形态的转换功能，左键点击即可改变形态。在战斗中跟屁龙头顶会出现集气条，集气条盈满之际合体之技会暂时<r>替换神通</r>，释放合体神通即可变化成真龙形态。）
drama_dialogue1304652.en: (A transformation ability allowing control over the Crimson Dragon, Azure Dragon, and Yellow Dragon has been added to the <r>buttons at the lower left corner of the screen</r>. Left click on it to change form. In battle, a Qi Refining Pill will appear above the head of the Following Dragon, and once it is full, the combination skill will <r>replace Ultimate Skill</r>.
