Unleashing the Combination Ultimate Skill will allow you to change into the form of a true dragon.)

drama_dialogue1305001.ch: 龙主，您似乎陷入瓶颈无法突破。你体内怀有龙息，我可以助你一臂之力！
drama_dialogue1305001.en: My lord, you seem to have hit a bottleneck that impedes your breakthrough. Since you have Dragon Breath inside your body, I can help you overcome this obstacle!

drama_dialogue1305002.ch: 龙女玉手拈个法诀然后点在你额心之上，将一股龙息送入你体内。你体内龙息与龙女气息相和，形成阴阳二气在体内游走，不多时全身一震，精力无穷涌出。
drama_dialogue1305002.en: Dragon Girl casts a spell on the tips of her fingers and presses them on your forehead, infusing a gust of Dragon Breath into your body. Your inner Dragon Breath merges with the Dragon Girl's, and the merged breath circulates all over your veins. After a while, you feel a tremble, and infinite Stamina gushes out inside your body.

drama_dialogue1305020.ch: 龙主，你天纵英才，在我眼里这榜上之人都及不上你呢。而且我相信总有一日，您的成就会超过这上面的人！
drama_dialogue1305020.en: My lord, your genius far exceeds those on the leaderboard. I'm confident one day you will make greater achievements than all of them added together!

drama_dialogue1305021.ch: 龙主，最重要的是不要泄气，我什么时候都在您身边支持你呢！
drama_dialogue1305021.en: My lord, never lose heart. I'm always at your back!

drama_dialogue1305022.ch: 嗯，这才是我认识的龙主嘛！
drama_dialogue1305022.en: Yeah, that's the Dragon Lord I knew!

drama_dialogue1305030.ch: 咦，这些功法好像似曾相识……
drama_dialogue1305030.en: Huh, these Martial Arts look familiar...

drama_dialogue1305031.ch: 龙女将她记忆中有关你所学习功法的心得告诉你，你由此获得进益
drama_dialogue1305031.en: Dragon Girl imparts to you the knowledge about your Martial Arts as she remembers it, and you benefit a lot.

drama_dialogue1305050.ch: 龙主兄弟，我跟着您给宗门出了很多力气，最近很累啊。不如带我回去青鳞池休息一下吧？
drama_dialogue1305050.en: My lord, I've been working hard with you for the sect, and I'm really tired lately. Could you take me back to Greenscale Spring to relax a bit?

drama_dialogue1305051.ch: 你来到青鳞池竟发现云涯与毛枣枣在一起，他们在池边准备了一桌精致的菜肴。
drama_dialogue1305051.en: You arrive at Greenscale Spring and find Yun Ya and Jujubes preparing a table of delicacies next to the spring.

drama_dialogue1305052.ch: 龙主大人，这是毛枣枣龙兄特意嘱托我替你置办的宴席，他可是花了大心思呢。
drama_dialogue1305052.en: My lord, I prepared this banquet for you at Jujubes's order. He spent a lot of time working on the plan.

drama_dialogue1305053.ch: 嘿嘿，什么大心思，举手之劳，举手之劳，都是云涯你去亲自操办的啊。
drama_dialogue1305053.en: You flatter me. I just entrusted the task to you, and it was you who made it happen.

drama_dialogue1305054.ch: 你们三人饱餐一顿，而这桌宴席似乎用了什么珍贵仙药作为食材，你吃完之后竟感觉全身精力流动，全身暖洋洋的十分舒服。
drama_dialogue1305054.en: You three enjoyed the meal. Perhaps it's the ingredients of precious herbs in the dishes, you feel warm and comfortable as Stamina circulates all over your body.

drama_dialogue1305070.ch: 藏经阁……唔……我总觉得这里有点似曾相识，以前里面好像有一本……
drama_dialogue1305070.en: Manual Library... Hmm... This place looks familiar. I remember a book here...

drama_dialogue1305071.ch: 毛枣枣说着竟在藏经阁一个不起眼的角落里抓起一本珍贵的秘籍，并交到你手上
drama_dialogue1305071.en: Jujubes picks up a valuable Manual from a corner and hands it over to you.

drama_dialogue1305072.ch: 怎么好像是我以前放在这里的？记不清了……你拿着吧，哈哈。
drama_dialogue1305072.en: Maybe it was me who put it there? I'm not sure now... Take it though, haha.

drama_dialogue1308001.ch: 龙主大人，近日宗门附近不知为何总有一群竹妖肆虐，导致周边不宁。而且这群竹妖目前已进入我宗地界，日日徘徊于昔日先代龙主隐居地方附近。
drama_dialogue1308001.en: My lord, a gang of Bambukis are ravaging around our sect lately. They have trespassed on our territory, lingering where the late Dragon Lord lived in seclusion.

drama_dialogue1308002.ch: 大人，那片地方藏有许多我宗秘密，向来只允许龙主亲自进入，属下不便查探。不知大人是否前往查探一番好确保没有妖物进入？
drama_dialogue1308002.en: My lord, since there are many sect secrets hiding there, only Dragon Lords are allowed to go in there. Could you please go in person to see if it has been invaded by monsters?

drama_dialogue1308004.ch: 你去到云涯所指地点，周围果然都是竹妖。
drama_dialogue1308004.en: You arrive at the place Yun Ya mentioned, and it is infested by Bambukis all over the place.

drama_dialogue1308005.ch: 你将竹妖群打败之后，这些竹妖忙不迭的窜逃开去。而他们似乎都朝同一个方向离去……
drama_dialogue1308005.en: You defeated the Bambukis, and they flee in terror. You notice that they seem to be escaping in the same direction...

drama_dialogue1308030.ch: 你一路跟随竹妖，竟然看见前方一个身穿黑衣的神秘人。那些竹妖则围在此人身边叽叽喳喳的像说着什么。而这名神秘人很快就发现了你，他转过头来盯着你，一双眼中透出敌意。
drama_dialogue1308030.en: You follow the fleeing Bambukis and see a mystery man in black ahead. The Bambukis gather around him and seem to be telling him something. He noticed you and turns his eyes at you, staring at you full of enmity.

drama_dialogue1308032.ch: 你是何人，为何接近我山庄禁地？
drama_dialogue1308032.en: Who are you? Why do you come to our Mountain Hamlet?

drama_dialogue1308034.ch: 周围突然放出大量烟雾，散尽之后，神秘人与竹妖已无踪迹。
drama_dialogue1308034.en: A fog suddenly appears out of nowhere and blocks your sight. After it disperses, the mystery man and the Bambukis are nowhere to find.

drama_dialogue1308035.ch: 这神秘人行踪诡秘，回去让云涯想办法应对才是。
drama_dialogue1308035.en: This mystery man is a sneaky devil. I should go back and tell Yun Ya to track him.

drama_dialogue1308060.ch: 竟有如此怪事？原来近日竹妖肆虐，都是有原因的。敢问龙主大人您以为应该如何是好？
drama_dialogue1308060.en: What? So there's something behind the Bambuki invasion. My lord, what's your plan to deal with them?

drama_dialogue1308061.ch: 事关重大，还是彻查为妙。
drama_dialogue1308061.en: It's very serious, and we should investigate it properly.

drama_dialogue1308062.ch: 唔，属下亦以为此事蹊跷，应尽早查明。事不宜迟，属下与龙主大人分头查明这名神秘人之事吧。
drama_dialogue1308062.en: Yes, I think it's rather strange. We should investigate right away. Let's go separate ways to track this mystery man.

drama_dialogue1308063.ch: 你再次发现了大量竹妖，而那名神秘人亦在其中。你正想过去一探，头顶突然黑影笼罩，一件巨物从头顶罩落。
drama_dialogue1308063.en: You find a lot of Bambukis again, and the mystery man is among them. Just as you are about to go after them, a black shadow falls from above and traps you inside.

drama_dialogue1308064.ch: 你正吃惊，四周突然轰隆一声巨响，眼前一黑竟然什么都看不见了。你，被巨鼎罩住了。
drama_dialogue1308064.en: Astonished, you hear a big bang around you, and your sight is blacked out: you are trapped inside a giant cauldron.

drama_dialogue1308065.ch: 你试图运转自己体内神通掀开覆盖着你的大鼎，可发出的气劲只在鼎中冲来冲去，撞得鼎内当当作响。
drama_dialogue1308065.en: You cast your Ultimate Skill in the hope of overturning the cauldron, but the power it unleashes can't break through it, ending up banging and rebounding in the small space.

drama_dialogue1308066.ch: 你不断运转神通，大鼎之内周围充斥着你逼出体外的灵气。这些灵气撞上鼎壁，又回弹到你身上，让你觉得全身剧痛。
drama_dialogue1308066.en: You keep casting your Ultimate Skill, and the Qi you unleashed permeates the cauldron. It rebounds and hits you, causing you great pain.

drama_dialogue1308067.ch: 你忍着痛苦，不断运转神通，突然间丹田一热，全身灵气迸发，只听得爆炸声响，眼前大放光明，巨鼎同时炸裂飞散。
drama_dialogue1308067.en: You keep casting your Ultimate Skill despite the great pain, and suddenly, you feel a heat deep inside your body and burst out all your Qi, blasting the cauldron to pieces and setting youself free.

drama_dialogue1308068.ch: 岂有此理，此人神神秘秘，出没于我宗附近还算计于我。得速速与云涯商量，要他定下应对之法！
drama_dialogue1308068.en: How dare he sneak around our sect and plot against me! I must discuss with Yun Ya as soon as possible to track him down!

drama_dialogue1308090.ch: 龙主大人，属下无用，竟找不到竹妖及神秘人踪影。嗯？大人为何看着有些不一样？似乎这短短一阵子时间，修为有了增长？
drama_dialogue1308090.en: My lord, please forgive me for my failure to find the Bambukis and the mystery man. Oh? You look quite different. You have made progress in cultivation these days?

drama_dialogue1308091.ch: 原来如此……宗主是被我宗先代龙主设下的法宝覆坤鼎所困。覆坤鼎是由龙主龙息驱动的，因为龙主久不出世，覆坤鼎已经渐渐失去效用，昔日此物都是用来保护我宗一件秘宝碧玉龙鳞的。
drama_dialogue1308091.en: So that's it then... You were trapped by Earthshaking Cauldron, the artifact set up by our late Dragon Lord. It was driven by Dragon Lord's Dragon Breath, and as a long time went by without a Dragon Lord to maintain it, it gradually lost its effect. It was set up in the first place to protect a treasure in the sect, the Emerald Dragon Scale.

drama_dialogue1308092.ch: 想来是因为大人您的龙息重新唤醒了此法宝，而覆坤鼎蒙尘已久，不辨敌我，所以将大人您也当成是妖物镇压。
drama_dialogue1308092.en: It must have been your Dragon Breath that awakened the artifact, and after a long slumber, it might have lost the ability to discern allies from enemies and trapped you as a monster.

drama_dialogue1308093.ch: 大人猜测得不错，碧玉龙鳞向来为修仙者和有一定修为的妖物觊觎，覆坤鼎又是保护我宗碧玉龙鳞的法宝，这些竹妖出没于我宗周围，必是想设法盗取我宗碧玉龙鳞。
drama_dialogue1308093.en: That's right. Emerald Dragon Scale has always been coveted by cultivators and monsters with cultivation power, and Earthshaking Cauldron is the artifact to protect Emerald Dragon Scale. These Bambukis sneaking around our sect must be plotting to steal it.

drama_dialogue1308094.ch: 既是我宗秘宝，当然要设法阻止妖物偷窃。
drama_dialogue1308094.en: Then we must stop them from stealing our treasure.

drama_dialogue1308095.ch: 不错。现在碧玉龙鳞藏在我宗附近龙涎涧中，我们马上赶往龙涎涧保住宗门宝物。
drama_dialogue1308095.en: You're right. Emerald Dragon Scale is now hidden in Dragon Saliva Gully near out sect. We must hurry there to protect it.

drama_dialogue1308120.ch: 大人且慢。神秘人居心叵测，此行可能会有凶险。唔，我看你修为增长，正巧可以将此气运转入你体内，与你命格暂时相合。
drama_dialogue1308120.en: Just a moment, my lord. The mystery man is a dangerous enemy, and this pursuit can be risky. Since you have made some progress in cultivation, it's time to transfer this Destiny into your body to merge with your Fate temporarily.

drama_dialogue1308121.ch: 传说数千年前一名龙主借此气运聚成的灵气模仿龙吟发出一啸，顿时风云变色，十分厉害。大人暂时改变命格加持此气运，纵使遇到危险也总有几分应对的余裕。
drama_dialogue1308121.en: Legend has it that thousands of years ago, a Dragon Lord used the Qi converged from this Destiny to mimic a dragon roar, which shocked the sky and rocked the earth. With this Destiny, you can better protect yourself should you be caught up in danger.

drama_dialogue1308122.ch: 云涯将气运赋予给你，而你模仿龙吟发出啸声，体内力量竟然越来越充沛。这神奇气运果然效用不凡。
drama_dialogue1308122.en: Yun Ya transfers the Destiny to you, and you try to mimic a dragon roar. Within an instant you feel power surging in you. This Destiny is indeed awesome.

drama_dialogue1308150.ch: 你来到云涯指点的地方，只见前面山洞大开，幽暗的山洞流出清泉蜿蜒而去。而洞口一片漆黑，里面似乎另有洞天。
drama_dialogue1308150.en: You arrive at the place mentioned by Yun Ya. A giant cave looms before you, and a stream is flowing from the cave, winding into the distance. The dark cave seems to be hiding some secret.

drama_dialogue1308151.ch: 你喝了一口龙涎涧的涧水，一股寒意渗透全身。可眨眼间这股寒意似被你体内灵气所化，渐渐温暖，继而化成暖流与你的灵气合作一处遍流全身。
drama_dialogue1308151.en: You scoop up a handful of water from the stream and drink it up, which sends chill throughout your body. Within an instant, this chill is warmed by your inner Qi and converts to a warm stream that merges with your Qi and flows in your veins.

drama_dialogue1308152.ch: 进入山洞之后，你摸黑前行，也不知走了多久，前面高处突然穿入天光一缕，照亮附近。原来眼前乃是一个石室，而石室之中只有一张石床，看起来乃是一处世外高人的洞府。
drama_dialogue1308152.en: You keep walking in the dark cave without knowing how far you have covered, and suddenly you catch a glimpse of light ahead. It turns out to be a stone chamber, in which there is only a stone bed. It must be a cave where an elite cultivator cultivates.

drama_dialogue1308153.ch: 此时石床突然洞开，里面出现一片绿油油的玉石鳞片，一看就知道乃是云涯所说的碧玉龙鳞。
drama_dialogue1308153.en: The stone bed snaps open, revealing a green gemstone scale. It must be the Emerald Dragon Scale Yun Ya mentioned.

drama_dialogue1308154.ch: 此时神秘人飞扑出来，想要抢夺你手中的碧玉龙鳞。
drama_dialogue1308154.en: The mystery man appears out of nowhere, rushing near to grab the Emerald Dragon Scale in your hand.

drama_dialogue1308155.ch: 其时你体内充盈灵气，眼看神秘人气势汹汹的冲来，忍不住使出云涯教给你的龙啸对着神秘人发出一声吼。这声长啸包含你一身神通精力，骤然发出，竟将神秘人放倒在地。而他身体亦慢慢变化，变成一只剑竹妖！
drama_dialogue1308155.en: Qi is surging to the full capacity in your body. As the mystery man charges to you, you let out a Dragon Roar Yun Ya taught you. This roar, unleashed with all your power, bursts out and knocks down the mystery man. His body begins to transform into a Sword Bambuki!

drama_dialogue1308156.ch: 哼，原来这又是一只竹妖。
drama_dialogue1308156.en: Hmph, so he's just another Bambuki.

drama_dialogue1308157.ch: 这只剑竹妖所使突刺攻击之法，与山庄武技功法，竟有颇多相同之处。你跟此妖一战之后，于门中秘传颇有领悟。而剑竹妖被你击败后，慢慢化为一团云雾，继而消失不见。
drama_dialogue1308157.en: The skills used by this Sword Bambuki have something in common with the Martial Skills and Martial Arts of your hamlet, and the fight improved your understanding of them, whereas the defeated Sword Bambuki turned into smoke and disappeared.

drama_dialogue1308158.ch: 你将剑竹妖击杀，那些竹妖亦因此散去，宗门附近恢复安宁，周围的百姓对解决这些竹妖的英雄称赞不已，宗门威望亦由此提高。此事总算暂告一段落。
drama_dialogue1308158.en: You slew the Sword Bambuki, and the other Bambukis scattered and fled. Peace returned to the sect, and the nearby inhabitants spoke in praise of the heroes, raising the prestige of the sect. The crisis is finally over.

drama_dialogue1308180.ch: 竹妖之事了却以后，云涯终日留在藏经阁中，究竟是什么原因呢？
drama_dialogue1308180.en: After the Bambuki crisis was solved, Yun Ya stays in the Manual Library all day long. What is he up to?

drama_dialogue1308181.ch: 云涯近日除去处理宗门事务之外，总在山庄藏经阁逗留，不如前往看望，看看他可有什么难处？
drama_dialogue1308181.en: Yun Ya has been spending a lot of time in the Manual Library after handling sect affairs every day. Why not pay him a visit and see if he needs help?

drama_dialogue1308182.ch: 属下参见龙主大人。嗯，龙主大人震破巨鼎，机缘巧合下增进了修为，现在实力较之先前颇有长进了。
drama_dialogue1308182.en: My lord. I see you have made progress in cultivation since you blasted open the cauldron and underwent all those coincidences.

drama_dialogue1308183.ch: 属下近日在藏经阁中，翻阅我宗典籍，发现有几本秘籍很适合大人您，因此便挑选出来好转送大人您。
drama_dialogue1308183.en: I've been searching the Manual Library these days and found some Manuals that would suit you. Here you are.

drama_dialogue1308184.ch: 先是妖物侵扰我宗，让我前往那处地方，后又遭遇法宝大鼎，传我气运，待我修为增长了，便又赠送秘籍，这一切可真是“机缘巧合”啊。
drama_dialogue1308184.en: Come to that, I was guided to that place to solve the monster crisis, where I met the cauldron artifact and received the Destiny, and now I have made progress in cultivation, you gave me these Manuals. What a coincidence!

drama_dialogue1308185.ch: 嗯，龙主大人这么一说，果然颇为巧合。这都是龙主大人福缘深厚的缘故啊。这些日子留在藏经阁中整理故旧秘籍，落下不少门中之事，眼下也该前往处置好为大人分忧了。若无要事，请恕属下先行告退。
drama_dialogue1308185.en: Now that you put it like that, it was indeed a peculiar coincidence! It was your good fortune that made it happen! Now, I've spent too much time sorting out old Manuals here these days, and a lot of sect work has piled up. I must go attend to them now to spare you worries. Please excuse me.

drama_dialogue1308200.ch: 你看见云涯正在山庄门户之外沉吟站立，似乎正在为什么事情苦恼。
drama_dialogue1308200.en: You see Yun Ya standing outside the hamlet gate deep in contemplation. He seems very concerned.

drama_dialogue1500002.en: It's actually... really the Elder Dragon Aura!

drama_dialogue1500003.ch: 众位先祖在上，我御龙山庄命不该绝，命不该绝！
drama_dialogue1500003.en: Ancestors... My Dragon Mountain Hamlet will not end, and my life will not end!

drama_dialogue1500005.ch: 龙祖血裔现世，便是我山庄复兴之时！
drama_dialogue1500005.en: The Elder Dragon Blood heralds the rejuvenation of my hamlet!

drama_dialogue1500006.ch: 不枉我苦苦支撑许久，心机算尽躲避大宗抹杀……
drama_dialogue1500006.en: My long-time support of the Sect has not been in vain. I have tried to avoid the erasure of the great Sects...

drama_dialogue1500008.ch: 嗯？咳咳……在下方才失态，还望阁下恕罪！不知阁下是否愿意与我前往敝宗一叙。
drama_dialogue1500008.en: Hm? Oh, ahem... Sorry I lost myself earlier. Do you mind coming to my Sect to have a little chat?

drama_dialogue1500009.ch: 既如此，在下先行回宗，恭迎阁下光临！
drama_dialogue1500009.en: Then I'll go back to my Sect and wait for you there!

drama_dialogue1500012.en: It's actually... really the Elder Dragon Aura!

drama_dialogue1500013.ch: 众位先祖在上，我御龙山庄命不该绝，命不该绝！
drama_dialogue1500013.en: Ancestors... My Dragon Mountain Hamlet will not end, and my life will not end!

drama_dialogue1500015.ch: 龙祖血裔现世，便是我山庄复兴之时！
drama_dialogue1500015.en: The Elder Dragon Blood heralds the rejuvenation of my hamlet!

drama_dialogue1500016.ch: 不枉我苦苦支撑许久，心机算尽躲避大宗抹杀……
drama_dialogue1500016.en: My long-time support of the Sect has not been in vain. I have tried to avoid the erasure of the great Sects...

drama_dialogue1500018.ch: 嗯？咳咳……在下方才失态，还望阁下恕罪！不知阁下是否愿意听我讲讲敝宗之事。
drama_dialogue1500018.en: Hm? Oh, ahem... Sorry I lost myself earlier. Would you mind listening to me speak of my Sect's matters?

drama_dialogue1500021.ch: 阁下既有此心，便也莫要嫌我唠叨。我御龙山庄曾经也是八荒名门，盛极一时。
drama_dialogue1500021.en: If you are interested, please let me introduce it to you. My Dragon Mountain Hamlet was once a famous and powerful Sect in this world.

drama_dialogue1500022.ch: 先祖芒仙与枣仙乃是一对神仙眷侣，他们带着龙祖阿毛遨游八荒，登临世间绝顶。
drama_dialogue1500022.en: Immortal Mang and Immortal Zao, our two ancestors, were a model couple. They traveled all over the world with Elder Dragon Mao and ascended to the peak of cultivation.

drama_dialogue1500023.ch: 二人本是青梅竹马，机缘巧合下得到龙祖，后历经重重磨难，终成正果。此后，二人风花雪月、比翼双飞，传为八荒美谈。
drama_dialogue1500023.en: They were friends in childhood, and one thing led to another, they obtained the Elder Dragon and were united after many sufferings. They lived a happy life ever after and left behind so many beautiful stories.

drama_dialogue1500024.ch: 后来，龙祖传下血脉，它的子嗣都以“芒”和“枣”为名，以纪念先祖的主人。
drama_dialogue1500024.en: Later on, the Elder Dragon gave birth to its children, who were all named after "Mang" and "Zao" to remember the masters of their ancestor.

drama_dialogue1500025.ch: 然而，自从二位先祖驾龙飞升后，历代弟子掌握御龙之术者寥寥，宗门遂日渐没落，甚至遭到八荒各大宗门的觊觎。
drama_dialogue1500025.en: However, after our two ancestors had gone to the other world, few of our Disciples managed to master the skill to tame dragons. Our Sect fell into a decline, and is now coveted by the other major Sects on the continent.

drama_dialogue1500027.ch: 目前，我宗已至穷途末路，门内弟子稀少，资源匮乏，内忧外患……
drama_dialogue1500027.en: At present, our Sect has reached the end of the road. Disciples are scarce, there is a lack of resources, there are internal and external problems...

drama_dialogue1500028.ch: 阁下实乃我宗门复兴之希望，在下恳请您加入我御龙山庄！
drama_dialogue1500028.en: You are really the hope of our Sect's rejuvenation, so please join our Dragon Mountain Hamlet!

drama_dialogue1500031.ch: 哈哈哈，列祖列宗开眼，我有生之年，终于等到了这一天！
drama_dialogue1500031.en: Finally! I waited so long and this day has come in my lifetime!

drama_dialogue1500032.ch: 按照宗门世代规矩，即便你身为龙主，也要从外门弟子做起，不过，我已然看出，你当上宗主是早晚的事。
drama_dialogue1500032.en: According to the rules of the sect's generation, even as a dragon master, you still have to start as an outer disciple. However, I can already see that it is only a matter of time before you become the sect leader.

drama_dialogue1500033.ch: 御龙山庄的未来就都寄托在你的身上了！
drama_dialogue1500033.en: The future of the Dragon Mountain Hamlet rests on your shoulders!

drama_dialogue1500041.ch: 好吧……既如此，在下绝不能强人所难。阁下若回心转意，随时前来即可，在下必在宗内恭候大驾。
drama_dialogue1500041.en: Well... In that case, I must not force others to do so. If you have a change of heart, come by at any time. I'll be waiting for you in the Sect.

drama_dialogue1500052.ch: 好吧……既如此，在下决不强人所难。阁下若回心转意，随时前来即可，在下必在宗内恭候大驾。
drama_dialogue1500052.en: Well, in that case, I must not force others to do so. If you have a change of heart, come by at any time. I'll be waiting for you in the Sect.

drama_dialogue1500056.ch: 好吧……既如此，在下决不强人所难。阁下若回心转意，随时前来即可，在下必在宗内恭候大驾。
drama_dialogue1500056.en: Well, in that case, I must not force others to do so. If you have a change of heart, come by at any time. I'll be waiting for you in the Sect.

drama_dialogue1500062.ch: 可惜，可惜，天要亡我，无可奈何……
drama_dialogue1500062.en: Ah, what a shame, what a shame. The Heavens are against me, so there is nothing I can do...

drama_dialogue1500071.ch: 阁下莫非回心转意，答应做我御龙山庄的宗主不成？
drama_dialogue1500071.en: Have you had a change of heart? You agree to become the Sect Leader of our Dragon Mountain Hamlet?

drama_dialogue1500081.ch: 关于宗主之位，阁下能否听我一言再做定夺？
drama_dialogue1500081.en: About the position of Sect Leader, can you listen to some words from me before making a decision?

drama_dialogue1500092.en: It's actually... really the Elder Dragon Aura!

drama_dialogue1500094.ch: 唉，可惜龙主竟已入旁门，天要亡我，天要亡我……
drama_dialogue1500094.en: Ah, what a shame that the dragon master has already joined another Sect. The Heavens are killing me, yes they are...

drama_dialogue1520001.ch: 不！难道我就要在这里倒下了……

drama_dialogue1520005.ch: 这，你要将力量给我？好热……啊啊啊！
drama_dialogue1520005.en: So, you want to give me power? It's so hot... Aaagh!

drama_dialogue1520006.ch: 不！难道我就要在这里倒下了……

drama_dialogue1520010.ch: 这，你要将力量给我？好热……啊啊啊！
drama_dialogue1520010.en: So, you want to give me power? It's so hot... Aaagh!

drama_dialogue1520011.ch: 不！难道我就要在这里倒下了……

drama_dialogue1520014.ch: 真龙血脉，岂容玷污，接受我的力量吧！
drama_dialogue1520014.en: Pure dragon's blood, impervious to infection, accept my power!

drama_dialogue1520021.ch: 不！难道我就要在这里倒下了……

drama_dialogue1520024.ch: 真龙血脉，岂容玷污，接受我的力量吧！
drama_dialogue1520024.en: Pure dragon's blood, impervious to infection, accept my power!

drama_dialogue1600001.ch: 修仙之路崎岖坎坷，我需要一锅<r>灵芝蒸全鸡</r>才能重拾干劲……
drama_dialogue1600001.en: The Path of Cultivation is rugged and full of turns. I could really use a <r>Steamed Chicken With Mushrooms</r>...

drama_dialogue1600002.ch: <r>山猪的肉质</r>紧实筋道、香而不腻，用来烧烤简直是八荒珍味，咬上一口，立地登仙！
drama_dialogue1600002.en: <r>Boar meat</r> is so succulent and juicy. It makes the perfect roast. One bite and you'll transcend immediately!

drama_dialogue1600003.ch: 近日修炼颇勤，身体略有亏虚，在下突然甚是想念那<r>十八香笋片汤</r>的滋味……
drama_dialogue1600003.en: You've been training hard and are feeling somewhat depleted, when suddenly the thought of <r>Spicy Bamboo Soup</r> comes to mind...

drama_dialogue1600011.ch: 你来到后山，远远看见一个巨大的食槽，是否要前往一探？
drama_dialogue1600011.en: Coming around the back of the mountain, you spy a huge manger. Do you want to take a closer look?

drama_dialogue1600021.ch: 哈哈哈！如此佳肴实乃在下梦中所求，此物便送与你以示谢意吧。
drama_dialogue1600021.en: Hahaha! This marvellous food is everything I ever dreamed it would be. Please take it, as a token of my appreciation.

drama_dialogue1600111.ch: 你来到后山，远远看见成片的灵果树，是否要前往一探？
drama_dialogue1600111.en: Coming around the back of the mountain, you spy an orchard of Spiritual Fruit. Do you want to take a closer look?

drama_dialogue1600121.ch: 不错不错！此果正是我所需之物，为表感谢，这东西就赠予你吧。
drama_dialogue1600121.en: Excellent! This is exactly the one I was looking for! Please take this as a token of my appreciation.

drama_dialogue1600201.ch: 我等修士一路走来尝遍修仙之苦，得此闲暇，何不来上一碗<r>甜汤</r>以慰口腹？记得，烹调汤品需要加入<r>三次</r>调料。
drama_dialogue1600201.en: The Path of Cultivation is a hard one. When you're taking a break, why not enjoy a bowl of <r>Sweet Soup</r> to comfort the belly? Remember, cooking soups requires the addition of ingredients <r>three times</r>.

drama_dialogue1600202.ch: 盐乃百味之首，烹饪缺之不可。便是熬制汤品，必也是<r>咸者</r>为佳！记得，烹调汤品需要加入<r>三次</r>调料。
drama_dialogue1600202.en: Salt is the King of Spices. No savory food is complete without it! If you are making soup, it better be <r>salty</r>! Remember, cooking soups requires the addition of ingredients <r>three times</r>.

drama_dialogue1600203.ch: 若说引发食欲、提神醒脑，还得属冰镇的<r>酸梅汤</r>合我心意！记得，烹调汤品需要加入<r>三次</r>调料。
drama_dialogue1600203.en: There's nothing like a drink of icy <r>sour plum soup</r> to whet the appetite and sharpen the mind! Remember, cooking soups requires the addition of ingredients <r>three times</r>.

drama_dialogue1600204.ch: 五味之外，以辣动人，在下<r>无辣不欢，见椒则喜</r>，不知八荒之内可有同好？记得，烹调汤品需要加入<r>三次</r>调料。
drama_dialogue1600204.en: Spicy food's the best. <r>If there's no spice, I'm not interested</r>. I seriously doubt there's anyone who likes it more than me. Remember, cooking soups requires the addition of ingredients <r>three times</r>.

drama_dialogue1600211.ch: 你来到后山，远远看见一口热气蒸腾的大锅，是否要前往一探？
drama_dialogue1600211.en: Coming around the back of the mountain, you spy a large cauldron of something hot. Do you want to take a closer look?

drama_dialogue1600221.ch: 此汤美味绝伦，深得烹饪妙法，在下有幸一品，全仗阁下手艺！
drama_dialogue1600221.en: This soup tastes sublime. It was made with great art. If I only could taste it, my Lord, I would be forever at your mercy!

drama_dialogue1710001.ch: 桀桀，你想要打探{0}的所在之处？你若是愿意支付灵石，我倒是可以帮你这个忙。
drama_dialogue1710001.en: Hoho, you want to know the whereabouts of {0}? If you're willing to spend a Spirit Stone on it, I might be able to help you out.

drama_dialogue1710002.ch: 不错，这访胜灵签你且收好。出城后，你将灵力注入这灵签中，便可感应{1}所在的方位。祝你好运！
drama_dialogue1710002.en: Not bad. Take this Worldly Fortune Stick. Once you're out of the city, infuse this fortune stick with Energy, then you'll be able to sense the location of {1}. I wish you good luck!

drama_dialogue1710101.ch: 你想要打探<r>{0}</r>的所在之处？真是不凑巧…{1}目前已消声灭迹了，你不妨过段时间再来吧！
drama_dialogue1710101.en: You want to know the whereabouts of <r>{0}</r>? Ah, I'm afraid you're out of luck... There's no trace of {1} right now, but you could always come back later!

drama_dialogue2000001.ch: 不远处似乎有个人躺在地上……
drama_dialogue2000001.en: There seems to be a person lying on the ground in the distance...

drama_dialogue2000002.ch: 你靠近查看，发现地上躺着的竟是一具衣着完好的尸体。
drama_dialogue2000002.en: You move closer to look, and realize you're looking at a perfectly dressed dead body.

drama_dialogue2000003.ch: 探查片刻后，你判断出此人刚死不久，其道心破碎、死状凄惨，想必生前也是一名天骄。
drama_dialogue2000003.en: You probe the body and realize the person has not been deceased for long. Their Taoist Mind is shattered. This person must have been heaven-chosen in life. It's a real shame that this happened.

drama_dialogue2000004.ch: 不过诡异的是，这道心破碎的状态并非自然，似是外力所致……
drama_dialogue2000004.en: The shattering of the Taoist Mind isn't natural, however. This looks like the result of some other force...

drama_dialogue2000006.ch: 你翻找尸体衣物，果真略有收获。
drama_dialogue2000006.en: You search through the person's clothes, and sure enough find something.

drama_dialogue2000007.ch: 你仔细验尸并反复观察周围痕迹，最终在尸体的身下发现了一颗色泽怪异的道心果与一张皱巴巴的信纸。
drama_dialogue2000007.en: You closely examine the body and look over the marks. After several examinations, you notice an Ugly-colored Taoist Fruit and a Crumpled Letter on the body.

drama_dialogue2000008.ch: 你不忍见人曝尸荒野，便随手挖坑将其掩埋了，一时间心中正气上涌，有所感悟。
drama_dialogue2000008.en: You find it distasteful to leave a body out in the open, and you dig a hole to bury it in. You feel satisfied for a moment that the right thing has been done.

drama_dialogue2000009.ch: 见此人死状诡异，你决定遁走而去，免得沾染了晦气。
drama_dialogue2000009.en: Alarmed by the strange circumstances, you leave the body as fast as possible so as not to invite any bad luck.

drama_dialogue2000010.ch:
你还在为参加升仙大会时屡被秒杀而犯愁吗？

你还在为辛苦挣得的道心果总会突然失窃而烦恼吗？

天宝真人牌道心果，价格公道、品质良心，修仙之途好帮手。
drama_dialogue2000010.en:
Tired of being instantly killed in the Immortal Tournament?

Frustrated by how often your hard-earned Taoist fruit is suddenly stolen?

Sage Tianbao's Taoist Fruit is high quality for a fair price, making it just the thing for that long road of training.

drama_dialogue2000030.ch: “看一看，瞧一瞧！稀世珍宝道心果今日特价甩卖，八百灵石一两，三千灵石半斤！天骄购买凭道心再打五折！”远处，一个道士模样的人吆喝着，身旁一群修仙者正交头接耳、窃窃私语。
drama_dialogue2000030.en: "You'd have to see it to believe it! This rare treasure of a Taoist Fruit is going for a great price today! 800 Spirit Stones, 50 grams. 3000 Spirit Stones, half a kilo! Heaven-chosen get another half off for their nobility!"  The shouts come from someone who appears to be a Cultivator, with several other Cultivators around whispering to each other fervently.

drama_dialogue2000031.ch: 诶？这不是那个人人喊打的天宝真人么？他怎么不算命改卖水果了？
drama_dialogue2000031.en: Huh? This isn't the Sage Tianbao everyone talks about, is it? What's a fortune teller like him doing selling fruit all of a sudden?

drama_dialogue2000032.ch: 你是聋还是瞎？那可是道心果啊，平日里只有升仙大会上排名前四的高手才能获得，是千金难求的宝贝！
drama_dialogue2000032.en: Are you deaf or blind? That's Taoist Fruit. It's usually only the top four in the Immortal Tournament who can get them. They're incredibly valuable!

drama_dialogue2000033.ch: 嗤，这等好东西，他一个臭算卦的上哪儿弄来这么多，想必是摘了些沙棠果拿来骗钱的吧！
drama_dialogue2000033.en: What? How did some good-for-nothing fortune teller get that many valuable items? This is some kind of scam for sure!

drama_dialogue2000034.ch: 我看未必，我曾听人言，这个天宝真人状似疯癫，但来头却不小，好像与那举办升仙大会的什么道心阁有些关联……
drama_dialogue2000034.en: Not necessarily. I've heard people say that this sage might look crazy, but he has a lot of influence. This might be connected in some way to someone from the Taoist Mind Pavilion, which holds the Immortal Tournament...

drama_dialogue2000035.ch: 嗯？原来如此，那我等还不上前捡漏？
drama_dialogue2000035.en: Huh? So that's it. Why don't we go take a closer look, then?

drama_dialogue2000036.ch: 围观不多时，许多修仙者纷纷掏出灵石，抢购这天宝真人出售的道心果。
drama_dialogue2000036.en: Watching the scene for some time, you see many Cultivators you see many cultivators taking the Spiritual Stones and competing with each other for Sage Tianbao's Taoist Fruit.

drama_dialogue2000037.ch: “我观阁下英武非常，想必也是天骄之人，何不趁此良机买些道心果，也好为日后提升修为做好准备。”一晃神的工夫，只见天宝真人直勾勾地盯着你，对你开口相劝。
drama_dialogue2000037.en: It does not take long for Sage Tianbao to recognize you, after which he insists, "You, sir, exude the valor of one who might also be Heaven-chosen. Why not take advantage of this opportunity and buy a Taoist Fruit? It would go a long way towards your training later."

drama_dialogue2000038.ch: 在下正有此意，这道心果我买了！
drama_dialogue2000038.en: That is just what I hope to do. I'll take this Taoist Fruit right here!

drama_dialogue2000039.ch: “哈哈哈，爽快！”天宝真人将道心果递了过来，似是无心去接你递去的灵石。
drama_dialogue2000039.en: "Hahaha. How nice!" Sage Tianbao hands over the Taoist Fruit and seems to accept your Spirit Stones without even thinking about it.

drama_dialogue2000040.ch: 多谢你的美意，我看还是不必了。
drama_dialogue2000040.en: I appreciate the sentiment, but I assure you it is unnecessary.

drama_dialogue2000041.ch: “唔，可惜，可惜……”天宝真人低首垂眉，似是在想些什么。
drama_dialogue2000041.en: "Hm. A pity, that. A real pity..." Sage Tianbao lowers his head as if in deep thought.

drama_dialogue2000042.ch: 我看阁下言行，分明不是天宝真人，乃是个冒充的假货！
drama_dialogue2000042.en: Having watched your words and actions, I see clearly that you are not Sage Tianbao, but a mere imposter!

drama_dialogue2000043.ch: “什么？你！”天宝真人一脸惊诧，双眼瞪得溜圆。
drama_dialogue2000043.en: "What? You...!" Sage Tianbao appears dumbstruck by this.

drama_dialogue2000044.en: Enough! You'll pay for this with your life!

drama_dialogue2000045.ch: “可恶！”天宝真人飞身闪开，一脸怨毒。
drama_dialogue2000045.en: "Ugh!" Sage Tianbao darts out of the way, his expression resentful.

drama_dialogue2000046.ch: 大胆狂徒，竟敢冒充天宝师弟！今日便是你的死期！
drama_dialogue2000046.en: How dare you impersonate Tianbao! I will make sure it is the last thing you do!

drama_dialogue2000047.ch: 就在此刻，远处飞来一道身影。来者杀气腾腾，一招一式直取天宝真人的要害，天宝真人竟也爆发出不俗的气场，欲与来人抗衡。一时间飞沙走石，在场众人纷纷惊惶逃遁。
drama_dialogue2000047.en: Right at that moment, a figure flies from the distance. With a murderous look in their eyes, they strike a blow right at Sage Tianbao's vitals. Tianbao himself lets out an otherwordly burst of energy to counter the attack. Sand and stone fly around the scene, and the onlookers scatter to safety.

drama_dialogue2000048.ch: 天宝真人几招之间落入下风，可正当他转身欲逃时，方圆百丈内已被天玄布下禁制。就在此生死时刻，这天宝真人面上狰狞之色一闪，竟笔直向你冲来，“哼，幸亏还有个不知死活的蝼蚁愣在此地，我刚好祭炼此人，或可绝处逢生！”
drama_dialogue2000048.en: Tianbao is at a disadvantage within a few moves. Just as he turns to escape, Tianxuan puts down a seal of a hundred feet. Tianbao appears to be in mortal danger and pleads with you. "Sir, if you were to save my life, I would be eternally grateful!"

drama_dialogue2000051.ch: 天玄小儿安敢放肆，待我蚀心殿圣女大人出关，必将尔碎尸万段！
drama_dialogue2000051.en: The child of Tianxuan dares to be so reckless? I will tear you apart when the Priestess emerges from the Mindsnap Temple!

drama_dialogue2000052.ch: 说时迟那时快，未等你反应过来，几个黑袍人出现在来者周围，他们凝结出奇异法阵，夺走了那天宝真人的尸体，随后竟转瞬消失无影。
drama_dialogue2000052.en: As soon as the words are spoken, a group of black-clothed figures appear, and before you can react, move into a powerful formation around Sage Tianbao, blocking Tianxuan's attacks, and then carrying the body of Tianbao without a trace.

drama_dialogue2000055.ch: 可恶，又让他们跑了……下次再遇，必让其死无葬身之地！
drama_dialogue2000055.en: Damn, they ran away again... Next time we meet, they will die without burial!

drama_dialogue2000056.ch: “嗖嗖！”破风声在你耳边作响，天宝真人用另一只手洒出漫天令旗，在你周身凝结了一座幽冥结界。“今日遇到在下，算你倒霉！”趁此工夫，他竟要吸取你的灵力。
drama_dialogue2000056.en: "Whoosh!" You hear wind blowing at your ears as Sage Tianbao throws countless flags in the sky with the other hand, which condense and shape a nether barrier around you. "You should have never walked outside today, mwahaha!" It seems he wants to absorb your Energy.

drama_dialogue2000057.ch: 哼，区区结界，也想拦住在下？幼稚！
drama_dialogue2000057.en: Hmph, you think you can stop me with a puny barrier like this? Don't make me laugh!

drama_dialogue2000058.ch: 蚀心殿的人渣本就当诛，没想到你还厚颜无耻冒名顶替，污蔑我道心阁。今日你葬身此处，可着实不冤，受死！
drama_dialogue2000058.en: Mindsnap Temple scum! How dare you pretend to be a Taoist Mind Pavilion member to tarnish our reputation! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue2000059.ch: 阁下身负重伤，还是速速医治为好，在下还需铲除此人余党，不便久留，告辞！
drama_dialogue2000059.en: You are heavily wounded and needs treatment as soon as possible, but I must wipe out their remnants first and can't stay here. Farewell!

drama_dialogue2000060.ch: “再不动真格的，可就小命不保了！”望着结界外施法破阵的天玄，此天宝真人焦急得额头见汗，他浑身灵力喷涌而出，已然无所保留。
drama_dialogue2000060.en: I'll be doomed if you can't do something about it!  Sage Tianbao is sweating heavily in panic as he watches Tianxuan who is casting spells outside the barrier in an attempt to break it. Tianbao has almost consumed all his Energy to hold on.

drama_dialogue2000081.ch: 唔……以在下的风水造诣，怕是错不了。
drama_dialogue2000081.en: Hm... Based on my Feng Shui, I fear there is no mistake.

drama_dialogue2000082.ch: 你在一处僻静小道行走，突然听到林中有几个黑袍人窃窃私语，他们似乎并未发现你的存在。
drama_dialogue2000082.en: You walk along a lonely path. And suddenly hear a few black-robed people whispering nearby. They seem not to have noticed you.

drama_dialogue2000083.ch: 你潜伏在暗处观察，发现这些黑袍人正在山崖下的墓穴中挖掘着什么。
drama_dialogue2000083.en: You hide in the darkness and watch them. You soon discover these people are digging up something at the cliff tomb right now.

drama_dialogue2000084.ch: 片刻后，几具尸体被黑袍人拖了出来，你隔着老远，无法看清具体样貌，只知道那确实是死人不假。
drama_dialogue2000084.en: A moment later, the black-robed people pull out several bodies. You keep your distance and cannot see the bodies' faces properly. You can only tell that they are indeed dead.

drama_dialogue2000085.ch: 那些恶人实在可恨，竟对天骄下此毒手！
drama_dialogue2000085.en: What an abhorrent crime to do this to a heaven-chosen!

drama_dialogue2000086.ch: 往日他们也只敢趁我等无法抽身之时，偷些死去多年的天骄之尸，没想到如今竟敢在光天化日下公然出手……
drama_dialogue2000086.en: They used to wait until we were occupied to steal a few long-dead bodies of the heaven-chosen. I never thought they would be so brazen as to do it in broad daylight...

drama_dialogue2000087.ch: 蚀心殿近来这般猖獗，恐怕其中有高手出世……
drama_dialogue2000087.en: The Mindsnap Temple has been so wild recently. There might be powerful beings in there...

drama_dialogue2000088.ch: 尔等勿要多言，此处乃是非之地，速速将尸体上的冥息化去，以免节外生枝！
drama_dialogue2000088.en: Thou needn't say that much. This is a troubled area. Hurry up and deal with the dark breath of the bodies lest more trouble be invited.

drama_dialogue2000090.ch: 哈哈哈哈，好一个道心阁！你们偷掘天骄尸体，以此炼制道心果，荼毒八荒修仙者，其心可诛！
drama_dialogue2000090.en: Hahaha. What a great Taoist Mind Pavilion! You dig up the bodies of the heaven-chosen and forge Taoist Fruit this way. So many tormented Cultivators. So many hearts to punish!

drama_dialogue2000091.ch: 哎呀，谁能想到，堂堂升仙大会的主办者，修仙界万人景仰的道心阁，竟是八荒的毒瘤恶疮，背地里干出此等下作行径！此事若传扬出去，啧啧啧……
drama_dialogue2000091.en: Oh dear. Who would have thought that an Immortal Tournament organizer, and a Taoist Mind Pavilion admired by many no less, would be some scourge tormenting people across the world. Tsk, tsk, tsk. If word of this gets out...

drama_dialogue2000093.ch: 正当黑袍人处理尸体之时，山崖之上突然又出现了几个黑袍人，双方剑拔弩张，眼看就要动手。
drama_dialogue2000093.en: The moment the black-robed people take care of the bodies, more black-robed people appear on the cliff. Both draw their weapons and a fight appears to be breaking out.

drama_dialogue2000094.ch: 哟哟哟，好大的脾气，让妾身瞧瞧是哪位仙师如此动怒~
drama_dialogue2000094.en: Ooh, we are in the presence of greatness, aren't we? Let me see who moves with such anger...

drama_dialogue2000096.ch: 哟，这不是小玄子嘛，多年未见，你可曾想念过妾身？
drama_dialogue2000096.en: Oh, it's you, little Xuan. It's been so long. Have you missed me?

drama_dialogue2000097.ch: 住口，你这无耻的老妖婆！

drama_dialogue2000098.ch: 哎呀，你怎会如此绝情！妾身可是时时刻刻都在挂念着我家小玄子呢~
drama_dialogue2000098.en: Aw, come on. How could you be so cold! I've always been worried about my little Xuan.

drama_dialogue2000099.en: Y-You'll pay for that with your life!

drama_dialogue2000100.ch: 山崖上下各飘飞出一道身影，二者战在一处，难舍难分。山崖上的黑袍人见状，纷纷一跃而下，朝山下黑袍人杀来。
drama_dialogue2000100.en: The figures lunge at each other from above and below the cliff. They fiercely lock into each other. Upon seeing this, the black-robed figures on the cliff jump down one by one, boring into the black-robed figures below.

drama_dialogue2000101.ch: 道友窥探多时，也是时候现身了。眼下形势紧急，还望道友勿要听信谗言，以八荒天道正义为重，助我道心阁剿灭此等奸邪之徒！
drama_dialogue2000101.en: You have watched long enough, Cultivator, and now it is time to act. The situation is dire, and I hope you will not listen to any slander. The law of the land must be upheld, and you must help me eliminate this wretched traitor!

drama_dialogue2000102.ch: 当然，这老妖婆我能够勉强应付，你只需助我门人斩杀对方其他人即可。
drama_dialogue2000102.en: Of course, I can take care of the traitor myself. It is the others in combat with my disciples whom I need you to help dispatch.

drama_dialogue2000103.ch: 哎呀，此地竟还有一位如此俊俏的人儿。不知道友可愿帮助妾身抵挡这些人面兽心之辈？若道友出手，妾身与蚀心殿必有重礼相赠！
drama_dialogue2000103.en: Well, now. It seems we still have one handsome and charming hero among us. Might you deign to help me stop these savages? I could make it worthwhile for the Mindsnap Temple if you do!

drama_dialogue2000104.ch: 那天玄有些难缠，妾身自会料理此人，你只需助我部下击杀对方其他人即可。
drama_dialogue2000104.en: Tian Xuan seems to be having some trouble. I can take care of him myself. I only need you to dispatch a few of his subordinates.

drama_dialogue2000105.ch: 道友既助我道心阁众人脱险，他日在下必有一番回报。此处有一封密函，道友按其上所言行事，自然可得机缘造化，在下还有要事在身，先行告辞了。
drama_dialogue2000105.en: I am truly indebted to you for your assistance to all of us. Here is a secret letter. If you follow its instructions, it will lead you to good luck. I have a pressing matter to attend to and must leave you now.

drama_dialogue2000106.ch: 哈哈哈，没想到道友不仅容颜俊美，实力也是威猛异常，实在甚合我意。这里有一封密函，你且按其上所言行事，你我日后自会再现，我便先走了~
drama_dialogue2000106.en: Hahaha. So there lies the heart of a lion behind that handsome face. I find that agreeable, I must say. Here is a secret letter. Just follow the instructions within. We'll meet again some day, but for now I must go...

drama_dialogue2000110.ch: ……阁下如此行为，真令妾身大失所望，妾身只好命属下好生伺候你了。
drama_dialogue2000110.en: ...You really disappointed me. I'm afraid I have to send my subordinates to handle you.

drama_dialogue2000111.ch: 阁下倒确有几番本事，这次就饶过你等一命，你我来日方长！
drama_dialogue2000111.en: You're not bad! I'll let you leave in one piece and save our duel for another day!

drama_dialogue2000112.ch: 道友既助我道心阁众人脱险，他日在下必有一番回报。此处有一封密函，道友按其上所言行事，自然可得机缘造化，在下还有要事在身，先行告辞了。
drama_dialogue2000112.en: I am truly indebted to you for your assistance to all of us. Here is a secret letter. If you follow its instructions, it will lead you to good luck. I have a pressing matter to attend to and must leave you now.

drama_dialogue2000113.ch: 下辈子记得，本领不够就别多管闲事。
drama_dialogue2000113.en: Bear this in mind, and stop being nosy in your next life.

drama_dialogue2000115.ch: 道友，你为何要弃明投暗，与我道心阁作对！
drama_dialogue2000115.en: My friend, why did you leave justice behind and join hands with the evil to fight against our Taoist Mind Pavilion?

drama_dialogue2000116.ch: 阁下为虎作伥，实为不智之举，八荒必受其害！道心阁所属，走！
drama_dialogue2000116.en: You're helping out the evil to sow the seed of devastation! A bad choice if you ask me! Taoist Mind Pavilion members, let's go!

drama_dialogue2000117.ch: 哈哈哈，没想到道友不仅容颜俊美，实力也是威猛异常，实在甚合我意。这里有一封密函，你且按其上所言行事，你我日后自会再现，我便先走了~
drama_dialogue2000117.en: Hahaha. So there lies the heart of a lion behind that handsome face. I find that agreeable, I must say. Here is a secret letter. Just follow the instructions within. We'll meet again some day, but for now I must go...

drama_dialogue2000118.ch: 在下肃清邪祟从来不留情面，阁下莫怪。
drama_dialogue2000118.en: I never show mercy to the evil. You deserve it.

drama_dialogue2000120.ch: 道友，你为何要弃明投暗，与我道心阁作对！
drama_dialogue2000120.en: My friend, why did you leave justice behind and join hands with the evil to fight against our Taoist Mind Pavilion?

drama_dialogue2000121.ch: 阁下为虎作伥，实为不智之举，八荒必受其害！道心阁所属，走！
drama_dialogue2000121.en: You're helping out the evil to sow the seed of devastation! A bad choice if you ask me! Taoist Mind Pavilion members, let's go!

drama_dialogue2000122.ch: 哈哈哈，没想到道友不仅容颜俊美，实力也是威猛异常，实在甚合我意。这里有一封密函，你且按其上所言行事，你我日后自会再现，我便先走了~
drama_dialogue2000122.en: Hahaha. So there lies the heart of a lion behind that handsome face. I find that agreeable, I must say. Here is a secret letter. Just follow the instructions within. We'll meet again some day, but for now I must go...

drama_dialogue2000123.ch: 在下肃清邪祟从来不留情面，阁下莫怪。
drama_dialogue2000123.en: I never show mercy to the evil. You deserve it.

drama_dialogue2000124.ch: ……阁下如此行为，真令妾身大失所望，妾身只好命属下好生伺候你了。
drama_dialogue2000124.en: ...You really disappointed me. I'm afraid I have to send my subordinates to handle you.

drama_dialogue2000125.ch: 阁下倒确有几番本事，这次就饶过你等一命，你我来日方长！
drama_dialogue2000125.en: You're not bad! I'll let you leave in one piece and save our duel for another day!

drama_dialogue2000126.ch: 道友既助我道心阁众人脱险，他日在下必有一番回报。此处有一封密函，道友按其上所言行事，自然可得机缘造化，在下还有要事在身，先行告辞了。
drama_dialogue2000126.en: I am truly indebted to you for your assistance to all of us. Here is a secret letter. If you follow its instructions, it will lead you to good luck. I have a pressing matter to attend to and must leave you now.

drama_dialogue2000127.ch: 下辈子记得，本领不够就别多管闲事。
drama_dialogue2000127.en: Bear this in mind, and stop being nosy in your next life.

drama_dialogue2000130.ch: “是你……”一道黑影突然出现在你的面前。
drama_dialogue2000130.en: "It's you..." A shadow sudden;y appears in front of you.

drama_dialogue2000131.ch: 几天前左护法大人还在此地等你，但似乎是听闻了什么消息，他带领几名手下前往魔族营地了……你若要找他，只管过去便是。
drama_dialogue2000131.en: The Left Protector was waiting for you here the other day. It seems he heard of some news and went with a few of his subordinates to a monster base... If you want to find him, you need only head there.

drama_dialogue2000132.ch: 魔族盘踞之所凶险万分，你还是小心为妙。
drama_dialogue2000132.en: Be wary. The realm of the monsters is extremely dangerous.

drama_dialogue2000133.ch: 几天前圣女大人还在到处找你，但似乎是听闻了什么消息，她带领几名手下前往魔族营地了……你若要找她，只管过去便是。
drama_dialogue2000133.en: The Priestess was looking for you here the other day. It seems she heard of some news and went with a few of her subordinates to a monster base... If you want to find him, you need only head there.

drama_dialogue2000134.ch: 魔族盘踞之所凶险万分，你还是小心为妙。
drama_dialogue2000134.en: Be wary. The realm of the monsters is extremely dangerous.

drama_dialogue2000135.ch: 人类，此处不是你该来的地方……不管是何缘故，还请速速离开。
drama_dialogue2000135.en: Human, this is not a place for you to come... Whatever the reason, please leave quickly.

drama_dialogue2000136.ch: 呃……原来是你，几天前确实有这么个人来过此地，似乎还是一男一女两个人一同到来的……
drama_dialogue2000136.en: Oh... It's you. There were two people like that here a few days ago. A man and a woman, I think, travelling together...

drama_dialogue2000137.ch: 那二人都不是平庸之辈，一见面就大打出手，一时间天崩地裂，连我魔族营地都震了几震……若是风前辈身在族中，想必是要去会一会这两位奇人的。
drama_dialogue2000137.en: They were no ordinary travelers. They started fighting right then and there in a great burst of violence, and even our monster base was shaken by the incident... If there were a senior among us, I'm sure they would be off to meet those two.

drama_dialogue2000138.ch: 话说，那两人似乎提到了什么“从未出现的道心”，随后见难分胜负，便往同永恒冰原的方向去了……
drama_dialogue2000138.en: Apparently the two spoke of some kind of "never-seen-before Taoist Mind." The victor seemed hard to distinguish, and they went in the direction of the Everfrost...

drama_dialogue2000139.ch: 有一人对我说，若有他人寻来，只顾告诉此人“永恒冰窟”四字即可……没想到，当今人类中还有相信我等魔族之人……
drama_dialogue2000139.en: One of them told me that if someone else comes looking, just tell them "Everfrost Cave." I never thought there were humans nowadays who believed in us monsters...

drama_dialogue2000140.ch: 来到此地，你发现了一处不寻常的冰窟，一股狂躁的灵力波动从冰窟中喷涌而出，令人心悸。
drama_dialogue2000140.en: You arrive and discover a mysterious ice cave. A fearsome wave of savage energy rushes forth from it.

drama_dialogue2000141.ch: 你进入冰窟，发现此地灵力紊乱，冰壁上满是术法留下的痕迹，地上似乎还隐约有凝固的血。
drama_dialogue2000141.en: You enter the ice cave and discover a scene of chaos within. There are traces of magic across the ice walls and what seems to be frozen blood on the ground.

drama_dialogue2000142.ch: 哼，不愧是被那家伙看重的人，倒的确有几分本事……
drama_dialogue2000142.en: Hm, as expected of a person that fellow has approved of. They do have some skills...

drama_dialogue2000144.ch: 你不必知道老夫是谁，但能通过老夫的试炼，你便拥有了获取此物的资格……
drama_dialogue2000144.en: There is no need for you to know who the old man is, but you have to pass his trial to earn the qualification to obtain this object...

drama_dialogue2000145.ch: 唉……不管给谁，那老家伙都会说我偏心……
drama_dialogue2000145.en: No... Whoever receives it, that old man will say I'm biased...

drama_dialogue2000147.ch: 你且听好，若那两个家伙无休止地争斗下去，八荒道心气运内耗衰竭，则修仙界必将遭逢变故……我想你一定知道我说的是谁……
drama_dialogue2000147.en: Listen carefully, if this constant fighting of theirs doesn't stop, it's going to tear the world inside out and bring calamity on the world of immortals... I think you know who I'm talking about...

drama_dialogue2000149.ch: 事到如今，老夫不必多作隐瞒，道心阁与蚀心殿，本是两个互不相干的势力，当然，“蚀心殿”在百年之前也还不叫这个名字……
drama_dialogue2000149.en: Things being as they are, I have no reason to hide this from you. Taoist Mind Pavilion, Mindsnap Temple... There has always been opposition between the two organizations. Of course, the Mindsnap Temple did not bear this name a hundred years ago...

drama_dialogue2000150.ch: 道心阁奉行气运生息的原则，将死去天骄的道心提取而出，归还八荒，以此滋养天地万物，促进更多天骄的诞生……以英才创盛世，自强奋发。
drama_dialogue2000150.en: The Taoist Mind Pavilion pursues life and destiny, taking the Taoist Mind of the departed heaven-chosen and returning it to the world, thus nourishing all things. They aim to create a flourishing world of excellence and self-improvement.

drama_dialogue2000151.ch: 而蚀心殿原本崇尚无为，其殿主眼见天骄在八荒横行无忌、形成阶级与压迫，便欲消除一切道心，使八荒回归本真。
drama_dialogue2000151.en: The Mindsnap Temple, on the other hand, pursues inaction. Their leader saw the Heaven-chosen's pride in the world and how it formed class and oppression. They seek to eliminate the Taoist Mind, so that the world may be returned to its true self.

drama_dialogue2000152.ch: 后来，蚀心殿中一股力量悄然发展壮大，这些人奉行融合归一的理念，将他人的道心夺为己用，以求参悟通天大道。他们以圣女为首，更改组织名称，背离了初代殿主的意愿……
drama_dialogue2000152.en: Later, a force in the Mindsnap Temple quietly grew stronger, and these people pursued the concept of fusion, appropriating others' Taoist Mind for themselves in order to comprehend the highest mastery. With the Priestess as their leader, they changed the name of their group, departing from the wishes of their original leader...

drama_dialogue2000153.ch: 自此，道心阁与蚀心殿水火不相容，其领袖也彼此斗争百年，不分胜负……
drama_dialogue2000153.en: Since then, the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple have been in conflict, and their leaders fought for a hundred years, with neither side emerging the victor...

drama_dialogue2000154.ch: 唉，此物实乃烫手山芋，你既通过老夫考验，便拿去吧，那二人的未来或许因你而变……
drama_dialogue2000154.en: Ah, this really is trouble waiting to happen. You've passed the old man's test, so take it. The future of those two might change because of you...

drama_dialogue2000157.ch: 你究竟是谁，为何会对我说出这等话语？
drama_dialogue2000157.en: Who are you? Why are you telling me this?

drama_dialogue2000158.ch: 抬头之时，方才的黑袍人竟已消失无影，而你眼前却出现了一个光团。
drama_dialogue2000158.en: When next you look up, the black-robed person is already gone and has left no trace. In front of you, now, is an orb of light.

drama_dialogue2000159.ch: 这个光团忽明忽暗、闪烁不定。你发动念力，刚想探明此物，却发现念力在接触到这光团的表面的一瞬便如同泥牛入海般不见了。
drama_dialogue2000159.en: This orb is not affected by light or darkness, and shines irregularly. You focus, and want to inspect this object, but then discover that your focus disappears with no hint of return as soon as you come into contact with the orb.

drama_dialogue2000160.ch: “此物乃是解开道心之秘的钥匙，若将其赠予那二人之一，则你将获得莫大机缘……”一道苍老的声音悠悠传来，在冰窟内回荡。
drama_dialogue2000160.en: "The object is the key to unlock the secret of the Taoist Mind. Give it to one of the two, and you will gain a great opportunity...," calls out an aged voice throughout the ice cave.

drama_dialogue2000161.ch: 莫非，这布满禁制之物，就是他们争夺的关键？
drama_dialogue2000161.en: Could this restricted item be the pivotal item they are fighting over?

drama_dialogue2000162.ch: 隐约间，天玄的虚影在你心中一闪而逝……
drama_dialogue2000162.en: In the confusion, Tianxuan's image flashes in your head...

drama_dialogue2000163.ch:
紧接着便是蝶怨……
该做出怎样的抉择呢……
drama_dialogue2000163.en:
Followed by Bitterfly...
What choice should you make...

drama_dialogue2000164.ch: 就在这时，你头顶上方落下几粒冰屑，随后但听“咔嚓”一声，冰窟顶部碎裂，一只凶兽从天而降，向你猛扑而来！
drama_dialogue2000164.en: Suddenly, a few ice chips fall over your head, and with a crack, the top of the ice cavern collapses. A ferocious beast jumps in from above and pounces on you!

drama_dialogue2000193.ch: 没想到，我道心阁费尽心机都未能得手的东西，竟然在你手里……
drama_dialogue2000193.en: I never thought that what the Taoist Mind Pavilion had failed to obtain would suddenly be in your hands...

drama_dialogue2000194.ch: 你此番前来，可是要将此物给予我道心阁？
drama_dialogue2000194.en: Have you come here to deliver this item to the Taoist Mind Pavilion?

drama_dialogue2000195.ch: 此物对我道心阁与那蚀心殿都极为重要，阁下能做出这般抉择，对我道心阁有大恩！
drama_dialogue2000195.en: This item is highly important to both us at the Taoist Mind Pavilion and those at the Mindsnap Temple. We are greatly indebted to you for this choice!

drama_dialogue2000196.ch: 既然阁下是如此深明大义之人，我道心阁自然不可把你再当作外人看待。
drama_dialogue2000196.en: With you being such a person of principle, it is only natural that we at the Taoist Mind Pavilion no longer treat you like an outsider.

drama_dialogue2000198.ch: 此乃我道心阁秘传的天机道种，不知阁下可有意传承？
drama_dialogue2000198.en: This is our secret Holy Taoist Seed. Perhaps you may be able to pass it on?

drama_dialogue2000199.ch: 只见天玄的手中，一颗皎洁无暇、流光闪烁的光团闪现，隐隐透出浩然正气，赫然是那道心阁独有的天机道种。
drama_dialogue2000199.en: You see an orb of light in Tian Xuan's hand. It radiates brilliantly and tirelessly. It lightly emits a powerful energy and is indeed the Holy Taoist Seed of the Taoist Mind Pavilion

drama_dialogue2000200.ch: 如此你便安心参悟，此地我自会留下道心阁弟子暗中护法。那蚀心殿近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我道心阁得到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，我当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000200.en: You can meditate here in peace now. I'll leave Taoist Mind Pavilion disciples here to protect you. Mindsnap Temple must be plotting against us lately. They won't just let us go now that we Taoist Mind Pavilion has this treasure. We should prepare for war in advance...

drama_dialogue2000201.ch: 你盘膝运功，感受天机道种之玄妙，不仅将其直接悟为道心，还获得了一次重塑逆天改命的机会！
drama_dialogue2000201.en: You sit cross-legged and ponder the wonders of the Taoist Seed. You gain Insight into the Taoist Mind, and also obtained a chance to Rewrite Destiny!

drama_dialogue2000202.ch: 各人都有各自秉持之道，此事倒不必强求，哈哈哈。
drama_dialogue2000202.en: All of us have our paths to hold fast to. There is no need to force this. Hahaha.

drama_dialogue2000203.ch: 既如此，在下就先行告退了，那蚀心殿近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我道心阁得到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，我当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000203.en: If this is the case, I'll leave now. The Mindsnap Temple has been acting up recently. Our Taoist Mind Pavilion has obtained this item, so they will certainly not give up. I should make preparations...

drama_dialogue2000204.ch: ……虽我道心阁不是那等夺人所爱之人，但若是此物，则也可另当别论。趁我改变主意前，快走。
drama_dialogue2000204.en: ...Although we, the Taoist Mind Pavilion, are not the sort to take loved ones from others, but if it is this object, it is a different matter. Go quickly, before I change my mind.

drama_dialogue2000208.ch: 没想到，我蚀心殿费尽心机都未能得手的东西，竟然在你手里……
drama_dialogue2000208.en: I never thought what that the Mindsnap Temple had failed to obtain would suddenly be in your hands...

drama_dialogue2000209.ch: 你此番前来，可是要将此物给予妾身？
drama_dialogue2000209.en: Have you come here to deliver this item to me?

drama_dialogue2000210.ch: 此物对我蚀心殿与那道心阁都极为重要，阁下能做出这般抉择，对妾身有大恩！
drama_dialogue2000210.en: This object is highly important to both us at the Taoist Mind Pavilion and those at the Mindsnap Temple. We are greatly indebted to you for this choice!

drama_dialogue2000211.ch: 既然阁下是如此爱憎分明之人，妾身与蚀心殿自然不可再把你当作外人看待。
drama_dialogue2000211.en: With you being a person so capable of discerning love from hate, it is only natural the Mindsnap Temple no longer treats you like an outsider.

drama_dialogue2000213.ch: 此乃我蚀心殿秘传的归一道种，不知阁下可有意传承？
drama_dialogue2000213.en: This is our secret Unique Taoist Seed. Perhaps you may be able to pass it on?

drama_dialogue2000214.ch: 只见蝶怨的手中，一颗深邃幽蓝、诡谲莫测的光团闪现，其上流光四溢，赫然是那蚀心殿独有的归一道种。
drama_dialogue2000214.en: You see a strange, deep blue orb in Bitterfly's hand. Its light permeates the entire temple, and you realize it is indeed the Unique Taoist Seed.

drama_dialogue2000215.ch: 如此你便安心参悟，此地妾身自会留下蚀心殿弟子暗中护法。那道心阁近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我蚀心殿得到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，妾身当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000215.en: You can meditate here in peace now. I'll leave Mindsnap Temple disciples here to protect you. Taoist Mind Pavilion must be plotting against us lately. They won't just let us go now that our Mindsnap Temple has this treasure. We should prepare for war in advance...

drama_dialogue2000216.ch: 你盘膝运功，感受归一道种之玄妙，不仅将其直接悟为道心，还获得了一次重塑逆天改命的机会！
drama_dialogue2000216.en: You sit cross-legged and ponder the subtleties of the Taoist Seed. You gain Insight into the Taoist Mind, and also obtained a chance to Rewrite Destiny!

drama_dialogue2000217.ch: 各人都有各自秉持之道，此事倒不必强求，哈哈哈。
drama_dialogue2000217.en: All of us have our paths to hold fast to. There is no need to force this. Hahaha.

drama_dialogue2000218.ch: 既如此，妾身就先行告退了……那道心阁近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我蚀心殿的到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，妾身当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000218.en: If this is the case, I'll leave now. The Taoist Mind Pavilion has been acting up recently. Our Mindsnap Temple has obtained this item, so they will certainly not give up. I should make preparations...

drama_dialogue2000219.ch: ……看在你主动前来的份上，妾身不便动手，下次再见之时，休怪妾身无情。
drama_dialogue2000219.en: ...On account of you taking the initiative to come to me, I will not make a move. The next time we meet, I shall show no mercy.

drama_dialogue2000220.ch: 如此你便安心参悟，此地我自会留下道心阁弟子暗中护法，那蚀心殿近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我道心阁得到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，我当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000220.en: You can meditate here in peace now. I'll leave Taoist Mind Pavilion disciples here to protect you. Mindsnap Temple must be plotting against us lately. They won't just let us go now that we Taoist Mind Pavilion has this treasure. We should prepare for war in advance...

drama_dialogue2000221.ch: 如此你便安心参悟，此地妾身自会留下蚀心殿弟子暗中护法，那道心阁近来蠢蠢欲动，如今我蚀心殿得到此物，他们必然不会善罢甘休，妾身当早做准备才是……
drama_dialogue2000221.en: You can meditate here in peace now. I'll leave Mindsnap Temple disciples here to protect you. Taoist Mind Pavilion must be plotting against us lately. They won't just let us go now that our Mindsnap Temple has this treasure. We should prepare for war in advance...

drama_dialogue2000231.ch: 这机缘一旦错过，可能今生今世便不会再有，你真的确定要放弃参悟这天机道种吗？
drama_dialogue2000231.en: If you miss this opportunity, you might never have another one throughout your life. Are you sure you don't want to study this Holy Taoist Seed?

drama_dialogue2000232.ch: 这机缘一旦错过，可能今生今世便不会再有，你真的确定要放弃参悟这归一道种吗？
drama_dialogue2000232.en: If you miss this opportunity, you might never have another one throughout your life. Are you sure you don't want to study this Unique Taoist Seed?

drama_dialogue2000250.ch: “这位道友气宇轩昂，来来来，让我天宝真人给你算一……，道友手下留情，休要动怒！”一道剑气将天宝真人的卦摊斩为两截，天宝真人吓得一个激灵，慌忙侧身躲避。
drama_dialogue2000250.en: "Now here is an imposing traveler if ever I saw one. Come here! Come here! Let me help you... Sir, no! Please, don't be hasty!" Sage Tianbao darts out of the way as a sword cuts hits stand in two.

drama_dialogue2000251.ch: 好你个牛鼻子妖道，竟敢贩卖剧毒道心果坑害于我！
drama_dialogue2000251.en: You filthy little weasel. How dare you try to sell poisoned Taoist Fruit to me!

drama_dialogue2000252.ch: 我看你是活腻歪了，平时算命骗骗钱也就罢了，这次还想要伤人性命！
drama_dialogue2000252.en: I've had more than enough of you. It's one thing to cheat people with your fortune telling, but to put them in harm's way like this!

drama_dialogue2000253.ch: 道友们，我邻居家的孩子吃了那道心果，上吐下泻了整整三天三夜，造孽啊！
drama_dialogue2000253.en: Friends, my neighbor's child has eaten one of these Taoist Fruits. He has been sick from both ends for three days and three nights now. We cannot stand for this!

drama_dialogue2000254.ch: “误会误会，都是误会！”天宝真人躲避着飞来的术法，满头大汗。
drama_dialogue2000254.en: "No! I assure you, this is a mistake!" His face drenched in sweat, Tianbao ducks for cover from a magic spell.

drama_dialogue2000256.ch: 哈哈哈，天宝你活该有此一劫，今日在下便也将往日仇怨一起算上！冲呀！
drama_dialogue2000256.en: Hahaha. How else did you think this would end, Tianbao? It's time I held you to account for my own grievances against you. Hah!

drama_dialogue2000257.ch: 近日贩卖道心果的天宝真人并非眼前这个算命的天宝真人，还请诸位认清仇家，勿要中了贼人奸计。
drama_dialogue2000257.en: The Sage Tianbao peddling Taoist Fruit is not the same Sage Tianbao you know as a fortune teller. I implore you to know your true enemy and not fall into their trap.

drama_dialogue2000258.ch: 天宝真人不堪受辱，双手掐诀发动秘术便化作一道流光遁走了，临行前还意味深长地看了你一眼……
drama_dialogue2000258.en: Unable to bear the humiliation, Tianbao clasps his hands together and turns himself into a stream of light. He glances meaningfully towards you for a fleeting moment, and then races away from the scene...

drama_dialogue2000259.ch: “我掐指一算，三月之后必有大事发生，道友尽可早做准备……”正当天宝真人消失之际，一句传音飘入了你的耳中。
drama_dialogue2000259.en: "As I count on my fingers, I predict that something significant will happen in three days' time. Be prepared, traveler..." Sage Tianbao leaves you with these words at the moment he vanishes.

drama_dialogue2000280.ch: 蚀心殿殊死一搏，倾全组织之力围攻道心阁，速至！
drama_dialogue2000280.en: The time has come for Mindsnap Temple to pit its entire forces against Taoist Mind Pavilion in a life-and-death battle. Let us be quick!

drama_dialogue2000283.ch: 虽然我不知你从何处知晓这一切，但此刻你既出现在这，便是我道心阁的天赐之人。
drama_dialogue2000283.en: I may not know how you came to know all this, but for you to appear now must mean you were sent by heaven to us at the Taoist Mind Pavilion.

drama_dialogue2000284.ch: 蝶怨，如今你狗急跳墙，竟不知死活带领组织送上门来，我道心阁全员必让你葬身于此，将蚀心殿彻底抹杀！
drama_dialogue2000284.en: So desperate are you, Bitterfly, that you lead your entire forces to our home? I will bury every last one of your people here, and end the Mindsnap Temple once and for all!

drama_dialogue2000285.ch: 哎呀，小玄子，别那么凶嘛，人家好害怕……唉，多好的一个人儿，可惜活不久了呢……
drama_dialogue2000285.en: Oof. Little Xuan, it's scary how fierce you can be... Shame such a good person won't be able to live longer...

drama_dialogue2000286.ch: 死到临头也敢调笑，在下敬你是个女英雄！
drama_dialogue2000286.en: You must be a real heroine to laugh in the face of death like that!

drama_dialogue2000287.ch: 确实，可惜了你这副好皮囊……
drama_dialogue2000287.en: A real pity, for such high quality goods like you to...

drama_dialogue2000288.ch: 道友，勿与此妖女多费口舌，为今之计，你我联手将此等八荒祸害彻底扫除，如何？
drama_dialogue2000288.en: Friend, there is no need to waste words with this wench. You and I together are enough to rid this world of all harm. What do you say?

drama_dialogue2000289.ch: 道友自信若此，想必有通天之能，在下便仰仗道友神威了！阁中弟子还需在下相助，得胜后你我再共饮！
drama_dialogue2000289.en: Judging from your confidence, you must be quite talented. I'll rely on you and your skills, then! The disciples in our pavilion still need my aid. Once we emerge victorious, let's have a celebratory drink together!

drama_dialogue2000290.ch: 好，与道友联手一战，共克八荒祸害，在下余生便也无憾了。
drama_dialogue2000290.en: All right. I'll have no regrets in this life after defeating the evil of the world with your help.

drama_dialogue2000291.ch: 呃……也罢，在下绝不强人所难，你且离去吧。
drama_dialogue2000291.en: Well... Fair enough. I cannot force you to do anything. Leave if you must.

drama_dialogue2000292.ch: 啊！是你，你果然会在妾身最需要的时候出现~
drama_dialogue2000292.en: Woah, it's you! Here you are in our hour of need!

drama_dialogue2000294.ch: 真不愧是妾身的看好之人……小玄子，你要再不挽留妾身，妾身可就要变心了哟~
drama_dialogue2000294.en: I was right to trust you. Now, little Xuan, when are you going to ask me to stay? If you don't, I just might have a change of heart...

drama_dialogue2000295.ch: 你这不知廉耻的妖妇，只会蛊惑那些道心不稳的懵懂之人，有本事就冲着我来！
drama_dialogue2000295.en: Shameless hussy! All you do is seduce the irresolute and foolish. Come at me if you dare!

drama_dialogue2000296.ch: 哎呀，羞死人了，你说什么呢~
drama_dialogue2000296.en: Aw, I'm flustered! What are you talking about?

drama_dialogue2000297.ch: 哼，废话少说，今日你既来我道心阁，就别想着回去了！
drama_dialogue2000297.en: Cut the crap. Now that you've arrived at Taoist Mind Pavilion, I'm not gonna let you leave alive!

drama_dialogue2000298.ch: 什么？你竟然想要现在就迎娶妾身？嘤嘤~
drama_dialogue2000298.en: Oh? Do you mean you want to marry me here and now? Aww!

drama_dialogue2000301.ch: 哎呀，小玄子急了！道友，你我联手对付他，此人必然不是我们的一合之敌！
drama_dialogue2000301.en: Aw, little Xuan, isn't that a bit hasty? Hey, friend, let's take him out together, friend. He's no match for us!

drama_dialogue2000302.ch: 道友自信若此，想必有通天之能，妾身便仰仗道友之神威了！门下弟子还需妾身相助，得胜后你我再共饮！
drama_dialogue2000302.en: Judging from your confidence, you must be quite talented. I'll rely on you and your skills, then! The disciples in our sect still need my aid. Once we emerge victorious, let's have a celebratory drink together!

drama_dialogue2000303.ch: 好，与道友联手一战，共克我组织宿敌，妾身余生便也无憾了。
drama_dialogue2000303.en: All right. I'll have no regrets in this life after defeating my sect's nemesis with your help.

drama_dialogue2000304.ch: 唔……也罢，妾身只是略有点失望，却不敢强人所难……你且离去吧。
drama_dialogue2000304.en: Eh... forget it. I'm slightly disappointed, but I'm not going to push you. Please take your leave.

drama_dialogue2000305.ch: 一声震天巨响传来，道心阁被夷为平地，你在剧烈的震荡中晕厥过去，醒来之时，周围已空无一人，但你清晰地记得，你胜利了……虽不知那个人现在如何，但你冥冥之中感觉，日后必有再见之时……
drama_dialogue2000305.en: Following a deafening boom, the Taoist Mind Pavilion is leveled to the ground. You lose your consciousness amidst the chaos and wake up a while later, all alone. You do remember, however, that you won the battle. You don't know how that person is now, but you have a feeling that you will meet again...

drama_dialogue2000330.en: It's been a while, my friend.

drama_dialogue2000332.ch: 正是在下！之前一战，我道心阁大获全胜，没有了蚀心殿的暗中作祟，升仙大会上能发放的道心果数量将得到大幅提升，此诚造福八荒修仙者的好事。
drama_dialogue2000332.en: The one and only. We, the Taoist Mind Pavilion, were victorious in the battle. With the Mindsnap Temple gone, the number of Taoist Fruit that can be distributed at the Immortal Tournament will have a significant increase. This is a great benefit to the world of Cultivators.

drama_dialogue2000333.ch: 但是，那妖妇蝶怨的尸首却未曾被我等寻得，恐怕是侥幸逃得了性命……
drama_dialogue2000333.en: However, we never found the body of the wicked Bitterfly. I'm afraid she may have escaped alive...

drama_dialogue2000334.ch: 八荒的长久安定，我等依旧任重道远！什么？你说那日最后出现的黑袍人？……咳咳……
drama_dialogue2000334.en: We still have a long way to go to achieve peace in the lands! What? The black-robed person who appeared at the end that day, you say? Ahem...

drama_dialogue2000336.ch: 哈哈哈，道友莫要误会，前日所战之地，乃是我阁佯装的诱饵，绝非培育道心神树之重地。
drama_dialogue2000336.en: Heh, in fact, the location we had the battle at the other day was not really the Taoist Mind Pavilion, where the Taoist Devine Tree is. It was just a decoy.

drama_dialogue2000337.ch: 此番邀请道友所去之处，才是我道心阁真正的一处分部。道友若有空前来，天玄必于其内盛情迎接！
drama_dialogue2000337.en: Now, I'm inviting you to the real Taoist Mind Pavilion... or at least a section of it. If you accept the invitation, I'll make sure you feel welcomed!

drama_dialogue2000338.ch: 道友，我就知道你一定会来的！
drama_dialogue2000338.en: I knew you'd come, my friend!

drama_dialogue2000339.ch: 这，便是我道心阁的镇阁之宝，道心神树了！
drama_dialogue2000339.en: Look, this is the Taoist Devine Tree, the most precious treasure of the Pavilion!

drama_dialogue2000340.ch: 你来到道心神树之下，感受着天道气运的流传，冥冥中有所顿悟。
drama_dialogue2000340.en: You stand under the Taoist Devine Tree, sensing the swirling auras of destiny. You end up gaining a lot of insight.

drama_dialogue2000341.ch: 原来，此树原本只是寻常的果树，却因道心阁在此地流转道心气运而近水楼台，就此得道成了灵物。
drama_dialogue2000341.en: This tree used to be an ordinary fruit tree. However, the Taoist Mind Pavilion released some Taoist Mind Destiny into the lands, and as this tree was in close proximity with the Pavilion, it ended up becoming a spiritual item.

drama_dialogue2000342.ch: 自此，其结出的果实便有使人心生顿悟之能。
drama_dialogue2000342.en: Since then, it has borne fruits of insight and inspiration.

drama_dialogue2000343.ch: 我道心阁屹立千年，少不了贤明之人的慷慨相助。自然，我等绝非忘恩负义之辈，今道友来此，在下正好有薄礼相赠，不知你可感兴趣？
drama_dialogue2000343.en: The Taoist Mind Pavilion has been standing for thousands of years, thanks to the help of wise ones. Naturally, we are not ungrateful. I happen to have a small gift for your coming today. Would you be interested?

drama_dialogue2000344.ch: 哈哈，道友来看，此乃异兽当扈，是八荒至罕之物，想必你未曾见过。
drama_dialogue2000344.en: Haha, to you, my friend, this strange beast Danghu is a rare thing of the world. You might not have seen it before.

drama_dialogue2000345.ch: 此鸟虽样貌奇特却疾如奔雷，不仅能日行万里，还可为道友寻到山野中天然诞生的道心果，只有我道心阁至亲至近之人才配拥有。
drama_dialogue2000345.en: Though this bird has a strange appearance, it is as fast as a thunderbolt. It can travel 10,000 miles in a day, and find the naturally-growing Taoist Fruit in the wilderness. Only the people close to the Taoist Mind Pavilion are worthy of possessing it.

drama_dialogue2000346.ch: 你可仔细赏玩此鸟……若有机缘，八荒山海中，你我自会再遇。
drama_dialogue2000346.en: Care for this bird and enjoy it... If opportunity allows, let us meet again in the world.

drama_dialogue2000347.ch: 没想到阁下心性寡淡、不求回报，着实是大才之相。
drama_dialogue2000347.en: I did not expect you to be indifferent and want not for return. Truly, a great talent.

drama_dialogue2000348.ch: 既如此，在下还有要事在身，便先行离去了。
drama_dialogue2000348.en: I have some other affairs to tend to, so I'll take my leave.

drama_dialogue2000349.ch: 若有缘再见，在下必与道友坐而论道、畅所欲言！
drama_dialogue2000349.en: Let's have a good debate the next time we meet!

drama_dialogue2000350.en: It's been a while, my friend.

drama_dialogue2000352.ch: ……道友，之前一战，道心阁损失惨重，然而那天玄秘法颇多，想必有活命之法，而道心阁根基深厚，也远非我蚀心殿能够抗衡……
drama_dialogue2000352.en: ...My friend, the Taoist Mind Pavilion suffered a lot of losses from the battle. Still, that Tianxuan is full of Secret Techniques, so he definitely survived. Besides, the Pavilion has a strong base, so we at Mindsnap Temple are still no match for them in our current state...

drama_dialogue2000353.ch: 恐怕此举，还未能动摇升仙大会的举办，不过他们也会受创不小，想必也拿不出多少道心果了，哈哈哈。
drama_dialogue2000353.en: I'm afraid this was not enough to shake the Immortal Tournament, but they will also be very affected. I am sure they will not be able to have many Taoist Fruits, hahaha!

drama_dialogue2000354.ch: 阁下莫要多虑，你既助妾身战胜道心阁，便对我蚀心殿有莫大恩情，妾身已将阁下列为我殿供奉之一，日后自有心意奉上，绝不比升仙大会那点道心果来得逊色……什么？你说那日最后出现的黑袍人？……咳咳……
drama_dialogue2000354.en: There is no need for you to worry. You have helped me defeat the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and done a great kindness to the Mindsnap Temple. I have listed you as one of the benefactors, and as for what we offer in future, it shall not be inferior to the Taoist Fruit of the Immortal Tournament... What? The black-robed person who appeared at the end that day, you say? Ahem...

drama_dialogue2000355.ch: 那些虚无缥缈之事便不去多想了。妾身此行前来，是想请道友去我蚀心殿内一游，妾身也有一物想赠予道友。
drama_dialogue2000355.en: Well, let's forget about questions that have no answers. I'm actually here today to invite you on a tour of Mindsnap Temple. I have a gift for you as well.

drama_dialogue2000356.ch: 道友，妾身便知你定会前来！
drama_dialogue2000356.en: I knew you'd come, my friend!

drama_dialogue2000357.ch: 这，便是我蚀心殿的镇殿之宝，归一池了！
drama_dialogue2000357.en: This is the Ward Pool, our temple's most cherished treasure.

drama_dialogue2000358.ch: 你来到归一池前，感受着天道气运的融合，冥冥中顿悟了一切。
drama_dialogue2000358.en: You stand in front of the Ward Pool, sensing the swirling auras of destiny. You end up gaining a lot of insight.

drama_dialogue2000359.ch: 原来，这归一池本就是寻常的灵池，然而，蚀心殿之人将道心气运封存在此灵池中，便孕育出了宛如浩瀚星辰般的壮阔之景。
drama_dialogue2000359.en: In fact, the Ward Pool used to be just a pool holding a slight spiritual aura. However, the Mindsnap Temple members sealed destiny in the pool, transforming it into its current vast, epic form.

drama_dialogue2000360.ch: 我蚀心殿在八荒阴影中生存，自然也不会亏待对我等有恩之人。道友，妾身有一物想赠予你，不知你意下如何？
drama_dialogue2000360.en: We, the Mindsnap Temple, survived in the shadows of the world. We will, naturally, be kind to those who have been kind to us. My friend, I have a gift for you. Would you be interested?

drama_dialogue2000361.ch: 道友上眼，此乃奇狐獙獙，是我蚀心殿的圣兽之一，与珠蟞鱼王互为左右护法。
drama_dialogue2000361.en: Look, my friend. This is a mythical Fox, one of the Guardians of the Mindsnap Temple. It is a Guardian, together with the Crab King.

drama_dialogue2000362.ch: 此兽得了一丝神兽血脉，不仅行如奔雷，还能吞噬天骄道心来将其转化为道心果，不过此举耗费颇大，一段时间内只能使用一次。
drama_dialogue2000362.en: This beast has a trace of the divine bloodline. It can move like lightning, and devour Heaven-chosen Taoist Minds to turn them into Taoist Fruit. However, this is a costly move and can only be used once in a while.

drama_dialogue2000363.ch: 道友尽管玩赏此狐，妾身还有要事，需先行离去。若有机缘，你我自会再遇。
drama_dialogue2000363.en: Care for this Fox and enjoy it. I have some important matters to tend to, so I'll be leaving first. Should opportunity allow, let's meet again.

drama_dialogue2000364.ch: 没想到阁下心性寡淡、不求回报，着实是大才之相。
drama_dialogue2000364.en: I did not expect you to be indifferent and want not for return. Truly, a great talent.

drama_dialogue2000365.ch: 既如此，妾身还有要事在身，便先行离去了。
drama_dialogue2000365.en: In any case, I have some other affairs to tend to, so I'll take my leave.

drama_dialogue2000366.ch: 若有缘再见，妾身再与道友坐而论道、畅所欲言！
drama_dialogue2000366.en: Let us have a good debate the next time we meet!

drama_dialogue2000401.ch: 此地尚有灵气残余，显然不久前有激烈的战斗发生……不过眼下这里空无一人，还是数日后再来吧。
drama_dialogue2000401.en: There is still Qi lingering around. Apparently a fierce battle was fought here not long ago... But now no one can be found here. Just come back some other day.

drama_dialogue2000411.ch: 你将灵力注入手中的玉牌，只见其上白光大放，数枚道心果悬浮而出，似乎你若能支付足够的灵石，这块玉牌便能将此道心果传送到你手中。然而，玉牌在灵力的冲击下微微颤抖，似乎无论如何选择，它都将损毁。
drama_dialogue2000411.en: You infuse Energy into the jade plaque on your palm. Blinding white light glows from it, and many Taoist Fruits float up. It seems the jade plaque will transfer the Taoist Fruit to you as long as you pay enough Spirit Stones. However, the jade plaque is vibrating under the impact of Energy, and it seems it won't survive any choice you would make.

drama_dialogue2000412.ch: 你将灵力注入手中的漆牌，只见其上乌光大放，数枚道心果悬浮而出，似乎你若能献祭一年的阳寿，这块玉牌便能将此道心果传送到你手中。然而，漆牌在灵力的冲击下微微颤抖，似乎无论如何选择，它都将损毁。
drama_dialogue2000412.en: You infuse Energy into the lacquered plaque on your palm. Blinding black light glows from it, and many Taoist Fruits float up. It seems the lacquered plaque will transfer the Taoist Fruit to you as long as you sacrifice one year of your lifespan. However, the lacquered plaque is vibrating under the impact of Energy, and it seems it won't survive any choice you would make.

drama_dialogue2000413.ch: 你满足了此牌的需要，数枚道心果应声而落，这玉牌也化为飞灰消失无影。
drama_dialogue2000413.en: You did what it asked, and several Taoist Fruits fall into your hands as the jade plaque breaks into ashes that vanish into thin air.

drama_dialogue2000414.ch: 你思前想后，还是决定把此牌收起、暂不使用，却没想到一阵微风吹过，这玉牌竟化为飞灰消失无影。
drama_dialogue2000414.en: After thinking for a while, you decided to set it aside and save it for another time, but a breeze drifts by and breaks the jade plaque into ashes that vanish into thin air.

drama_dialogue2000415.ch: 你满足了此牌的需要，数枚道心果应声而落，这漆牌也化为飞灰消失无影。
drama_dialogue2000415.en: You did what it asked, and several Taoist Fruits fall into your hands as the lacquered plaque breaks into ashes that vanish into thin air.

drama_dialogue2000416.ch: 你思前想后，还是决定把此牌收起、暂不使用，却没想到一阵微风吹过，这漆牌竟化为飞灰消失无影。
drama_dialogue2000416.en: After thinking for a while, you decided to set it aside and save it for another time, but a breeze drifts by and breaks the lacquered plaque into ashes that vanish into thin air.

drama_dialogue2000501.ch: 道友，你听说了吗，最近云陌州似有煞星降世，即便强如天骄，遇之也会暴毙身亡。
drama_dialogue2000501.en: My friend, have you heard about an evil being born in Yun Mo the other day? Even someone as strong as a Heaven-chosen can fall in its hand.

drama_dialogue2000502.ch: 真的假的！！！我读书少、胆子小，你可不要吓唬我……
drama_dialogue2000502.en: What?! I-I've never heard about such a thing. Please don't scare me...

drama_dialogue2000503.ch: 哎呀，我这可是提醒你走夜路时多加小心。若不信，你尽管去那等妖兽丛生的区域探查一番。
drama_dialogue2000503.en: Well, well, I'm just saying you should watch out while walking outside at night. If you don't believe it, you can go to those beast-infested areas just as usual!

drama_dialogue2000504.ch: 那可免了，我还想多活两年，哎，你别走那么快，等等我……
drama_dialogue2000504.en: No, no, I don't want to die yet. Hey, wait, don't leave me behind...

drama_dialogue2001001.ch: 兄弟，我已探得匪首阳泽在前方不远，听说他身怀重宝，不如我两将之击杀取走他的宝贝吧？
drama_dialogue2001001.en: Hey bro, the bandit leader Yangze is not far ahead. He has many treasures with him. How about we kill him and take his treasures?

drama_dialogue2001002.ch: （你听到前方两名修仙者正在谈论近日肆虐州中的匪首阳泽，他们正打算联手将之击杀以除州中大患。）
drama_dialogue2001002.en: (You overhear two cultivators talking about the bandit leader Yangze who has been on the rampage lately. They are planning to kill him and rid the province of this threat.)

drama_dialogue2001003.ch: （两人边说边走，片刻去得远了。这时一个高大壮硕的汉子却从小路转了出来，他背负一堆异宝走在前方，一双充满精光的眼睛四下环顾，显得十分警惕。）
drama_dialogue2001003.en: (They walk as they talk and disappear in the distance. Then a tall, brawny man appears from a lane. He is carrying a bag of treasures and watching around alertly.)

drama_dialogue2001004.ch: （突然间两名黑袍人从天而降，与阳泽交起手来。不过眨眼功夫，阳泽就被击倒在地。）
drama_dialogue2001004.en: (Suddenly two black-robed persons jump in from above and engage Yangze in a fight. Within a short time, Yangze is knocked down to the ground.)

drama_dialogue2001005.ch: 阳泽，这可总算找到你了。

drama_dialogue2001006.ch: （此时，另一名黑袍人则朗声历数阳泽二十条大罪。）
drama_dialogue2001006.en: (Another black-robed person reads aloud the twenty crimes Yangze committed.)

drama_dialogue2001007.ch: 死不足惜的东西，把这些都吃了！
drama_dialogue2001007.en: Even your death can't redeem your crimes! Eat them up!

drama_dialogue2001008.ch: 另一名黑袍人从怀中掏出一大把道心果强行塞进阳泽嘴里，强迫其全部吞下，然后一掌击在他头顶，阳泽就此俯伏地上。
drama_dialogue2001008.en: Another black-robed person produces a handful of Taoist Fruits from his inside pocket, thrusts them into Yangze's mouth to force him to swallow them, and slaps him on his head, knocking him down immediately.

drama_dialogue2001009.en: You got the scum's Taoist Mind?

drama_dialogue2001012.ch: 哼，这个恶匪倒也有点本事。我一个不慎，被他打落了面罩。
drama_dialogue2001012.en: Hmph, he's not bad. He dropped my veil in the fight.

drama_dialogue2001013.ch: 走在野外容易暴露身份，赶紧离开吧。
drama_dialogue2001013.en: We'll be spotted out here. Let's go.

drama_dialogue2001014.ch: 两名黑袍人就此离开。匪首俯伏在地，额心一个窟窿伤痕，他的背包装着刚盗取的宝物，旁边还有几枚道心果散落地上……不过这些他都无福消受了。
drama_dialogue2001014.en: The two black-robed persons have left. The bandit leader is lying prone on the ground, a hole on his forehead. His bag full of recently stolen treasures is lying beside him, and several Taoist Fruits are scattered on the ground, which he will have no chance to enjoy.

drama_dialogue2001030.ch: 你走在前方却遭遇仇人正在与旁人激斗，不过最后你的仇人被对手击败，倒在地上。而这名对手小心翼翼的上前，似乎想给你仇人最后一击。
drama_dialogue2001030.en: As you are walking, you see your enemy defeated by someone after a fierce fight. The opponent approaches your enemy carefully, ready to land the final blow.

drama_dialogue2001031.ch: 得罪了我，你可别想留全尸了……我要将你烧成灰烬……
drama_dialogue2001031.en: You won't have a whole body after crossing me... I'll burn you to ashes...

drama_dialogue2001032.ch: （眼看你的仇人便要死于非命，此时空中一个黑衣人落下出手将你仇人的对手击晕……）
drama_dialogue2001032.en: (As your enemy is about to be killed, a man in black robe falls from the sky and knocks out your enemy's opponent...)

drama_dialogue2001033.ch: 这，是我阁道心树上佳的“肥料”，岂容你任意处置？
drama_dialogue2001033.en: This is the perfect "manure" for our Taoist Mind Tree. I won't let you destroy it!

drama_dialogue2001035.ch: 你的仇人突然暴起，凌厉的杀招直逼黑袍人。而黑袍人反应极快，只一闪躲过攻势，便即出手将你仇人击倒……
drama_dialogue2001035.en: Your enemy suddenly jumps up and lunges at the black-robed person, who shuns the sneak attack and then knocks down your enemy...

drama_dialogue2001036.ch: 哼，好家伙，原来诈死想要反扑击杀对手。倒是我一时大意被你打落面罩……呵，无妨，反正你以后也没机会跟别人说了。
drama_dialogue2001036.en: Hmph, so you were feigning death for a sneak attack. I was careless to let you drop my veil... Well, you won't leave here alive to tell anyone what you saw.

drama_dialogue2001037.ch: （黑袍人一边桀桀的笑一边在你仇人的头上鼓捣什么，随即将之放回地上，这才缓缓离去。而你的仇人伏在地上，便再无动静……）
drama_dialogue2001037.en: (The black-robed person smirks as he tinkers away on your enemy's forehead, then he puts your enemy's body back to the ground before walking away slowly. Your enemy lies still on the ground, forever this time...)

drama_dialogue2001060.ch: （你看见升仙大会主持人与一名神秘黑袍人正神神秘秘的说着什么。）
drama_dialogue2001060.en: (You see the Immortal Tournament Announcer whispering something stealthily with a mysterious black-robed person.)

drama_dialogue2001061.ch: 近日蚀心殿蠢蠢欲动，似乎想要抢夺我阁道心树果实。左护法命我向你转达，要速速前往道心树处保护树上果实。
drama_dialogue2001061.en: The Mindsnap Temple is plotting against us lately. They want to snatch our Taoist Mind Tree Fruits. The Left Protector sent me to tell you to go to the Taoist Mind Tree and protect its fruits.

drama_dialogue2001063.en: The black-robed person left, and you are going to...

drama_dialogue2001064.ch: 你设法跟随，没走多远就发现两名黑袍人正在激斗。不多时，另外一名黑袍人失手落败，你跟随的黑袍人则一伸手就将落败者面罩扯落。
drama_dialogue2001064.en: You follow up and see two black-robed persons engaged in a fierce fight ahead. After a short while, the other black-robed person is defeated, and the black-robed person you are following pulls down the loser's veil.

drama_dialogue2001066.ch: 不要废话，既然败于你手要杀要剐任凭处置！
drama_dialogue2001066.en: Cut the crap! Do as you like to give me a quick death!

drama_dialogue2001067.ch: 哼，我偏不杀你。滚回去跟蝶怨那妖妇说，你失手了。
drama_dialogue2001067.en: Hmph, I won't let you die so easily. Get back to that Bitterfly hag and tell her you failed.

drama_dialogue2001068.ch: （那名黑袍人皱了皱眉，重新戴上面罩按着胸口一拐一拐的离开了……）
drama_dialogue2001068.en: (The defeated black-robed person frowns, restores the veil, and leaves with a limp...)

drama_dialogue2001069.ch: 呵，你拥有的道心长成之日可是十分难得。眼下饶你，来日却大有用处。
drama_dialogue2001069.en: Hmph, your Taoist Mind will be useful when it fully matures. I'll let you live until then.

drama_dialogue2001070.en: Stay out of trouble and leave.

drama_dialogue2001090.ch: （天空中突然霹雳乱闪，然后轰隆轰隆的爆炸声此起彼伏，仿佛山崩地裂。如此声势，附近必有大能历经雷劫。）
drama_dialogue2001090.en: (Lightning and thunder shake the sky and rock the earth. It must be someone with great power attempting a breakthrough nearby.)

drama_dialogue2001091.ch: （你来到雷击点附近，发现一个修仙者枯坐石上，天灵盖已被劈开，一阵阵灵气从中升起然后飘散。而修仙者面前还有一名黑袍人正对之细细打量。）
drama_dialogue2001091.en: (You arrive at the site struck by lightning and find a withered cultivator sitting on a rock with the skull split in halves and a wisp of Qi rising outside and evaporating. In front of the cultivator is a black-robed person who is looking at the cultivator closely.)

drama_dialogue2001092.ch: 可怜，云栖洞的碧云真君终究无法突破悟道之境。看在你一代大能的份上，在下亲自为你入土为安。想必那棵垂死的果树得了真君滋养，定能起死回生，呵呵呵呵呵……
drama_dialogue2001092.en: What a shame the Cloud Sovereign of the Cloud Cavern didn't make it to the next realm. I'll give you a worthy burial that suits your status. With your nutrition, our dying fruit tree will surely be rejuvenated, hehehehe...

drama_dialogue2001093.ch: （黑袍人伸出一手在碧云真君额头鼓捣了一阵，却突然惊呼一声疾退两步。而他的面罩亦因此掉落。）
drama_dialogue2001093.en: (The black-robed person extends a hand and tinkers away on the Cloud Sovereign's forehead, but something startles him and forces him to step back and drop his veil.)

drama_dialogue2001094.ch: 真君死后附身的雷劫残电竟如此厉害……
drama_dialogue2001094.en: The remaining lightning on his body is so powerful...

drama_dialogue2001095.ch: （黑袍人将面罩拾起重新戴上这才缓缓走开。而他远离之后，你看见地上还遗下几个奇怪果实……）
drama_dialogue2001095.en: (The black-robed person picks up his veil and puts it back before walking away slowly. After he disappears in the distance, you walk near and find several strange fruits on the ground...)

drama_dialogue2001120.ch: 吾友，日前我突破之际，遭遇土劫，侥幸不死，却从此头脑混沌记不起事情。我总觉得我的某些重要的东西放在不远处的幻虚洞，但我几番进入都找不到那件东西……你能否替我将之取回？
drama_dialogue2001120.en: My friend, my breakthrough effort the other day was interrupted by an accident which I barely survived, but it left my memory in a mess. I feel I left something important in the Illusory Cavern not far from here, but I couldn't find them myself... Could you please find them for me?

drama_dialogue2001121.ch: 你来到朋友所说的幻虚洞，然后挪开石洞巨石，发现里面竟有两枚道心果，以及黑色衣袍面罩……
drama_dialogue2001121.en: You arrive at the Illusory Cavern, pushing away a giant rock that blocks its entrance, and find two Taoist Fruits and a set of black robe and veil inside...

drama_dialogue2001122.ch: 吾友，我的头还是很痛……我记不起来……记不起来……
drama_dialogue2001122.en: My friend, my head aches badly... I can't remember anything... I can't remember anything...
