drama_dialogue2211271.ch: 阁主遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
drama_dialogue2211271.en: The Master points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

drama_dialogue2211272.ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
drama_dialogue2211272.en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

drama_dialogue2211273.ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
drama_dialogue2211273.en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.

drama_dialogue2211274.en: How did you save their lives?

drama_dialogue2211275.ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
drama_dialogue2211275.en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

drama_dialogue2211276.ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
drama_dialogue2211276.en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

drama_dialogue2211277.ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
drama_dialogue2211277.en: I may take them with me.

drama_dialogue2211278.ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
drama_dialogue2211278.en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

drama_dialogue2211279.ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
drama_dialogue2211279.en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

drama_dialogue2211280.ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
drama_dialogue2211280.en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

drama_dialogue2211282.ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
drama_dialogue2211282.en: You won't leave me behind, will you?

drama_dialogue2211283.en: I still have something to attend to.

drama_dialogue2211284.ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
drama_dialogue2211284.en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

drama_dialogue2211285.ch: 阁主看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
drama_dialogue2211285.en: The Master glares coldly at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

drama_dialogue2211311.ch: 你进入房间之后发现房间之中的摆设布置以及房间布局与之前的房间完全一样，只不过左右调转过来了。因此，这间房子就像是原来房子的镜像倒映。
drama_dialogue2211311.en: You enter the room and find that the furnishings and layout there are exactly the same as the previous room, except that the left and right sides have been reversed. This room is a mirror reflection of the first one.

drama_dialogue2211312.ch: 而你进入到，里面果然发现另外一个罗盘，打开之后，同样投映出夜雨楼的记忆投映。
drama_dialogue2211312.en: As you enter, you see another compass inside, which, when opened, also projects Night Rain's memories.

drama_dialogue2211331.ch: 琅琊阁主衡天正凭栏沉吟，屋外夜雨淅沥。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
drama_dialogue2211331.en: The Pavilion Master and Night Rain are standing side by side on a high ground and looking at a cavern in the distance.

drama_dialogue2211332.ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
drama_dialogue2211332.en: Heroes of this world? There are very few of them, and even fewer when it comes to cultivators who can achieve what you and I have achieved.

drama_dialogue2211333.en: That's good. If I'm as invincible as you, Master, I'll be fearless.

drama_dialogue2211334.ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
drama_dialogue2211334.en: Storms abound at the summit, so be careful when you reach the top. Even the best cultivator has fears. Besides, I'm far from being invincible.

drama_dialogue2211335.ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
drama_dialogue2211335.en: Seriously, Master? Nobody in this world can beat you!

drama_dialogue2211336.ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
drama_dialogue2211336.en: Not for now. But maybe there will be in the future. For example, that person.

drama_dialogue2211337.ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
drama_dialogue2211337.en: Night Rain sees a young cultivator with a bamboo hat on his back carrying things in front of a cave.

drama_dialogue2211338.ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
drama_dialogue2211338.en: That man? I know him. He's famous. But that guy is a self-important clown at best. I don't think he'll make it.

drama_dialogue2211339.ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
drama_dialogue2211339.en: I beg to differ. I find him free-spirited, upstanding, sensitive, and unique. If anyone were to be a worthy opponent of mine, it would be this man.

drama_dialogue2211340.ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
drama_dialogue2211340.en: I don't believe it. If that's the case, why don't you just kill him now to nip the threat in the bud?

drama_dialogue2211341.ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。
drama_dialogue2211341.en: You know what? Somehow I feel like this young man is quite similar to me, and maybe that's why I have high hopes for him. Alright, we need to go back.

drama_dialogue2211342.ch: 琅琊阁主衡天说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
drama_dialogue2211342.en: Oh? Now I get it. You're giving yourself a compliment, Master.

drama_dialogue2211343.ch: 阁主当先引路走在前面。夜雨楼紧随其后，走了没几步她突然回顾远处青年，目光之中分明透出一丝杀气。
drama_dialogue2211343.en: The Master leads the way and is followed by Night Rain, who looks back furiously at the young man in the distance.

drama_dialogue2211361.ch: 阁主身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
drama_dialogue2211361.en: The Master is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

drama_dialogue2211362.ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
drama_dialogue2211362.en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

drama_dialogue2211363.ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
drama_dialogue2211363.en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

drama_dialogue2211364.ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
drama_dialogue2211364.en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

drama_dialogue2211365.ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
drama_dialogue2211365.en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

drama_dialogue2211367.ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
drama_dialogue2211367.en: Since when do you have a say here?!

drama_dialogue2211368.ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
drama_dialogue2211368.en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

drama_dialogue2211369.ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
drama_dialogue2211369.en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

drama_dialogue2211372.ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
drama_dialogue2211372.en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

drama_dialogue2211373.ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。

drama_dialogue2211374.ch: 阁主没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
drama_dialogue2211374.en: The Master ignores his disciple and leaves.

drama_dialogue2211375.ch: 衡天……你就算让我死，我也会招办不误的……
drama_dialogue2211375.en: Hengtian... Even if you want me to die, I'll do it...

drama_dialogue2211401.ch: 琅琊阁主身受重伤，他目视天元山巅峰，凌厉的目光之中闪烁一丝无奈。夜雨楼从旁扶持，她看着阁主的目光则充满了温柔。
drama_dialogue2211401.en: The Pavilion Master is seriously injured and looks at the peak of Tian Yuan Mountain helplessly. Night Rain is helping him up and tender are her eyes.

drama_dialogue2211402.ch: 你快走吧。我连斗女娲、苍龙与张三，如今状态已经很差了。今日可能就要栽在张三手中了。
drama_dialogue2211402.en: Go now. I've fought Nuwa, Black Dragon, and Zhang San in a row, and I'm a mess now. Zhang San's probably going to kill me.

drama_dialogue2211403.ch: 你说什么话呢？我这就想办法将女娲苍龙一一困住。师父，这么多事我们都走过来了，今天这关也能撑过去的。
drama_dialogue2211403.en: What are you talking about? I'll try to trap Nuwa and Black Dragon. Master, we've come a long way, and we can make it this time.

drama_dialogue2211404.ch: 撑过去，不行了。张三已经有动静了。还记得很久以前，我们第一次相见时就跟你解释过了。
drama_dialogue2211404.en: It's not going to work. Zhang San is already making a move. Remember what I told you when we first met?

drama_dialogue2211405.ch: 我都记得，你说得我都记得。上下四维为宇，古往今来为宙，天元山则是连接一切位面的关键枢纽。
drama_dialogue2211405.en: I remember everything. The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects all realms.

drama_dialogue2211406.ch: 很好……很好……如今张三已将我们进入天元山的节点冻住。也就是说，天元山中就是我们的时间，但连接到八荒的，则是一万年前。
drama_dialogue2211406.en: Very good... Very good... Zhang San has frozen the time and space, where we entered Tian Yuan Mountain. That means we're now living the time inside the mountain, but the time out there is 10,000 years ago.

drama_dialogue2211407.en: What?! Why did he do that?

drama_dialogue2211408.ch: 如我所料不差，张三要与我赌命，他准备牺牲自己将我留在天元山中，然后从万年之前召来帮手给我最后一击。
drama_dialogue2211408.en: As I expected, Zhang San risks his life to trap me here in the mountain and will summon his helpers from 10,000 years ago to kill me.

drama_dialogue2211410.ch: 以你本事，如今还能冲出天元山封印，迟了就没办法了。快快离开，万勿逗留。
drama_dialogue2211410.en: But you can still break out of the seal on the mountain today. Time is not on our side. Go now.

drama_dialogue2211411.ch: 阁主说完，飞身而起往山巅上去了。夜雨楼还想留住师父，已经慢了。
drama_dialogue2211411.en: The Master then flies up to the top of the mountain. Night Rain wants to make him stay, but it's too late.

drama_dialogue2211413.ch: 师父……雨楼一路陪着你走过来，绝不会离开你的。我们生也在一起，死也在一起！
drama_dialogue2211413.en: Master... I've been with you all the way here. I'll never leave you. Even if we were to die, we would die together!

drama_dialogue2211414.ch: 张三，我就是用尽一切手段，就算身死道消，也不会让你奸计得逞的！
drama_dialogue2211414.en: Zhang San, I don't care if I die or lose all my cultivation. I'll do whatever it takes to stop you!

drama_dialogue2211431.ch: 罗盘投映出来的诸多情景似乎都是夜雨楼与一名男子往昔的点点滴滴。而她似乎是刻意将这些东西保留下来了。
drama_dialogue2211431.en: The many scenes projected by the compass look like what happened between Night Rain and a man in the past. She seemed to have deliberately kept those memories in the compass.

drama_dialogue2211432.ch: 此时四顾房中，只见左边仍有一处门廊，被封锁起来。
drama_dialogue2211432.en: You look around the room and see a closed doorway to the left.

drama_dialogue2211433.ch: 使用木簪后，通道门扉洞开，你沿路行走，来到一处山崖边上，只见远方有一村落，里面人踪迹来去，怡然自乐，彷如世外。
drama_dialogue2211433.en: You use the wooden pin and unlock the doorway. Walking down the path, you reach a cliff, where a village can be seen in the distance with people coming and going. They look relaxed and delighted as if they were out of this world.

drama_dialogue2211451.ch: 你来到村中，几名村汉立即投来奇怪目光。观其骨骼精神可知这些都并非修道之人。
drama_dialogue2211451.en: As you arrive in the village, a few villagers cast strange glances at you. You can tell that none of them are cultivators.

drama_dialogue2211452.ch: 这些村人说，他们的祖先在冥气的泄露过程中遭难，恰逢琅琊阁主营救。之后，阁主就派遣他的弟子夜仙子照顾他们。
drama_dialogue2211452.en: The villagers tell you that when their ancestors were suffering a leak of the Nether Air, the Pavilion Master came to their rescue. He also sent his disciple, Lady Night, to look after them.

drama_dialogue2211453.ch: 然则，琅琊阁主固然没有出现，夜仙子也没再前来。不过这些村民十分感激二人对他们所做的一切。他们愿意留在这片乐土中，等候二人归来。
drama_dialogue2211453.en: But neither the Master nor Lady Night showed up again. But these villagers are deeply indebted to them. They stay in this promised land in the hope that one day they will return.

drama_dialogue2211454.ch: 接待你的村民都是摇了摇头，他们认为外面的世界十分凶险。只有琅琊阁主为他们特意留下的这片土地才是真正的世外桃源。而他们只愿意留在此处。
drama_dialogue2211454.en: The villagers who receive you shake their heads. They find the world outside danger-ridden and this land that the Pavilion Master left behind for them a true paradise, so they are certainly not leaving.

drama_dialogue2211455.ch: 你正想离开之际，这些村民都纷纷向你问起琅琊阁主以及夜雨楼的行踪。
drama_dialogue2211455.en: As you are about to leave, all the villagers start to ask you about the whereabouts of the Master and Night Rain.

drama_dialogue2211456.ch: 接待你的村民都是摇了摇头，他们认为外面的世界十分凶险。只有琅琊阁主为他们特意留下的这片土地才是真正的世外桃源。而他们只愿意留在此处。
drama_dialogue2211456.en: The villagers who receive you shake their heads. They find the world outside danger-ridden and this land that the Pavilion Master left behind for them a true paradise, so they are certainly not leaving.

drama_dialogue2211457.ch: 你正想离开之际，这些村民都纷纷向你问起琅琊阁主以及夜雨楼的行踪。
drama_dialogue2211457.en: As you are about to leave, all the villagers start to ask you about the whereabouts of the Master and Night Rain.

drama_dialogue2211481.ch: 这些村民听你数说阁主的恶行，都是露出怒容纷纷驳斥于你，并将你赶离村中。
drama_dialogue2211481.en: When they hear you talking about the Master's evil deeds, they look furious, rebuke you, and shoo you out of the village immediately.

drama_dialogue2211501.ch: 这些村民听说你不知阁主行踪，都是十分伤心，纷纷痛苦流涕。似乎，琅琊阁主昔日亦曾出手救民，惠及一方。
drama_dialogue2211501.en: The villagers are upset and even cry when they learn you don't know where the Master is. It looks like they feel really beholden to him for saving their lives.

drama_dialogue2211502.ch: 这些村民越哭越是伤心，你无法劝慰，只得默默离开了此处。
drama_dialogue2211502.en: The villagers are so upset they just can't stop crying. There is nothing you can do to console them, so you have to leave.

drama_dialogue2211601.ch: 你来到夜雨楼指点的地方，只见周围遍植翠竹鲜花，更兼山环水带，景色十分优美。可以看出乃是经过精通风水之术的高人刻意布局营造的。
drama_dialogue2211601.en: You follow Night Rain's instructions and find the location, which is surrounded by bamboo, flowers, mountains, and water. It is a beautiful place and its layout was obviously designed by a Feng Shui expert.

drama_dialogue2211602.ch: 你进入房屋后，在一个抽屉之中找到一个锦盒，而盒子里面则珍而重之的包裹两层油布，掀开以后，里面是一枚刻画八荒山海形势的木雕。此物颜色深沉，十分精致，极似一支木簪。
drama_dialogue2211602.en: You enter the house and find a box in a drawer. There are two layers of oilcloth inside, and under them, you find a wooden carving depicting this world. This thing is dark in color and very well-made. It looks like a hairpin.

drama_dialogue2211603.ch: 这应该就是夜雨楼嘱托取得的木簪，这就继续登山吧？然则她的住处似乎藏有其他隐秘，我要不要再四周看看呢？
drama_dialogue2211603.en: It must be the wooden hairpin that Night Rain asked me to get. I can continue to climb the Mountain now, but there may be more secrets hidden around her residence. Perhaps I should walk around to explore before leaving here?

drama_dialogue2211800.ch: 只见夜雨楼手拿一支奇特簪子独自避在角落之中。她查看簪子时露出从未所见的温柔神情。正觉诧异之时，簪子突然发出异芒，投射出无数虚影组成的片段。
drama_dialogue2211800.en: You see Night Rain hiding in a corner with a curious hairpin in her hands. She is looking at the hairpin with a warm expression never seen before. You try to understand the strange scene, but the hairpin suddenly glows. Visios of images unfold before you.

drama_dialogue2211850.ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
drama_dialogue2211850.en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

drama_dialogue2211851.ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
drama_dialogue2211851.en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

drama_dialogue2211853.ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
drama_dialogue2211853.en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

drama_dialogue2211854.ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
drama_dialogue2211854.en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

drama_dialogue2211855.ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
drama_dialogue2211855.en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

drama_dialogue2211856.ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
drama_dialogue2211856.en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

drama_dialogue2211857.ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
drama_dialogue2211857.en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

drama_dialogue2211858.ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
drama_dialogue2211858.en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

drama_dialogue2211859.ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
drama_dialogue2211859.en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

drama_dialogue2211860.ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
drama_dialogue2211860.en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

drama_dialogue2211861.ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
drama_dialogue2211861.en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

drama_dialogue2211862.ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
drama_dialogue2211862.en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

drama_dialogue2211863.ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
drama_dialogue2211863.en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says "Nonsense" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

drama_dialogue2211864.ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
drama_dialogue2211864.en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

drama_dialogue2211865.ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
drama_dialogue2211865.en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

drama_dialogue2211866.ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
drama_dialogue2211866.en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

drama_dialogue2211867.ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
drama_dialogue2211867.en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

drama_dialogue2211900.en: Night Rain, what do you think of this technique?

drama_dialogue2211901.ch: 嗯，确实突破了悟道之境，一举踏入从未履足的新境界……只是……只是……
drama_dialogue2211901.en: Well, it did help me break through Enlightenment to a whole new realm... But... but...

drama_dialogue2211902.ch: 我知道你的忧虑。我能掌控冥气化为冥羽，你也能。但八荒修仙者未必都有这个本事掌控冥羽。
drama_dialogue2211902.en: I understand your concerns. I can transform the Nether Air into the Nether Feather and so can you. But not every cultivator in this world can do that.

drama_dialogue2211903.ch: 不错……一个不慎，冥灵错误交汇，修仙者恐遭爆体而亡之祸。
drama_dialogue2211903.en: You're right... One little error could lead to terrible deviations that threaten to blow up and kill cultivators.

drama_dialogue2211904.ch: 那么难道因为他们无法熟练掌握此法，八荒就因此停滞不前么？
drama_dialogue2211904.en: So just because they can't master this technique, the whole world has to be stuck in this impasse?

drama_dialogue2211905.ch: 嗯，我昔日以青空重瞳观风望气，隐约推知八荒终局，是毁灭……如今逃离这场灾难的唯一办法是飞升上界，离开八荒。
drama_dialogue2211905.en: I used to watch with my Sky Double Pupils and could see this world heading for destruction... Now the only way out is to leave for the upper realms and achieve ascension.

drama_dialogue2211906.ch: 不止如此，一切事物的终局都是毁灭。假使我们有幸到达上界，仍要立即设法继续飞升，直到触摸道源，摆脱万千世界的束缚。这才算是真正的“长生”。
drama_dialogue2211906.en: All things must come to an end. If we are lucky enough to reach the upper realms, we'll have to continue to ascend until we access the source of the Tao and are free from the bondage of all worlds. And that, is true "immortality".

drama_dialogue2211907.ch: 雨楼，我以为你是少数能明白我的人，如何连你也露出疑惑之色？
drama_dialogue2211907.en: Night Rain, I thought you were one of the few people who truly knew me. But why do you look so confused now?

drama_dialogue2211908.ch: 不……我只是……只是觉得您胸中所含，致广大而尽精微，无所不包，让人无法窥测。
drama_dialogue2211908.en: No... I just... realize what you have in your mind is so vast and so subtle that no one could ever decipher.

drama_dialogue2211909.ch: 任谁都有不知道的事，若有朝一日触摸道源，了解了这寰宇一切，可能你又会觉得本尊浅薄无知之至。
drama_dialogue2211909.en: We can't know everything. If you manage to access the source of the Tao and learn all the secrets about the cosmos, you may find me fairly shallow and ignorant.

drama_dialogue2211910.ch: 不，请师父将雨楼收录门下，雨楼愿意侍奉左右，以求有朝一日，得闻大道。
drama_dialogue2211910.en: No, please take me as your disciple, Master. I will serve you and learn from you on my way toward the true path.

drama_dialogue2211911.ch: 哈哈哈哈，我视你为友，你却要拜我为师吗？
drama_dialogue2211911.en: Hahahaha, I see you as a friend, but you want to be my disciple?

drama_dialogue2211912.ch: 雨楼愿执弟子礼，追随师父左右。还请师父万勿嫌弃！
drama_dialogue2211912.en: I would like to follow you as a disciple. Please don't say no, Master!

drama_dialogue2211913.ch: 夜雨楼说完，双膝一跪，竟给男子行起拜师之礼来。男子迟疑之色一闪而过，最终面对夜雨楼受了她拜师大礼。
drama_dialogue2211913.en: Night Rain kneels down and gives the man the salute of worship. The mysterious man hesitates for a moment before he accepts her salute.

drama_dialogue2211950.ch: 男子凭栏坐看屋外夜雨。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
drama_dialogue2211950.en: The man is sitting beside the rail, gazing into the night and the falling rain. Occasionally, he knocks at the rail with a finger, following the rhythm of raindrops. Night Rain is playing a guqin in the room, and hearing that, she pauses. Amid the subtle silence, she lowers her head and listens to the sounds from the man carefully.

drama_dialogue2211951.ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
drama_dialogue2211951.en: Night Rain, don't be shy. Here is your home, not mine.

drama_dialogue2211953.ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
drama_dialogue2211953.en: We will never find a solution by mere thinking as long as the upper realms are inaccessible to us. It's in vain.

drama_dialogue2211954.ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
drama_dialogue2211954.en: Master, could you please... tell me what you are thinking about?

drama_dialogue2211955.ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
drama_dialogue2211955.en: Sure. Your point of view is unique, and our thoughts will complement each other.

drama_dialogue2211956.ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
drama_dialogue2211956.en: Remember the Tao's source I mentioned to you last time? It's a mysterious being from which we can learn about the true path and the truth of the universe. However, the source of the Tao also needs us. Every time when new insights emerge in our minds, the Tao's source will try to absorb them.

drama_dialogue2211957.ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
drama_dialogue2211957.en: And by doing that, the Tao's source continues to improve itself. It will also draw worlds with plenty of insights closer.

drama_dialogue2211958.ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
drama_dialogue2211958.en: That's to say, a world with more insights will be more attractive to the Tao's source, and even the source of the Tao itself may get closer to the world by moving through dimensions. Once the world is close enough to the Tao's source, the gateway to ascension will open.

drama_dialogue2211959.ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
drama_dialogue2211959.en: And Tian Yuan Mountain is the gateway. It's the point where the Tao's source attracts various dimensions and realms. See? We always think that the Tao's source contains all the truths of the cosmos, but even the source itself is not perfect. It tells us about the world, and our insights improve it in turn.

drama_dialogue2211960.ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。

drama_dialogue2211961.ch: 男子说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
drama_dialogue2211961.en: The man finishes speaking. He continues to knock with his fingers, and Night Rain knows he must begin to think about arcane matters again. She folds her sleeves and sits straight beside him, glimpsing the man with a sweet smile.

drama_dialogue2212000.ch: 男子遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
drama_dialogue2212000.en: The man points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

drama_dialogue2212001.ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
drama_dialogue2212001.en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

drama_dialogue2212002.ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
drama_dialogue2212002.en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.

drama_dialogue2212003.en: How did you save their lives?

drama_dialogue2212004.ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
drama_dialogue2212004.en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

drama_dialogue2212005.ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
drama_dialogue2212005.en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

drama_dialogue2212006.ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
drama_dialogue2212006.en: I may take them with me.

drama_dialogue2212007.ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
drama_dialogue2212007.en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

drama_dialogue2212008.ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
drama_dialogue2212008.en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

drama_dialogue2212009.ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
drama_dialogue2212009.en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

drama_dialogue2212011.ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
drama_dialogue2212011.en: You won't leave me behind, will you?

drama_dialogue2212012.en: I still have something to attend to.

drama_dialogue2212013.ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
drama_dialogue2212013.en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

drama_dialogue2212014.ch: 男子看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
drama_dialogue2212014.en: The man glares at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

drama_dialogue2212050.ch: 男子身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
drama_dialogue2212050.en: The man is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

drama_dialogue2212051.ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
drama_dialogue2212051.en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

drama_dialogue2212052.ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
drama_dialogue2212052.en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

drama_dialogue2212053.ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
drama_dialogue2212053.en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

drama_dialogue2212054.ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
drama_dialogue2212054.en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

drama_dialogue2212056.ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
drama_dialogue2212056.en: Since when do you have a say here?!

drama_dialogue2212057.ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
drama_dialogue2212057.en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

drama_dialogue2212058.ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
drama_dialogue2212058.en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

drama_dialogue2212061.ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
drama_dialogue2212061.en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

drama_dialogue2212062.ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。

drama_dialogue2212063.ch: 男子没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
drama_dialogue2212063.en: The man ignores his disciple and leaves.

drama_dialogue2212100.ch: 你拿出木簪摸索把玩，未料此物竟突然发出异芒，投射出无数虚影组成的片段。
drama_dialogue2212100.en: You take out the wooden hairpin for inspection, but suddenly a strange glow emits from it. Visions of images unfold before you.

drama_dialogue2212150.ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
drama_dialogue2212150.en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

drama_dialogue2212151.ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
drama_dialogue2212151.en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

drama_dialogue2212153.ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
drama_dialogue2212153.en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

drama_dialogue2212154.ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
drama_dialogue2212154.en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

drama_dialogue2212155.ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
drama_dialogue2212155.en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

drama_dialogue2212156.ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
drama_dialogue2212156.en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

drama_dialogue2212157.ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
drama_dialogue2212157.en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

drama_dialogue2212158.ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
drama_dialogue2212158.en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

drama_dialogue2212159.ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
drama_dialogue2212159.en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

drama_dialogue2212160.ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
drama_dialogue2212160.en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

drama_dialogue2212161.ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
drama_dialogue2212161.en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

drama_dialogue2212162.ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
drama_dialogue2212162.en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

drama_dialogue2212163.ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
drama_dialogue2212163.en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says "Nonsense" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

drama_dialogue2212164.ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
drama_dialogue2212164.en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

drama_dialogue2212165.ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
drama_dialogue2212165.en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

drama_dialogue2212166.ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
drama_dialogue2212166.en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

drama_dialogue2212167.ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
drama_dialogue2212167.en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

drama_dialogue2212200.en: Night Rain, what do you think of this technique?

drama_dialogue2212201.ch: 嗯，确实突破了悟道之境，一举踏入从未履足的新境界……只是……只是……
drama_dialogue2212201.en: Well, it did help me break through Enlightenment to a whole new realm... But... but...

drama_dialogue2212202.ch: 我知道你的忧虑。我能掌控冥气化为冥羽，你也能。但八荒修仙者未必都有这个本事掌控冥羽。
drama_dialogue2212202.en: I understand your concerns. I can transform the Nether Air into the Nether Feather and so can you. But not every cultivator in this world can do that.

drama_dialogue2212203.ch: 不错……一个不慎，冥灵错误交汇，修仙者恐遭爆体而亡之祸。
drama_dialogue2212203.en: You're right... One little error could lead to terrible deviations that threaten to blow up and kill cultivators.

drama_dialogue2212204.ch: 那么难道因为他们无法熟练掌握此法，八荒就因此停滞不前么？
drama_dialogue2212204.en: So just because they can't master this technique, the whole world has to be stuck in this impasse?

drama_dialogue2212205.ch: 嗯，我昔日以青空重瞳观风望气，隐约推知八荒终局，是毁灭……如今逃离这场灾难的唯一办法是飞升上界，离开八荒。
drama_dialogue2212205.en: I used to watch with my Sky Double Pupils and could see this world heading for destruction... Now the only way out is to leave for the upper realms and achieve ascension.

drama_dialogue2212206.ch: 不止如此，一切事物的终局都是毁灭。假使我们有幸到达上界，仍要立即设法继续飞升，直到触摸道源，摆脱万千世界的束缚。这才算是真正的“长生”。
drama_dialogue2212206.en: All things must come to an end. If we are lucky enough to reach the upper realms, we'll have to continue to ascend until we access the source of the Tao and are free from the bondage of all worlds. And that, is true "immortality".

drama_dialogue2212207.ch: 雨楼，我以为你是少数能明白我的人，如何连你也露出疑惑之色？
drama_dialogue2212207.en: Night Rain, I thought you were one of the few people who truly knew me. But why do you look so confused now?

drama_dialogue2212208.ch: 不……我只是……只是觉得您胸中所含，致广大而尽精微，无所不包，让人无法窥测。
drama_dialogue2212208.en: No... I just... realize what you have in your mind is so vast and so subtle that no one could ever decipher.

drama_dialogue2212209.ch: 任谁都有不知道的事，若有朝一日触摸道源，了解了这寰宇一切，可能你又会觉得本尊浅薄无知之至。
drama_dialogue2212209.en: We can't know everything. If you manage to access the source of the Tao and learn all the secrets about the cosmos, you may find me fairly shallow and ignorant.

drama_dialogue2212210.ch: 不，请师父将雨楼收录门下，雨楼愿意侍奉左右，以求有朝一日，得闻大道。
drama_dialogue2212210.en: No, please take me as your disciple, Master. I will serve you and learn from you on my way toward the true path.

drama_dialogue2212211.ch: 哈哈哈哈，我视你为友，你却要拜我为师吗？
drama_dialogue2212211.en: Hahahaha, I see you as a friend, but you want to be my disciple?

drama_dialogue2212212.ch: 雨楼愿执弟子礼，追随师父左右。还请师父万勿嫌弃！
drama_dialogue2212212.en: I would like to follow you as a disciple. Please don't say no, Master!

drama_dialogue2212213.ch: 夜雨楼说完，双膝一跪，竟给男子行拜师之礼。男子迟疑之色一闪而过，最终面对夜雨楼受了她拜师大礼。
drama_dialogue2212213.en: Night Rain kneels down and gives the man the salute of worship. The mysterious man hesitates for a moment before he accepts her salute.

drama_dialogue2212250.ch: 男子正凭栏坐看屋外夜雨。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
drama_dialogue2212250.en: The man is sitting beside the rail, gazing into the night and the falling rain. Occasionally, he knocks at the rail with a finger, following the rhythm of raindrops. Night Rain is playing a guqin in the room, and hearing that, she pauses. Amid the subtle silence, she lowers her head and listens to the sounds from the man carefully.

drama_dialogue2212251.ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
drama_dialogue2212251.en: Night Rain, don't be shy. Here is your home, not mine.

drama_dialogue2212253.ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
drama_dialogue2212253.en: We will never find a solution by mere thinking as long as the upper realms are inaccessible to us. It's in vain.

drama_dialogue2212254.ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
drama_dialogue2212254.en: Master, could you please... tell me what you are thinking about?

drama_dialogue2212255.ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
drama_dialogue2212255.en: Sure. Your point of view is unique, and our thoughts will complement each other.

drama_dialogue2212256.ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
drama_dialogue2212256.en: Remember the Tao's source I mentioned to you last time? It's a mysterious being from which we can learn about the true path and the truth of the universe. However, the source of the Tao also needs us. Every time when new insights emerge in our minds, the Tao's source will try to absorb them.

drama_dialogue2212257.ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
drama_dialogue2212257.en: And by doing that, the Tao's source continues to improve itself. It will also draw worlds with plenty of insights closer.

drama_dialogue2212258.ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
drama_dialogue2212258.en: That's to say, a world with more insights will be more attractive to the Tao's source, and even the source of the Tao itself may get closer to the world by moving through dimensions. Once the world is close enough to the Tao's source, the gateway to ascension will open.

drama_dialogue2212259.ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
drama_dialogue2212259.en: And Tian Yuan Mountain is the gateway. It's the point where the Tao's source attracts various dimensions and realms. See? We always think that the Tao's source contains all the truths of the cosmos, but even the source itself is not perfect. It tells us about the world, and our insights improve it in turn.

drama_dialogue2212260.ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。

drama_dialogue2212261.ch: 男子说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
drama_dialogue2212261.en: The man finishes speaking. He continues to knock with his fingers, and Night Rain knows he must begin to think about arcane matters again. She folds her sleeves and sits straight beside him, glimpsing the man with a sweet smile.

drama_dialogue2212300.ch: 男子遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
drama_dialogue2212300.en: The man points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

drama_dialogue2212301.ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
drama_dialogue2212301.en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

drama_dialogue2212302.ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
drama_dialogue2212302.en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.

drama_dialogue2212303.en: How did you save their lives?

drama_dialogue2212304.ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
drama_dialogue2212304.en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

drama_dialogue2212305.ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
drama_dialogue2212305.en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

drama_dialogue2212306.ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
drama_dialogue2212306.en: I may take them with me.

drama_dialogue2212307.ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
drama_dialogue2212307.en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

drama_dialogue2212308.ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
drama_dialogue2212308.en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

drama_dialogue2212309.ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
drama_dialogue2212309.en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

drama_dialogue2212311.ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
drama_dialogue2212311.en: You won't leave me behind, will you?

drama_dialogue2212312.en: I still have something to attend to.

drama_dialogue2212313.ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
drama_dialogue2212313.en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

drama_dialogue2212314.ch: 男子看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
drama_dialogue2212314.en: The man glares at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

drama_dialogue2212350.ch: 男子身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
drama_dialogue2212350.en: The man is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

drama_dialogue2212351.ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
drama_dialogue2212351.en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

drama_dialogue2212352.ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
drama_dialogue2212352.en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

drama_dialogue2212353.ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
drama_dialogue2212353.en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

drama_dialogue2212354.ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
drama_dialogue2212354.en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

drama_dialogue2212356.ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
drama_dialogue2212356.en: Since when do you have a say here?!

drama_dialogue2212357.ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
drama_dialogue2212357.en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

drama_dialogue2212358.ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
drama_dialogue2212358.en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

drama_dialogue2212361.ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
drama_dialogue2212361.en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

drama_dialogue2212362.ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。

drama_dialogue2212363.ch: 男子没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
drama_dialogue2212363.en: The man ignores his disciple and leaves.

drama_dialogue2212400.ch: 道友，此处封印十分霸道，对修仙者有害无益，你还是赶快离开此处，绕道再继续登山吧。
drama_dialogue2212400.en: Good cultivator, the seal here is too overwhelming. It will hurt you if you continue to go from here. Please pick another route if you can.

drama_dialogue2212401.ch: 你身上气运全赖所服丹药以及我重瞳激发药力聚成，消散极快。若气运消失，不妨重新回到此处，我能以重瞳之力，再次为你激发药力。
drama_dialogue2212401.en: The destiny on you is from the elixir you took and the power of my double pupils. It will soon disperse, but don't worry. I'll activate the elixir's power for you again if you find its effect is gone.

drama_dialogue2212402.ch: 夜雨楼说完此话便转身走开，一个人避在远处。
drama_dialogue2212402.en: Night Rain finishes speaking and steps away into the distance.

drama_dialogue2212403.ch: 只见她停在远方背对着你，然后温柔地凝视一支从怀中摸出的簪子。片刻后这支簪子生出重重幻象投射于虚空之中。
drama_dialogue2212403.en: She stops somewhere far from you, leaving you behind her back. She seems to be looking at a hairpin tenderly, and soon, views begin to emerge from the curious object and unfold in nothingness.

drama_dialogue2212404.ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
drama_dialogue2212404.en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

drama_dialogue2212405.ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
drama_dialogue2212405.en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

drama_dialogue2212407.ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
drama_dialogue2212407.en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

drama_dialogue2212408.ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
drama_dialogue2212408.en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

drama_dialogue2212409.ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
drama_dialogue2212409.en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

drama_dialogue2212410.ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
drama_dialogue2212410.en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

drama_dialogue2212411.ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
drama_dialogue2212411.en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

drama_dialogue2212412.ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
drama_dialogue2212412.en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

drama_dialogue2212413.ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
drama_dialogue2212413.en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

drama_dialogue2212414.ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
drama_dialogue2212414.en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

drama_dialogue2212415.ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
drama_dialogue2212415.en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

drama_dialogue2212416.ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
drama_dialogue2212416.en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

drama_dialogue2212417.ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
drama_dialogue2212417.en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says "Nonsense" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

drama_dialogue2212418.ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
drama_dialogue2212418.en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

drama_dialogue2212419.ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
drama_dialogue2212419.en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

drama_dialogue2212420.ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
drama_dialogue2212420.en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

drama_dialogue2212421.ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
drama_dialogue2212421.en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

drama_dialogue2212450.ch: 天元山上的传送阵竟直通山下？嗯，山上大事未了，应该养精蓄锐，继续探索山上奥秘。
drama_dialogue2212450.en: To my surprise, the portal on Tian Yuan Mountain leads to somewhere at its foot. Well, urgent matters are calling me there, and I should keep myself in good condition to continue my journey.

drama_dialogue2212451.ch: 但夜雨楼刚才查看发簪时故意避开我，而那支发簪能显出无数虚象片段，应是藏有许多秘密，我要不要<r>回去夜雨楼那里查探一下</r>呢？
drama_dialogue2212451.en: But Night Rain steps away from me before starting to inspect her hairpin, and I see many visions emerge from it. It must contain many secrets. Should I <r>come back to Night Rain and investigate</r>?

drama_dialogue2212452.ch: 天元山中，充满了未知之数，由我以重瞳之力为你聚成气运，稍微提升一下你的实力吧。
drama_dialogue2212452.en: Various dangers lurk in Tian Yuan Mountain. Here, I'll grant you a destiny. I condensed it using my power of double pupils, and it may enhance you a bit.

drama_dialogue2212470.ch: 天元山上的传送阵竟直通山下？嗯，山上大事未了，应该养精蓄锐，继续探索山上奥秘。
drama_dialogue2212470.en: To my surprise, the portal on Tian Yuan Mountain leads to somewhere at its foot. Well, urgent matters are calling me there, and I should keep myself in good condition to continue my journey.

drama_dialogue2212471.ch: 你正计划接下来的事情，刚从夜雨楼手中取得的簪子却突然透出光芒，无数虚影浮于眼前组成一段事件片段。
drama_dialogue2212471.en: You're thinking about the next step while the hairpin from Night Rain suddenly glows. Images float into the air, and you see a vision of the past unfold before you.

drama_dialogue2212472.ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
drama_dialogue2212472.en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

drama_dialogue2212473.en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

drama_dialogue2212482.ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
drama_dialogue2212482.en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

drama_dialogue2212483.ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
drama_dialogue2212483.en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

drama_dialogue2212484.ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
drama_dialogue2212484.en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

drama_dialogue2212485.ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
drama_dialogue2212485.en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says "Nonsense" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

drama_dialogue2212486.ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
drama_dialogue2212486.en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

drama_dialogue2212487.ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
drama_dialogue2212487.en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

drama_dialogue2212488.ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
drama_dialogue2212488.en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

drama_dialogue2212489.ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
drama_dialogue2212489.en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

drama_dialogue2212490.ch: 这支发簪十分古怪，<r>当中或藏有许多不为人知的秘密，要不要先查看一下呢</r>？
drama_dialogue2212490.en: This hairpin is so strange. <r>It must contain many secrets. Should I inspect it first</r>?

drama_dialogue2220001.ch: 哦？是你。呵呵，这便是张三的安排吗？
drama_dialogue2220001.en: Oh? It's you. Hmph, so is this all Zhang San's plan?

drama_dialogue2220002.en: It's been a long time, my friend. Do you still remember me?

drama_dialogue2220003.ch: 还记得吗？云陌异族，风氏燧人；
drama_dialogue2220003.en: Well. Remember? I'm from the Feng Clan, the alien race in Yun Mo.

drama_dialogue2220004.ch: 后世称我为女娲，而昔日族中，大家都叫我风里希。
drama_dialogue2220004.en: I'm known as Nuwa now, but in the old days, my fellow clansmen called me Feng Lixi.

drama_dialogue2220005.ch: 嗯，原来如此。想必日前天元山发生剧变，生成结界，导致天元山通道接向旧日八荒。如此说来，你我已约有万年不曾见面了，难怪你已不记得我了。
drama_dialogue2220005.en: It's not surprising to know that you can't recall me. In your eyes, I am just an old friend. But from my point of view, our story took place a long time ago. We haven't seen each other for at least 100,000 years, I guess?

drama_dialogue2220006.ch: 风里希叮嘱继续上山需要先行参悟第十三律，要不要先到她提及的地方查探一下呢？
drama_dialogue2220006.en: Feng Lixi insisted that one must learn the Thirteenth Verse before venturing up the mountain. Perhaps it would be wise to go check the place she spoke of?

drama_dialogue2220021.ch: 我受张三所托，在此接引前来的修仙者。
drama_dialogue2220021.en: Zhang San asked me to stay here and guide the visiting cultivator.

drama_dialogue2220022.ch: 如今你在天元山中，时刻受到影响，待我为你唤醒道心，再作前行吧。
drama_dialogue2220022.en: Now that you're in Tian Yuan Mountain, you're under the influence. Let me elevate your Taoist Mind before you move forward.

drama_dialogue2220023.ch: 不过，唤醒道心非同一般，需要你我全力激战之际，以我体内盘古真血点燃你蕴藏道心。因此你将与我一战。此战我不会留手，也请你万勿轻忽。
drama_dialogue2220023.en: But the elevation requires extraordinary efforts. I need to ignite your hidden Taoist Mind with the true blood of Pangu in my body while you and I are having a duel. So I'll do my best to fight you, and so should you.

drama_dialogue2220041.ch: 不错，你的实力已远超我的想象。
drama_dialogue2220041.en: Very well. You're way more powerful than I expected.

drama_dialogue2220042.ch: 后面的路由张三挚友苍龙镇守，苍龙与张三情谊深厚，如你贸然经过，恐怕他会将你视为前来闯关救主的琅琊阁人。
drama_dialogue2220042.en: The road ahead is guarded by Black Dragon, Zhang San's best friend. If you are to pass there unannounced, he'll probably think you're a member of Manual Pavilion to save the Master.

drama_dialogue2220043.ch: 张三与苍龙相交之际，曾以第十三律引起苍龙注意，苍龙得闻天籁，而张三喜获知音。是故这第十三律对于苍龙意义非凡。
drama_dialogue2220043.en: When Zhang San met Black Dragon, he played the Thirteenth Verse to attract Black Dragon's attention. Black Dragon heard the beautiful ethereal music, while Zhang San found a like-minded friend. That's why the Thirteenth Verse is of great significance to Black Dragon.

drama_dialogue2220044.ch: 而我手中玉笛则是参悟第十三律的关键。因此，张三曾以神念嘱托，希望我将玉笛转赠来者。来人悟得第十三律，即往后方雾海烟渚吹奏。苍龙闻声，自会明白一切。
drama_dialogue2220044.en: And the jade flute is the key to understanding the Thirteenth Verse. Therefore, one of Zhang San's souls asked me to gift the flute to the visitor. When the person fully grasps the Thirteenth Verse and plays it in the Sandbank of Mist behind, Black Dragon would hear it and know everything.

drama_dialogue2220045.ch: 至于第十三律，我始终无法窥破，因此不能助你参悟此律。但我听闻当日张三曾于一个神秘竹林中，斫竹钻孔，创制第十三律。
drama_dialogue2220045.en: But the Thirteenth Verse is too arcane for me to grasp, so you need to figure it out alone. However, I've heard that it was composed by Zhang San in a mysterious bamboo forest by making holes in the bamboo there.

drama_dialogue2220046.ch: 据我所知，开天元音，远古希声，起于八荒形成之初，而第十三律亦据此推演所得。
drama_dialogue2220046.en: As far as I know, the Thirteenth Verse derives from the ancient sound of creation, which emerged at the birth of this world.

drama_dialogue2220047.ch: 而我昔日曾在一处名为“幽篁”的洞天之中，发现远古希声。你前去一探，或能有所发现。
drama_dialogue2220047.en: I found the ancient sound in a cave called You Huang. Maybe you'll find something there after inspection.

drama_dialogue2220048.ch: 唉，这玉笛原本就是当年机缘巧合下从你手中取走的，现在几经波折，总算兑现承诺将之归还你手了。
drama_dialogue2220048.en: Well, it's quite a coincidence that I got the jade flute from you back then, and now, after many turns of fate, I've kept my promise and returned it to you.

drama_dialogue2220061.ch: 你脸现疑惑，想必心中有许多疑问。可是有什么想问吗？
drama_dialogue2220061.en: I see you frowning with confusion. Feel free to ask me any questions.

drama_dialogue2220081.ch: 单从我口中并不能了解张三。要了解他，还是由你亲眼去看看为好。
drama_dialogue2220081.en: You can't really know Zhang San from what I say. So it's best for you to meet him and see for yourself.

drama_dialogue2220082.ch: 听闻远古之际，夸父族长昭灵曾在一处遗迹中篆刻壁画预言未来之事，壁画前留有梦尘匣数个，专为印证预言真伪，该匣开启后即能看见张三之事。
drama_dialogue2220082.en: I heard that in ancient times, Zhao Ling, the chief of the Kuafu Clan, had created murals in the ruins to predict the future. Below the murals are several Dream Dust Boxes, designed to prove his prophecies. Open the boxes and you'll learn Zhang San's stories.

drama_dialogue2220083.ch: 你若想了解张三，不妨前往遗迹一探。
drama_dialogue2220083.en: If you want to know what kind of person Zhang San is, go to the ruins.

drama_dialogue2220090.ch: 那就好。八荒危难，急如星火，还盼你尽快参悟第十三律，赶往山顶。
drama_dialogue2220090.en: Alright. The world is facing imminent destruction. Please comprehend the Thirteenth Verse and climb up to the Mountain's top as soon as possible.

drama_dialogue22201.ch: 今日大喜！整个城镇早早就被装饰成了一派喜庆的氛围！各路亲朋好友也驾乘着祥云瑞兽前来参加你们的结亲仪式！
drama_dialogue22201.en: It's your big day! The whole town has turned out for it! Friends and family riding fantastic palanquins gather to attend your wedding ceremony!

drama_dialogue22202.ch: 在各路亲朋好友的见证和祝福之下，你们许下了山盟海誓，正式结成了夫妻！
drama_dialogue22202.en: Under the adoring gaze of friends and family you make your solemn vows and formally tie the knot!

drama_dialogue2221001.ch: 只见前方风允婼神情警惕，四处张望；而你的接近亦马上引起他的注意。
drama_dialogue2221001.en: Feng Yunchuo is looking around warily and sees you approach him immediately.

drama_dialogue2221003.ch: 唉，小女风里希突然瞒着我来到此处，如今不知去向。让我好生担心。
drama_dialogue2221003.en: Alas, Feng Lixi sneaked out. I thought she was here, but she's not. I'm looking for my daughter.

drama_dialogue2221004.ch: 风允婼突然神情变得十分专注，双眼看向前方，他略一思索后便即急步而去。
drama_dialogue2221004.en: Feng Yunchuo suddenly becomes very focused and looks ahead. After contemplating for a while, he rushes off.

drama_dialogue2221021.ch: 你跟随风允婼进入一片茂密竹林之中，只转了几转便失去了风允婼踪影。不过此时远方突然有人出声示警。
drama_dialogue2221021.en: You follow Feng Yunchuo into a dense bamboo forest but soon lose sight of him. Then someone in the distance suddenly speaks out.

drama_dialogue2221023.ch: 你所在地方突然黑影隆起，一只庞大的妖兽立在前方，对你嘶吼咆哮。
drama_dialogue2221023.en: A dark shadow rises. A huge monster towers above you, hissing and roaring.

drama_dialogue2221041.ch: 你将妖兽击败，未料只眨眼之间，妖兽重新聚合，恢复原形。
drama_dialogue2221041.en: You defeat the monster, but in the blink of an eye, it reshapes into its original self.

drama_dialogue2221042.ch: 此妖需以特殊方法击杀，平常武技灵技，奈何不得！唉，不得已，只好强行试试！
drama_dialogue2221042.en: This thing can't be killed without a special technique. Normal martial skills don't work! Fine, I have to give it a go!

drama_dialogue2221043.ch: 从旁出现的风里希念动咒诀，之后幽深竹林之中刮起狂风。而风声穿过周围竹子竟发出阵阵怪声。与此同时，你身上玉笛亦发出一丝若有若无的异响。
drama_dialogue2221043.en: Feng Lixi shows up from the side and casts spells, after which a gust sweeps the bamboo forest and makes a strange sound through the surrounding bamboo. At the same time, your jade flute makes an unusual and inexplicable sound

drama_dialogue2221044.ch: 啊？！这！可以给我看看那笛子吗？
drama_dialogue2221044.en: What?! Can I see your flute?

drama_dialogue2221045.ch: 你才将笛子交到风里希手中，前方妖兽已张开血盘之口，挥爪朝你两抓来。风里希闪身避过。但你两却因此被妖兽分隔开去。
drama_dialogue2221045.en: Just as you hand the flute to Feng Lixi, the monster opens its giant mouth and swings its claws. Feng Lixi dodges them, but the two of you are separated by the monster.

drama_dialogue2221046.ch: 这……管不了那么多了！你看看你身边一根翠竹，上面已有若干刻度。请你依我所说在上面分别洞穿孔窍！
drama_dialogue2221046.en: I... We have no choice! See the scales on the bamboo there? Make holes on it!

drama_dialogue2221047.ch: 你穿孔已毕，风里希再起风咒，那根竹子发出的声音越发古怪。时而仿佛编钟激响，震耳欲聋，时而又似呢喃细语，几不可闻。那妖兽闻此怪响十分难受，竟一把将风里希抓了起来。
drama_dialogue2221047.en: When you've finished making the holes, Feng Lixi casts spells again and the bamboo starts to make more and more strange sounds. Sometimes it sounds like a deafening chime, and sometimes, an almost inaudible whisper. The sound infuriates the monster and it grabs Feng Lixi with one claw.

drama_dialogue2221048.ch: 我……我无法施法，请你在末尾再开一孔，距离对上一孔约差三分！孔窍开毕，再以一口真元吹响竹管！
drama_dialogue2221048.en: I... can't cast a spell now. Make another hole at the end of the bamboo, about three inches away from the previous one! Then blow the bamboo pipe with your true Yuan!

drama_dialogue2221049.ch: 你含着一口真元对着竹管吹孔喷出，异响再次发出，同时周围竹管纷纷断折，周边实地亦陆续开裂，喷出熔岩。
drama_dialogue2221049.en: You use your true Yuan to blow the pipe. Once again, it makes a strange sound, while all the surrounding bamboo breaks and the ground cracks, spewing out lava.

drama_dialogue2221050.ch: 妖兽受怪响波及，痛苦难当，终于松开抓住风里希的大手。此时风允婼突然出现将妖兽制服。风里希眼看父亲现身，忙取匕首割下妖兽身上一物后迅速逃离。
drama_dialogue2221050.en: The monster is in great pain amid the strange sound and lets go of Feng Lixi. At that moment, Feng Yunchuo suddenly shows up and contains the monster. When Feng Lixi sees her father, she cuts off something from the monster's body with a dagger and flees.

drama_dialogue2221052.ch: 风允婼眼看女儿遁去，忙急步追赶，二人眨眼间就没了踪影。周围一切亦尽归平静，只余竹管所发余音仍未散去。
drama_dialogue2221052.en: As his daughter disappears, Feng Yunchuo hurries to go after her. Both of them are gone and all is quiet in the forest, except for the lingering sound from the bamboo pipe.

drama_dialogue2221053.ch: 方才吹动竹管发出异响，莫非与第十三律有所关联？这里应该就是女娲所说藏有第十三律奥秘的地方了。
drama_dialogue2221053.en: Does the strange sound of the bamboo pipe have something to do with the Thirteenth Verse? There must be the place Nuwa said to find the secret of the Thirteenth Verse.

drama_dialogue2221054.ch: 你回到刚才竹林深处静静参研，四周余音飘荡空中，仿佛团团无形气息穿梭流转。
drama_dialogue2221054.en: You return to the bamboo forest and study the pipe. The lingering sound is there as if it were a mass of invisible breath flowing back and forth in the air.

drama_dialogue2221055.ch: 竹管经你吹动之后，立即破裂四散，空中所留余音迅速聚合，发出异响。与此同时，你感觉眼前出现一片荒芜大陆，前方岩浆喷射，地裂天崩，轰隆巨响震耳欲聋。
drama_dialogue2221055.en: When you blow on the bamboo pipe, it immediately breaks up and scatters, and the lingering sound in the air quickly converges into a cacophony of noises. A wasteland emerges before your eyes, with lava spewing out, the earth shattering, and the sky collapsing with a deafening roar.

drama_dialogue2221056.ch: 你听见一声轰鸣，之前看见的荒芜大陆消失不见，眼前又是竹林景致。但是周围只有倒下的竹子，裂开的土地。附近地面还留有各种奇特纹理，似为余音声波所留。
drama_dialogue2221056.en: You hear a loud rumbling and then the wasteland disappears and the bamboo forest comes back. But the bamboo is fallen and the ground is cracked with all sorts of unusual textures that look like they are left by the aftershocks of the sound waves.

drama_dialogue2221101.ch: 你刚刚那样做实在太冒险了，什么远古希声，只怕子虚乌有！
drama_dialogue2221101.en: That's too dangerous... The ancient sound? There is no such thing!

drama_dialogue2221102.ch: 可是刚刚的确发出了那种声音了呀！

drama_dialogue2221104.ch: 当时我在竹林中布下竹管阵，打算借之激发远古希声，击杀妖兽。只可惜，有些地方没想明白，因此一直没能成事。
drama_dialogue2221104.en: I set up a bamboo pipe formation in the forest and thought I could trigger the ancient sound to kill the monster. But there remained something I couldn't understand and I didn't make it work.

drama_dialogue2221105.ch: 只是没想到，我祭起风咒，却让恩人手中的笛子发出异响，而异响一发，竟带动了竹林竹管发出远古希声，由此逼退了妖兽。
drama_dialogue2221105.en: But to my surprise, my wind spell induced strange sounds from the flute in our savior's hands. Its notes then resonated with the bamboo tubes and produced the ancient sound that drove away the monster.

drama_dialogue2221106.ch: 远古希声？你是从哪里知道这些的？
drama_dialogue2221106.en: The ancient sound? How did you learn all this?

drama_dialogue2221107.ch: 我在祖先留书找到的。书中说，远古希声来自天地初成之际。这种声音十分宏大，却又不易听见，而且能塑造万物，十分神奇。
drama_dialogue2221107.en: From a book left by my ancestors. It says that the ancient sound came from the beginning of the heavens and the earth. It's loud yet difficult to hear, and it can shape everything.

drama_dialogue2221108.ch: 一成一毁总是相生并存，所谓塑造万物，也可能是毁灭万物的意思。刚刚希声一发，就显出十分强大的威力，可见这声音十分危险。你太鲁莽了。
drama_dialogue2221108.en: With birth comes demise. If something can shape everything, it may destroy everything. Just now, the ancient sound manifested its power. It's very dangerous. You really should have thought twice.

drama_dialogue2221109.ch: 唉，连你也这么说，只怕父亲又要怪我了。
drama_dialogue2221109.en: Is that so? Alas, I guess Father will be upset by that.

drama_dialogue2221110.ch: 哼，知道就好。你来这里是出于一片好意，但一声不响的自个来，只会让我让族长担心！
drama_dialogue2221110.en: Hmph, so you know about it, huh? I know you meant to help, but coming alone without telling anyone only makes me and Chief worry about you!

drama_dialogue2221111.ch: 好了好了，末姐姐也来说教了。

drama_dialogue2221151.ch: 风允婼负手前方，他身后站着的是风萍末。其时，风允婼正严辞斥责风萍末
drama_dialogue2221151.en: Feng Yunchuo is standing with his hands in front of him, and behind him is Feng Pingmo. Feng Yunchuo is giving Pingmo a dressing-down.

drama_dialogue2221152.ch: 你早就知道里希出来干什么对吧？
drama_dialogue2221152.en: You knew what Lixi was doing, didn't you?

drama_dialogue2221154.ch: 你瞒着我？心中可还当我是族长？你说，这演的是哪一出？给我详细道来！
drama_dialogue2221154.en: And you didn't tell me anything? Do you still see me as Chief? Why did you keep it from me? Explain yourself!

drama_dialogue2221155.ch: 里希曾与我说，我族恩人曾四方游历，成为八荒之中的修仙大能。她对恩人十分敬佩。再者，她觉得族人世受冥气之苦，惨不可言。因此她一直希望离开族中寻找破解族中厄运的方法。
drama_dialogue2221155.en: Lixi told me that the savior of our clan had traveled around and was a remarkable cultivator. She admired the person a lot. She also felt sorry for our clansmen who suffered the Nether Air. So she had always wished to leave and find a way out for the entire clan.

drama_dialogue2221157.ch: 八荒广大，我们又何曾已一一探明？在遥远未知的地方也许真有克制冥气的办法也未可知。
drama_dialogue2221157.en: This world is too vast and there are so many things we don't know about it. There may be a way to contain the Nether Air in a distant and unknown land out there.

drama_dialogue2221158.ch: 哼，所以她就偷偷来到幽篁洞天？
drama_dialogue2221158.en: Hmph, that's why she left for You Huang Cave behind my back?

drama_dialogue2221159.ch: 里希年纪虽小，却非不识轻重。她来此处，乃是为了您身上的旧伤。
drama_dialogue2221159.en: Lixi may be young, but she knows what she's doing. She came here in search of a remedy for your old injury.

drama_dialogue2221160.ch: 里希曾说，族长早年为保护族人，身上曾落下暗伤。需服食幽篁洞天之中的妖兽气囊才能痊愈。
drama_dialogue2221160.en: Lixi said you got injured when you fought to protect our clansmen, and the air bag of the monster in You Huang Cave could heal the problem.

drama_dialogue2221161.ch: 所以她……她就设法以希声击杀那只遭冥气侵蚀的妖兽……
drama_dialogue2221161.en: So she... came here and sought to kill the corrupted monster with the ancient sound...

drama_dialogue2221162.ch: 不错。里希虽打定主意到外游历寻找根治族人的办法，但却又十分不放心。她不放心族长您的旧患。所以才偷偷来到此处为你取得妖兽气囊。
drama_dialogue2221162.en: That's right. Lixi decided to leave the clan and find a way to cleanse the Nether Air, but she was worried about your old injury, Chief. That's why she left behind your back, trying to get the monster air bag for you.

drama_dialogue2221163.ch: 里希……里希身上真血与我等不同。她极有潜力觉醒，成为我族未来希望。以你眼光应该也已看出来了。我是为了保护她才……
drama_dialogue2221163.en: Lixi... Her true blood is different from ours. She has the potential to awaken and she's our best hope. You should know that I want to protect her and...

drama_dialogue2221164.ch: 族长，我们不妨这样看待此事。若里希体内真血果然非比寻常，这不更应提早外出历练？
drama_dialogue2221164.en: Chief, since Lixi's true blood is so extraordinary, isn't it all the more reason to let her leave the clan and grow stronger?

drama_dialogue2221165.ch: 荒唐！她身系我族存亡之重，怎能冒险在外？
drama_dialogue2221165.en: Ridiculous! She's the key to the very survival of our clan. I can't let her risk her life!

drama_dialogue2221166.ch: 族长身系我族存亡之重，不也冒险在外？
drama_dialogue2221166.en: You're also the key to the very survival of our clan, Chief. But you're already risking your life, aren't you?

drama_dialogue2221168.ch: 族长，里希长大了，未来她的成就会比你我都高，你看她刚刚不就克制了幽篁洞天之中的妖兽了？我们应该尽早放手的。
drama_dialogue2221168.en: Chief, Lixi's going to achieve much more than you and I. She managed to contain the monster in You Huang Cave, right? Let her do what she wants to do.

drama_dialogue2221170.ch: 若族长仍不放心，我可以陪伴里希左右保护她平安。她对我始终有几分依恋，我也偶得机缘，并未被冥气侵蚀，不致惹来修仙者注意。
drama_dialogue2221170.en: I can keep her company and protect her if you don't want Lixi to be on her own. She likes me, and I've yet to be corrupted by the Nether Air, which keeps me under the radar of cultivators.

drama_dialogue2221171.ch: 风允婼脸现迟疑之色，他思索良久，仍无头绪，无奈下只发出一声长叹。
drama_dialogue2221171.en: Feng Yunchuo looks hesitant and he ponders for a long time. He still can't make up his mind and gives a deep sigh.

drama_dialogue2221201.ch: 只见远方风里希走在路上，但前路突然转出两人，正是风萍末与风允婼。
drama_dialogue2221201.en: In the distance, Feng Lixi is walking down the road when two people suddenly show up. There they are. Feng Pingmo and Feng Yunchuo.

drama_dialogue2221204.ch: 我知道的，父亲，我错了，我这就回族中。
drama_dialogue2221204.en: I know, Father. I'm sorry. I'll go back with you to the clan.

drama_dialogue2221205.ch: 族长、里希，你们先聊。我稍后再来。
drama_dialogue2221205.en: Chief, Lixi, you two talk. I'll see you later.

drama_dialogue2221206.ch: 里希，我知道你一直想到外面游历。且不说在外多有凶险，你怎知不会扑空一场，白费功夫？
drama_dialogue2221206.en: Lixi, I know you've always wanted to see the world. But do you have the slightest idea how crazy this world is and that your efforts may not pay off?

drama_dialogue2221207.ch: 父亲，族人太苦了。若有一线机会，我都愿意去尝试，去为他们争取。你说过，身为族长，保护族人就是你不能推卸的责任。我是你的女儿，保护他们，也是我的责任。
drama_dialogue2221207.en: Father, our people have been suffering too much, and for too long. Even if there's only a glimmer of hope, I'll seize it to give them a better life. You said you were obliged to protect them as Chief. I'm your daughter, and I share your obligation.

drama_dialogue2221208.ch: 也许，这就是我们的命呢？
drama_dialogue2221208.en: But maybe it's our destiny to suffer?

drama_dialogue2221209.ch: 不，岂有生来就注定要受苦这种说法？如果这是命，女儿就去改了它！
drama_dialogue2221209.en: No, nobody is destined to suffer! If this is our destiny, I've got to change it!

drama_dialogue2221211.ch: 嗯……需知道，出门在外，远非家中可比。
drama_dialogue2221211.en: Well... Life away from home is not easy. You need to brace yourself for that.

drama_dialogue2221212.ch: 父亲……你答应让我离开族中？
drama_dialogue2221212.en: So, Father... does that mean you'll let me leave?

drama_dialogue2221213.ch: 哼，再不答应，恐怕你得隐瞒于我离家出走了。不过你不要高兴太早，我会让风萍末一路上看着你，否则以你眼下本事，独自离家只怕眨眼就要遭殃。
drama_dialogue2221213.en: Hmph, if I don't, you'll find a way out anyway. But listen, I'll send Feng Pingmo along so that she can keep an eye on you. Otherwise, you won't be able to save your own skin.

drama_dialogue2221215.ch: 嗯，风萍末体质奇特，与常人无异，由她保护，不易遭外人察觉你的真实身份。
drama_dialogue2221215.en: Yes, she's got a unique physique that makes her appear like a non-cultivator. She can help cover up your true identity.

drama_dialogue2221216.ch: 啊，这个……给你，可以治你旧患。
drama_dialogue2221216.en: So, this... is for you. A remedy for your old injury.

drama_dialogue2221217.ch: 哼，本事不差，竟查到以远古希声击杀幽篁洞天内的大妖兽。先回家准备准备吧。风萍末在等着了。
drama_dialogue2221217.en: Hmph, not bad. You managed to find out how to kill the Mythical Beast in You Huang Cave with the ancient sound. Alright, go back home and get ready. Feng Pingmo is waiting for you.

drama_dialogue2221218.ch: 风允婼说完急急转过身去，带着女儿返回族中。
drama_dialogue2221218.en: Feng Yunchuo then turns around and takes her daughter back to the clan immediately.

drama_dialogue2221251.ch: 你依女娲指示来到一个石洞之中，深入后发现前方石壁分为三面，左中右分别篆刻：狩仙真血、双圣会面、赠笛之会；此外边角仍有一些壁画，不过大都已经残缺不存，仅有两三幅仍能查看。
drama_dialogue2221251.en: You follow Nuwa's instructions and arrive at a stone cave. Deep in the cave, you find that the stone wall there is divided into three parts with three murals: True Blood of the Hunting Fairy on the left, Meeting of the Two Saints in the middle, and Gifting the Flute on the right. A few other murals can also be found around the corners, but most of them are broken and crumbling. Only two or three remain legible.

drama_dialogue2221271.ch: 石壁之上篆刻一个男子正与一名女子恶斗，男子体内有一个发光的圆球，而女子体内有一滴血液。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
drama_dialogue2221271.en: Above the stone wall is a mural of a man fighting against a woman. A glowing orb is inside the man's body and a drop of blood is inside the woman's body. You also find a secret box right in front of the stone wall.

drama_dialogue2221291.ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
drama_dialogue2221291.en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

drama_dialogue2221293.ch: 只见一名人身蛇尾满脸煞气的女子正与张三鏖战。两人遥遥相对，分别以灵力攻击对方，僵持不下。
drama_dialogue2221293.en: A serpent-tailed woman is fighting with Zhang San, her killing vibe high. They keep a distance away and are battering each other with Energy, but neither of them seems to have the upper hand.

drama_dialogue2221294.ch: 二人各以性命相搏，胜负即将分晓。就在此时该名女子脸上煞气消去，同时身上浓重的冥气亦慢慢飘散，她跪倒抱头，似乎十分难受。张三则退开半步，一脸诧异。
drama_dialogue2221294.en: Both of them are determined to kill the other, and it looks like the fight is finally coming to an end. At that very moment, the woman's killing vibe disappears, and the heavy Nether Air on her body fades away. She falls to her knees and holds her head in great distress. Astonished, Zhang San steps back.

drama_dialogue2221295.ch: 但他立即醒转，又上前攻向那名女子。危急中女子急拔腰背饰物扫向张三。那件饰物状如长笛，挥动之际同时响起一丝若有若无的声音，张三似乎受到声音影响，出手稍慢，只来得及将对手手中玉笛缴下避过一击，而她则已趁机远遁。
drama_dialogue2221295.en: But he immediately goes forward and strikes the woman, who takes out something from her waist and swings it at Zhang San. A faint sound is heard from the flute-like object in her hand. Zhang San is distracted and his moves slow down a bit. He manages to snatch the jade flute from his opponent's hand and dodge the blow, while she has taken the opportunity to escape.

drama_dialogue2221296.ch: 这……就是狩仙子吗？好厉害的冥妖！这是……笛子吗？
drama_dialogue2221296.en: So she's... the Hunting Fairy? This Nether Demon is insane! Is this... a flute?

drama_dialogue2221311.ch: 石壁之上是一个头戴竹笠的男子，他眼看远方，而远方则是连绵山川。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
drama_dialogue2221311.en: Above the stone wall is a man with a bamboo hat on his head. He's looking into the distance, where mountains roll into the horizon. In front of the stone wall, you see a secret box.

drama_dialogue2221331.ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
drama_dialogue2221331.en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

drama_dialogue2221332.ch: 张三走在路上，只见前方一名身形曼妙的女子缓缓走近，那是冥妖狩仙子。张三皱了皱眉，立时骈指捻诀，准备与之决斗。
drama_dialogue2221332.en: As Zhang San walks along the path, he sees a slender lady coming closer to him. She is the Hunting Fairy, a Nether Demon. Zhang San frowns, moves his fingers, and casts a spell, all ready to strike.

drama_dialogue2221333.ch: 请不要误会，我没有恶意。
drama_dialogue2221333.en: Please don't get me wrong. I come in peace.

drama_dialogue2221334.ch: 我是来道谢的。先前我遭到琅琊阁劫持，受冥气感染，丧失神智，沦为旁人傀儡，多亏与你一战，触发我体内变化，这才清除所有冥气觉醒过来。
drama_dialogue2221334.en: I'm here to say thank you. When I was kidnapped by the Manual Pavilion, I was infected by the Nether Air and lost my sanity, completely at the mercy of those people. But our duel triggered a transformation in my body, cleansed my Nether Air, and I awakened my  blood.

drama_dialogue2221336.ch: 不错，你果然有所察觉。如我所料不差。当日你我交手之际，因为全力应战，体内盘古真血全部觉醒。
drama_dialogue2221336.en: That's right. I knew you could tell. I was fighting with all my might, and that awakened the true blood of Pangu in my body.

drama_dialogue2221337.ch: 当时，我仿佛看见了天地四维，无穷宇宙，心底也产生无穷无尽的喜悦。这，应该是你将你的道心传递给我了？
drama_dialogue2221337.en: I felt like I could see the four dimensions of heaven and earth and the vast cosmos. My heart was filled with endless joy. So I suppose you passed on your Taoist Mind to me, right?

drama_dialogue2221338.ch: 那之后，我凭借盘古真血与道心相互作用，终于辟除体内冥气，并恢复了神智。也是道心，让我窥见了盘古真血的神妙。
drama_dialogue2221338.en: After that, the interaction between my Pangu blood and Taoist Mind removed the Nether Air in my body and restored my sanity. The Taoist Mind has also allowed me to see the wonder of the true blood of Pangu.

drama_dialogue2221339.ch: 当日一战，在下也是受益匪浅。如非你盘古真血的阳和之力，我的道心亦无法升华成长。
drama_dialogue2221339.en: I also benefited a great deal from our fight. If it weren't for the Yang power of your Pangu blood, my Taoist Mind wouldn't have been able to grow.

drama_dialogue2221340.ch: 道心传递到你身上之后，我感受到自己道心亦被塑造一新。那颗道心质朴纯和，十分剔透。你，不是一个恶人。
drama_dialogue2221340.en: Ever since my Taoist Mind was passed on to you, it has been reshaped too, and I find it incredibly kind and pure. Turns out you're not an evil person.

drama_dialogue2221341.ch: 我不是恶人？昔日丧失神智，所作恶事只怕不少。唉，今日前来，乃是为道谢，如今致意毕了。也该走了。
drama_dialogue2221341.en: I'm not? I can't even remember how many evil deeds I did back when I lost my sanity. Alas, now that I've expressed my gratitude, it's time to say goodbye.

drama_dialogue2221342.ch: 姑娘，且慢……今后，你有何打算？
drama_dialogue2221342.en: Hold on, Lady... So, what's your plan now?

drama_dialogue2221343.ch: 昔日我有一位朋友，从永宁州一直去到赤幽州，最后成为仙盟领袖。我很仰慕这位朋友，因此打算今后也四方游历，凭借这盘古真血的异能为八荒生灵做点好事，也算为我的过去赎罪……
drama_dialogue2221343.en: A friend of mine went from Yong Ning to Chi You and then became the head of the Cultivator Alliance. I admire that, so my plan is to travel around and see the world. If I could also do good with the power of my Pangu blood, that would be an atonement for my sins...

drama_dialogue2221344.ch: 四方游历，为八荒生灵做点好事？有意思。
drama_dialogue2221344.en: Travel around and do good? Interesting.

drama_dialogue2221345.ch: 张三目送她远去，然后转头看向另外一边。只见远山起伏，连绵不尽，张三略一迟疑，也终于迈开脚步，朝远方走去。
drama_dialogue2221345.en: Zhang San watches her go away before he turns to look at the other side. Rolling mountains undulate and sweep down to the horizon. He hesitates for a while and then keeps walking down the road.

drama_dialogue2221401.ch: 石壁之上篆刻一名男子将笛子递给一个人身蛇尾的女子。而男子似乎正在交代女子一些重要的事情。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
drama_dialogue2221401.en: Above the stone wall is a mural of a man handing a flute to a woman with a snake's tail. He seems to be explaining something very important to her. In front of the stone wall, you see a secret box.

drama_dialogue2221411.ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
drama_dialogue2221411.en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

drama_dialogue2221412.ch: 张三在远山前吹起玉笛，雾霭之中一个女子人影显露出现，
drama_dialogue2221412.en: Zhang San plays his jade flute on a mountain. A woman is silhouetted against the fog.

drama_dialogue2221413.ch: 久违了，张三。哦？你的道心并不稳定，可是遇有什么困难？
drama_dialogue2221413.en: It's been a long time, Zhang San. Well, your Taoist Mind is getting irregular. What's wrong?

drama_dialogue2221414.ch: 琅琊阁主意欲飞升上界，因此造成四方灾劫。我想阻止他。
drama_dialogue2221414.en: The Pavilion Master seeks to ascend to the upper realms and calamities ensue. I need to stop him.

drama_dialogue2221416.ch: 琅琊阁主，八荒唯一。要在他手上取胜，又谈何容易？
drama_dialogue2221416.en: He's the best cultivator in this world. It won't be easy for me to beat him.

drama_dialogue2221417.ch: 既是如此，那便打消这个念头吧。

drama_dialogue2221419.ch: 呵呵，记得从前我跟你说过那名游历八荒的朋友。在我眼里，他从来不会放弃，遇有任何困难都不会。也是为此，那位朋友才能从永宁州一步步走到赤幽州，成为仙盟之主吧？
drama_dialogue2221419.en: Well, remember that friend I told you about who was traveling around the world? No matter what happened, he never gave up. And that's probably why he came a long away from Yong Ning to Chi You and eventually became the head of the Cultivator Alliance.

drama_dialogue2221420.ch: 如今你是后继之人，胸中志气，反而不如？
drama_dialogue2221420.en: You're also a member of the Alliance. Where are your courage and resolve?

drama_dialogue2221421.ch: 可惜！这位前辈所处时代终究太过久远，仙盟之中的记事也散轶不全，我无法从中推知其英风侠骨。
drama_dialogue2221421.en: Unfortunately, this heroic former head of the Alliance lived in a time ages ago, and the incomplete archives in our Alliance don't document his stories.

drama_dialogue2221422.ch: 听闻八荒远古，曾有三神器流传，辗转去到有缘人手中。我记得这位朋友手中便有其中一件神器。当年这位朋友，持神器、落金乌、平东海、破冥山、败刑天，统领仙盟，对抗兽潮，功绩那是数不尽数。
