drama_dialogue23401.ch: 你遭遇到了怪物的袭击。

drama_dialogue23501.en: Congratulations on your promotion to Sect Master.

drama_dialogue23502.en: Congratulations on your promotion to Grand Elder.

drama_dialogue23503.en: Congratulations on your promotion to Elder.

drama_dialogue23504.ch: 恭喜你晋升为真传弟子。
drama_dialogue23504.en: Congratulations on your promotion to True Disciple.

drama_dialogue23505.ch: 恭喜你晋升为内门弟子。
drama_dialogue23505.en: Congratulations on your promotion to Inner Disciple.

drama_dialogue23506.ch: 恭喜你加入{0}，成为外门弟子。
drama_dialogue23506.en: You have joined {0} as a Outer Disciple.

drama_dialogue23508.ch: 做好准备下次在来挑战吧！
drama_dialogue23508.en: Come back when you are ready!

drama_dialogue23509.en: Well done! Keep up the good work!

drama_dialogue23510.ch: 凭你这点实力也想加入{0}，打败我再说吧。
drama_dialogue23510.en: You think to join {0}? Beat me, then we'll talk.

drama_dialogue23511.ch: 不错，有两下子，接下来你可能就没这么好运了。
drama_dialogue23511.en: You know what you're doing. Maybe next time you won't be so lucky.

drama_dialogue23601.ch: 这是一块指示牌，需要查看通往何处的方向？
drama_dialogue23601.en: It's a direction sign. Do you need to check which way you're going?

drama_dialogue23701.ch: 竟然是{0}的{1}，我们这小城镇拍卖不了，你可以去{2}看看。
drama_dialogue23701.en: It's a {0} {1}. You cannot auction it here. You should try {2}.

drama_dialogue23702.ch: {0}才{1}，我们这里可不收，你可以去{2}看看。
drama_dialogue23702.en: Only {0} does {1}. We don't take them here. You can try at {2}.

drama_dialogue23703.ch: 我们这里只收取{0}的道具，你有其它问题吗？
drama_dialogue23703.en: We only take {0} items here. Is there anything else I can help you with?

drama_dialogue23704.en: {0} is a {1} item. Go to {2} and have a look.

drama_dialogue23801.ch: 你已是{0}强者了，在我们宗门修炼对你起到的帮助不大，你可以去加入更加强大的宗门来提升实力。
drama_dialogue23801.en: You're a {0} Cultivator. The cultivation of our sect won't be much use to you. You should join a stronger sect to increase your strength.

drama_dialogue23802.ch: 你已是我们宗门的荣誉弟子了，宗门任务这些事情交给师弟师妹们做就好了。
drama_dialogue23802.en: You're already a Honored Disciple. Leave the Sect Missions to Junior Disciples.

drama_dialogue24231.ch: 升仙大会可是众多修道者毕生所追求的目标，能在升仙大会一举夺魁的话，不但能声名远扬，还能获得稀有的<g>道心果</g>。需要我为你详细介绍升仙大会的规则吗？
drama_dialogue24231.en: Many Cultivators aspire to fight in the Immortal Tournament. Immortal Tournament winners not only make a name for themselves, but they can win rare <g>Taoist Fruit</g>. Do you want me to explain the rules of the Immortal Tournament to you?

drama_dialogue24232.ch: 升仙大会是由<g>道心阁</g>所举办的，<g>道心阁</g>是一个非常神秘的组织，除了每3年一次的升仙大会，其它时候都不会出现。
drama_dialogue24232.en: The Immortal Tournament is held in the <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g>. The <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g> is a very mysterious organization that only meets once every three years to convene the Immortal Tournament.

drama_dialogue24233.ch: 传说<g>道心阁</g>的开宗宗主在机遇之下，发现了一棵千万年的<g>道心神树</g>，通过神树的帮助，实力大涨，继而创立了<g>道心阁</g>。
drama_dialogue24233.en: It is said the founder of the <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g> discovered a thousand year old <g>Taoist Devine Tree</g>. Eating its fruit he gained powers which enabled him to establish the <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g>.

drama_dialogue24234.ch: 而各大门派因为觊觎<g>道心阁</g>的神树，围绕神树发生了多次大战，各大宗门的精英都在这场争斗中陨落殆尽，最后不得不停止了争斗，并达成了一致的协定。
drama_dialogue24234.en: Numerous sects fought for possession of the <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g>'s tree, losing many of their best fighters in the process. Finally a truce was called and an agreement reached.

drama_dialogue24235.ch: <g>道心神树</g>依旧由<g>道心阁</g>拥有并守护，但是每3年神树结果时，需要拿出一部分<g>道心果</g>给其它门派分享，而这升仙大会便是各大宗门争取<g>道心果</g>的一场比试，在比试中获得的名次越高，得到的<g>道心果</g>也越多，全凭个人实力！
drama_dialogue24235.en: The <g>Taoist Mind Pavilion</g> continues to watch over the <g>Taoist Devine Tree</g>, but every 3 years some of the <g>Taoist Fruit</g> crop is shared with the other sects. During the Immortal Tournament great sects compete for the <g>Taoist Fruit</g> which are distributed according to rank. The stronger you are, the more <g>Taoist Fruit</g> you win! It's all up to you!

drama_dialogue2500002.ch: 你感觉地面微微震动，碎石细砾更是无故虚浮。此时破风声起，一道青影急速掠过。之后地面复归静止，碎石亦重落地上。你正疑惑究竟发生什么事，两名修仙者已同时御剑来到。
drama_dialogue2500002.en: A slight shake comes from under your feet, and you see gravel floating into the air. Then, an azure streak flashes before your eyes, followed by a howling gale. After that, the land becomes calm again, and the rock shards fall to the ground. Before you could figure out what happened, two cultivators are riding their swords here.

drama_dialogue2500003.ch: 明明就在这附近，怎么不见了呢？话说，凭你本事竟将古时暮仙州大能多次围剿未果的妖兽伤了？
drama_dialogue2500003.en: I saw it fled here, but where is it now? By the way, did you really get it injured? The monster has escaped from the master cultivators in Mu Xian many times.

drama_dialogue2500004.ch: 哼，你这话什么意思？我老实跟你说吧。当时我看见这妖物角上缠着一截断开的缚仙索，便用法器隐藏了自身声息，偷偷摸过去解开了那段绢子然后用那玩意捆住了妖兽。
drama_dialogue2500004.en: Hmph. Are you looking down upon me? Listen. I found a broken Immortal Rope tied on its horn and sneaked into its side after hiding my breath with an artifact. Then, I took the rope and bound the monster with it.

drama_dialogue2500005.ch: 听说那是极为罕有的法宝，听闻古时懂得制作此绢的大能仅织就两条缚仙索便心力耗尽而死。竟然有一截挂在那妖物身上么？这可真是一番机缘啊。
drama_dialogue2500005.en: I heard that the rope is a rare artifact, and even its maker got exhausted and died after having woven only two of them. You say you found a broken Immortal Rope on the monster? That's incredible.

drama_dialogue2500006.ch: 嘿嘿，就是。那妖物被束缚后，实力大减，被我几番追击，一路逃遁至此。我们分头寻觅那妖物，赶紧将他拿下吧。
drama_dialogue2500006.en: Indeed. The monster is restrained by the rope, and I chased it all the way here. Let's search in different directions and catch it now.

drama_dialogue2500007.ch: 你说得极是，这眼前的好处不能放过。
drama_dialogue2500007.en: You're right. We must seize the opportunity.

drama_dialogue2500060.ch: 前方树丛之间一妖伏倒地上。一截白索交缠着妖兽身体以及前足，使其不能移动。此外妖兽后足有一道剑伤，创口已可见骨。
drama_dialogue2500060.en: A creature is lying flat in the shrubbery before you. Its body and front legs are bound motionlessly by a white rope. You also noticed a wound in its rear leg that cuts deeply into the bone.

drama_dialogue2500061.ch: 妖兽察觉有人接近，立即生出警觉。它回头看了看你，眼中透出森寒敌意，不过敌意眨眼间化去，转为无奈之色。最后只发出两声嗷嗷的哀声，便又闭目转过头去。
drama_dialogue2500061.en: The creature noticed you as well. It turns its head and looks at you with wary, hostile eyes, but the next moment, you see a sadness in them. Finally, it whinnies mournfully and turns back again, eyes closed.

drama_dialogue2500070.ch: 你刚为青兽解开其身上交缠着的白索。眼前便出现一番离奇的情景。
drama_dialogue2500070.en: You untie the white rope on the creature. Just at that moment, a strange scene emerges before your eyes.

drama_dialogue2500071.ch: 丛林之中躺着一只额上生角的青马。当时它被一截白索缠着，蜷缩地上，正舔舐着前足伤口。此时一名男子慢慢走近，那只青色的妖兽见状发出嗷嗷怪叫。
drama_dialogue2500071.en: An azure steed is lying in the forest, a horn on its forehead. It is bound by a white rope and could only curl up to lick the wound on its front leg. A mysterious man steps closer, and the creature groans in a strange tone.

drama_dialogue2500072.ch: 额生一角，可通灵韵。嗯，是一只䑏疏。缠在你身上的是……缚仙索，你的前腿受了伤，又被缚仙索困住。
drama_dialogue2500072.en: Born with a horn that can conduct energy... You're a Fiery Unicorn. The stuff that binds you is Immortal Rope. You got injured in your front leg and bound.

drama_dialogue2500073.ch: 我知道了。䑏疏是八荒中极为罕有的妖兽。传说你的角又是十分难得的仙材。你被其他修仙者发现并设法捕捉，后遭仙索束缚以致受伤，对吧？
drama_dialogue2500073.en: I know why. You're an extremely rare creature in the world, and legends said that your horn is a divine material as rare and precious as yourself. I guess you were discovered and hurt by other cultivators, and was bound by the rope, right?

drama_dialogue2500074.ch: 这名修仙者微微一笑，伸手解开缚仙索，再用手扶起青马。妖兽察觉修仙者的动作变得十分暴躁，但发现他并无恶意便后慢慢宁定，一拐一拐的离开了。
drama_dialogue2500074.en: The cultivator smiles as he tries to release the creature from the rope and supports the steed to stand with his hands. The creature seems to be irritated by his action, but after noticing his kindness, it calms down and walks away with a limp.

drama_dialogue2500075.ch: 去吧去吧，缚仙索可是你的克星，千万不要再被这东西困住了。
drama_dialogue2500075.en: Now you are free. Remember to be careful when facing the Immortal Rope. It will trap you with no effort.

drama_dialogue2500076.ch: 你清醒过来，那妖兽已经从白索的缠缚中挣脱开来。妖兽看了你一眼后这才摆动受伤的后足飞奔而去。
drama_dialogue2500076.en: The scene faded, and you find the creature has freed itself from the rope. It casts you a glimpse and walks away with a wounded leg.

drama_dialogue2500100.ch: 这日你走在路上，只见不远处树丛上一只妖兽缓步踱出。定睛细看，却是之前你放走的那只额生一角的青马。
drama_dialogue2500100.en: Today, a creature with a horn walks out from the shrubbery alongside the road. It's the azure steed you helped before.

drama_dialogue2500101.ch: 马儿驻足前方，静静的看着你。过了片刻这才往前走两步并轻轻的朝你叫了一声。
drama_dialogue2500101.en: The steed stops in front of you and gazes at you quietly. Moments after, it steps forward and neighs to you.

drama_dialogue2500110.ch: 你伸手摸了摸青马，眼前突然浮现一片情景。
drama_dialogue2500110.en: You stroke the steed. A curious scene begins to unfold in your mind.

drama_dialogue2500111.ch: 只见男子挥袖发出灵力摇动前方大树。沙沙落叶声中，两枚果子从上面坠落被他伸手接住，然后递给身边青马。
drama_dialogue2500111.en: A man is trying to shake the tree in front of him with energy waves; his sleeves flutter in the wind. Two fruits fall to his palms amid scattering leaves, and he hands them to the steed at his side.

drama_dialogue2500112.ch: 吃吧，这可是我们修仙者十分钟爱的仙果。为了追查那处秘穴，半年以来马不停蹄，也是叫你受累了。唉，希望不会白来一趟吧。
drama_dialogue2500112.en: Here you are. We cultivators like the fruit a lot, and I guess you must feel tired now since we've traveled a long way in the past half year for the whereabouts of the secret cave. Hope our effort won't be in vain.

drama_dialogue2500113.ch: 哈哈，我也太傻了。白来一趟不是挺好的吗？这起码能够证明八荒太平无事呀。
drama_dialogue2500113.en: Well, maybe it's not so bad to find our effort leading to nowhere. It at least proves that the world is free from threats.

drama_dialogue2500114.ch: 那青马将果子食尽，用头轻轻顶了顶男子。男子则用手拍了拍马儿，主仆二人振作精神后，再次踏上旅程。
drama_dialogue2500114.en: The steed finished eating and nudges the man with its head. The man pats the steed in turn, and soon, they continue their journey after taking a rest.

drama_dialogue2500115.ch: 你回过神来的时候，发现马儿正低着脑袋朝你手腕蹭了一下。然后用嘴轻轻衔着你的衣袖，扯着你走动。
drama_dialogue2500115.en: Your attention is drawn back by a gentle rub on your wrist. The steed is caressing you with its head. Then, it holds your sleeve in the mouth and pulls it in a direction.

drama_dialogue2500116.ch: 你任青马引路，不多时来到一个山洞之中。只见地上摆着几片青叶，上面放着几枚果子。马儿放脱你的袖子，衔着一个果子塞到你手中，这才踏着脚步离开。
drama_dialogue2500116.en: The azure steed leads your way into a mountain cave shortly after. You noticed a thin layer of green leaves on the ground, as well as the fruits on it. The horse fetches a fruit and put it into your hands, and walks away.

drama_dialogue2500120.ch: 青马眼看你要离开，连忙走前两步，用嘴轻轻衔着你的衣袖，扯着你走动。
drama_dialogue2500120.en: The azure steed hurries forward to you and holds your sleeve in the mouth, trying to pull you in a direction.

drama_dialogue2500121.ch: 你任青马引路，不多时来到一个山洞之中。只见地上摆着几片青叶，上面放着几枚果子。马儿放脱你的袖子，衔着一个果子塞到你手中，这才踏着脚步离开。
drama_dialogue2500121.en: The azure steed leads your way into a mountain cave shortly after. You noticed a thin layer of green leaves on the ground, as well as the fruits on it. The horse fetches a fruit and put it into your hands, and walks away.

drama_dialogue2500200.ch: 你感觉地面微微震动，碎石细砾更是无故虚浮。同时破风声起，一道青影急速掠过。之后地面复归静止，碎石亦重落地上。
drama_dialogue2500200.en: A slight shake comes from under your feet, and you see gravel floating into the air. Then, an azure streak flashes before your eyes, followed by a howling gale. After that, the land becomes calm again, and the rock shards fall to the ground.

drama_dialogue2500220.ch: 你发现青马踪迹，走近一看，却见它正与两只妖兽正在搏斗。其时当康朝青马猛扑，却被它飞蹄踢翻，将之踩在地上。另一边山挥从旁冲至，亦被青马昂首撞倒。
drama_dialogue2500220.en: The azure steed seems to be there. On a closer look, you find it fighting against two monsters, one is a Dangkang that got tramped on the ground after a failed charge, and the other is a Mountain Specter, who falls down awkwardly after colliding with the steed from the side.

drama_dialogue2500221.ch: 青马轻松打倒两只妖兽后，更将它们玩弄于股掌之中。良久以后，眼看二兽再无顽抗之力便飞起后蹄将他们全部踢飞。
drama_dialogue2500221.en: The steed defeated its opponents and even made some feigned attacks on the subdued monsters. Finally, after they gave up resisting, the steed kicks them into the distance with its rear legs.

drama_dialogue2500222.ch: 它击败二兽，挺胸四顾，凌厉的眼神轻轻一转，落到你身上，同时一股无形威压浪潮般朝你袭来。
drama_dialogue2500222.en: The victorious creature is looking around proudly. Suddenly, its keen eyes meet yours, and you feel unknown coercion comes to you overwhelmingly.

drama_dialogue2500240.ch: 你转身离去，未料青马已悄无声息的跟了上来，还用头轻轻撞了撞你肩膀。
drama_dialogue2500240.en: You turn and leave, but the steed has already followed you here. It nudges your shoulder with the head.

drama_dialogue2500250.ch: 这青马一改之前友好态度，竟与你对视起来。片刻以后，青马似乎服软，终于收敛眼中神光。
drama_dialogue2500250.en: The seemingly tamed steed meets your eyes with a defying gaze, but soon, it becomes friendly again; the fierce glow in its eyes faded.

drama_dialogue2500251.ch: 你前方的威压感亦逐渐消弭，与此同时你的手臂微微一动，那马儿已经凑了上来用头轻轻碰你手臂。
drama_dialogue2500251.en: The coercion before you slowly disappeared as well. At the same time, you feel something touches your arm - the steed is nudging you.

drama_dialogue2500400.ch: 你感觉地面微微震动，碎石细砾更是无故虚浮。同时破风声起，一道青影急速掠过。之后地面复归静止，碎石亦重落地上。
drama_dialogue2500400.en: A slight shake comes from under your feet, and you see gravel floating into the air. Then, an azure streak flashes before your eyes, followed by a howling gale. After that, the land becomes calm again, and the rock shards fall to the ground.

drama_dialogue2500420.ch: 䑏疏见你到来，便抬头看着你，轻轻发着嗷嗷叫声。
drama_dialogue2500420.en: The Fiery Unicorn looks at you as you walk to it. It whinnies softly.

drama_dialogue2500430.ch: 䑏疏用颈项与你轻轻揩擦，然后半蹲地上，似乎是希望你坐上它背后。
drama_dialogue2500430.en: The Fiery Unicorn rubs its neck on you and bends down. It seems to be inviting you to ride on it.

drama_dialogue2500440.ch: 你坐上䑏疏背后，不料这马儿发出一声嘶鸣，随即迈开四蹄，腾跃空中，踏虚飞奔。
drama_dialogue2500440.en: You sit on its back. The next moment, the Fiery Unicorn dashes into the sky with a cheerful neigh, its hoofs step on the air.

drama_dialogue2500441.ch: 䑏疏去如疾风，不片刻已带着你冲入云层之中。
drama_dialogue2500441.en: Soon, the Fiery Unicorn has carried you into the clouds.

drama_dialogue2500460.ch: 䑏疏于空中跑得极快，你将手探入云中，竟在云海上带出一道雪白的涟漪。
drama_dialogue2500460.en: The creature gallops forward. You reach out to the cloud, and your fingertip leaves a soft, snowy wake on its surface.

drama_dialogue2500461.ch: 突然间，座下青马飞速剧增，带着你穿破云层，来到美丽的高空之上。只见前方一碧无垠，除去东方的旭日，还有三五仙洲，浮于高空，景色令人叫绝。
drama_dialogue2500461.en: Suddenly, the steed accelerates and carries you somewhere far above the clouds. Under the cerulean canopy is a glorious rising sun, as well as mysterious islands floating in the thin air. You marvel at what you see.

drama_dialogue2500462.ch: 䑏疏带你飞行一阵，终于重新回到八荒大陆之上。它看了你一眼。这才轻叫一声，转身离去。
drama_dialogue2500462.en: Finally, the Fiery Unicorn carries you back to the firm land after the wonderful journey. It looks at you and makes a gentle whinny, and leaves.

drama_dialogue2500470.ch: 䑏疏带你破云而出。只见高空之上，一碧无垠，除去东方的旭日，还有三五仙洲，浮于高空，景色令人叫绝。
drama_dialogue2500470.en: The Fiery Unicorn emerges from the cloud, and you begin to marvel at the scenery. Under the cerulean canopy is a glorious rising sun, as well as mysterious islands floating in the thin air.

drama_dialogue2500471.ch: 䑏疏带你飞行一阵，终于重新回到八荒大陆之上。它看了你一眼。这才轻叫一声，转身离去。
drama_dialogue2500471.en: Finally, the Fiery Unicorn carries you back to the firm land after the wonderful journey. It looks at you and makes a gentle whinny, and leaves.

drama_dialogue2500700.ch: 喂，你听说了吗？那只䑏疏似乎重现暮仙州了。
drama_dialogue2500700.en: Hey, have you heard it? The Fiery Unicorn seems to appear in Mu Xian again.

drama_dialogue2500701.ch: 有这等事？据闻这妖兽很久以前便一路逃窜去到南边永宁州中，怎会无端端重回暮仙州？
drama_dialogue2500701.en: Well? I heard that the monster fled south to Yong Ning a long time ago. Why would it be back to Mu Xian without reason?

drama_dialogue2500702.ch: 我也不明白。听说很久以前，暮仙州有过一场危机，如今人类栖息的繁华之地，当年曾有冥山崛起之事。
drama_dialogue2500702.en: I don't know why, too. Someone told me that there was a disaster fell upon Mu Xian. The prosperous land today once suffered heavy losses from the growing of the Nether Mountains.

drama_dialogue2500703.ch: 而那回的灾难就是这䑏疏惹起的。咱们为防当年灾难再度发生，一定要将这妖兽一举击杀。
drama_dialogue2500703.en: And it was because of the Fiery Unicorn. We must kill it for once and all if we want to keep our world away from the disaster centuries ago.

drama_dialogue2500704.ch: 是极。我听闻这䑏疏有通灵之能，不但能感通人心，还能察知冥气枢纽的存在，这回必是来打的那冥气枢纽的主意。
drama_dialogue2500704.en: Indeed. Legends said that the Fiery Unicorn can conduct energy. It can read our thoughts and can detect the nexus of Nether Air. This time it must come for the sinister stuff.

drama_dialogue2500705.ch: 别看这䑏疏只是一只妖兽，却十分机警聪明，咱们要尽早将它找出来。
drama_dialogue2500705.en: Do not underestimate the Fiery Unicorn. The monster is surprisingly clever. We'd better find it as soon as possible.

drama_dialogue2500720.ch: 䑏疏再度出世，你怎么看这事？
drama_dialogue2500720.en: The Fiery Unicorn appears again. What do you think about it?

drama_dialogue2500721.ch: 什么怎么看？咱们应该赶紧谋定大计将这妖兽拿下。
drama_dialogue2500721.en: Think about it? I think we should make a plan and catch it at once.

drama_dialogue2500722.ch: 嗯，毕竟它会引发冥山崛起，太可怕了。
drama_dialogue2500722.en: Yes. It would be horrible if it can raise the Nether Mountains.

drama_dialogue2500723.ch: 嘿嘿，平日看你精明得很，不想你也相信这鬼话。
drama_dialogue2500723.en: Hehe. I didn't expect even such a sensible person like you would believe the rumor.

drama_dialogue2500725.ch: 以我推测，䑏疏会令冥山崛起云云乃是一个借口，古时那些“前辈”只是为了得到䑏疏头顶的额角罢了。
drama_dialogue2500725.en: In my eyes, the theory of Fiery Unicorn and Nether Mountains is but an excuse. The predecessors who made up it were only aiming at the horn on the creature's head.

drama_dialogue2500727.ch: 我这说法没根据，䑏疏致冥山崛起就有根据了？
drama_dialogue2500727.en: Maybe not. But neither does the story you believed.

drama_dialogue2500728.ch: 既是如此，你为何也想着捕捉䑏疏？
drama_dialogue2500728.en: So why do you want to catch the Fiery Unicorn too?

drama_dialogue2500729.ch: 我当然是冲着䑏疏额角去的。别净在这说废话了。快快准备一下，我们去捕捉䑏疏。
drama_dialogue2500729.en: For its horn, certainly. Stop talking nonsense now. Time to get prepared for the hunt.

drama_dialogue2500750.ch: 围捕……䑏疏……？莫非……是在捕捉那只青马？
drama_dialogue2500750.en: Catch the... Fiery Unicorn? Do they mean the azure steed I met?

drama_dialogue2500751.ch: 那只额生一角的青色马儿出现在你脑海之中。它与你示好亲近的情景好像走马灯般重现你眼前。
drama_dialogue2500751.en: You remember the creature with a mysterious horn, as well as the time you spent together.

drama_dialogue2500800.ch: 䑏疏已困在这数里之中，赶紧合围击杀吧。
drama_dialogue2500800.en: We have encircled the Fiery Unicorn here. Time to take a final strike.

drama_dialogue2500801.ch: 你说得轻巧，这妖兽来去如电，想要找到他谈何容易啊？
drama_dialogue2500801.en: But it would be difficult. The monster moves with lightning speed, and where could we find it?

drama_dialogue2500802.ch: 别废话了，另外一边的人已经出手重创䑏疏，听闻还带了专门捕捉妖兽的缚仙索。你现在不设法去捉，到时便捉不到这妖兽了。
drama_dialogue2500802.en: Stop complaining. Cultivators from the opposite line have wounded the beast heavily, and they even bring an Immortal Rope to secure success. The monster will fall into their hands if we just keep talking here.

drama_dialogue2500803.ch: 知道了知道了，可恶，这么多人来抢吗？
drama_dialogue2500803.en: I see, I see. Didn't expect so many people to be craving our prey.

drama_dialogue2500804.ch: 你避过这些人的耳目，来到群山深处。不多时便听见一个熟悉的兽类叫声自暗处发出。那声音听着既似求救，亦像哀鸣，让人十分揪心。而你循声寻觅，果然发现那青马便跪倒一处草丛旁边。
drama_dialogue2500804.en: You go to the mountain's depth without being noticed by the cultivators. Soon, you hear a familiar groaning from a dark corner. You are not certain whether the creature is calling for help or moaning out of pain, yet you feel an inexplicable sympathy. You follow the sound and find the azure steed kneeling beside a shrub.

drama_dialogue2500805.ch: 青马发现你到来，急忙凑过头来轻轻碰触你手，你脑海中立时浮现一些片段。
drama_dialogue2500805.en: The creature touches your hand eagerly as soon as it sees you approaching. A clip from the past emerges in your mind.

drama_dialogue2500806.ch: 青马舔舐后足伤口，然后颤颤巍巍的站起，但经过几次尝试后，还是跪倒地上无法移动。
drama_dialogue2500806.en: The azure steed is licking the wound in its rear leg and tries to stand up. It made several trembling attempts, but could only kneel back to the ground in the end.

drama_dialogue2500807.ch: 青马……咦！你是一路跟着我的吗？你这创口太深，要想恢复如昔只怕有点为难，以后你就只能这样一拐一拐的走了吧？
drama_dialogue2500807.en: Hey, good steed... Oh? Are you following me here? Your wound cuts too deep, and I'm afraid that it may never fully recover. Maybe you need to walk with a limp forever.

drama_dialogue2500808.ch: 我听说淬阳树胶能愈灵兽伤口，只是不易寻得。嗯，帮人帮到底，我这便替你找来吧？
drama_dialogue2500808.en: I know a medicine that can cure the creatures of your kind. It is called Rosy Gum but is hard to find. Well, it's not impossible for me to find you some, since I helped you so many times.

drama_dialogue2500809.ch: 听闻这淬阳树胶能在暮仙州地底妖兽环伺之地寻得。唉，看来还得花些功夫才能找到那玩意。
drama_dialogue2500809.en: The gum hides beneath the ground of Mu Xian among the monster's lairs. Sigh. I'll have to go a long way for it.

drama_dialogue2500810.ch: 马儿，等我回来。我会将你治好的。
drama_dialogue2500810.en: Good steed, wait for me here. I'll be back soon.

drama_dialogue2500811.ch: 你……是希望我替你去找那淬阳树胶治伤吗？
drama_dialogue2500811.en: Do you want me to... find the Rosy Gum for you?

drama_dialogue2500812.ch: 青马一声不发，只是用透着绝望和哀色的双眼看了看你，然后拐着后足，慢慢挪到暗处隐藏起来。
drama_dialogue2500812.en: The azure steed does not respond. It gazes at you mournfully and staggers to a hidden shelter with a wounded rear leg.

drama_dialogue2500850.ch: 青马旧主昔日似乎是在此处寻得树胶的，若青马记忆无误，里面应充斥大量妖兽……
drama_dialogue2500850.en: The steed's old friend probably found the gum here. But the clip from the steed has told me that there are a lot of monsters in it...

drama_dialogue2500860.ch: 你击退妖兽后，立即在树根处割破一个小口让树汁流出，结成凝胶。只片刻间，树胶凝固，树筋伤口复原，你的蓄囊中也已满载树胶。
drama_dialogue2500860.en: You defeated the monsters and cut a little opening at the root of the tree. Soon, the sap condensed into the gum, and you managed to collect a pack of it at the time the cut recovered.

drama_dialogue2500861.en: Time to be back and rescue the steed.

drama_dialogue2500900.ch: 青马躲藏暗处正用舌头轻轻舔舐伤口。它察觉有人接近立即露出暴烈警惕的眼神，但发现是你后，就又慢慢变成无奈的神色。
drama_dialogue2500900.en: The azure steed is still there. It is licking the wound, and, noticing someone is here, its eyes glow with wary and ferocious sparks. But it calms down again helplessly after recognizing you.

drama_dialogue2500910.ch: 你正要为其疗伤，身后却响起脚步之声。
drama_dialogue2500910.en: Just at the time you are about to tend its wound, you hear another person comes behind you.

drama_dialogue2500911.ch: 恭喜道友，贺喜道友，没想到你先擒下了这䑏疏。来，我们来处死它。
drama_dialogue2500911.en: Congrats, fellow cultivator. Now that you have caught the Fiery Unicorn, let's kill it.

drama_dialogue2500920.ch: 依道籍记载，当年便是此妖致冥山崛起，让暮仙州变成一片鬼域的。
drama_dialogue2500920.en: Ancient tomes recorded that the monster made the Nether Mountains grow and turned Mu Xian into a desolate land.

drama_dialogue2500930.ch: 琅琊阁中自有秘典笔录其恶，更兼修仙者口耳相传，如何能假？
drama_dialogue2500930.en: Its crimes were both recorded in the Manual Pavilion and told by cultivators. Aren't they evidence?

drama_dialogue2500931.ch: 道友，你在怀疑在下？如今妖兽负伤，又复受困，正是击杀此妖的良机。你要么这就离开，不要妨碍我。要么与我一并合力击杀妖兽。
drama_dialogue2500931.en: Are you doubting my words? Now the monster is wounded and cornered, and I will not let the chance slip. Let's kill it together, or you'd better leave here if it sounds too cruel for you.

drama_dialogue2500940.ch: 好家伙，你是要独占䑏疏是吧？好，今日先收拾了你，再杀䑏疏！
drama_dialogue2500940.en: I see. You want to make the prey yours, right? Okay, I'll deal with you first!

drama_dialogue2500950.ch: 你当机立断，回身出手。䑏疏有伤在身，毫无反抗之力，被你出手击杀。
drama_dialogue2500950.en: You deliver a decisive strike. The wounded Fiery Unicorn was too weak to stand your attack and died immediately under it.

drama_dialogue2500951.ch: 嘿嘿，道友，我想说，你还是选错了……
drama_dialogue2500951.en: Hehe. Fellow cultivator, you made a wrong choice...

drama_dialogue2500952.ch: 你背后狂风骤起，那名修仙者竟以雷霆万钧之势对你发起攻击。
drama_dialogue2500952.en: A fierce wind rushes from your back. The cultivator launches an attack on you when you are distracted.

drama_dialogue2500960.ch: 你将此人击败，䑏疏肉身亦慢慢化为微尘，天风一吹，立即化为漫天烟气消散不见。看来，䑏疏额角是为至宝，亦不过子虚乌有。
drama_dialogue2500960.en: You defeated your opponent, but the Fiery Unicorn's body also fades into a strain of dust. It is soon scattered by the wind - perhaps the myth about its miraculous horn is really only a myth.

drama_dialogue2500980.ch: 甚好。道友不要再插手此事了，就等我来斩杀此妖，还暮仙州一个安宁吧。
drama_dialogue2500980.en: Good. It's better not to get involved in it. I'll bring Mu Xian the peace it has always been longing for.

drama_dialogue2500981.ch: 人心鬼蜮，向来难测，你不想插手此事，故选择离开。未料背后突然发出轰鸣，一股巨大的烟尘冲上半天，继而劲气扑面而来，将附近一切尽数夷平。
drama_dialogue2500981.en: You know how unfathomable a person could be and decide not to intervene. You turn to leave the spot, but suddenly you hear a rumble behind you. A dense smoke rises to the sky, and shortly after, the shockwave reduces the area into flat ground.

drama_dialogue2500982.ch: 你回看远处，只觉此前有关那青马的一切便如一场梦幻。
drama_dialogue2500982.en: You look back blankly and feel the time you spent with the steed is so unreal.

drama_dialogue2501000.ch: 䑏疏之角确为至宝，但此妖为恶亦是证据确凿，我贪图妖角，并不妨碍我替天行道，铲除恶兽。
drama_dialogue2501000.en: You're right. The Fiery Unicorn's horn is a treasure, and the monster is doing harm to us. I want its horn, and I also want to bring the world justice by killing the evil creature. That's it.

drama_dialogue2501001.ch: 道友，你在怀疑在下？如今妖兽负伤，又复受困，正是击杀此妖的良机。你要么这就离开，不要妨碍我。要么与我一并合力击杀妖兽。
drama_dialogue2501001.en: Are you doubting my words? Now the monster is wounded and cornered, and I will not let the chance slip. Let's kill it together, or you'd better leave here if it sounds too cruel for you.

drama_dialogue2501010.ch: 好家伙，你是要独占䑏疏是吧？好，今日先收拾了你，再杀䑏疏！
drama_dialogue2501010.en: I see. You want to make the prey yours, right? Okay, I'll deal with you first!

drama_dialogue2501020.ch: 你当机立断，回身出手。䑏疏有伤在身，毫无反抗之力，被你出手击杀。
drama_dialogue2501020.en: You deliver a decisive strike. The wounded Fiery Unicorn was too weak to stand your attack and died immediately under it.

drama_dialogue2501021.ch: 嘿嘿，道友，我想说，你还是选错了……
drama_dialogue2501021.en: Hehe. Fellow cultivator, you made a wrong choice...

drama_dialogue2501022.ch: 你背后狂风骤起，那名修仙者竟以雷霆万钧之势对你发起攻击。
drama_dialogue2501022.en: A fierce wind rushes from your back. The cultivator launches an attack on you when you are distracted.

drama_dialogue2501030.ch: 甚好。道友不要再插手此事了，就等我来斩杀此妖，还暮仙州一个安宁吧。
drama_dialogue2501030.en: Good. It's better not to get involved in it. I'll bring Mu Xian the peace it has always been longing for.

drama_dialogue2501031.ch: 人心鬼蜮，向来难测，你不想插手此事，故选择离开。未料背后突然发出轰鸣，一股巨大的烟尘冲上半天，继而劲气扑面而来，将附近一切尽数夷平。
drama_dialogue2501031.en: You know how unfathomable a person could be and decide not to intervene. You turn to leave the spot, but suddenly you hear a rumble behind you. A dense smoke rises to the sky, and shortly after, the shockwave reduces the area into flat ground.

drama_dialogue2501032.ch: 你回看远处，只觉此前有关那青马的一切便如一场梦幻。
drama_dialogue2501032.en: You look back blankly and feel the time you spent with the steed is so unreal.

drama_dialogue2501150.ch: 你将对手击败，青马伤口似亦已好转。它慢慢直起后腿，站了起来，艰难的挪移着。此时脚步声起，又有修仙者相继来到。
drama_dialogue2501150.en: You defeated your opponent, and the condition of the azure steed seems to have improved. The creature stretches its rear legs slowly and stands up, trying to move with much effort. Just at that time, you hear the sound of steps. More cultivators are heading here.

drama_dialogue2501151.ch: 刚才的打斗声响应是从此处发出。
drama_dialogue2501151.en: The sound of fighting came from here.

drama_dialogue2501152.ch: 不要再耽搁了，为了这妖物已经有四五名道友受伤了。
drama_dialogue2501152.en: No time to waste. A half dozen of cultivators have been wounded by it.

drama_dialogue2501153.ch: 他们最好都伤了、死了……那么便剩下你我……呃啊！！你要……独吞……
drama_dialogue2501153.en: Good. Just let them die, then you and I will... NO! You... hog it...

drama_dialogue2501154.ch: 你说得不错，最好大家都伤了、死了。但还剩下你我也不见得有什么好……䑏疏之角是我的……是我的！咦！
drama_dialogue2501154.en: You're right. Those cultivators are not worthy of my mercy, and neither are you. The Fiery Unicorn's horn is mine... It's mine! Wait...

drama_dialogue2501155.ch: 这名修仙者发现了你与䑏疏，双眼中立即射来贪婪和凶狠的光芒。
drama_dialogue2501155.en: The cultivator notices you and the Fiery Unicorn. You see blatant greediness in the person's eyes.

drama_dialogue2501156.ch: 哦，刚刚的事情你都看在眼里了吧？哎呀，䑏疏也在。真是太好了。那怨不得我了……你去死吧！！
drama_dialogue2501156.en: You saw what happened just now right? And the Fiery Unicorn is here too. That's good. I'll kill you two with one strike!

drama_dialogue2501170.ch: 你将对手击败，䑏疏似乎又恢复不少，已能踢踏踢踏的走了起来。不过此时又有两名修仙者察觉这边的动静相继赶到。
drama_dialogue2501170.en: You defeated the opponent. The Fiery Unicorn seems to be much better; it can stagger forward now. However, your fight attracted another two cultivators here.

drama_dialogue2501171.en: Here! The Fiery Unicorn is here!

drama_dialogue2501172.ch: 快动手！这妖物还走不动！
drama_dialogue2501172.en: Catch it! It cannot move now!

drama_dialogue2501200.ch: 你与修仙者接连战斗，发出偌大动静。此次群起捉捕䑏疏的修仙者相继发现你们的踪迹，纷纷赶来。
drama_dialogue2501200.en: Another fierce fight. The cultivators searching for the Fiery Unicorn all noticed the sound you made and are hurrying here for their prey.

drama_dialogue2501201.ch: 䑏疏腿脚似乎已经恢复的差不多，它半蹲下身来，似乎正等待你坐上背后，一起离开。
drama_dialogue2501201.en: The wound in the Fiery Unicorn's leg has nearly recovered. It lowers its body before you like inviting you to ride on it and leave here together.

drama_dialogue2501203.ch: 䑏疏四蹄飞起，跃至空中。此时一名修仙者从旁而至，扬手间一段白索飞出，缠向青马。那白索见风即长，变成十多丈长的匹练不断缠绕青马。
drama_dialogue2501203.en: The Fiery Unicorn leaps into the sky. However, a cultivator on the ground throws out a white rope, and it soon extends to a long and firm strip around the creature.

drama_dialogue2501204.ch: 青马最终因被捆绑而掉落地上，再也无法动弹。这时人声大作，四方修仙者纷纷朝这边聚拢逼近。青马眼中露出神光，同时额角闪闪发亮。
drama_dialogue2501204.en: The steed is restrained by the rope and falls to the ground again. The rope renders it unable to move even a single step, and it has been surrounded by cultivators from all directions. The creature's eyes shine with unusual sparks, and its horn begins to glow.

drama_dialogue2501205.ch: 同时你眼前再度浮现出那名男子与青马的情景。其时男子正竭力控制掌中法阵，吸纳冥气，降下冥山。但地上符文已渐渐暗淡，情况即将失控。
drama_dialogue2501205.en: You see two familiar figures before your eyes, one is the mysterious man, and the other is the steed. The man is absorbing Nether Air into the array on his palm with all efforts, apparently trying to lower the Nether Mountains. However, the glow from the runes on the ground is fading, and soon the condition would be out of control.

drama_dialogue2501206.ch: 可恶……太勉强了！天地之变，终究不是人力所能抵挡……
drama_dialogue2501206.en: Ugh... Much more difficult than thought... Changing the course of nature is beyond a human being's power...

drama_dialogue2501207.ch: 此时青马的额角泛起闪光，一股力量从角上溢出传到男子手上。他地上的阵法原本已黯淡无光，此时再度明亮起来。
drama_dialogue2501207.en: But at the same time, a glow emits from the steed's horn and flows into the man's hand. The array on the ground becomes radiant again as well.

drama_dialogue2501208.ch: 啊？！是你……在帮我？！这便是额角的真正力量……很好！把你角上力量借给我吧！
drama_dialogue2501208.en: Oh? Are you... helping me? Does it come from your horn... Thank you. Now please lend me the power in it!

drama_dialogue2501209.ch: 青马额角的力量不断涌入你手掌上，同时你掌中胀满之感越来越厉害……
drama_dialogue2501209.en: The incredible energy from the steed's horn gathers in your palm, and you feel the power gradually brimming to full...

drama_dialogue2501210.en: Okay, I'll see if it will do.

drama_dialogue2501211.ch: 你挥手间，扬出一道碧绿气浪。这道气浪朝四方扩散，眨眼间将周遭夷为平地……
drama_dialogue2501211.en: You wave your hand and release a cerulean shockwave. It expands out in a moment and crushes everything on its way...

drama_dialogue2501212.ch: 敌人都被打败了……䑏疏呢？
drama_dialogue2501212.en: The enemies are defeated... And where is the Fiery Unicorn?

drama_dialogue2501550.ch: 青马被捆绑地上，无法动弹，他的额角变得暗哑无光。他回头看了看你，发出一声嘶鸣。声音之中虽有无奈，却也不乏威严。
drama_dialogue2501550.en: The creature is still being bound by the rope. The glow on its horn has faded away. It turns back and looks at you, and lets out a melancholy, yet august, neigh.

drama_dialogue2501570.ch: 你在接触青马的一刻，眼前隐约幻化一片模糊的情景。
drama_dialogue2501570.en: Another clip emerges before you as you touch the steed.

drama_dialogue2501590.ch: 前方紫雾迷蒙，四周紫黑色的山峰次第崛起。男子在地上画着一个阵法以之吸收着冥气，旁边的青马额角亦是光芒闪烁。
drama_dialogue2501590.en: Gruesome hills and cliffs are shrouded in the dark mist. The man is watching an array on the ground and the Nether Air that is being absorbed, and the steed's horn shines beside him.

drama_dialogue2501591.ch: 哼，好马儿，那我们就并肩将这段泄露冥气的枢纽封印了吧！
drama_dialogue2501591.en: Well, good steed. Let's seal the fissure together, or the Nether Air will keep seeping out.

drama_dialogue2501592.ch: 一人一兽合力施法，前方雾气却越来越多，渐渐形成强大气流吹拂人兽。
drama_dialogue2501592.en: The two begin to cast a spell with combined power, but the mist starts to condense too. Soon, they find themselves struggling forward against the fierce flow of Nether Air.

drama_dialogue2501593.en: That won't do. Leave here, good steed.

drama_dialogue2501594.ch: 青马发出一声怒嘶，不退反进，竟挡在男子身前，迎着紫气艰难前进。
drama_dialogue2501594.en: The steed cries out angrily. Then, it steps before the man and presses on in the howling dark flow.

drama_dialogue2501596.ch: 青马没听男子喝斥，反而迎着气流缓缓前进。男子眉头一皱，从怀中摸出一段白索对青马挥出，将其缠住。白马被缚，无法与冥气相抗，最终被冥气吹飞。
drama_dialogue2501596.en: The steed ignores him and continues to move forward. The man frowns and takes a white rope from his chest. He throws it to the creature and lets it be bound, and the next moment, the steed is blown away by the flow.

drama_dialogue2501597.ch: 马儿，离开这里以后尽可能的跑吧。可不要再被觊觎你顶上尖角的人盯上了！
drama_dialogue2501597.en: Escape here and run as fast as you can. Remember not to be caught again by the persons craving your horn!

drama_dialogue2501598.ch: 男子说完继续施法，双掌间阵法变得额外明亮。周围的冥气则像滚滚巨浪，一边朝男子身上袭去，一边被不断吸阵法之中。
drama_dialogue2501598.en: The man continues to cast the spell. The array in his palms emits dazzling rays of light, absorbing all the torrents of Nether Air that are about to devour him.

drama_dialogue2501599.ch: 不多时冥气尽被吸纳，四周崛起的冥山山体亦相继崩裂消散。
drama_dialogue2501599.en: The Nether Air is fully absorbed into the array shortly afterward, and the Nether Mountains begin to crack and collapse.

drama_dialogue2501600.ch: 青马重获自由，再度站起。它眼中原本的哀色慢慢褪去继而露出威严，然后转头看着你。
drama_dialogue2501600.en: The azure steed stands up. It is free again; its sad eyes are now full of dignity. The creature turns back and looks at you.

drama_dialogue2501610.ch: 青马似乎听懂了你的话，他轻轻发出一声嘶鸣，对你作出回应。
drama_dialogue2501610.en: The steed seems to know your meaning. It whinnies gently as a response.

drama_dialogue2501620.ch: 青马似乎对你点了点头，然后转过身去撒开四蹄，跃上半空化作一道青影消失于远空之中。
drama_dialogue2501620.en: The steed nods slightly. Then, it gallops away and leaps into the air, and soon vanishes beyond the cerulean canopy.

drama_dialogue2501630.ch: 青马似乎对你点了点头，然后踢踏两步走到你身前站定。而你则取出炼妖壶将青马吸进壶中。
drama_dialogue2501630.en: The steed nods slightly. Then, it steps toward you and stands there, and you absorb it into your Mythical Gourd.

drama_dialogue2501631.ch: 这只古时协助大能解决暮仙州冥山之患的妖兽飘零多时，终于有了自己的归宿。
drama_dialogue2501631.en: The mysterious creature used to be a powerful ally of a master cultivator against the Nether Mountains in Mu Xian. Finally, after years of wandering, it arrives home.

drama_dialogue2502001.ch: 半空中青影一闪而过，你发现那只额生一角的青马再次出现在你面前。
drama_dialogue2502001.en: An azure streak flashes before your eyes. The steed with a horn appears before you again.

drama_dialogue2502002.ch: 只见那马儿嘴上叼着一本秘籍，并将之交到你手后，便迈开蹄子离开了。
drama_dialogue2502002.en: The steed is holding a manual in its mouth. It puts it in your hands and leaves.

drama_dialogue2502003.ch: 只见那马儿嘴上叼着一本秘籍，并将之交到你手。然后站定看着你。
drama_dialogue2502003.en: The steed is holding a manual in its mouth. It puts it in your hands and looks at you.

drama_dialogue2502004.ch: 你刚接过青马递来的秘籍，眼前突然浮现一片情景。
drama_dialogue2502004.en: A clip unfolds before your eyes as you take the manual.

drama_dialogue2502005.ch: 那名男子正站在秘窟前凝神苦思，他身边的青马则一直留意四周情状。
drama_dialogue2502005.en: The man is thinking about something in front of a secret cave, with the steed keeping watch at his side.

drama_dialogue2502006.ch: 秘籍都十分高深，这究竟是个什么遗迹？又是什么人曾在这里面钻研秘籍？
drama_dialogue2502006.en: The manuals are very complicated. What would this ruin be used for? And who would study manuals in it?

drama_dialogue2502007.ch: 这处遗址是你带我来的。马儿啊，你说呢？我们一路发现的这些遗址当中到底藏着什么秘密？
drama_dialogue2502007.en: You bring me here, good steed. What do you think about it? Have you found anything on all of the ruins we discovered on our journey?

drama_dialogue2502008.ch: 哼，琅琊阁是个什么神秘组织，为什么要这样推演这些秘籍……
drama_dialogue2502008.en: Hmph. What is the Manual Pavilion? And why would they make out the manuals with such a method...

drama_dialogue2502009.ch: 他们和冥山崛起究竟有什么关联……
drama_dialogue2502009.en: Do they have something to do with the Nether Mountains...

drama_dialogue2502030.ch: 半空中青影一闪而过，你发现那只额生一角的青马再次出现在你面前。
drama_dialogue2502030.en: An azure streak flashes before your eyes. The steed with a horn appears before you again.

drama_dialogue2502031.ch: 只见那马儿口衔灵果，并将之塞你手中。
drama_dialogue2502031.en: The steed carries some Spiritual Fruits in its mouth. It puts them into your hands.

drama_dialogue2502060.ch: 半空中青影一闪而过，你发现那只额生一角的青马再次出现在你面前。
drama_dialogue2502060.en: An azure streak flashes before your eyes. The steed with a horn appears before you again.

drama_dialogue2502061.ch: 只见那马儿用嘴轻轻咬着你的衣袖似乎要带你去什么地方。
drama_dialogue2502061.en: The steed is pulling your sleeve gently. It may hope you follow its steps.

drama_dialogue2502062.ch: 马儿将你带到充满妖气之地，前方定必满布凶险，可要跟随进入？
drama_dialogue2502062.en: The azure steed brings you to somewhere near monster lairs. Enter the place and fight the monsters?

drama_dialogue2502063.ch: 马儿协助你将前方妖物尽数歼灭后，用蹄足刨开土地，挖出若干宝物。
drama_dialogue2502063.en: You two defeated the monsters together, and the steed digs something out from the earth with its hoof.

drama_dialogue2502064.ch: 它将宝物挖出以后，用凌厉的目光看了你一眼，便踏着脚步离开了。
drama_dialogue2502064.en: It places the treasure on the ground and glares at you, and turns to leave.

drama_dialogue2502065.ch: 你还没搞明白眼前情况，只见青马额角微微发出光芒，你眼前突然窥见一片幻象。
drama_dialogue2502065.en: Before you could know what happened, the steed's horn begins to glow, and a clip from the past emerges before your eyes.

drama_dialogue2502066.ch: 男子走在前方目视远方山势，后面青色角马轻步跟随，眼看男子停定脚步，便发出一声嘶鸣。
drama_dialogue2502066.en: The man is walking in the front, his eyes gazing at the distant hills. The steed follows his steps and neighs when finding the man stops.

drama_dialogue2502067.ch: 按照山势，此处应该是泄气之处，那边则是围堵收截的关隘。这是人为布置的。若我所料不差，这种风水之地通常藏有异宝。
drama_dialogue2502067.en: The Qi will flow out here following the course of hills and will be blocked and collected by the mountain pass there. The terrain is arranged by someone, and, if I am true, there are treasures hidden under the extraordinary Feng Shui here.

drama_dialogue2502068.ch: 男子指点远山，侃侃而谈。青马停在旁边，俯首倾听，偶尔踢足地上，发出一两声脆响。
drama_dialogue2502068.en: The man points to the mountains and talks to the creature. The steed stands beside him and listens with attention, kicking its hoofs on the ground casually.

drama_dialogue2502069.ch: 哈哈，我每次都说得忘形了。难为你还一字不漏的听了去。马儿马儿，我们过去看看吧。
drama_dialogue2502069.en: Well, seems that I'm obsessed with explaining things again, and I hope you won't feel bored. Let's go there and take a look now.

drama_dialogue2502070.ch: 男子轻拍青马背脊，与其一并前行，往远处山隘去了。
drama_dialogue2502070.en: The man pats the steed on its back and walks together to the mountain pass.

drama_dialogue2502090.ch: 你正打算专心学习秘籍，忽觉半空中掠影闪过，定睛看时，却是那青马。
drama_dialogue2502090.en: Something flits through the sky as you are about to begin learning the manual. It's the azure steed.

drama_dialogue2502091.ch: 青马朝你发出一声嘶叫，然后在不断奔腾纵跃，似乎在提示着什么。
drama_dialogue2502091.en: The steed cries to you and leaps around you as if it wants to remind you of something.

drama_dialogue2502092.ch: 你不明所以，正想将青马喝退，再回看手中秘籍。正当此时，你原本感觉难以参透的难题竟一一贯通。
drama_dialogue2502092.en: You feel a bit disturbed and decide to admonish it, but just at the moment, you find the arcane words in the manual all make sense.

drama_dialogue2502093.ch: 你知道那是青马故意展现各种情状借以对你进行启发，然而当你抬头时，前方马影无踪，只有几缕扬起的微尘未曾落下。
drama_dialogue2502093.en: You know the steed inspired you with its moves and stances. You raise your head to see it again, only to find strains of fine dust drifting in the air.

drama_dialogue2502094.ch: 你还在潜心回想那些最新感悟的东西，没想到眼前突然浮现一片奇特的情景。
drama_dialogue2502094.en: You try to comprehend what you've learned recently, and a clip begins to unfold in your mind.

drama_dialogue2502095.ch: 男子正于浓荫下读书，旁边青马发出踢踏蹄响，轻轻走近。
drama_dialogue2502095.en: The man is reading under a tree, and the steed walks closer to him in crisp steps.

drama_dialogue2502096.ch: 为何你好像总对我看的书很感兴趣？也罢，我就给你讲解讲解吧。
drama_dialogue2502096.en: It seems that you are always interested in what I'm reading. Alright, I'll tell you.

drama_dialogue2502097.ch: 男子说完真的将手中秘籍的阅读心得逐一说出。一个人给妖兽讲授秘籍本就奇特，更为古怪的是马儿亦专心倾听。他们一个讲一个听，俨然便是一对师徒。
drama_dialogue2502097.en: The man really begins to explain the manual to the mysterious creature. It's curious to see a human being teaching something to a steed, and what renders the scene more incredible is that the equine student is listening to its teacher attentively.

drama_dialogue2502098.ch: 我看这些，都是为了查出那个关键枢纽。究竟这人是通过什么法子将枢纽隐藏起来的呢？高明。
drama_dialogue2502098.en: I want to know more about the crucial nexus from those records. How could the person manage to conceal it? That's unbelievable.

drama_dialogue2502120.ch: 半空中青影一闪而过，你发现那只额生一角的青马再次出现在你面前。
drama_dialogue2502120.en: An azure streak flashes before your eyes. The steed with a horn appears before you again.

drama_dialogue2502121.ch: 它踢踏两步朝你走来，然后用嘴轻轻扯着你的袖子，将你带到一个神秘的洞穴中。
drama_dialogue2502121.en: It comes to you in cheerful steps and holds your sleeve in its mouth. Then, it brings you to a mysterious cave.

drama_dialogue2502130.ch: 它从里面叼出来几枚尖石塞到你手中，才嘶叫两声转身而去。
drama_dialogue2502130.en: It takes some rock shards from it and puts them into your hands. Then, it leaves with brisk neighs.

drama_dialogue2502140.ch: 它从里面叼出来几枚尖石塞到你手中，才嘶叫两声转身而去。而你伸手接过石子的瞬间，眼前竟浮现一片奇特的情景。
drama_dialogue2502140.en: It takes some rock shards from it and puts them into your hands. Then, it leaves with brisk neighs. A peculiar scene unfolds before you as you hold the shards.

drama_dialogue2502141.ch: 你看这些石子闪亮尖锐，不是跟你的角很像吗？我跟你说，这些石子可以帮助我们修仙者修炼功法，可是绝好的东西呢。
drama_dialogue2502141.en: These shiny and sharp shards are really like your horn. We cultivators are very fond of them since they help a lot in practicing martial arts.

drama_dialogue2502142.ch: 说起你的角，据闻驩疏额角含有极大灵力，而且一生之中仅能使用三次。驩疏成胎不易，能够安然出生更是万中无一。
drama_dialogue2502142.en: And your horn... I read from books that it contains unimaginable energy, but it could only be used three times in your life. It's usually difficult for your species to conceive offspring, and it's even more difficult to see the babies be born alive.

drama_dialogue2502143.ch: 而驩疏婴儿在出生之际便已使用了一次额角灵力，以保住自身性命。这么说的话，你的额角应该还能再使用两次。剩下两次给我用一下吧，怎样？
drama_dialogue2502143.en: You had used your horn once to secure your survival at the time you were born. I guess now you could use it two more times. Would you mind lending me a chance?

drama_dialogue2502144.ch: 咦，你生气了？马儿啊马儿，我这不是开玩笑吗？
drama_dialogue2502144.en: Well, did my words annoy you? Oh, don't take it to heart, good steed! I'm just kidding...

drama_dialogue2502145.ch: 驩疏感通人心，似乎听懂了这名男子的话。它露出不愉之色，转头离开。那名男子哈哈大笑，跟上走远的驩疏，与它并肩远去。
drama_dialogue2502145.en: The Fiery Unicorn seems to understand what the man said. It turns to leave in displeasure. The man laughs and hurries to the steed, and the two walk away into the distance together.

drama_dialogue2600001.ch: 你听说了吗？近日琅琊阁公开了一部分界元石的信息。
drama_dialogue2600001.en: Recently, the Manual Pavilion announced its findings on a treasure called Enigmatic Stone. Have you heard of it?

drama_dialogue2600003.ch: 孤陋寡闻的东西！当你学习更深奥神妙的功法时，就不得不舍弃从前悟出的心得对不对？
drama_dialogue2600003.en: Hey, you're too ill-informed! In the past, when we found a more advanced Martial Art, we must abandon what we learned and begin to work on the new manual, right?

drama_dialogue2600004.ch: 若你拥有这件宝物，就可以用它保留你以往参研功法时感悟出来的重要心得。
drama_dialogue2600004.en: And now, if we have the stone in hand, we could pick some insights from our previous martial arts to preserve.

drama_dialogue2600005.ch: 若你以后得了机缘学习到更为强大的功法，还能从界元石中将保留的心得提取出来，并完美契合到新功法之中。
drama_dialogue2600005.en: What's more, the insight recorded in it could be put into your new Martial Art if you happen to find a near-perfect one.

drama_dialogue2600006.ch: 什么？！还有此等神妙之物？！琅琊阁实是造福我等修仙者啊！
drama_dialogue2600006.en: Well? That's incredible! The Manual Pavilion is really doing good for us!

drama_dialogue2600007.ch: 我们赶紧去<r>琅琊阁</r>询问<r>关于界元石</r>之事吧，这次发现的石矿极为有限，过了这村就没这店了。
drama_dialogue2600007.en: Let's set out to the <r>Manual Pavilion</r> to ask about their findings on that <r>Enigmatic Stones</r>. It's said that the precious ore is so rare, and our opportunity knocks but once.

drama_dialogue2600020.ch: 仙长你好，近日八荒地脉变化，从而让部分界元石显露于世。而我阁已查知其确切方位。
drama_dialogue2600020.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, some Enigmatic Stones emerge from earth veins, and our Pavilion has found their whereabouts.

drama_dialogue2600021.ch: 这界元石可刻录保留以往修炼功法时感悟出来的心得，并能将其融合到新修炼的功法里。乃绝世之妙宝。
drama_dialogue2600021.en: The Enigmatic Stone is a treasure for cultivators. It can record the insights from your previous Martial Arts and put them into another once you are about to learn a new manual.

drama_dialogue2600022.ch: 如今只需交纳一定灵石以供我阁启动新一轮的秘籍研究即可获知界元石所在。
drama_dialogue2600022.en: If you want to know where the mysterious stones are, you could pay the Pavilion some Spirit Stones, since we need funds to carry out our new research on manuals.

drama_dialogue2600023.ch: 我阁一向旨在不遗余力提高修仙者修为，若仙长对此感兴趣，不妨到各地<r>琅琊阁管理员</r>处询问关于<r>界元石之事</r>。
drama_dialogue2600023.en: The Manual Pavilion is always glad to help our fellow cultivators. If you are interested in the <r>Enigmatic Stone</r>, please ask <r>Pavilion Clerks</r> in cities and towns for more information.

drama_dialogue26001.ch: {#building10005Name_162101}乃是{#areaName2}中的传说之地。据说{#building10005Name_162101}中蕴养着极为珍贵的天材地宝，这些天材地宝可以使炼气境的修仙者在突破至筑基境时能够获得更加强大的力量！
drama_dialogue26001.en: {#building10005Name_162101} is a place of legend in {#areaName2}. The {#building10005Name_162101} is said to be home to incredibly valuable Heaven and Earth Treasures that grant Qi Refining Cultivators even greater powers when they breakthrough to Foundation.

drama_dialogue2600100.ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此，只需要提供500灵石即可获知八荒至宝界元石位置所在。
drama_dialogue2600100.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals. If you are also here for the whereabouts of the Enigmatic Stone, you could exchange the information with 500 Spirit Stones.

drama_dialogue2600110.ch: 如今我阁急需灵石维持编修计划，除去仙长目前身处的小店外，其余各州已发现界元石矿藏的琅琊阁也已发出告示，以界元石的位置交换灵石。
drama_dialogue2600110.en: We are in urgent need of funds for our research. Except for the store you're in, other Manual Pavilions throughout the world have all posted their findings on the distributions of Enigmatic Stones nearby, as well as their needs for Spirit Stones.

drama_dialogue2600111.ch: 若仙长对界元石仍有需求，不妨前往我阁分号，继续获知界元石分布位置。
drama_dialogue2600111.en: If you need more Enigmatic Stones, you may visit the Pavilion's other branches. They may as well know where could you find them.

drama_dialogue2600112.ch: 界元石效用神妙，从古至今都为修仙者所看重。仙长若有心取得此物，可要赶紧了。
drama_dialogue2600112.en: The Enigmatic Stone has always been a treasure craved by cultivators. Please hurry up in case it was seized by others.

drama_dialogue2600130.ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
drama_dialogue2600130.en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

drama_dialogue2600131.ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600131.en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

drama_dialogue2600132.ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600132.en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

drama_dialogue2600133.ch: 元灵被你击溃后，渐自化为一股青岚。烟光映照下，可见洞窟深处藏有一枚闪闪发亮的晶石。那，即是界元石。
drama_dialogue2600133.en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turns into a cyan haze, and amid it, you see something shining at the deepest end of the cave. It's the Enigmatic Stone.

drama_dialogue2600300.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

drama_dialogue2600310.ch: 仙长，这界元石乃八荒地脉石芯增生形成的灵石矿藏。自古即为善于堪舆的修仙者所青睐，并千方百计挖掘获取。
drama_dialogue2600310.en: Dear cultivator, the Enigmatic Stones are a kind of special ore grown from the heart of the earth veins. They were sought after for centuries by cultivators excelling in Geomancy.

drama_dialogue2600311.ch: 界元石为了应对古时修仙者采挖之举，因此衍生出强大的自卫能力。
drama_dialogue2600311.en: Therefore, the Enigmatic Stones developed means to defend themselves.

drama_dialogue2600312.ch: 它们化生元灵，并模仿学习前来采挖的修仙者的各种功法，从而提升自己实力，击退来犯者。
drama_dialogue2600312.en: They formed Enigmatic Souls and learned from the cultivators searching for them, and acquired many Martial Arts to drive intruders away.

drama_dialogue2600313.ch: 也因为这个缘故，界元石所生元灵实力绝不亚于强大的修仙者。仙长前往地脉分支取得界元石，可千万要小心。
drama_dialogue2600313.en: After years of development, the power of those Souls is now equal to some master cultivators. Please do be careful in your search for them.

drama_dialogue2600330.ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。

drama_dialogue2600331.ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600331.en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

drama_dialogue2600332.ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600332.en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

drama_dialogue2600333.ch: 元灵被你挫败后，慢慢化作一团青气。微光照耀下，只见洞窟内壁镶嵌闪烁异芒的晶体。那，便是琅琊阁提及的界元石。
drama_dialogue2600333.en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turns into a cyan haze, and amid the dim light, you see something shining on the wall of the cave. It's the Enigmatic Stone mentioned by the Manual Pavilion.

drama_dialogue2600350.ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此我阁愿意公开部分界元石的确切位置，以换取灵石。不知仙长是否有意获取这界元石呢？
drama_dialogue2600350.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

drama_dialogue2600351.ch: 仙长，这界元石乃八荒地脉石芯增生形成的灵石矿藏。自古即为善于堪舆的修仙者所青睐，并千方百计挖掘获取。
drama_dialogue2600351.en: Dear cultivator, the Enigmatic Stones are a kind of special ore grown from the heart of the earth veins. They were sought after for centuries by cultivators excelling in Geomancy.

drama_dialogue2600352.ch: 界元石为了应对古时修仙者采挖之举，因此衍生出强大的自卫能力。
drama_dialogue2600352.en: Therefore, the Enigmatic Stones developed means to defend themselves.

drama_dialogue2600353.ch: 它们化生元灵，并模仿学习前来采挖的修仙者的各种功法，从而提升自己实力，击退来犯者。
drama_dialogue2600353.en: They formed Enigmatic Souls and learned from the cultivators searching for them, and acquired many Martial Arts to drive intruders away.

drama_dialogue2600354.ch: 也因为这个缘故，界元石所生元灵实力绝不亚于强大的修仙者。仙长前往地脉分支取得界元石，可千万要小心。
drama_dialogue2600354.en: After years of development, the power of those Souls is now equal to some master cultivators. Please do be careful in your search for them.

drama_dialogue2600360.ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
drama_dialogue2600360.en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

drama_dialogue2600361.ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600361.en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

drama_dialogue2600362.ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。

drama_dialogue2600511.ch: 只不过，界元石元灵十分厉害，我阁分派不出这许多大能前往击败元灵。同时急于筹集灵石进行新一轮的大编修以适应我阁定期产出新秘籍的需求。

drama_dialogue2600512.en: Therefore, we could only trade the information with cultivators in exchange for Spirit Stones. These Enigmatic Stones are ancient beings, and after centuries of development, their Souls are already formidable opponents.

drama_dialogue2600513.ch: 仙长前往取石，可千万要小心。

drama_dialogue2600552.ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600552.en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

drama_dialogue2600553.ch: 元灵遭你击溃，随即化作烟云渐次消散。其时石洞深处突现光芒，十分夺目。细看下发现那正是琅琊阁提及的界元石。
drama_dialogue2600553.en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turned into a haze and soon disappeared. Suddenly, a dazzling beam emits from the deepest end of the cave, and following it, you find the Enigmatic Stone mentioned by the Manual Pavilion.

drama_dialogue2600560.ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此我阁愿意公开部分界元石的确切位置，以换取灵石。不知仙长是否有意获取这界元石呢？
drama_dialogue2600560.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

drama_dialogue2600561.ch: 仙长，前往寻找界元石前请听我一言。这界元石我阁原本想取得以保留罕有之功法心得。
drama_dialogue2600561.en: Senior cultivator, I have a piece of advice for you. We also intended to get some Enigmatic Stones for ourselves to record the rare knowledge found in manuals.

drama_dialogue2600562.ch: 只不过，界元石元灵十分厉害，我阁分派不出这许多大能前往击败元灵。同时急于筹集灵石进行新一轮的大编修以适应我阁定期产出新秘籍的需求。
drama_dialogue2600562.en: However, the Souls of the stones are not easy to deal with. Our master cultivators are usually too busy to offer help, and unfortunately, we're in urgent need of Spirit Stones to cover our new research on manuals and their regular publishing.

drama_dialogue2600563.ch: 无奈下，这才希望将这至宝托付于八荒修仙者。这些界元石留存八荒已久，元灵已十分厉害。
drama_dialogue2600563.en: Therefore, we could only trade the information with cultivators in exchange for Spirit Stones. These Enigmatic Stones are ancient beings, and after centuries of development, their Souls are already formidable opponents.

drama_dialogue2600564.ch: 仙长前往取石，可千万要小心。
drama_dialogue2600564.en: Please do be careful in your journey, senior cultivator.

drama_dialogue2600570.ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
drama_dialogue2600570.en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

drama_dialogue2600571.ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。

drama_dialogue2600710.ch: 嗯，不是小店看轻了仙长。这界元石万分稀有，能保存至今的，其本身一定饱含灵力。若感知外界冒犯，便可能生成元灵击退来人。
drama_dialogue2600710.en: Well, please take the stones seriously. The Enigmatic Stones are rare treasures, and those that haven't been extracted now are all brimmed with energy. Once they feel they're threatened, their soul will emerge as the intruder's opponents.

drama_dialogue2600711.ch: 界元石自古以来一直为修仙者喜爱。修仙者多次试探采挖，元灵则屡屡与修仙者交锋，将其击退。因此我们八荒修仙者已经间接将界元石培养得十分厉害。
drama_dialogue2600711.en: The Enigmatic Stones are craved by cultivators for centuries, and they have seen many powerful but careless intruders being defeated and dispelled. That is to say, they also gained experience in numerous battles against us.

drama_dialogue2600712.ch: 所以界元石一旦化灵，无异于大能修士，绝代强者。仙长到时还需小心应对。
drama_dialogue2600712.en: So, please do be careful. The Souls of Enigmatic Stones are fearsome opponents equal to master cultivators of our kind.

drama_dialogue2600771.en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

drama_dialogue2600772.ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。
drama_dialogue2600772.en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

drama_dialogue2600773.ch: 元灵被你击败，随即化作烟云渐次消散。其时石洞深处突现光芒，十分夺目。细看下发现那正是琅琊阁提及的界元石。
drama_dialogue2600773.en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turned into a haze and soon disappeared. Suddenly, a dazzling beam emits from the deepest end of the cave, and following it, you find the Enigmatic Stone mentioned by the Manual Pavilion.

drama_dialogue2600780.ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此我阁愿意公开部分界元石的确切位置，以换取灵石。不知仙长是否有意获取这界元石呢？
drama_dialogue2600780.en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

drama_dialogue2600781.ch: 嗯，不是小店看轻了仙长。这界元石万分稀有，能保存至今的，其本身一定饱含灵力。若感知外界冒犯，便可能生成元灵击退来人。
drama_dialogue2600781.en: Well, please take the stones seriously. The Enigmatic Stones are rare treasures, and those that haven't been extracted now are all brimmed with energy. Once they feel they're threatened, their soul will emerge as the intruder's opponents.

drama_dialogue2600782.ch: 界元石自古以来一直为修仙者喜爱。修仙者多次试探采挖，元灵则屡屡与修仙者交锋，将其击退。因此我们八荒修仙者已经间接将界元石培养得十分厉害。
drama_dialogue2600782.en: The Enigmatic Stones are craved by cultivators for centuries, and they have seen many powerful but careless intruders being defeated and dispelled. That is to say, they also gained experience in numerous battles against us.

drama_dialogue2600783.ch: 所以界元石一旦化灵，无异于大能修士，绝代强者。仙长到时还需小心应对。
drama_dialogue2600783.en: So, please do be careful. The Souls of Enigmatic Stones are fearsome opponents equal to master cultivators of our kind.

drama_dialogue2600790.ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
drama_dialogue2600790.en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

drama_dialogue2600791.ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。

drama_dialogue2600980.ch: 元灵被你击败后，突然光芒大盛，继而消散无踪。透过强光，可隐约看见石窟深处竟遗落一份手稿。
drama_dialogue2600980.en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It disappeared in a dazzling light, and with the help of it, you noticed there is a manuscript in the corner of the cave.

drama_dialogue2601071.ch: 地脉柱石周围能量闪烁，似乎感受到了威胁并拒绝着所有来者！！！
drama_dialogue2601071.en: Sparks of energy emit from the stone. It seems to have felt something and is beginning to defend itself.

drama_dialogue2601072.ch: 突然，能量集中至一处，一只远古修士的虚影渐渐形成......
drama_dialogue2601072.en: Suddenly, the energy condenses into a figure of an ancient cultivator...

drama_dialogue26011.ch: {#building10005Name_162104}乃是{#areaName2}中的传说之地。据说{#building10005Name_162104}中蕴养着极为珍贵的天材地宝，这些天材地宝可以使筑基境的修仙者在突破至结晶境时能够获得更加强大的力量！
drama_dialogue26011.en: {#building10005Name_162104} is a place of legend in {#areaName2}. The {#building10005Name_162104} is said to be home to incredibly valuable Heaven and Earth Treasures that grant Foundation Cultivators even greater powers when they breakthrough to Qi Condensation.

drama_dialogue26012.ch: 你若是想要寻找{#building10005Name_162104}，可以到{mapData114}、{mapData115}附近去找找看。除了这两处外，据说在{#areaName3}中，也有一处{#building10005Name_162104}，但{#areaName3}中危机四伏，若是没有足够的实力，切勿轻易踏足。
drama_dialogue26012.en: If you want to find the {#building10005Name_162104} go and look near {mapData114} or {mapData115}. In addition to these two locations, they say there's a {#building10005Name_162104} in {#areaName3}, however {#areaName3} is very dangerous. Only go there if you are confident you can survive.

drama_dialogue26021.ch: {#building10005Name_162107}乃是上古遗留至今的宝地，据说其中藏着不少宝物。而这{#building10005Name_162107}，据说就藏在{#areaName4}中的某处，但修仙者想要打开{#building10005Name_162107}难于登天。
drama_dialogue26021.en: {#building10005Name_162107} is an ancient site reputed to contain many treasures. The {#building10005Name_162107} is supposedly located somewhere in {#areaName4}, though access is notoriously difficult to achieve.

drama_dialogue26022.ch: 你若是想试试，可以到{mapData117}、{mapData118}、{mapData119}、{mapData120}附近去看看。
drama_dialogue26022.en: If you want to try, go and look near {mapData117}, {mapData118}, {mapData119} or {mapData120}.

drama_dialogue26031.ch: {#building10005Name_162111}在{#areaName5}深处，具体方位无人知晓。{#areaName5}中危机四伏，若是没有足够的实力，切勿轻易踏足。
drama_dialogue26031.en: The {#building10005Name_162111} is located in the depths of {#areaName5}, though the exact location is unknown. {#areaName5} is very dangerous. Only go there if you are confident you can survive.

drama_dialogue26041.ch: 法宝并不难炼，各州城镇中的<r>工坊</r>内都配备了炼制所需的砧炉，难点在于炼制法宝所需的核心材料非常稀有，阁下只能从一些极其危险的<r>特殊大妖兽</r>身上取得。
drama_dialogue26041.en: Artifacts are not difficult to forge, as the <r>workshops</r> in cities have the forge already. The difficult part lies in obtaining the core materials, which can only be found with <r>special mythical beasts</r> that are very powerful and dangerous.

drama_dialogue26042.ch: 有了核心材料之后，收集剩下那些辅助材料便不是什么难事了。
drama_dialogue26042.en: Once you have the core materials, it's not that difficult to get the rest.

drama_dialogue26043.ch: 因为法宝乃是基于核心材料而成，故不同的核心材料会炼制出不同的法宝，诸多法宝形象有别、功能各异，还需阁下亲自体验方知其中妙处。言尽于此，祝阁下早日得宝而归。
drama_dialogue26043.en: Different core materials produce artifacts that are different in their appearances and functions, so you must experiment and discover them on your own. With that said, I hope you get your artifacts soon.

drama_dialogue26051.ch: 在靠近冥山的地方有一处冥气稀薄的所在，名唤<r>陨幽谷</r>，谷中有大量被冥气侵蚀的可怕生物，可谓凶险异常。
drama_dialogue26051.en: There's a place near the Nether Mountains called <r>Fallen Valley</r>. It's full of creatures that have been corrupted by evil, and very dangerous.

drama_dialogue26052.ch: 然而正是此处，有一种神秘晶石暗藏其内。此晶石受冥气滋养，化作了沟通冥界魂魄的桥梁。
drama_dialogue26052.en: A mysterious crystal is concealed within. After being immersed in dark energy, it became a bridge for the souls of the underworld.

drama_dialogue26053.ch: 阁下若能激发这晶石中的星辰之力，便有可能召唤出器灵。
drama_dialogue26053.en: If you can trigger the power of the stars in the crystal, you might be able to summon an artifact spirit.

drama_dialogue26054.ch: 若向仙祠供奉足够数量的东西时，可获得仙人的回馈。仙祠分布于八荒各州，每个仙祠的恩赐各不相同，阁下若有幸遇见可参拜一番。传闻，登仙境的强者可与仙人有所交流，若得到其认可将会被赐予强大的仙法。
drama_dialogue26054.en: Offer sacrifice to an Immortal Shrine, and the Immortal would repay your worship once your offerings are enough. Immortal Shrines can be found all over the world, each with its unique blessings. You may worship at it when you see one. It is said that the Transcendent elites can communicate with immortals, and can be granted powerful Heavenly Arts once recognized by them.

drama_dialogue26055.ch: 传闻修仙者登仙后，若有机缘寻得那星主仙祠，便可在其中重新凝结冥羽，不过前提是要得到仙人认可……当真是玄而又玄……
drama_dialogue26055.en: I've heard that once a cultivator reaches Transcendent, they could find Gleaming Pieces Shrine and try to condense their Nether Feather there again, but they must win the recognition of that Immortal first... See, everything is connected like pieces on a Go board...

drama_dialogue2650100.ch: 此地与天上日月并行，十分神奇。
drama_dialogue2650100.en: The place moves together with the suns and the moon. That's incredible.

drama_dialogue2650101.ch: 取得浩然之气才能增强实力，解决十日凌天的大患！
drama_dialogue2650101.en: The Haoran Breath will certainly boost my strength. I'll see if I could deal with the ten suns then!

drama_dialogue2650102.ch: 就算再危险十倍我也要进入这地方一探究竟！
drama_dialogue2650102.en: I'll rummage through there even if my journey would be ten times harsher!

drama_dialogue2650103.ch: 据闻元时空由道源牵引之力绞合组成，经年吸纳宇宙尘埃而成一个虚幻位面，今日就要进入这不归玄境探个明白。
drama_dialogue2650103.en: I've heard that the Originverse came from the converged drawing force in the Tao's source, and it is a plane formed from the cosmos dust gathered in eons. Now it's time for me to unveil its secrets in the Ground of No Return.

drama_dialogue2650110.ch: 这点气息，让我感受到无穷宇宙……这是为何？
drama_dialogue2650110.en: Why... This breath seems to reveal to me the entire universe.

drama_dialogue2650111.ch: 这就是浩然气了吗？我的心中热热的，似乎再无犹豫，再无顾虑……
drama_dialogue2650111.en: Is it the Haoran Breath? I found my bosom so warm, and my mind, free of scruples or worries...

drama_dialogue2650112.ch: 有了这点浩然气，我就能执神弓，落金乌了！
drama_dialogue2650112.en: That's it! I'll shoot the golden crows down with the help of Haoran Breath!

drama_dialogue2650120.ch: 敌人十分厉害，究竟是什么东西影响着这些妖物……
drama_dialogue2650120.en: The enemies are unexpectedly fierce. What on earth is affecting them...

drama_dialogue2650121.ch: 浩然之气竟使这些失智妖物变得如此强悍……今日先行撤退吧。
drama_dialogue2650121.en: Haoran Breath rendered these monsters frenzied... Seems that I must retreat today.

drama_dialogue2650122.ch: 此间敌人真是强大。若能弄明白元时空穿越位面的道理，此后上天入地，自在随心，击落天上金乌便非难题了。
drama_dialogue2650122.en: These enemies are formidable. If I could find out the way to traverse planes in the Originverse, I would be able to go everywhere and capture the Golden Crows with ease.

drama_dialogue2650200.ch: 这地方好奇怪……里面藏有什么秘密吗？
drama_dialogue2650200.en: This place is strange... Are there secrets in it?

drama_dialogue2650201.ch: 听说这里面留有浩然之气，不知是真是假？
drama_dialogue2650201.en: Someone told me that the Haoran Breath is kept there. Is it true?

drama_dialogue2650202.ch: 我要将浩然之气带走，让兄弟姐妹们增强实力，好一起对付何罗鱼！
drama_dialogue2650202.en: My siblings will benefit a lot from Haoran Breath and get prepared for our fight against Leviathan!

drama_dialogue2650203.ch: 先祖爷爷曾在玉鸾族的高人处知道元时空通道，这是不同于飞升牵引之力的通道，难道这不归玄境便是……便是元时空生成的通道？
drama_dialogue2650203.en: My grandpa knew a passage to the Originverse from a master in the Jade Bird Clan. He said that it is a channel different from the drawing force in ascension. Does it mean that... the Ground of No Return is one of the paths opened from the Originverse?

drama_dialogue2650210.ch: 好神奇！这气息附在身上，让我感觉轻飘飘的。
drama_dialogue2650210.en: That's wonderful! The breath makes me feel as light as a feather.

drama_dialogue2650211.ch: 这是什么感觉？好暖和呀。
drama_dialogue2650211.en: I feel... so warm, though I don't know why.

drama_dialogue2650212.ch: 这感觉就像在母亲的怀里，温暖、舒适、安然……这是为什么呢？浩然之气……这是气息的名字？
drama_dialogue2650212.en: I feel like I'm embraced by my mother. It's comfortable and secure, but why would I have such a feeling... Haoran Breath? Is it what it's called?

drama_dialogue2650213.ch: 呼，终于通过这不归玄境。所谓元时空真是奇妙，若有朝一日族人遭难，我们正好整体迁来这里避难！
drama_dialogue2650213.en: Ah, I've got to the end of the Ground. The Originverse is so incredible, and I believe it would allow us to find refuge here if bad things befall our clan someday!

drama_dialogue2650220.ch: 好可怕的地方，今日没办法探明，改天再来好了。
drama_dialogue2650220.en: It's so gloomy here, and I'm afraid I couldn't reach its end now. I'll come here again later.

drama_dialogue2650221.ch: 何罗鱼即将作乱于东海，我不能在这里丢了性命！今天先离开好了。
drama_dialogue2650221.en: I cannot perish here. I'll save my life for our future battle against Leviathan in the East Sea, and now I'll go.

drama_dialogue2650300.ch: 八荒这鬼地方竟有这样一个奇特的地方，有趣，有趣！
drama_dialogue2650300.en: Didn't expect that I could find such a curious place in the mortal world. Good!

drama_dialogue2650301.ch: 嘿！我就没见过这种时空错乱的洞天。这八荒大陆还是有点东西哈。
drama_dialogue2650301.en: Well? The time and space there are interwoven. The mortal world seems not as boring as I expected.

drama_dialogue2650302.ch: 以前的老大说，浩然气是很了不起的东西，我要不要进去瞧瞧呢？
drama_dialogue2650302.en: Our boss once said that, Haoran Breath is... superb! Should I delve into the place and see it?

drama_dialogue2650303.ch: 元时空通道中的牵引之力会不会就是浩然之气呢？嘿嘿，老鸡我今天就要一探究竟！
drama_dialogue2650303.en: The drawing force in the passage to Originverse... Could it be the Haoran Breath? I'll find out more about it!

drama_dialogue2650310.ch: 哇！这究竟是为什么？我拳头特别有劲儿！浩然气！这是浩然气！
drama_dialogue2650310.en: Whoa! My fists are brimmed with power! Haoran Breath! It must be Haoran Breath!

drama_dialogue2650311.ch: 这是为什么？我从来没感受过这气息！说不清道不明的。
drama_dialogue2650311.en: What is the feeling? I never sensed the breath before... I don't know what's it.

drama_dialogue2650312.ch: 本鸡王好像听到……浩然气？这就是浩然气吗？一点浩然气，千里快哉风！嘿嘿，拿到手了！
drama_dialogue2650312.en: I heard something like... Haoran Breath? Is it the legendary stuff? Then I get it! An august spirit and a cheerful ethos!

drama_dialogue2650313.ch: 哦，将这元时空通道走了个遍，果然十分有趣，十分有趣！
drama_dialogue2650313.en: Good, I've fully explored the place. Is it the passage to the Originverse? It really surprised me!

drama_dialogue2650320.ch: 情况不妙，本上仙要使出暗藏秘术……“鸡毛遁影大法”了。
drama_dialogue2650320.en: Oh, the situation is a bit tricky. Luckily, I know a secret art called Gone with the Chicken's Wings.

drama_dialogue2650321.ch: 今天打不过，来日躺着过！我要撤退啦！
drama_dialogue2650321.en: Better to fight another day when I'm in a good mood! Goodbye!

drama_dialogue2650400.ch: 有意思。秘境之中，乃是一处死地，却偏偏保留生气。这是为什么呢？
drama_dialogue2650400.en: Why there would be a lively breath in such a desperate realm? Fascinating.

drama_dialogue2650401.ch: 师尊曾言，秘境之中存有浩然之气，进入取得此物，或能借此探索道源奥妙。
drama_dialogue2650401.en: My master once said that, there is something called Haoran Breath in the realm. Maybe it could unveil the secrets of the Tao's source for us.

drama_dialogue2650402.ch: 我就要进去看看，这浩然之气究竟是何物！
drama_dialogue2650402.en: Haoran Breath? I'll take a look at it there!

drama_dialogue2650403.ch: 这里便是元时空吗？真叫人吃惊。师尊没有青空重瞳，竟凭一己之力，推测到不归玄境便是元时空生成的通道。
drama_dialogue2650403.en: Is there the Originverse? Unbelievable. And my master even deduced that the Ground of No Return is a passage there without my Sky Double Pupils.

drama_dialogue2650410.ch: 我原以为这浩然气乃在这不归玄境最深处，其实一路走来，它已在自然养成。有意思……
drama_dialogue2650410.en: I thought the breath could only be found in the depth of the realm, but it seems that it has been nurtured all the way with me. Interesting...

drama_dialogue2650411.ch: 我身怀青空重瞳，能窥破天下气息，却始终没办法看透这点温暖的浩然气……这是为何？
drama_dialogue2650411.en: Nothing could escape my Sky Double Pupils, except for... the Haoran Breath. It's warm but confusing, and I don't know why...

drama_dialogue2650412.ch: 好，有了这点气息就能化解师尊体内的冥气了！
drama_dialogue2650412.en: Great! I'll see if the breath could neutralize the Nether Air in my master's body!

drama_dialogue2650413.ch: 同声相应，同气相求。道源吸引一切能够产生共鸣的东西，这元时空通道便是这种特质的产物吗？得到这些信息，总算不虚此行。
drama_dialogue2650413.en: The Tao's source attracts all that bears a similarity to it like birds of a feather. Did the passage to the Originverse come from it? I didn't expect that I could gain such an insight from the journey here.

drama_dialogue2650420.ch: 好强，今天暂且作罢……日后再来探索好了。
drama_dialogue2650420.en: The enemies are formidable... I'd return now and continue the journey another day.

drama_dialogue2650421.ch: 我不能……死在此处……今日暂且撤退……
drama_dialogue2650421.en: I couldn't die here... I must retreat...

drama_dialogue2650500.ch: 浩然气似乎与道源息息相关……这是为何？
drama_dialogue2650500.en: The Haoran Breath seems to share some properties with the Tao's source, but why?

drama_dialogue2650501.ch: 要弄清楚道心的一切奥妙，就必须先探明这浩然气的隐秘。
drama_dialogue2650501.en: I believe the breath would be an answer to our questions on Taoist Minds.

drama_dialogue2650502.ch: 此地应是后来生成，并非源自创世。这是为什么呢？
drama_dialogue2650502.en: If I were true, the place forms after the creation of the world. But I don't know why.

drama_dialogue2650503.ch: 这里便是不归玄境吗？它真的和元时空通道有千丝万缕的关联吗？不知道能否在这里面发掘道心相关信息，借此参透道源？
drama_dialogue2650503.en: Is the place the Ground of No Return, a place connected indispensably with the Originverse? Maybe I could find out more about the Taoist Mind and understand its source afterward.

drama_dialogue2650510.ch: 横如千里重云，竖似万古长藤，这气息真正深不可测！
drama_dialogue2650510.en: The breath resembles heavy clouds and winding vines. It's really inexplicable.

drama_dialogue2650511.ch: 我已经得到此物了吗？虚虚渺渺，搏之不得，我应该用什么言语去描绘此物呢？好神奇……
drama_dialogue2650511.en: Is it the breath I am searching for? It's... ethereal and hard to catch, and... Well. It seems to be beyond my words.

drama_dialogue2650512.ch: 噢？这地方着实有趣。初初进入，便觉精神振作，越是深入，体内越是气息浑然，充塞五内。
drama_dialogue2650512.en: Well? The place is brimmed with curious energy. I felt refreshed at the time I stepped into it, and my spirit was even higher since then.

drama_dialogue2650513.ch: 从当初进入而至如今离开，屡遭强敌。这不归玄境，不，元时空通道真不简单。
drama_dialogue2650513.en: I encountered so many tough fights here from the beginning of my journey. The Ground of No Return is truly extraordinary... Or I should better call the place the passage to the Originverse.

drama_dialogue2650520.ch: 不归玄境实在太过凶险，今日不宜再深入调查了……
drama_dialogue2650520.en: The Ground of No Return is indeed dangerous. I'd better stop here and continue my survey another day...

drama_dialogue2650521.ch: 咳……可恶，玄境妖物连挫我两重分形，应该先行撤退了。
drama_dialogue2650521.en: Oh, that's not good. I have lost two of my clones there. I must go.

drama_dialogue2650600.ch: 哼，这浩然之气究竟是什么东西？本座倒是十分好奇。
drama_dialogue2650600.en: Hmph. I'd like to know how incredible the so-called Haoran Breath will be.

drama_dialogue2650601.ch: 今日，我就要弄明白浩然之气究竟是个什么东西！
drama_dialogue2650601.en: Today, I'll find the Haoran Breath and figure out all its secrets!

drama_dialogue2650602.ch: 浩然之气，会和上界有所关联吗？我必须进入不归玄境，将这一切彻查明白。
drama_dialogue2650602.en: Will there be any connection between the Haoran Breath and the upper realm? The answer to my question may be in the Ground of No Return.

drama_dialogue2650603.ch: 哼，不归玄境由元时空牵引之力生成，元时空果然便是这宇宙中联通各位面的关键之处。今日势需仔细记录此间一切。
drama_dialogue2650603.en: Hmph. The Ground of No Return comes from the drawing force in the Originverse, and therefore it proved that the Originverse would be the nexus to every dimension in the cosmos. I must record it in every detail now.

drama_dialogue2650610.ch: 本尊博识天下万物，却对这点气息感到全无头绪……有意思。
drama_dialogue2650610.en: The breath is one of the few, if not the only, things that I've not known of... Interesting.

drama_dialogue2650611.ch: 有意思，这不归玄境的浩然气不断合成，来到此处最终成形。造化神奇，果真叫人吃惊不已。
drama_dialogue2650611.en: Good. The Haoran Breath here continues to merge, and finally, it condenses into a form. Nature is truly admirable.

drama_dialogue2650612.ch: 真是意外之喜！我昔日偶得奇遇，探知冥气底细之一二，今日又获浩然气之奥秘，来日融合二气体用双修，飞升指日可待矣。
drama_dialogue2650612.en: That's a surprise! I used to have a glimpse of the essence of Nether Air, and now I know what the Haoran Breath is. I will soon ascend if I combine them together in my cultivation.

drama_dialogue2650613.ch: 有意思，这浩然气本质便是道源牵引之力吧？不归玄境虽是元时空积聚宇宙残粒聚成的位面，但要从此到达高维位面还需仔细研究。
drama_dialogue2650613.en: Interesting. The essence of the Haoran Breath is the same as the force from the Tao's source, right? And the Ground... though it is a plane from the Originverse's cosmos dust, the portal here to the higher dimensions still hides from me.

drama_dialogue2650620.ch: 形势不妙，应该先行撤退……
drama_dialogue2650620.en: It's no good for me to stay here for too long. I'd go now.

drama_dialogue2650621.ch: 我向以飞升大业为重，岂可将性命白白交代在此？今天先行离开好了。
drama_dialogue2650621.en: Our ascension is more important than an adventure here. I'll leave to plan my next steps.

drama_dialogue2650700.ch: 此处十分奇特，或者我探索一番后就能悟出进一步保护白源区的秘法。
drama_dialogue2650700.en: The land is worth exploring. Maybe the secret technique to protect Bai Yuan is there.

drama_dialogue2650701.ch: 八荒灾难总是连续不断，我要将浩然气带走，以之守护白源区。
drama_dialogue2650701.en: The world has suffered too many disasters. I'll take the Haoran Breath away as a shield for Bai Yuan.

drama_dialogue2650702.ch: 如果是阿禹，他一定会不怕艰难探索到底的。
drama_dialogue2650702.en: What if Yu were here? He must be glad to brave the land to its deepest corner.

drama_dialogue2650703.ch: 当日他离开之际，曾几番嘱托我保护白源遗民，据传不归玄境便是元时空通道，此地广袤无边且在不断衍伸，正好作为白源区百姓的避难之所。嗯，我要先好好查探一番。
drama_dialogue2650703.en: I remember the day he left and his words for me to protect the folks in Bai Yuan. It is said that the Ground of No Return is a passage to the Originverse, and is vast and always expanding. I think it would be a good shelter for my fellow villagers, but I'd like to do a survey on it now.

drama_dialogue2650710.ch: 有了这气息，我就能增强自己的实力！我要封印白源，保护那里面的先民……即使他们会恨我！
drama_dialogue2650710.en: My power will be enhanced by the breath! I could keep the residents in Bai Yuan from danger by sealing the entire area, though my decision may incur their resentment...

drama_dialogue2650711.ch: 浑浑融融，仿佛一颗迟赤子之心……有点像阿禹那个傻子。
drama_dialogue2650711.en: It's pure and ardent like an enthusiast's mind, or more precisely... Yu's mind.

drama_dialogue2650712.ch: 这气息有一种说不清道不明的感觉，是一种一往无前的勇气。
drama_dialogue2650712.en: I can feel something from the breath. It reminds me of an indomitable courage.

drama_dialogue2650720.ch: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧，保住性命才能保护白源。今日先行撤退好了！
drama_dialogue2650720.en: Now I must leave, since Bai Yuan is waiting for me - my homeland needs me.

drama_dialogue2650800.ch: 我……很好奇这里面究竟有什么东西……
drama_dialogue2650800.en: I'm really curious about... what hides there.

drama_dialogue2650801.ch: 浩然气为道源微尘，据说能穿梭于各位面，我这就进去弄明白这一切……
drama_dialogue2650801.en: It's said that Haoran Breath is a strain of dust from the Tao's source that travels among dimensions. Time to check if the legend is true...

drama_dialogue2650802.ch: 这里面的路很长很远……看不见尽头……里面真的保存有一点浩然气吗？
drama_dialogue2650802.en: There is still a long way ahead, and I don't know where it leads to... Is the breath really here?

drama_dialogue2650803.ch: 真理，这便是真理吗？昭灵上祖猜测不错。这不归玄境，不、这元时空通道便是连接其他位面的关键通道，我要往里面走走没看看能不能进入别的位面。
drama_dialogue2650803.en: Is it the truth? Zhao Ling the Ancestor was right. The Ground of No Return... well, the passage to the Originverse is truly a channel to other dimensions. I'd venture into its depth and see if I could reach other planes.

drama_dialogue2650810.ch: 有了这气息，我就能增强自己的实力！我要封印白源，保护那里面的先民……即使他们会恨我！
drama_dialogue2650810.en: My power will be enhanced by the breath! I could keep the residents in Bai Yuan from danger by sealing the entire area, though my decision may incur their resentment...

drama_dialogue2650811.ch: 浑浑融融，仿佛一颗迟赤子之心……有点像阿禹那个傻子。
drama_dialogue2650811.en: It's pure and ardent like an enthusiast's mind, or more precisely... Yu's mind.

drama_dialogue2650812.ch: 这气息有一种说不清道不明的感觉，是一种一往无前的勇气。
drama_dialogue2650812.en: I can feel something from the breath. It reminds me of an indomitable courage.

drama_dialogue2650820.ch: 我不能输，我还要探明八荒每一个地方……
drama_dialogue2650820.en: I can't perish here. A whole world awaits me to explore outside the place...

drama_dialogue2650821.ch: 怪物太强，我还是先离开好了……
drama_dialogue2650821.en: I'd better leave for now. The enemies are not easy to deal with...

drama_dialogue2650900.ch: 这里面好像有无限的空间，还有无限的时间。嗯，很适合我种蘑菇呢！
drama_dialogue2650900.en: I can feel infinite time and boundless space in it. My mushrooms will thrive there!

drama_dialogue2650901.ch: 据蔽日仙菌大人说，只要取得里面的一点气息，就能将八荒大地变成蘑菇场……哎嘿嘿。
drama_dialogue2650901.en: According to our Sun Blocking master, a mysterious breath in it could turn the world into a fertile mushroom field... Hehehe.

drama_dialogue2650902.ch: 为了成为浩然气加持的药灵，我要进去闯荡啦！
drama_dialogue2650902.en: Let's go! I'll become the first Mushroom Man enhanced by the Haoran Breath!

drama_dialogue2650910.ch: 浩然气！是传说中的浩然之气！我做梦都没想到……能够得到这东西！
drama_dialogue2650910.en: That legendary Haoran Breath! I'm not dreaming, right? I get it!

drama_dialogue2650911.ch: 这意外的气息会不会让我更美丽，会不会让我长出十根尾巴？嘻嘻。
drama_dialogue2650911.en: Will I become more beautiful with such an extraordinary breath? Will I get my tenth tail? Hehe.

drama_dialogue2650912.ch: 这点气息口感醇厚，滑过上颚十分绵软顺滑！除去淡淡的柑橘气，还隐隐有一股榛果之息！不对！怎么可能有这种味道？！大概是我饿了吧！
drama_dialogue2650912.en: The breath tastes mellow. It flows through my palate smoothly, with a hint of orange and hazelnut... Well? Why could it have any taste? Maybe I'm hungry now.

drama_dialogue2650920.ch: 这里边的怪物好厉害，我得赶紧逃命！
drama_dialogue2650920.en: The monsters here are so terrifying! I must escape now.

drama_dialogue2650921.ch: 菇生要紧，不能就此死去！我先逃为敬！
drama_dialogue2650921.en: A mushroom's life is also worth cherishing! I'd go now, bye-bye!

drama_dialogue2651000.ch: 这里就是不归玄境了吗？我要一闯到底，看看这里面有什么玄机！
drama_dialogue2651000.en: Is here the Ground of No Return? I can't wait to rush into it!

drama_dialogue2651001.ch: 听说这里有浩然之气，拿了那点气息以后我就可以打遍八荒无敌手了！
drama_dialogue2651001.en: I heard that I can find the Haoran Breath here! Then, I'll become the strongest one in the world!

drama_dialogue2651002.ch: 这地方好大！我要将这些妖物统统逐走，一统不归玄境，让我的猪子猪孙来生活！
drama_dialogue2651002.en: The land is so vast! What if I drive these monsters off and bring my piggies here?

drama_dialogue2651010.ch: 哇哈哈哈哈，这一点浩然气居然可以让我长出一层膘来！好东西，好东西啊！
drama_dialogue2651010.en: Ohhhh! I am gaining weight under the Haoran Breath! That's... awesome!

drama_dialogue2651011.ch: 哼，只要有了这一息神妙无比的浩然之气，就能将我那窝猪崽全部养得白白胖胖了！
