drama_dialogue6002230.en: When you look into the empty cup again, the moon has disappeared. A short while later, a fog rises in the forest, and you turn your head to look at Yuanzhi beside you.

drama_dialogue6002231.ch: 不知是酒或雾在作祟，只见她的双眼在雾中变得迷离，失去了曾经清晰的灵动，好似从前的愿知已经死了，却而代之的是另一人。
drama_dialogue6002231.en: Perhaps it's the alcohol, or the fog, but you see her eyes turn blurry in the fog, losing the clear quick-witted shine they once had. It was as if the past Yuanzhi has died and been replaced by another person.

drama_dialogue6002232.ch: 你们饮酒片刻，愿知忽然开口。
drama_dialogue6002232.en: You both drink for a short while, and Yuanzhi suddenly speaks.

drama_dialogue6002235.ch: 无事，只是想唤一下前辈您。
drama_dialogue6002235.en: Nothing. I just wanted to call out to you.

drama_dialogue6002236.ch: 明月之下，长空寂寥，万物俱静，只余雾中人影，同天共饮。
drama_dialogue6002236.en: Under the moonlight, the vast skies are silent. Everything is quiet, and only the silhouettes of people in the fog remain, drinking under the same sky.

drama_dialogue6002237.ch:
渊源何，渊源何？
劝君莫求其渊源。
此生路途多惘然，何不行乐忘人间？
月圆对酒当歌舞，远尘世，抛愁烟，只余兴致拂天弦。
其生苦短，求而不尽，望君莫知也。
drama_dialogue6002237.en:
What, O what, is the reason of it all?
You, my friend, do not need to know.
The path of life is paved by regrets, so why not enjoy while the moment lasts?
Dance under the sky, drink under the moon. Leave civilization behind, and all its worries too.
Life is short, and so is youth. Live, friend, pursue not the truth.

drama_dialogue6002241.ch: 你拒绝了她，她脸上却是一副早有预料的模样，笑了笑，不再提及此事，将你送至村口，最后朝你望上一眼。
drama_dialogue6002241.en: You reject her, and she has this look on her face like she'd expected it. She smiles and doesn't mention it again. She walks with you to the entrance of the village and takes one last look at you.

drama_dialogue6002251.ch: 你来到村内，却不见愿知身影。
drama_dialogue6002251.en: You come to the village but you do not see Yuanzhi.

drama_dialogue6002252.ch: 你准备在她屋前等待她回来，忽然瞥见门上写有一行字。
drama_dialogue6002252.en: You are prepared to wait in front of her house, but suddenly spot a sentence on the door.

drama_dialogue6002253.ch: 走近门前，你发现上面是她的字迹，上面写道：前辈，屋内桌上有一信，请您阅读。
drama_dialogue6002253.en: You walk to the door and discover that it is her handwriting, and she wrote: There is a letter on the table in the house. Please read it.

drama_dialogue6002254.ch: 将门推开，你见桌上确有一信，便将信封拆开，凭着窗外阳光阅读信上字句。当你读完最后一个字时，手中信纸悄然滑落。
drama_dialogue6002254.en: You push the door open and see that there is indeed a letter on the table. You open the envelope and read the words by the sunlight through the window. The letter slips from your hands as you finish reading the last word.

drama_dialogue6002255.ch:
致前辈：
当您读到这封信时，我已经不在了，您可记得我初次见面提出的问题？
那时我问您“求知于世人而言可否重要？”我并不清楚世人的想法，但对于我而言，求知便是唯一所剩之物。
drama_dialogue6002255.en:
O' Kind One,
When you read this letter, I will no longer be here. Do you remember the question I asked when we first met? 
I asked you if the truth of a matter is important to people. I don't know how ordinary people think, but to me, seeking knowledge is the only thing I have left.

drama_dialogue6002256.ch:
我已寻到了获得所追求答案的方法，为此，无论我需要付出何种，即便是生命，我也愿意将其抛弃，以换取答案。
感谢前辈一直以来的关照，桌上放有一枚坚岩戒，戒指内存着我多年来的积蓄及一些丹药，愿它们能在前辈求道路途上发挥作用。

君愿知
drama_dialogue6002256.en:
I have found a new way to obtain the answers I seek. I am willing to give up everything for the answers, even my life.
Thank you for your care. There is a Hardened Stone Ring on the table, and it holds my savings and some Elixirs. I hope that they will be useful on your path of the Heavenly Way.

Jun Yuanzhi

drama_dialogue6002261.ch: 意识到这只妖兽不是你能对抗的，你选择了抛下愿知逃走。
drama_dialogue6002261.en: You realize that this monster is not one you can take down, and you choose to abandon Yuanzhi and escape.

drama_dialogue6002262.ch: 当你转身的那一刻，一股温热的液体溅到你后颈上。
drama_dialogue6002262.en: The moment you turn around, a warm liquid splashes on the back of your neck.

drama_dialogue6002263.ch: 这时，你想起上次见面，愿知送给你的丹药、对你的笑容，以及她离去时开心的背影。你突然想要回身迎战，但你这份勇气刚升起，便立刻熄灭了。
drama_dialogue6002263.en: At that moment, you recall the Elixir Yuanzhi gave you the last time you met, the smile she gave you, and the sight of her walking away happily. You suddenly want to turn back and battle, but your courage is extinguished as soon as it rose.

drama_dialogue6002264.ch: 你没有勇气回头，没有勇气面对妖兽与她的惨状。身后那只妖兽发出了震耳欲聋的嘶吼，像是庆祝自己战斗胜利，又像在嘲笑你的怯懦。
drama_dialogue6002264.en: You don't have the courage to turn back. You have no courage to face the monster and her miserable condition. The monster behind you lets out a deafening hiss, as if celebrating its victory, or mocking your cowardice.

drama_dialogue6002265.ch: 妖兽并未追来，但它的嘶吼声一直环绕在你耳边，久久未能散去。你一直逃着，不知道逃了多远……
drama_dialogue6002265.en: The monster did not come after you but its hiss resounds in your ears for a long time. You keep running, and lose track of how far you've run...

drama_dialogue6002266.ch: 终于，在经过一处树林时，你被一块碎石绊倒。你从地上爬起，虽知道妖兽并未追来，却仍不敢向身后望去。
drama_dialogue6002266.en: Finally, you trip over a piece of broken rock after passing through a section of the woods. You pick yourself off the ground. You know that the monster did not chase after you, but you still do not dare to looks behind you.

drama_dialogue6002267.ch: 你下意识用右手摸了摸后颈的液体，放在眼前，却见手上一片鲜红。血已经凉了，就和你的心一样。
drama_dialogue6002267.en: You subconsciously touch the liquid on the back of your neck and with your right hand, and hold your hand in front of you. You see bright red on your hand. The blood has turned cold, just like your heart.

drama_dialogue6002271.ch: 来到村庄后，你没有见到愿知身影。
drama_dialogue6002271.en: You come to the back of the village but do not see Yuanzhi.

drama_dialogue6002272.ch: 刚出村庄，你遇见了一名路过的修仙者，他和你攀谈起来，告诉你此处十余天前出现一名走火入魔的女修士，现在已经被铲除了。
drama_dialogue6002272.en: Right after leaving the village, you meet a passing Cultivator. You get to talking with him, and he tells you that a female Cultivator who misguidedly focused on hallucinations appeared in the area ten days ago, and she has now been eradicated.

drama_dialogue6002273.ch: 修仙者走后，你准备离去，却见一颗枯萎的老榕树下，一把长剑插在落叶堆中。
drama_dialogue6002273.en: After the Cultivator leaves, you are ready to leave when you see a sword stuck into a pile of fallen leaves under a withered old banyan tree.

drama_dialogue6002274.ch: 你将长剑拔起，却见剑柄上刻有两字：愿知。你猛地回头望向村中，透过街道，你看见了孤独伫立在尽头的那座空屋。
drama_dialogue6002274.en: You pull the sword free and see a name engraved on the hilt: Yuanzhi. You return to the village, and through the empty streets, you see the empty house standing alone at the end.

drama_dialogue6002275.ch: 那一刻，你身后的老榕树被一阵狂风刮过，枯叶纷飞，只余你独身一人对天长望，感叹人生无常。
drama_dialogue6002275.en: At that moment, a gust of wind blows through the old banyan tree behind you. Withered leaves fly, leaving you to look up at the sky, lamenting the impermanence of life.

drama_dialogue6002281.ch: 来到村外，你想要寻找愿知，却远远看见唯一完好的茅屋也成了废墟。你心头一紧，赶紧跑去。离近后，却见茅屋前洒有一滩早已干涸的血迹，走上前，发现地上躺着一把长剑。
drama_dialogue6002281.en: You come to the outskirts of the village and are about to look for Yuanzhi when you see from afar that the only intact thatched house has become ruins too. You tense up and rush over. As you get close, you see a pool of blood that has dried up quite some time ago in front of the house. You walk to it and find a sword lying on the ground.

drama_dialogue6002282.ch: 你将长剑拾起，却见剑柄上刻有两字：愿知。
drama_dialogue6002282.en: You pick up the sword and see a name on the hilt: Yuanzhi.

drama_dialogue6002283.ch: 你独身一人站在原地，四下张望，心中怀有一丝侥幸。从清晨到傍晚，你一直坐在一块碎石上，等待着那道身影出现。
drama_dialogue6002283.en: You stand alone on the spot, looking around. There is a shred of hope in your heart. From early morning to late evening, you sit on a chunk of broken stone, waiting for that figure to appear.

drama_dialogue6002284.ch: 最后，一名路过的修仙者瞟了你一眼，忽然顿下脚步。他对你说，上个月这里死了一名女修士，被妖兽吃了。说完，他摇摇头，离去了。
drama_dialogue6002284.en: Finally, a passing Cultivator glances at you and stops abruptly in his tracks. He tells you that a female Cultivator died here last month. She was eaten by a monster. He shakes his head after saying that, and leaves.

drama_dialogue6002291.ch: 你敲了敲门却没有听到回应…可能愿知暂时还不想见你。
drama_dialogue6002291.en: You knock on the door but hear no response... Maybe Yuanzhi doesn't want to see you yet.

drama_dialogue6002292.ch: 你敲了敲门却没有听到回应…似乎愿知并不在家中。
drama_dialogue6002292.en: You knock on the door but hear no response... It seems Yuanzhi is not home.

drama_dialogue6002301.ch: 你来到村内，却不见愿知身影。
drama_dialogue6002301.en: You come to the village but you do not see Yuanzhi.

drama_dialogue6002302.ch: 你准备在她屋前等待她回来，忽然瞥见门上写有一行字。
drama_dialogue6002302.en: You are prepared to wait in front of her house, but suddenly spot a sentence on the door.

drama_dialogue6002303.ch: 走近门前，你发现上面是她的字迹，上面写道：前辈，屋内桌上有一信，请您阅读。
drama_dialogue6002303.en: You walk to the door and discover that it is her handwriting, and she wrote: There is a letter on the table in the house. Please read it.

drama_dialogue6002304.ch: 将门推开，你见桌上确有一信，便将信封拆开，凭着窗外阳光阅读信上字句。当你读完最后一个字时，手中信纸悄然滑落，本来准备交给愿知的问心也悄然掉落在地上。
drama_dialogue6002304.en: You push the door open and see that there is indeed a letter on the table. You open the envelope and read the words by the sunlight through the window. The letter slips from your hands as you finish reading the last word. The book which you were planning to give to Yuanzhi, Examine Oneself, also fell quietly to the ground.

drama_dialogue6002305.ch:
致前辈：
当您读到这封信时，我已经不在了，您可记得我初次见面提出的问题？
那时我问您“求知于世人而言可否重要？”我并不清楚世人的想法，但对于我而言，求知便是唯一所剩之物。
drama_dialogue6002305.en:
O' Kind One,
When you read this letter, I will no longer be here. Do you remember the question I asked when we first met? 
I asked you if the truth of a matter is important to people. I don't know how ordinary people think, but to me, seeking knowledge is the only thing I have left.

drama_dialogue6002306.ch:
我已寻到了获得所追求答案的方法，为此，无论我需要付出何种，即便是生命，我也愿意将其抛弃，以换取答案。
感谢前辈一直以来的关照，桌上放有一枚坚岩戒，戒指内存着我多年来的积蓄及一些丹药，愿它们能在前辈求道路途上发挥作用。
 君愿知
drama_dialogue6002306.en:
I have found a new way to obtain the answers I seek. I am willing to give up everything for the answers, even my life.
Thank you for your care. There is a Hardened Stone Ring on the table, and it holds my savings and some Elixirs. I hope that they will be useful on your path of the Heavenly Way.
Jun Yuanzhi

drama_dialogue6002311.ch: 你想为愿知报仇但无奈不敌妖兽，你受到妖兽的攻击晕了过去。醒来后发现身体并无大碍，只是妖兽已经不知所踪…
drama_dialogue6002311.en: You want to avenge Yuanzhi, but are helpless against the monster. You are hit by the monster's attack and faint. When you wake up, you discover that you are not seriously injured, and the monster has disappeared...

drama_dialogue6002321.ch: 你见到一座石碑，石碑上刻着一行字：君若道行尚浅之，切莫误入不归途。
drama_dialogue6002321.en: You see a stone Stele. On it is engraved: If you wallow only in the shallows of cultivation, step not on this path by mistake.

drama_dialogue6002331.ch:
致前辈：
当您读到这封信，愿知已经不在了。
很抱歉，之前饮茶时，我欺骗了您。实际上，真相所需代价，与其说危险重重，倒不如说是十死无生。若要获得它，我便必须献出自身性命。
或许您会奇怪，我对一个真相为何如此执着。为此，前辈请听愿知讲个故事。
drama_dialogue6002331.en:
O' Kind One,
I will be gone when you read this letter.
I'm sorry, I lied to you when we had tea together. There is a price to pay for truth, and rather than describe it as dangerous, it is more apt to say that it is deathly. I will have to sacrifice my life for the truth.
You might wonder why I'm so obsessed with the truth, and if so, please know this story.

drama_dialogue6002332.ch: 从前，有一对双生子，姐姐叫愿知，妹妹叫愿求。姐妹俩很要好，从来形影不离。十二岁时，她们在湖边许下约定，将来要一起步入修仙界，共同探求天道。
drama_dialogue6002332.en: Once upon a time, there was a pair of twins. The elder sister was named Yuanzhi, and the younger sister was named Yuanqiu. The sisters were close, and never far from each other. When they were twelve, they made a promise to each other by the lake. They promised to step into the world of cultivation together, and seek the Heavenly Way.

drama_dialogue6002333.ch:
某个夜晚，姐妹俩看见，村长怀抱着一件东西，失魂落魄地从山中归来。此后，怪事便不断发生，村长家的小儿子神秘失踪，有人在深更半夜听到诡异的叫声，还有些晚归之人看到了妖物的黑影，从此被吓得疯疯癫癫。
听村里老人说，此乃妖邪作祟，它专寻心有破绽之人，只要心中坦荡，便会平安无事。
drama_dialogue6002333.en:
One night, the sisters saw the village chief return dazedly from the mountains with something in his arms. After that, strange things kept happening in the village. The village chief's son disappeared mysteriously. Some people heard eerie screams in the dead of night, and some people returning home late saw the dark shadow of monsters and became so frightened they became deranged.
The old people of the village said that this was the work of an evil monster. It was looking for people with weak minds. You would be safe so long as your mind was steady.

drama_dialogue6002334.ch:
姐妹俩自幼长在村中，无处可去，她们只能这样过着担惊受怕的生活。
为了保护妹妹，愿知日夜苦修着父母遗留的吐纳之法。她用了三年便突破到筑基，被千里之外的宗门看中，获得了参加宗门小比的机会。
drama_dialogue6002334.en:
The sisters had grown up in that village and had nowhere to go. They could only live their lives in fear.
Day and night, Yuanzhi practiced the breathing method left by their parents, all to protect her younger sister. It took her three years to break through to the Foundation stage. She was noticed by a Sect from a distant place, and she received the opportunity to participate in the Sect's small competition.

drama_dialogue6002335.ch:
而愿求则没有半点仙根，她三年来毫无寸进，眼看与天道无缘。
为了照顾妹妹的情绪，愿知向她承诺，待自己进入宗门，一定想办法为妹妹愿求寻找提升资质之法。愿求淡然一笑，并不言语。
drama_dialogue6002335.en:
Yuanqiu, on the other hand, did not seem to have any talent for cultivation. She had made no progress for three years, and it seemed her fate did not lie on the Heavenly Way.
To cheer her younger sister up, Yuanzhi promised her that she would find a way for her to increase her chances of cultivation after she joined the Sect. Yuanqiu smiled wanly, but didn't say a word.

drama_dialogue6002336.ch:
小比之期将至，愿知跋山涉水前往宗门，然而等她赢得小比回村之时，见到的却是一片冲天火光、满地鲜血残骸和已成废墟的房屋。
愿知不相信这一切，她从村这边走到村那边，再走回来，傻傻地盼望妹妹会从某个角落出现。在徘徊一夜后，姐姐终于明白，愿求没了，只留下愿知。
drama_dialogue6002336.en:
The small competition was just around the corner. Yuanzhi traveled to the Sect, and returned to the village after winning only to find walls of fire. The ground was soaked in blood, and the houses were in ruins.
Yuanzhi could not believe it. She walked from one side of the village to the other, and back again, foolishly hoping that her sister would appear from some corner. After a night of walking back and forth, the elder sister finally understood that Yuanqiu was gone. Yuanzhi was alone.

drama_dialogue6002337.ch:
仇恨瞬间笼罩了愿知的全身，她发疯似的练剑，到处寻找妖物的踪迹，却发现，村长家中有着许多沾满鲜血的修士衣物。
这时，一个想法在愿知脑中出现——自始至终她都没有发现妹妹的尸体，难道村人并未身死，那场屠村灾祸中，死的是其他人？
drama_dialogue6002337.en:
Hatred instantly enveloped Yuanzhi. She practiced feverishly with the sword, and went about looking for traces of the monster. However, she discovered that the village chief's home had several pieces of blood-soaked Cultivators' clothing in it.
A thought entered Yuanzhi's mind at that moment. She had not found her younger sister's body. Could the people of the village still be alive? Perhaps some other person had perished in the village massacre?

drama_dialogue6002338.ch:
无数的悬念围绕着愿知，妹妹生还的可能又令她重新燃起希望之火，她不顾宗门的催促，放弃了正道修仙的坦途，夜以继日地寻找妹妹的下落。
随着时间推移，愿知的见闻不断增长，她隐约猜到，当年村长所带回之邪物可能让他家的小儿子变成了妖物，此后这妖物便避开村民、猎杀过往的修士以提升修为。
drama_dialogue6002338.en:
Countless thoughts ate at Yuanzhi, and the possibility of her sister's survival rekindled the fire of hope. She ignored the Sect's words, and abandoned cultivation of the Heavenly Way to look for her sister, day and night.
As time went on, Yuanzhi's insight grew, and she surmised that the item the village chief had brought back to the village years ago might have turned his son into a monster. And since then, the monster had been avoiding villagers and hunting passing cultivators to increase its strength.

drama_dialogue6002339.ch:
种种想法在愿知脑内徘徊，甚至有时她都无法理性地思考。最终，她来到了一座名为道我的山前。
“想知道妹妹在哪里？想探求屠村的真相？快过来，你要的答案尽在其中……”刚开进山脉范围，一个声音便在愿知的脑内突兀地响起。
drama_dialogue6002339.en:
All sorts of thoughts ran through Yuanzhi's mind, and she couldn't even think straight sometimes. She eventually came to a mountain called Mount Daowo.
A voice rang abruptly in Yuanzhi head as soon as she stepped within range of the mountain. "Want to know where your younger sister is? Do you want to know the truth behind the Atrocity of the village? Come, all the answers you seek are therein..."

drama_dialogue6002340.ch:
愿知刚开始还不以为意，直到她在此山之中寻到了一个妖物。
这妖物见到愿知后却呆呆地立在原地，其身后一物散发着诡异的波动，似乎真的蕴藏着最终答案。
愿知没能忍住，便与妖物展开了厮杀，可这妖物说来奇怪，它死死护着那东西，无论如何也不让愿知触碰，同时，这妖物明明有无数机会对愿知下死手，却终究未曾伤她一毫。
drama_dialogue6002340.en:
Yuanzhi was unconcerned about it at first, until she found a monster on the mountain.
This monster stood blankly when it saw Yuanzhi, but there was an object behind it which emitted strange waves of aura, like it really was hiding the final answer.
Yuanzhi could not hold herself back and started attacking the monster. Strangely, the monster protected that item stubbornly, and didn't let Yuanzhi touch it, no matter what. During their fight, the monster had plenty of opportunities to deal a fatal blow to Yuanzhi, but it did not harm her at all in the end.

drama_dialogue6002341.ch:
姐姐无法理解眼前的一切，那个妖物是否就是村长家的小儿子，而自己的妹妹，究竟会在哪里……
在长年的奔波中，愿知的精神世界逐渐变得脆弱，对于多年的执著，她开始怀疑自我，把对真相的期望寄托在脑海中那道虚无缥缈的低语之上。
战斗中，愿知瞥见了那东西的样子，原来是一本封面写着“问心”二字的古朴书籍。
drama_dialogue6002341.en:
The elder sister could not understand what she saw. Was the monster the village chief's son? And her sister... Where could she be...?
The long years of wandering about had worn gradually at Yuanzhi's spiritual world, and her years of seeking answers made her start to doubt herself. Had she built her expectations of the truth on vague whispers in her mind?
In the midst of battle, Yuanzhi caught a glimpse of the item. It was a simple book with the words "Examine Oneself" written on the cover.

drama_dialogue6002342.ch:
后来的事，前辈也都知晓了。
当您为我取回《问心》之时，我发现其封面上竟然还有两行小字，却是我妹妹愿求的笔迹。
也许我早该料到这一切……当年我修为有成，进入宗门，便必然要与妹妹分开，而以她敏感的心思，必然会被那邪祟趁虚而入……
drama_dialogue6002342.en:
You know what happened next.
When you retrieved the book titled Examine Oneself for me, I found two more small lines on its cover. It was my younger sister Yuanqiu's handwriting.
Perhaps I should have seen this coming... I had some accomplishment in cultivation and had joined a Sect. I was bound to be separated from my sister, and with her sensitive nature, she was sure to be taken advantage of by that evil spirit...

drama_dialogue6002343.ch:
不过说来也可笑，我明知这是《问心》的陷阱，也会心甘情愿地着它的道，因为我还是不愿相信，那个妖物就是我的妹妹愿求，她竟会傻到被那个声音吸引，堕为妖物。
也许，能够证明这个真相的，只有我自己也化为妖物，如此，我执念了却，便也死心了。
drama_dialogue6002343.en:
It is laughable. I knew that this "Examine Oneself" was a trap, but I fell willingly into it because I was still unwilling to believe that the monster was my younger sister Yuanqiu. I didn't want to believe that she would be so foolish as to be drawn to that voice and be turned into a monster.
Perhaps the only way to prove this is to turn into a monster myself so that my obsession would be concluded.

drama_dialogue6002344.ch:
前辈，与您相处，是愿知在家人离去后最开心的一段时日，请您不要为我哀伤，我是幸福的，在最后一刻，我得到了自己想要到的答案。唯一的遗憾，便只有不能亲口与前辈道别。
感谢前辈一直以来的关照，桌上有一枚石沉戒，戒指内存着愿知多年来的积蓄及丹药，但愿能在您求道之路上发挥作用。请前辈不要嫌弃这份浅薄心意。
若有来世，还望与君再遇。
drama_dialogue6002344.en:
Spending time with you was the happiest time of my life after my family had left me. Please do not mourn for me. I am happy. I got the answer I wanted in my last moments. My only regret is that I could not say goodbye to you in person.
I am grateful for all the care you have shown me. There is a Sinking Stone Ring on the table. The ring contains my savings and Elixirs. I hope that this can be useful to you on your path of seeking the Heavenly Way. Please, do not shun my superficial intentions.
If these is a next life for me, I hope that I will get to meet you again.

drama_dialogue6003001.ch: 你看见一名身着劲装、背负行囊的年轻人，估计因为饱经风霜，他的面庞略显黝黑。年轻人擦了擦汗、稍作喘息，碰巧也看见了正在打量他的你，便向你举手招呼。
drama_dialogue6003001.en: You see a young man dressed in sturdy clothing, carrying luggage on his back, and presume that his face is tanned due to the exposure to weather. The young man wipes his sweat, a little out of breath, and happens to see you sizing him up. He raises a hand in greeting.

drama_dialogue6003002.ch: 您好，在下游远致，无名小辈，久居偏僻小乡。可否请教仙长此间地名，最近城镇，周遭幽胜？
drama_dialogue6003002.en: Hello, my name is Yuanzhi. I'm just some nobody who has lived for a long time in a remote village. Could I beg of you, Master, to tell me the name of this place, the closest town, and the surrounding landscape?

drama_dialogue6003003.ch: 你将所知尽数告诉少年，并看出他毫无修为。如此凡人，走在城镇之中尚可，倘若落在荒僻之地，只怕要遭遇不测，于是你便劝说他尽早回家，不要到处乱闯。
drama_dialogue6003003.en: You tell the young man what you know, and see that he has no cultivation. Such a mortal would be alright if he walked about in town, but he would meet with misfortune out in the middle of nowhere. And so, you try to persuade him to go home as soon as possible and not wander about.

drama_dialogue6003004.ch: 哈哈，小村里前后左右各走百步到头，吆喝一声尽有邻里答应，但是我希望认识更多的人，看更多的景致，这才瞒着爹娘走出来的……这其中危险，我虽未曾细思，但想来也值得一冒。
drama_dialogue6003004.en: Haha, the small village is a hundred paces from beginning to end, and a yell is heard by all neighbors. Still, I hope to meet more people, and see more sights. It's why I kept my trip a secret from my parents... I have not considered the dangers of doing so, but I think it is worth the risk.

drama_dialogue6003005.ch: 你觉得这名年轻人十分有趣，而且精神可嘉，便邀其到附近酒肆坐下详谈。一番交谈后你了解到，原来远致兄弟竟然立志踏遍八荒世界，看尽天地景致……但是，这远行的第一步，便是须要一大笔盘缠。
drama_dialogue6003005.en: You find this young man very interesting, and his spirit is commendable. You invite him to a nearby tavern to sit and chat. After talking for a bit, you learn that Yuanzhi aspires to travel all over and see the sights of the world... But the first step of this long journey requires a large sum of money.

drama_dialogue6003006.ch: 仙长愿意慷慨解囊，真叫远致五内铭感。对了，我与酒馆中的老板相熟，他知我志愿，便为我寻了件秘宝，此物能够千里传书，我这便将仙长定为传书对象，借此给您说说途中经历。
drama_dialogue6003006.en: I am grateful to you, Master, for your generosity. Oh yes, I am familiar with the tavern owner and he knows my aspirations. He found a treasure for me that is capable of sending letters over great distances. I can make Master the recipient of the letters and tell you about my experiences on my journey.

drama_dialogue6003007.ch: 仙长既不愿意，远致亦不好强人所难。
drama_dialogue6003007.en: If Master doesn't want to, I shall not insist.

drama_dialogue6003008.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003008.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003009.ch:
仙长，分别多日，敢问是否安好？
话说，村中老人都不希望晚辈离开村庄，说外头与村内无二，而我始终不以为然，只苦于找不到理据去与其辩驳。然而，近日我别有发现！离开云陌州后，我去到一处山中，此地之峰异于寻常，竟都脱离山腰飞至半空！这些峰上还有水流淌下，形成悬空之瀑，宛如白练飞舞，实在妙极！如此奇观，想必我村中长辈不会相信。
drama_dialogue6003009.en:
It has been days since we parted, Master. Are you well?
Speaking of which, the village elders don't want the younger generation to leave the village. They say that it is the same outside the village, and I never agreed with that view, but could not find any reason to argue against it. However, I have recently discovered something else! After leaving Yun Mo, I went to a mountain with unusual peaks. They have separated from the mountainside and are flying in the air! These peaks also have water flowing down them, forming a hanging waterfall, just like white silk fluttering in the breeze! Amazing! My village elders would not believe such a miraculous sight.

drama_dialogue60030091.ch: 眼下胜景在前，心中豁朗，我突然觉得长辈们否定我的言语都微不足道了。传说天元山是八荒之中最神秘的所在，希望有朝一日我也能够前往一探。哈哈，仙长大约会笑我痴人说梦吧？
drama_dialogue60030091.en: Now that the scenery is before my eyes, my mind is clear. I feel all of a sudden that the words the elders spoke in rejection of mine are insignificant. Legend has it that Tian Yuan Mountain is the most mysterious existence in the world,and I hope that I will be able to go there and explore it one day. Ah, Master, you will laugh at my foolish dream, surely.

drama_dialogue60030092.ch: 对了，我在这山中流连了三天才离去。山中嘉树遍地，上面附着琳琅五色的果子，我摘其充饥，顿时口舌生津、遍体阳和、好像有使不尽的力气。因此我摘下几枚随信奉上，希望仙长喜欢。
drama_dialogue60030092.en: By the way, I stayed on this mountain for three days before I left. Fine trees cover the mountain, and fruits which glitter with color grow on them. I picked these to sate my hunger, and at once my mouth was filled with flavor, and my body full of positivity, as if I had boundless strength. I picked some of these fruits and send them to you with these letter in hope that you will like them.

drama_dialogue6003010.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003010.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003011.ch:
仙长，不得了啦！
昨天我翻了三座山，眼看夕阳西下，天色转眼就要入黑。记得您千叮万嘱，不可以夜宿荒郊，以免惹来妖邪觊觎，恰好当时我看见不远处有一栋精舍，于是便去乞求借宿一宵。那院落的主人是个年轻美貌的姑娘，她眼波流转间便答应了我的请求。
drama_dialogue6003011.en:
Goodness, Master!
I went over three mountains yesterday, and saw that the sun was setting and that dark would descend soon. I remembered your words of caution to not stay in the deserted countryside at night and avoid attracting evil spirits. I happened to see a fine house nearby, so I went to beg for a night's lodging. The owner of the house was a beautiful young girl, and she agreed to my request with roving eyes.

drama_dialogue60030111.ch:
晚上我用热水泡了泡脚，刚准备歇下，没想到屋主人竟然进到我的房间里头。
当时那位姑娘裙衩半褪，绮罗轻舒，还露出半截雪白的臂膀，哇，那可真是美得让我几乎晕厥。她款款靠近，小嘴在我耳边轻声呢喃，叫我心神荡漾、魂飞九霄……
但我转念一想，姑娘收留我便是对我有恩，我一堂堂八尺男儿怎能作此非分之想？为了让自己冷静下来，我一把推开她，径直冲到屋外朝池塘里一跳。只待冷水浸没头顶，我这才恢复理智。
drama_dialogue60030111.en:
At night, I soaked my feet in hot water and was just about to lie down to rest when the owner of the house unexpectedly entered my room.
The lady's skirt was half open, and her silks loose. Half of her snow-white arm was revealed too! Oh my! The sight was so beautiful I almost passed out. She approached me, and spoke soft whispers into my ear with her petite lips. My mind was in disarray, and my soul in heaven...
But the thought came to me that this young lady had taken me into her house out of kindness, so how could a strapping man like myself behave so inappropriately? To calm myself down, I pushed her away and rushed straight to a pond outside the house, and jumped. I regained my senses only when the cold water covered my head.

drama_dialogue60030112.ch:
那位姑娘见我举动古怪，只是幽幽叹了口气，朝我看了眼就别过身回自己房去了。
岂知隔天起来，我竟然睡在一块顽石之上，原本的床榻消失无影，连精舍也一并没了，最古怪的是，那位美丽的姑娘也不知所踪……我环顾四周，发现手边握着一截毛茸茸的像尾巴一样的东西，仙长您说奇怪不奇怪？
这件事好生叫我惦记，尾巴随信寄与仙长，希望仙长能释我疑惑。
drama_dialogue60030112.en:
The young lady just sighed at my odd behavior, and glanced at me before returning to her own room.
When I woke up the next day, I found myself sleeping on a rock. The bed had disappeared, and the fine house was nowhere to be seen. The strangest thing was that the beautiful young lady had disappeared too... I looked around and found a fluffy tail-like thing in my hand. Isn't it strange, Master?
I keep thinking about this. I have enclosed this tail in my letter to you, Master. I hope you can clear up my doubts.

drama_dialogue6003012.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003012.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003013.ch:
仙长，记得您切切叮嘱，让我看见妖怪就即刻远离。
前天我进到一处森林，突然就遇见妖怪了！那妖怪鹿首人身，头顶两只犄角，我大胆猜测它应该是只鹿妖吧？
当时看见他手持斧头猛砍树木。我便觉得十分可惜，毕竟那截木料实属良材……想到这里，我竟鬼使神差般上前劝阻。那只鹿妖听我所言，转过头来目露凶光，把我吓得心头一突。正当我以为自己命不久矣之时，孰料他却长篇大论地给我说什么疏伐间伐的道理，说自己是为了隔开树木让其长得更佳，好在林中积攒灵气。
drama_dialogue6003013.en:
Master, I remembered your instructions to immediately put distance between myself and a monster if I spot one.
I entered a forest the day before yesterday, and suddenly encountered a monster! The monster had the head of a deer and the body of a man, with two horns on its head. It's probably a Deer Spirit, right?
I saw it holding an axe and chopping at a tree. I thought it was a waste because the wood was fine wood after all... With that thought in mind, I stepped forward for some explained reason to advise it against doing so. The Deer Spirit listened to my words and turned to glare at me. I was scared to death. Just when I thought I was going to die, it gave me an unexpected lecture on the rationale behind thinning and cutting. It said that it was spacing out the trees to make them grow better, so that it could gather Qi better in the forest.

drama_dialogue60030131.ch: 我看鹿妖伯伯年事已高，又并未对我不利，于是也拿起一把斧子帮着他一起砍伐。我俩合力忙活了三天，才将整片林子的树木处置好。鹿妖伯伯感谢我帮忙，还好吃好喝招待了我三天——虽然全都是素食……
drama_dialogue60030131.en: The Deer Spirit was elderly in years, and had not made any moves against me, so I took up an axe as well to help it trim the trees. We worked together for three days to tidy all the trees in the forest. The Deer Spirit thanked me for helping, and wined and dined me for three days, though it was all vegetarian, of course...

drama_dialogue60030132.ch:
仙长，我看妖怪未必都穷凶极恶，您以为如何？
对了，鹿妖伯伯送了我一颗绿油油的东西，他说是什么珍贵的内丹，那玩意放在行囊里，一直有股腥气传出，实在叫人受不了。我将内丹随信转赠于您，希望对您的修为有所裨益。
drama_dialogue60030132.en:
Master, I think not all monsters are fiendish. What do you think?
Oh yes, the Deer Spirit gave me a green thing. It said it's some precious orb. I put it in my travel bag, and a fishy smell keeps coming from it. I really can't bear it anymore. I have sent the orb with this letter, and I hope it will be beneficial to your cultivation.

drama_dialogue6003014.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003014.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003015.ch:
仙长，前天我进到一处宗门领地，还被该宗的知客道长好生款待。
可就在我安顿之时，宗门内突然人声喧天，知客道长不知就里出外查探，没想到竟当场被抓拿起来，锁在云房内。我当时害怕极了，就掀开坐塌钻了进去，知客道长让我千万不要作声，那群人还会去而复返。
drama_dialogue6003015.en:
Master, I stepped into a Sect's territory the day before yesterday, and was treated well by the receiving monk.
However, when I was settling in, a commotion arose in the Sect, and the receiving monk went out to investigate. To my surprise, I was seized immediately and locked in the Cloud Room. I was so scared I collapsed right away when I went in. The receiving monk told me to not make a sound, no matter what, and that the group will go and come back.

drama_dialogue60030151.ch:
原来这宗门内发生动乱，一名长老欲夺取掌门之位，还要肃清门中旧派。知客道长将这番原委简要告诉我，让我见机行事。果然，没过一会儿就有人来将知客道长提走。仙长，我听见知客道长在外惨叫了一声，究竟发生什么事了？
我不敢出去……不敢出去……
所幸，我在坐塌下躲了一夜无人发现。
drama_dialogue60030151.en:
It turns out that there was turmoil within the Sect, and an Elder wanted to seize the leadership position and purge the Sect of the old faction. The receiving monk told me the reason for this in brief, and told me to take the opportunity to run when I see it. As expected, someone came to carry away the receiving monk soon after. Master, I heard the receiving monk scream outside. What happened?
 I dare not go out... I dare not...
 Fortunately, I hid under the mat all night undetected.

drama_dialogue60030152.ch:
隔天，我鼓起勇气，提心吊胆地走出去，发现遍地都是躺着的人，有的还在痛苦呻吟。我不敢帮助他们，只急急忙忙的离开了宗门领地。
仙长，我是不是应该去帮助他们……
drama_dialogue60030152.en:
The next day, I mustered my courage and walked out fearfully to find people sprawled about all over the place. Some were moaning in pain. I dared not help them, and left the Sect in a great hurry.
Master, should I have helped them...?

drama_dialogue6003016.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003016.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003017.ch: 仙长，我曾在一本古书上看到，十万大山里头守着一只大妖山挥，于是我千辛万苦进到那里，想要看看山挥的形貌。但走着走着我却突然迷失了方向，进到一片广袤无边的黑色泥潭中了。我原想涉潭而渡，却发现里面竟然有许许多多全身泛着紫光、大腿般粗细的蛇虺游走潭底，我一接近它们就张开恶吻向我咬来，看来此路是行不通了。
drama_dialogue6003017.en: Master, I once read about the Mountain Specter that guards the Hundred Thousand Hills in an ancient book. So I travelled there with great difficulty, wanting to see the Mountain Specter with my own eyes. But as I walked along the hills, I lost my way and stumbled upon a boundless, dark swamp. I wanted to cross it, but then I saw serpents as thick as my calves, glistening with purple light as they slithered along the bottom of the swamp. When I neared, they bared their fangs and snapped at me. That swamp was impassable.

drama_dialogue60030171.ch:
既然无法渡过泥潭，我只好另寻道路离开，不想周围那些奇花异草竟也有知觉。当时，一只猫儿大小的古怪小妖从奇花下面闪过，它头顶的花苞瞬间“哗”一下突然绽开、露出獠牙，然后仿佛点了点头一般，将小妖整个生吞了，不多时吐出几根骨头来。
原来，周围的植物竟会伺机袭击进入这片林子的生物。目前天下霖雨，那些花怪树精都向天嗷嗷怪叫，似乎这场雨让它们变得特别兴奋。
drama_dialogue60030171.en:
Realizing I could not get past, I looked for another way out, not knowing that the surrounding plants were actually sentient. There was this strange little monster in the size of a cat that was leaping across the ground beneath the bushes, when suddenly the buds atop of the bush bloomed instantly, then it bared teeth, threw its head back and gulped down the little monster in one bite! It spat out some bones moments later. 
 It turns out that the sentient plants would wait for an opportunity to attack any creatures entering the forest. At present, it is raining and those strange flower faeries and tree spirits are howling at the sky. It seems like the rain excites them.

drama_dialogue60030172.ch: 我有点害怕，所以躲在一棵巨型蘑菇的菌伞下面，希望这些植物快点冷静下来，好让我从中通过。
drama_dialogue60030172.en: I'm a little spooked, so I've hidden under a giant mushroom. I hope these plants calm down soon and let me pass.

drama_dialogue6003018.ch: 根据信中描述，你隐隐知道远致兄弟的遇险所在。当前远致危如累卵，不知全速赶去是否能将其救下。
drama_dialogue6003018.en: From the descriptions in the letter, you can roughly decipher the whereabouts of Yuanzhi. He is in grave danger, will be able to save him if you rush there?

drama_dialogue6003019.ch: 你在黑潭大展身手，奋起神威，周边树精花妖一应枯萎退散。
drama_dialogue6003019.en: You arrive at the swamp and leap into action, unleashing your powers in battle. The tree spirits and flower faeries wither away in defeat.

drama_dialogue6003020.ch: 你从边上一朵巨形蘑菇的菌盖下扶出了双手抱头、惊魂未定的远致兄弟。你仔细一瞧，他除了受了惊吓外，气色竟然极佳，仿佛是吃了什么奇珍异果所致。这时，面前的巨形蘑菇微一抖动，落下一层晶莹的粉末，你眼前仿佛星幕，精光点点，煞是好看。
drama_dialogue6003020.en: You find a shaken Yuanzhi hiding underneath the cap of a giant mushroom nearby. When you inspect him closer, you find that although he still looks slightly rattled, his expression was positively glowing, as if under the influence of some rare and exotic fruit. The giant mushroom quivers above you, and layer of iridescent powder showers down, sparkling and glimmering in front of you like a cluster of stars. It was a beautiful sight.

drama_dialogue6003021.ch: 因为呼吸吐纳，你吸进了菇菌的粉末，你怀疑其中有毒，立即运动心法排除异物，但粉末瞬间被你心法炼化成为一股暖流遍游体内，你感觉无比舒服，精神舒畅。
drama_dialogue6003021.en: As you breathe, you inhale the mushroom powder, but suspecting that it is poisonous, you try to rid of it using your Mind Skills, but the powder is instead forged into a warm current that travels through your whole body. You instantly feel refreshed and energized.

drama_dialogue6003022.ch: 仙长，若非得您千里迢迢前来救援，远致必难幸免！
drama_dialogue6003022.en: Master, if you hadn't travelled all the way here in time, Yuanzhi would have perished without doubt!

drama_dialogue6003023.ch: 远致，前途未必尽是康庄平坦，更多时候是进退维谷、寸步难行，你身无道法，险阻亦必加倍，不如早早回到家中罢？
drama_dialogue6003023.en: Yuanzhi, the path that lies ahead of you is not an easy one. It would be a long, strenuous path to travel, even more so for you since you are not equipped with Tao. Maybe you should return home now while you still can?

drama_dialogue6003024.ch: 仙长，您说的我都已经想过了，但远致绝不会半途而废的！
drama_dialogue6003024.en: Master, I've thought about your words carefully, but Yuanzhi will not give up easily!

drama_dialogue6003025.ch: 远致，此后你每踏出一步定必遍地荆棘，然而事不为不成，路不行不达，唯有持之以恒，方有所得！请你万勿气馁，我虽在远方，亦必尽力关照！
drama_dialogue6003025.en: Yuanzhi, every step ahead of you may be full of obstacles. Please do not be discouraged, even though I am far away, I will try my best to aid you on your journey.

drama_dialogue6003026.ch: 仙长所说与远致心思不谋而合。远致定会谨记仙长教诲，此后定然鼓勇前行！
drama_dialogue6003026.en: Yuanzhi agrees with Master's every word. I will remember your teachings and continue my journey with courage!

drama_dialogue6003027.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003027.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003028.ch:
仙长，久疏问候。
早前我去到华封州南部，看见一只人面龙身的怪物正在沉睡，于是伸手碰触，从上面摘下一块鳞片来，没想到怪物由此惊醒，当空飞去，落在远处。我尾随跟踪，突然一道霹雳落在我身上，将我打得外焦里嫩，头发都炸开了。
drama_dialogue6003028.en:
Master, it has been a long time since I wrote you last. 
 A few days ago I travelled to the southern part of Hua Feng. I saw a monster deep in slumber, it had the face of a human and the body of a dragon, so I reached out and plucked a scale from its body. I was caught by surprise when it startled awake, it flew off and landed in the distance. When I tried to follow it, I was struck by a bolt of lightening, scorching me until my hair exploded.

drama_dialogue60030281.ch:
现在我只有一只手能动，于是就凭独臂爬到一处向阴的大石头旁边栖身，应该暂时无虞。仙长，多问一句，您之前说修仙不易，动辄会招来天劫，你说的天劫是不是就是被雷劈？
还有好多想说，不过这会我手还很麻，先辶……
drama_dialogue60030281.en:
Master, it has been a long time since I last wrote to you. 
 A few days ago I travelled to the southern part of Hua Feng. I saw a monster in deep slumber, it had the face of a human and the body of a dragon, so I reached out and tore off a scale from its body. I was taken by surprise when it woke up, flew and landed in the distance. When I tried to follow it, I was struck by a bolt of lightning, scorching me until my hair exploded.

drama_dialogue6003029.ch: 信中最后一字只写了边旁，估计是个“这”字，游远致应该想说“先这样”……想来雷泽之中处处艰险，便是积年修士亦不易应对。远致兄弟于道法一窍不通，无以依傍，是否应该前往搭救？
drama_dialogue6003029.en: The letter ends there, you assume the letter "n" was meant to be the word "now"... Lei Ze is filled with dangers, even experienced cultivators may find it difficult to survive there. Yuanzhi is alone and not equipped with Tao, should you go to his aid?

drama_dialogue6003030.ch: 击退纠缠的妖怪后，只见前方落雷处处，你使动身法闯将进去，好容易才看见远致趴倒在一块尖石下方。看来若非这块巨石遮挡，他早就被雷泽的惊雷打成齑粉了。
drama_dialogue6003030.en: After repelling the monsters, you see lightening striking everywhere around you. You use your Motion Skill to go break into Lei Ze where you see Yuanzhi cowering beneath a sharp boulder. If not for the shelter of the giant boulder, he would have undoubtedly been struck into smithereens by the lightning bolts.

drama_dialogue6003031.ch: 你二话不说将远致夹在肋下，全力冲出雷泽。脱离险境后，远致一把坐倒在地，他怀中跌落一片暗哑的铁片，你认得那是“天陨玄精”，是一枚极难得的宝贝，若将其研碎后和水吞服，必有妙用。
drama_dialogue6003031.en: Without a word, you scoop him up with one arm, and make a mad dash out of Lei Ze. When you've finally escaped from danger, Yuanzhi collapses onto the ground. A piece of dull metal falls out of his arms, you recognize it as a "Comet Shard", an extremely rare mineral. If it is crushed and swallowed with water, it will have an astonishing effect.

drama_dialogue6003032.ch: 你设法将玄精捣碎让远致服下，远致依言而为，然而他对你也十分关心，取出水壶让你解渴，你喝下之后才发觉远致将剩余玄精混在壶中给你喝下了。
drama_dialogue6003032.en: You crush the powder and tell Yuanzhi to take it, he does as instructed. However, he shows concern for you and offers you water to quench your thirst, after drinking it, you realize he had mixed the remainders of the powder into your water.

drama_dialogue6003033.ch: 天陨玄精奇妙非凡，一经吞服，你感觉头脑一震，然后由脚心升起一股凉浸浸滑腻腻的气息遍流全身。
drama_dialogue6003033.en: You feel a wooziness in your head, then a cool, silky aura travelling up your body from the soles of your feet.

drama_dialogue6003034.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中突然无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003034.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then suddenly a letter appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003035.ch:
仙长，我被一群山贼抓了！
他们将我丢到山寨一口井里、饿了我三日三夜，让我就算出得井去也无力逃跑。
他们说我是这口枯井的第八十二个客人，山寨中还有二十八口枯井。那晚月色极好，光华照进井底，我想象之前受困在这里的人都已遭难，就觉得十分可怕。一时间，我竟没忍住，当场吓得失声大叫。那些山贼则哈哈大笑，说我胆怯。
drama_dialogue6003035.en:
Master, I've been captured by a group of bandits! 
 They've thrown me into a dry well in their fort and starved me for three days and three nights straight so I would not have the energy to run even if I were to find a way to climb out. 
 They told me I am the eighty-second person to "visit" the well, and there are twenty eight more dry wells in this fort. The moonlight was shining with brilliance and illuminated the bottom of the well, and I imagined the sufferings of the people who were trapped here before me, the thoughts terrified me so badly I couldn't help but to scream aloud. The bandits laughed and ridiculed me for being a coward.

drama_dialogue60030351.ch:
这群凶徒不知残害了多少无辜性命，只恨我身上并无道法，不能狠狠地惩治他们！
唉，我眼下自身难保，又说什么惩治恶徒呢？不知他们要关我多久，我先好好睡一觉，养足力气，试试明日能否攀住井壁，爬上去逃跑！
drama_dialogue60030351.en:
How many innocent lives have been taken by the hands of these cruel murderers? I hate that I do not have any Tao within me to serve justice upon them! 
 Oh, look at me! Talking about serving justice when I can't even save myself! I'm not sure how long they plan to keep me trapped here, I shall rest now and attempt to climb my way out tomorrow!

drama_dialogue6003036.ch: 你从信件中得知远致的情况之后不禁勃然大怒，没想远致竟然被恶徒掳走，受困井底。不知当前即刻赶赴是否能救起远致呢？
drama_dialogue6003036.en: You are furious upon reading the letter from Yuanzhi, how dare these bandits capture and imprison him in a well! Will you rush there in time to save him?

drama_dialogue6003037.ch: 你狠下心剿灭了这窝匪徒，最后在一处枯井中将远致兄弟捞了上来。
drama_dialogue6003037.en: You ruthlessly wipe out the whole group of bandits and retrieve Yuanzhi from the bottom of the well.

drama_dialogue6003038.ch: 远致兄弟很激动，不断诉说这群山贼的恶行。世途险恶，到处都有强人出没，你对这些都了然于心，但并不十分忍心告诉他，这便是现实。
drama_dialogue6003038.en: Yuanzhi rambles on about the evil deeds of the bandits, clearly aggravated. You have come to terms with the fact that the world is a treacherous place full of corrupt and wicked people long ago, though you don't have the heart to tell him of this reality.

drama_dialogue6003039.ch: 显然，这次的遭遇很让远致觉得匪夷所思。他沮丧了好一阵，终于还是踏起步子继续前行。你看着远致兄弟在夕阳下渐去渐远，觉得他的身板似乎比之前更加挺拔。
drama_dialogue6003039.en: Clearly, Yuanzhi find theses events outlandish and unacceptable. He sulks for a while before finally continuing on his journey. You watch him as he walks into the sunset, his back stiffer and straighter than before.

drama_dialogue6003040.ch: 你突然心生感应，眼前虚空之中竟立刻无端掉落一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003040.en: You have a peculiar feeling, then a letter suddenly appears out of thin air and drops into your hands.

drama_dialogue6003041.ch:
十万火急！我要被冻住了！
自从上次一睹九霄雷神之风姿，我便突发奇想，要将这些大妖怪外貌神态统统记录簿上。而我听闻东北雪原有一古神长乘，凛凛威风，所以便前往永恒冰原去碰碰运气了。
drama_dialogue6003041.en:
Please help! I've been frozen!
 Ever since witnessing the grace of the Cloud Nine Hatuibwari last time, I had an epiphany to document the appearances of these large monsters into a journal. I heard that there was an ancient, majestic Leonid in the northeast region, so I travelled to Everfrost to try my luck.

drama_dialogue60030411.ch: 这边抬头低头看过去都是白茫茫一片，如果不是走在地上，我根本分不清天上和地下。一刮起风雪之后，昏天黑地，更是什么都看不见。我感觉那风雪刮了足有七日七夜，若非掘出一个雪坑暂时栖身，我差点就要命丧此处……幸好最后还是撑了过来。
drama_dialogue60030411.en: Everywhere I look, I am surrounded by white. If not for the fact that I am walking on it, I would not be able to tell the ground apart from the sky. Then came a blizzard, the sky dimmed and I couldn't see anything at all. It felt as though the blizzard raged on for seven days and seven nights. If I hadn't been able to dig a pit to hide myself in, I swear I would have died here..... Fortunately, I survived.

drama_dialogue60030412.ch:
雪停之后，晴空明净，四下一廓，我看见不远处有一枚冰晶十分漂亮，所以我想摘下来送给仙长，谁知道我刚刚碰到那颗冰晶时，掌上冻感传来，手背顿时起了层霜，这霜层还一直朝我手臂蔓延。我刚想撤手可整个人已经牢牢粘在冰晶上面了！
现在我左手已经结成玄冰，霜雪漫到我胸前，冻住了我左半边身子，估计很快我就会被完全冻住……
千不该，万不该，我就不该起贪念！！
drama_dialogue60030412.en:
When the snow stopped, the sky cleared and I saw a beautiful crystal not far from where I was. I wanted to gift it to master, but as soon as I touched the stone, I felt a cold prickling on my palm. Then a layer of frost suddenly formed on the back of my hand and spread onto my arms. I wanted to withdraw my hand, but I was stuck onto the crystal! 
 Now my left hand is entirely ice, and the frost has spread to my chest, freezing the left side of my body. I suspect I will be completely frozen sooner or later....
 I shouldn't have! Shouldn't have! SHOULD NOT HAVE BEEN SO GREEDY!!

drama_dialogue6003042.ch: 你当初嘱咐远致兄弟的时候总觉得遗漏了什么，现今才醒觉，忘了叮嘱他千万不要进入永恒冰原。却不想，这个不知天高地厚的远致果然去到跑到那边冰天雪地里去了。远致陷身冰雪，性命垂危，应当即刻前往！
drama_dialogue6003042.en: You remember feeling like you had forgotten something important when you warned Yuanzhi of the possible dangers before his journey. Now it hits you that you forgot warn him against entering Everfrost. Surely enough, the reckless Yuanzhi found his way there and got himself trapped in ice and frost, you should rescue him immediately!

drama_dialogue6003043.ch: 当时远致被冻成雪人一般站在原地，前方远空黑云压顶，相信马上就有一场大风雪，救走远致刻不容缓。你发现远致的手连在一颗闪闪发亮的冰晶上，一时无法分离，于是施展法术将冰晶从远处切割开来，连着冰晶和远致一起带走。
drama_dialogue6003043.en: You see Yuanzhi frozen onto the ground like an ice sculpture. Dark clouds roll over the sky above you, foreshadowing the blizzard that is about to come, you must rescue Yuanzhi immediately. You find his hand stuck onto the shimmering crystal, unable to move, so you use your Tao to cut open the crystal, leaving it stuck onto Yuanzhi's hand as you bring him with you.

drama_dialogue6003044.ch: 离开永恒冰原后，你运动术法融去远致身上的玄冰。远致不一会醒来，马上便将手上冰晶递来你面前。
drama_dialogue6003044.en: After leaving Everfrost, you cast a spell to melt away the frost covering Yuanzhi's body. In a while, he awakens and hands you the crystal in his palm.

drama_dialogue6003045.ch: 仙长，我看这枚冰晶不同寻常，想要取了来送给您，没想到被冻住了……
drama_dialogue6003045.en: Master, I saw this peculiar crystal and wanted to bring it to you, I didn't expect to be frozen....

drama_dialogue6003046.ch: 你也觉得此物果然神妙，便从远致手中接过冰晶。突然间冰晶在你手中化去，瞬间沁入皮肤，一股冰凉渗透全身。你感觉一阵激灵，然后全身生出气力。
drama_dialogue6003046.en: You also find the item captivating, so you reach out to take it from him. When your hand closes around the stone, it melts away in an instant and seeps into your skin. You feel a cool sensation run through you, then a sudden burst of energy courses through your body.

drama_dialogue6003047.en: What? How come the crystal melted?

drama_dialogue6003048.ch: 此物经年不化，名为“霜元”，需借赤子元阳化去。你被冰晶冻住，全身阳气输入冰晶中化去了霜元冰壳，是以到我手中便化为“元水”，渗透皮下流走于经络间，可以说好处都被我独占了。
drama_dialogue6003048.en: This is a "Frost Essence", it can only be melted using pure Yang energy. You were frozen by the crystal, and your Yang energy was consumed by it while trying to melt it. It became "Essence Liquid" only when I touched it, and it's energy was absorbed by my body, you can say that I've taken all the benefits that you suffered for.

drama_dialogue6003049.ch: 远致听了你的话后，哈哈大笑，对此毫不介怀，他拍了拍自己身上冰霜，负起行囊渐又去远，眨眼间成了冰天雪地中的一颗黑点。
drama_dialogue6003049.en: Yuanzhi laughs at your words, clearly not bothered by the situation. He dusts away the remaining frost on his body and shoulders his bag, carrying on with his journey. His figure soon becoming a tiny speck within the vast land of snow and ice.

drama_dialogue6003050.ch: 专爱走南闯北的远致最近许久未有音讯，不知是不是又陷身在什么奇怪地方等待救援？你正在这样想，突然空中就出现书信一封，你急忙用手接住。
drama_dialogue6003050.en: You have not heard from Yuanzhi - the ever so reckless traveler, for a long while. Just as you start to wonder if he is in danger again, a letter appears out of thin air, you catch it in haste.

drama_dialogue6003051.ch:
仙长，多得您一直以来的关照，我才遇难呈祥，逢凶化吉。远致感激不尽。
我远行回来后回到村中，将这次的行程笔录成书，名为《远致行纪》。
drama_dialogue6003051.en:
Master, thank you for all your help. You have rescued me from death countless times and for that Yuanzhi is eternally grateful. 
 Upon completing my journey and returning to my village, I documented my travels into a book named [The Journey of Yuanzhi]

drama_dialogue60030511.ch:
此书一经发表竟然颇受欢迎。有些宗门说《远致行纪》专道八荒地理，乃是八荒奇书，还专为门人作为蒙书，必须熟习。有这么多人研读，真叫我始料不及。
回想与仙长初见，仿佛只如昨日，但中间已经历经无数险阻，好几次还差点丢了性命，若非仙长不远千里救援于我，可能我现在已经作了妖怪的口粮了吧？
drama_dialogue60030511.en:
Once the book was published, it turned out to be quite popular. Some sects have dubbed [The Journey of Yuanzhi] to be a travel guide for the world and have even made it study material for their members. It was honestly quite unexpected. 
 I remember meeting Master for the first time like it was yesterday, we've gone on so many adventures since then, and many times I've almost died. If Master had not come to my rescue so tirelessly, maybe I would be monster feed by now?

drama_dialogue60030512.ch:
所以我始终认为若无仙长，则无《远致行纪》。我将这本小书也随书信一并寄到您手，希望仙长不要嫌弃。
至于现在，已有好几个宗门及城镇琅琊阁拜托我再作远行。前途凶险，绝非单单一腔热血足以克服，因此我心中仍在犹豫。
仙长您以为呢？
drama_dialogue60030512.en:
Without Master, [The Journey of Yuanzhi] would not have existed. I have enclosed a copy of the book along with this letter, I hope you do not mind. 
 Recently, many sects and even the Manual Pavilion have asked me to voyage once again. I now understand how dangerous it can be, and know that I can not overcome dangers with only my bravado, so I am still hesitant. 
 What do you think, Master?

drama_dialogue6003052.ch: 专爱走南闯北的远致最近许久未有音讯，不知是不是又陷身在什么奇怪地方等待救援？你正在这样想，突然脑海出现一副画面，一处山崖附近落有一袭外装短衣，依稀是远致的外衫！你走上前去，果然有衣衫委在地上，你从里面搜出一封书信。
drama_dialogue6003052.en: You have not heard from Yuanzhi - the ever so reckless traveler, for a long while. Just as you start to wonder if he is in danger again, you see a vision in your mind: A short coat on the ground near the edge of a cliff, it looks like Yuanzhi's coat! You walk there, and surely enough there is a coat lying on the ground, you retrieve a letter from within the garment.

drama_dialogue6003053.ch:
仙长，最近是不是忙着斩妖除魔？真盼还能一见仙长威风。
坦白说，我又遭遇凶险了。其实我挺盼望您大展神威来解救于我的，但是我总不能一直打扰您……
drama_dialogue6003053.en:
Masters, have you been busy slaying demons and monsters lately? I wish to see you again. 
 Frankly speaking, I am in dire danger and hope that you will come to my rescue, but I loathe to be your burden all the time...

drama_dialogue60030531.ch:
我想这次是真的要完了。唉，不过没关系了。
记得村里的祠长说自己有通灵之术，能够接收不知道什么地方传来的信息，有一天他记下了一首叫做“词”的东西，里面说“读圣贤书，所学何事？而今而后，庶几无愧”。
drama_dialogue60030531.en:
Oh, I think it's really going to be over for me this time, but it's okay.
 I remember the shrine chief of my village saying that he had psychic abilities, and was able to receive messages from unknown places. One day he wrote down a message called a "lyric", it said this: "Why do we learn, from sacred books? From now onwards, I have no qualms".

drama_dialogue60030532.ch:
这段叫词的东西文绉绉的我也半懂不懂，不过他应该是说费尽心力学习的学问只是为了对得起自己，让自己无怨无悔。
扯远了，走遍远致是我的理想，我为此践行过了，虽然没能走到终点，不过也可以“庶几无愧”了。
drama_dialogue60030532.en:
I did not understand even a half of these words called lyrics, but I assume he meant the knowledge that he has worked hard to learn is just to be worthy of himself, so that he can have no regrets. 
I'm going off topic, it was my dream to travel far and wide, and for that very dream I embarked on this journey, even though I will not survive until the end, I guess I can also say "I have no qualms".

drama_dialogue6003054.ch: 白茸尾上飘出一股微带膻腥的幽香，看来远致遭遇的乃是一只狐妖……
drama_dialogue6003054.en: A faint pungent aroma wafts up from the white tail, it seems that Yuanzhi encountered a fox spirit...

drama_dialogue6003055.ch: 你去到一处所在，周围青山环布，绿水萦绕，只不过周遭果然残留一股强烈的妖狐之气。
drama_dialogue6003055.en: When you arrive, you see luscious green mountains and flowing rivers, but surely enough, the strong aura of a fox spirit surrounds you.

drama_dialogue6003056.ch: 远致兄弟夜宿荒郊，果然招来狐妖魅惑，所幸他天性耿介，临事坐怀不乱，才不致遭了横祸。但狐妖为何独独留下尾巴？这却叫人好生不解。
drama_dialogue6003056.en: Yuanzhi had set up camp in the wilderness overnight, which had attracted the fox spirits - trying to capture prey with their seductive spells. Fortunately Yuanzhi is righteous in character and did not give in to their charms, successfully evading danger. But why had the fox spirit left her tail behind? It is a mystery.

drama_dialogue6003057.ch: 那枚所谓“内丹”果然十分腥臭，令人作呕，但你觉得妖核内藏玄机，于是设法剥离，发现中间竟飞出一缕精魄。而你认得，此物与器灵残魂颇为相似。
drama_dialogue6003057.en: The so called "orb" had a revolting, rancid stench, but you feel that the orb must contain something important, so you peel it back just to see a wisp of spirit fly out of it. You recognize it as A Remnant Artifact Spirit.

drama_dialogue6003058.ch: 器灵残魂！远致兄弟福泽颇厚，莫非那鹿妖竟是一只隐逸在外的器灵？他感念远致好意相助，所以分出残魂转赠于他。
drama_dialogue6003058.en: Remnant Artifact spirit! Yuanzhi is a blessed one indeed, could it be that the Deer Spirit is a wandering Artifact Spirit? It was grateful to Yuanzhi for his help, so he separated a portion of his spirit to offer as a gift?

drama_dialogue6003059.ch: 剑穗上面有一片黑色的迹斑，微闻一阵血腥之气。不问可知，必是远致兄弟卷入宗门动乱后在地上拾获。你颇为感慨，修仙者终究是人非神，是人便不离各种鬼蜮心绪，惨酷行径。你有些心灰意懒，于是运起术法，伸手一扬，剑穗立时化为尘埃，飘散空中。万幸的是，远致兄弟总算逃过一场杀身之祸。
drama_dialogue6003059.en: There was a splotch of back on the sword tassels, and an unmistakable stench of blood. Yuanzhi must have picked it up after being involved in a sect riot. You let out a sigh, cultivators are only human after all, and there will always been violence, greed and cruelty within humans. Feeling a little disheartened, you conjure a spell, and with a wave of your hand the tassel disintegrates into ashes, scattering into the air. Fortunately, Yuanzhi has managed to escape from a violent death.

drama_dialogue6003080.ch: 唉，可惜了大好儿郎，我赠他家中独门传书秘宝，希望能够让他在危难之际发出险信，向四方求助，捡回一条小命。
drama_dialogue6003080.en: Alas, it is such a darn shame, I gifted him a family heirloom so he can send out a signal in times of danger, hopefully help will come to him then.

drama_dialogue6003081.ch: 嘿，来我这的人问来问去不过那些问题，偏偏这傻子说要游历八荒。唉，他现今仍未走远，希望少年人悬崖勒马，安生一点。
drama_dialogue6003081.en: Ha! People who come to me always ask the same questions, but this fool said he was going to take an adventure around the world! Hmm, he mustn't have gone far, I hope the young man comes to his senses soon and returns home.

drama_dialogue6003082.ch: 游历八荒？呵，敢情是名特立独行之人，有趣有趣。
drama_dialogue6003082.en: An adventure around the world? Ha, he must be quite a character, very interesting indeed.

drama_dialogue6003090.ch: 依远致图纸指向，应是这里。远致未习道法武功，凭他身手，确实无法轻易到得此间。不知他在这边发现了什么？唔，这是？！
drama_dialogue6003090.en: According to Yuanzhi's map, it should be here. He hasn't learned Tao and martial arts, and with his skill, he would not be able to reach here easily. I wonder what he found here? Hmm, what is this?!

drama_dialogue6003091.ch: 远致魂归渺渺，这是他特意记下要去一探的地方，我好算完了他心愿，不枉相识一场。咦，这大石下露出一角的是……？
drama_dialogue6003091.en: Yuanzhi's soul has not rested, since he made a specific note to visit this place, I assume I have completed his wishes. Hm, what's that peeking out from beneath that rock?

drama_dialogue6003092.ch: 游远致十分有趣，而且精神可嘉，可出行需要大笔盘缠。
drama_dialogue6003092.en: You Yuanzhi is an interesting person with a laudable ambition, but a journey would cost a lot of money.

drama_dialogue6003100.ch: 远致手无缚鸡之力，我这次营救，没准叫他之后随意冒险，还是不救了吧。
drama_dialogue6003100.en: Yuanzhi is weak and inexperienced, if I rescue him this time, he may become even more reckless in the future, I shouldn't.

drama_dialogue6003101.ch: 可惜还要要事，只好先将远致兄弟放在一边了。
drama_dialogue6003101.en: Too bad there are more important matters at hand, Yuanzhi can wait.

drama_dialogue6003102.ch: 恶贼穷凶极恶，恐怕早已下手害死远致，我再做什么也于事无补。
drama_dialogue6003102.en: Bandits are known for their vicious and cruel nature, I'm afraid Yuanzhi is already done for, there is nothing else I can do.

drama_dialogue6003103.ch: 前方沼泽按远致描述一定有许多妖物，现在前往就会遭到攻击。
drama_dialogue6003103.en: According to Yuanzhi's description, the swamp is swarming with monsters, if I go now I will surely be attacked.

drama_dialogue6003104.ch: 雷泽之中必定潜藏强敌，前方救助游子，必有阻碍。
drama_dialogue6003104.en: Strong enemies lie within Lei Ze, it would be difficult to go in and rescue him

drama_dialogue6003105.ch: 强盗竟敢扣下游远致，这边进入一定发生激斗。
drama_dialogue6003105.en: The bandits have imprisoned Yuanzhi within their fort, a tough battle awaits you if you choose to enter here.

drama_dialogue6003106.ch: 冰封之地，妖怪很多，再作前行便要遭到妖怪妨碍了。
drama_dialogue6003106.en: There are many monsters within the frozen lands, if you go ahead you will be met with more of them.

drama_dialogue6090001.ch: 一只猴子在一颗异树下仰望树上的果子。
drama_dialogue6090001.en: A monkey sits under a strange tree, staring up at its fruit.

drama_dialogue6090002.ch: 猴子迅速拿走果实，钻进了树林里，很快又跑了过来将一包物品放在了你的脚下，快速钻回了树林。
drama_dialogue6090002.en: It grabs the fruit and disappears into the trees. After a moment it runs over, drops a bag at your feet, then retreats back into the trees.

drama_dialogue6090003.ch: 只觉身前一股大力传来，你被弹出老远，感觉到这棵树并不欢迎你的到来，你无奈离去。
drama_dialogue6090003.en: A tremendous force strikes you from the front, sending you flying. You get the feeling the tree is not pleased to see you and are left with no choice but to leave.

drama_dialogue6090004.ch: 赶走偷果实的猴子以后你正要离去，突然大地摇晃地上出现一个地洞，里面似有宝气传出。
drama_dialogue6090004.en: You chase off the thieving monkey and are about to leave when a large hole appears in the ground and the scent of treasure wafts out.

drama_dialogue6090005.ch: 你上前拿出宝物，满树的树叶也开始飘荡，似乎在向你表示感谢,你拿起宝物后离去。
drama_dialogue6090005.en: You go forward and take out the treasure. All the leaves on the tree start shaking, as if in thanks. You pick up the treasure and leave.

drama_dialogue6090006.ch: 猴子赶走你后开始爬树摘果子，怎奈你修为不够无力相助只好离去。
drama_dialogue6090006.en: The monkey gets rid of you and starts climbing the tree to pick fruit. Your cultivation is just too weak and you have no choice but to leave.

drama_dialogue6090007.ch: 猴子与树慢慢消失在你的身后。
drama_dialogue6090007.en: Behind you the monkey and the tree slowly fade away.

drama_dialogue6090010.ch: 你路过一片江河，只见从水中跃出数条怪鱼，鱼身而鸟翼，发出像鸭子的叫声，扇动翅膀渐渐远去，转瞬间暴雨降下将你淋成落汤鸡。
drama_dialogue6090010.en: You pass along a stretch of river and notice a shoal of strange-looking fish leaping out of the water. The fish appear to have birds' wings and make quacking sounds like ducks. Flapping their wings, they fly away into the distance. Suddenly the skies open, drenching you from head to toe.

drama_dialogue6090011.ch: 山林中突然传来惊天鼓声。你寻声而去，只见林间一只异兽马身虎齿，身上白色而尾部漆黑头上还长有一角，与前方数只巨虎争斗。
drama_dialogue6090011.en: Suddenly you hear the deafening sound of drums coming from the forest. Going to investigate, you find a strange beast with the body of a horse and the teeth of a tiger. It has a white coat, a black tail and a horn on its head, and it is facing off against some enormous tigers.

drama_dialogue6090012.ch: 看着他们的争斗你心有所悟，在它们注意到你之前离开了这里。
drama_dialogue6090012.en: Watching them fight is very enlightening and you leave before they can notice you.

drama_dialogue6090013.ch: 你路过一条河，只见一条怪鱼腹部朝上一动不动，似乎已经死去，你走近前去，只见此鱼，鱼首似蛇眼似马耳身有六足。
drama_dialogue6090013.en: Crossing a river, you notice an odd-looking fish. It is belly-up and not moving, as though dead. As you move closer, you see it has snake-like eyes, horse's ears and six little feet.

drama_dialogue6090014.ch: 你心念一动，难道此鱼就是冉遗？你挥刀切下一片食下，只觉周围阴霾一扫而空。
drama_dialogue6090014.en: You have a thought. Could it be a Ranyi fish? You pull out your knife and cut a slice off to eat. Suddenly you sense the shadows lift.

drama_dialogue6090015.ch: 前方草丛中传来悉悉索索的声音，你仔细看去，只见一只长着紫色翅膀的奇怪的老鼠正在翻找一处小地洞。
drama_dialogue6090015.en: You hear rustling coming from some bushes up ahead. Looking closely, all you can see is a strange mouse with purple wings rummaging around in a burrow.

drama_dialogue6090016.ch: 你怀着好奇往前走了一步，老鼠一惊用双翼掩住脑袋，双眼从羽翼间看到你后转瞬飞走。
drama_dialogue6090016.en: Curiously you move forward. The startled mouse covers its head with its wings. As soon as it spots you, it flies away.

drama_dialogue6090017.ch: 你轰开地洞露出了藏在里面的东西。
drama_dialogue6090017.en: You blast open the hole to get at the things inside.

drama_dialogue6090018.ch: 行走间天空乌云密布，远处一道道闪电蓄势待发，你急忙寻找避雨之处，可附近一片荒野，情急之下你躲入一颗大树底下。
drama_dialogue6090018.en: The sky darkens and lightning starts striking in the distance. You desperately search for somewhere to shelter but there is nothing around. Finally, you take shelter under a large tree.

drama_dialogue6090019.ch: 暴雨瞬间而至电闪雷鸣，你正自庆幸，突然一道闪电劈向大树。
drama_dialogue6090019.en: The rain thunders down and lightning flashes all around. Just as you are thinking yourself very clever, a massive fork of lightning strikes the tree under which you are standing.

drama_dialogue6090021.ch: 等你醒来时发现全身焦黑。
drama_dialogue6090021.en: When you come to, your entire body is charred black.

drama_dialogue6090022.ch: 前方悬崖上一颗灵果发出阵阵诱人的香味。
drama_dialogue6090022.en: A Spiritual Fruit growing on a cliff is giving off a wonderful fragrance.

drama_dialogue6090023.ch: 一只猿猴一跃而出向你攻来。

drama_dialogue6090024.ch: 你心有疑虑，看了灵果一眼离开了此地。
drama_dialogue6090024.en: You take one look at the Spiritual Fruit, hesitate, and walk away.

drama_dialogue6090025.en: You take the Spiritual Fruit and depart.

drama_dialogue6090026.ch: 没想到此果竟有如此强力魔猿守护，你念念不舍得离开了此地。
drama_dialogue6090026.en: You didn't think this fruit would be guarded by such a powerful Dire Ape. Reluctantly you tear yourself away.

drama_dialogue6090027.ch: 天边泛起一道彩虹下方似有灵气汇聚。
drama_dialogue6090027.en: A rainbow unfurled beneath the clouds. There appears to be a confluence of Qi energy beneath it.

drama_dialogue6090028.ch: 彩虹下有一潭雾气升腾的清水，旁边有一颗异树长有人面果实。
drama_dialogue6090028.en: Under the rainbow mist rises off a pool of clear water. On the bank there is a strange tree with human-faced fruit.

drama_dialogue6090029.en: You're not really in the mood and continue on your way.

drama_dialogue6090030.ch: 你刚刚喝下一口潭水，潭水似乎受惊一般迅速渗入地下，雾气消散只剩一口干枯多时的水潭痕迹。
drama_dialogue6090030.en: You take a sip of the pond water. The water seems to startle and sinks into the soil. The mist dissipates, leaving a dry cracked depression in the ground.

drama_dialogue6090031.ch: 喝下潭水后你觉得自己修为提升了。
drama_dialogue6090031.en: You feel like drinking the pool water has enhanced your Cultivation.

drama_dialogue6090032.ch: 突如其来的狂暴力量在你体内翻滚，你压制不住一口鲜血喷出晕了过去。醒来时发现体内灵气竟散去不少。
drama_dialogue6090032.en: Suddenly you feel a powerful surge of energy inside you. Fresh blood erupts out of your mouth and you pass out. When you come to, you feel like your Qi has been seriously depleted.

drama_dialogue6090033.ch: 你刚一摘取果实，树木瞬间枯萎消散，只有留在你手中的果实证明了你看到的并非幻觉。
drama_dialogue6090033.en: As soon as you pick the fruit, the wood withers and vanishes. The fruit in your hand is the only proof you didn't just imagine the tree.

drama_dialogue6090034.ch: 你经过一片山峦，山谷内传来鹿的叫声似有光亮传出。
drama_dialogue6090034.en: You're passing through a mountainous area when you hear the sound of deer bleating. Light is coming from somewhere.

drama_dialogue6090035.ch: 在山谷的一个洞内你发现了宝物。
drama_dialogue6090035.en: You find a treasure inside a cave in the valley.

drama_dialogue6090036.ch: 顺着叫声你在谷底的一面湖上找到了一只羽毛赤红的野鸡，正发出叫声捕食湖里的鱼。
drama_dialogue6090036.en: Following the sounds, you come to a lake on the valley floor where you find red-feathered fowl. It is making all kinds of noises as it hunts fish in the lake.

drama_dialogue6090037.ch: 你心头一颤，此鸟竟是胜遇,遇之则国泽!你迅速向城内报告此事让人早做准备。
drama_dialogue6090037.en: Your heart skips a beat. It's the Shengyu bird! It is a good omen! You rush back to town to tell everyone.

drama_dialogue6090038.ch: 你一不小心跌入一片深潭。
drama_dialogue6090038.en: Carelessly you fall into the pool.

drama_dialogue6090039.ch: 等爬起来时发现，身上似乎丢了什么。
drama_dialogue6090039.en: You think you lose something as you climb out.

drama_dialogue6090040.ch: 只见谭中一物发出淡淡光芒，你将其抓入手中爬出水潭。
drama_dialogue6090040.en: Something is glimmering at the bottom of the water. You grab it and climb out.

drama_dialogue6090041.ch: 天空中一只绿色的鹦鹉从你身边飞过，嘴里边飞边重复着“南边桥下挂着我留给你的东西，翼儿，你切记不可说与他人知晓。”
drama_dialogue6090041.en: A green parrot flies right past you. It is talking as it flies. "I left you something under the bridge to the south, Chickadee. Don't tell anyone."

drama_dialogue6090042.ch: 你顺着河流找到了那座桥，果然在桥下挂着一个袋子，你收起袋子在别人发现之前快步离去。
drama_dialogue6090042.en: Presently you come to the bridge. Sure enough, there's a bag hanging under the arch. You take it down before anyone else can notice and leave quickly.

drama_dialogue6090043.ch: 一只黄鼠狼叼着一颗珠子从你身边跑过，后面一只狐狸正在猛追。
drama_dialogue6090043.en: A weasel holding a small sphere in its mouth runs past you. It is being chased by an angry fox.

drama_dialogue6090044.ch: 你赶走了狐狸，黄鼠狼叼着珠子跑开，一会儿又出现时嘴里咬着一个盒子，放到你脚下后就跑走了。
drama_dialogue6090044.en: You chase off the fox and weasel gets away with the bead. After a while it returns, carrying a box in its mouth and places it at your feet.

drama_dialogue6090045.ch: 你收起盒子内的东西离开了这里。
drama_dialogue6090045.en: You remove the contents of the box and leave.

drama_dialogue6090046.ch: 你拦下黄鼠狼，取回珠子扔到狐狸脚下，狐狸盯着你迟疑一番，似乎最终顶不住诱惑，跳过去叼起珠子眨眼就跑开了。
drama_dialogue6090046.en: You stop the weasel, take the bead and throw it towards the fox. The fox stares warily at you, but then picks it up and runs off as fast as it can.

drama_dialogue6090047.ch: 再次出现时一股紫气从狐狸身上升腾而起，而后融入你的体内，再看去时狐狸早已不见踪影。
drama_dialogue6090047.en: When the fox re-emerges, a purplish mist is rising off it. The mist seeps into your body, but when you look back, the fox is already gone.

drama_dialogue6090048.ch: 野兽之间的事情就让它们自己解决吧，你继续赶路。
drama_dialogue6090048.en: Let them sort it out. You keep walking.

drama_dialogue6090049.ch: 看你拦不住狐狸，黄鼠狼发力往前逃去。
drama_dialogue6090049.en: When you fail to stop the fox, the weasel runs away at high speed.

drama_dialogue6090050.ch: 眼看你拦不住，狐狸发力追向黄鼠狼。
drama_dialogue6090050.en: When you fail to stop it, the fox runs after the weasel at high speed.

drama_dialogue6090051.ch: 你结束修炼正要睁眼起身，突然灵海中出现了一片石壁的模糊影像。
drama_dialogue6090051.en: You finish mediating and are just about to get up, when the image of a stone wall appears in your mind.

drama_dialogue6090052.ch: 你凝神看了半天一种若有若无的感觉一直笼罩着你，却始终得不到突破，慢慢影像消失了，你仍然一无所获。
drama_dialogue6090052.en: You stare at it for what seems like an age. A sense of uncertainty comes over you and you do not achieve Breakthrough. Gradually the image fades away and you are back where you started.

drama_dialogue6090053.ch: 石壁上的影像越来越清晰，仿佛是某种修炼方法，你依法修炼，感觉到自身修为更进一步。
drama_dialogue6090053.en: The image of the wall becomes clearer and clearer, as though you are engaging in a form of practice. You feel like your cultivation has been enhanced.

drama_dialogue6090054.ch: 黑暗中突然出现无数双眼睛盯着你。
drama_dialogue6090054.en: Countless pairs of eyes appear in the darkness, staring at you.

drama_dialogue6090055.ch: 你望向那些眼睛似乎有一丝陶醉，突然一个红点融入了你的体内，一股狂暴之力传遍了全身。
drama_dialogue6090055.en: Watching these eyes you feel a little distracted. Suddenly something red leaps into you and berserk energy spreads through your body.

drama_dialogue6090056.ch: 你盯着这些眼睛无所畏惧，眼睛在你的盯视下一个个消失。
drama_dialogue6090056.en: You look back at the eyes fearlessly. One by one they disappear.

drama_dialogue6090057.ch: 一种毛骨悚然的感觉让你本能地狂奔起来离开了这个地方，但内心的恐惧仍然挥之不去。
drama_dialogue6090057.en: A feeling of terror sweeps over you and you run madly away from the scene, but the fear remains with you.

drama_dialogue6090058.ch: 你走在草丛间，耳中传来歌谣之声。
drama_dialogue6090058.en: Walking through the brush you hear someone or something singing.

drama_dialogue6090059.ch: 你正觉得奇怪，一匹面部白色身上带有虎纹的马唱着歌谣绕你一圈后走过，它红色的尾巴甚至在你身上扫了几下。
drama_dialogue6090059.en: A strange horse with a white face and tiger stripe coat trots over to you, circles around you, flicking its red tail at you several times before galloping away. It is singing.

drama_dialogue6090060.ch: 看着离去的虎纹马你不禁哑然失笑。
drama_dialogue6090060.en: Watching its tiger haunches disappear into the distance, you burst out laughing.

drama_dialogue6090061.ch: 前方山谷传来震天咆哮。
drama_dialogue6090061.en: Ferocious snarling sounds are coming from a valley up ahead.

drama_dialogue6090062.ch: 你凝神望去，只见一只白首赤足的猿猴正与一只通体漆黑头上冒着青光的巨蟒扭打在一起，嘶吼中大地震颤。
drama_dialogue6090062.en: Peering into the distance you see a white ape fighting a massive black snake. Their roaring fills the skies.

drama_dialogue6090063.ch: 看见如此惊心动魄的战斗，你心有明悟，忽有所感，修为得到提升。
drama_dialogue6090063.en: Witnessing this epic battle, you gain sudden insight. Your cultivation has been enhanced.

drama_dialogue6090064.ch: 一阵大风卷起，你立足不稳跌下山崖。
drama_dialogue6090064.en: Strong winds pick up. You lose your footing and fall down the cliff.

drama_dialogue6090065.ch: 此时一狮头鹿角，虎眼麋身身披龙鳞的异兽腾云而至，将你托起并带回了山上，而后踏云而去。
drama_dialogue6090065.en: At that moment, a strange beast with the head of a lion, antlers of a deer, body of a moose and covered in dragon scales gallops towards you on a cloud, lifts you up, returns you to the mountain and then gallops away.

drama_dialogue6090066.ch: 你心中感叹时发现一丝灵气留在了体内。
drama_dialogue6090066.en: Sighing inwardly, you find a trace of Qi has rubbed off on you.

drama_dialogue6090067.ch: 一道叱咤之声划过天空，你抬头看时一只人面之蛇扇动翅膀从天空飞过，其后滔天洪水呼啸而来，你拼尽全力逃离这片区域后精疲力尽。
drama_dialogue6090067.en: You hear something above you. Looking up, you see a snake-like creature with the face of a person and wings of a bird flying over. In its wake you hear the roaring of flood waters converging. You get the hell out of there before collapsing in exhaustion.

drama_dialogue6090068.ch: 一股正气从你身上升起。
drama_dialogue6090068.en: An air of righteousness emanates from your body.

drama_dialogue6090069.ch: 喝下潭水后你觉得自己修为提升了。
drama_dialogue6090069.en: You feel like drinking the pool water has enhanced your Cultivation.

drama_dialogue6090089.en: Your heart skips a beat. It's the Shengyu bird! It is a good omen! You rush back to town to tell everyone.

drama_dialogue6090098.en: You engage in a form of practice, enhancing your cultivation.

drama_dialogue6090117.en: Sighing inwardly, you find a trace of Qi has rubbed off on you.

drama_dialogue6090121.ch: 你心中感叹时发现一丝灵气留在了体内。
drama_dialogue6090121.en: Sighing inwardly, you find a trace of Qi has rubbed off on you.

drama_dialogue6090122.ch: 你感到疲倦结束修炼起身离去。
drama_dialogue6090122.en: Feeling exhausted, you stop cultivating, get up and leave.

drama_dialogue6090123.ch: 你找了半天也没有再次看到光亮，只好无奈离去。
drama_dialogue6090123.en: You search for ages but do not see the light again. Out of options, you leave.

drama_dialogue6090124.ch: 你找了半天再也没有听到叫声，只好无奈离去。
drama_dialogue6090124.en: You search for ages but do not hear the sound again. Out of options, you leave.

drama_dialogue6090125.ch: 你找了半天什么都没有找到，却在这山峦间感受到了一丝大地的气息。
drama_dialogue6090125.en: You search for ages but don't find anything, though in the mountains you detect a thread of earthly essence.

drama_dialogue6090140.ch: 你远远看见树上站着一只野鸭子，你觉得很奇怪，靠近前去发现这只奇怪的动物竟然有一条老鼠似的尾巴。
drama_dialogue6090140.en: Off in the distance you can see a wild duck sitting in a tree. Thinking this is strange, you move closer only to find it has a mouse's tail!

drama_dialogue6090141.ch: 察觉到你的异动，这只动物迅速飞走。不久你大病一场。
drama_dialogue6090141.en: Sensing your approach, the creature takes off in a hurry. Not long after you become very ill.

drama_dialogue6090142.ch: 看见这个奇怪的动物令你心中不安，远远离开了这里。离去不久你生病一场，但好在不久就痊愈了。
drama_dialogue6090142.en: For some reason the creature makes you feel uneasy, and you put the place far behind you. Not long after you fall ill, but luckily you recover quite quickly.

drama_dialogue6090143.ch: 你路过一山，正觉得饥渴时看见山上有一棵树，长着枣树的叶子开着黄色的花朵，结有像桃子一样的果实。
drama_dialogue6090143.en: You're crossing a mountain feeling thirsty and hungry when you notice a tree with yellow flowers and peach-like fruit.

drama_dialogue6090144.ch: 吃下果实后你心中阴霾一扫而空，心情大好。
drama_dialogue6090144.en: Eating the fruit really lifts your spirits.

drama_dialogue6090145.ch: 你抵抗住诱惑继续赶路。
drama_dialogue6090145.en: You resist the temptation and continue on your way.

drama_dialogue6090146.ch: 通过约束自身你的耐力提高了。
drama_dialogue6090146.en: By exercising your self-restraint, you improve your endurance.

drama_dialogue6090147.ch: 你沿河行走中只见远方山上似有金玉之光，更远处空中似有五彩光华闪动。
drama_dialogue6090147.en: Following along the riverbank, you see golden light falling on distant mountains. Beyond them, colorful light moves playfully in the sky.

drama_dialogue6090148.en: Your search for a long time without result.

drama_dialogue6090149.ch: 你在山顶找到了一些灵石。
drama_dialogue6090149.en: You find some Spirit Stones on the mountaintop.

drama_dialogue6090150.ch: 你寻找半天也没有找到，但却发现了一处灵力浓郁之处，好好修炼了一番。
drama_dialogue6090150.en: Your search for a long time without result, but you do find a place with abundant energy, and cultivate there for a while.

drama_dialogue6090151.ch: 你赶到附近时五彩光华早已不再，只感觉到一股柔和的光芒慢慢消失。
drama_dialogue6090151.en: You give chase but the colorful lights have long gone. All you can see is the gentle light slowly fading.

drama_dialogue6090152.ch: 你赶到附近只见天空中一只凤凰飞过，散发出五彩光芒慢慢将你笼罩，你回过神来时发现自己如重生一般。
drama_dialogue6090152.en: You give chase. A Phoenix flies overhead, bathing you in colorful light. When you come to, you feel reborn.

drama_dialogue6090153.ch: 你走在沼泽中，突然看见水中出现了一些奇怪的鳖鱼，只见这鳖鱼形状像肺而长有四双眼睛，六只脚，还能吐珠。
drama_dialogue6090153.en: Tromping through a swamp, you notice some strange-looking fish in the water. They have a bulbous shape, four pairs of eyes, six feet and a pearl in the mouth.

drama_dialogue6090154.ch: 你的手刚刚靠近，就被一口咬住怎么都不松口，过了半个时辰你终于挣脱，再也没有抓它的想法了。
drama_dialogue6090154.en: As you reach out, it bites your finger and doesn't let go. One hour later you finally manage to pull your finger out of its mouth. You give up on the idea of trying to catch it.

drama_dialogue6090155.ch: 你从后面一把将其抓住，它挣扎着想要咬你却咬不到。你开心地找了个地方将其烤熟吃掉，发现全身散发出一股暖意，身上所有不适全部消失。
drama_dialogue6090155.en: You grab it from behind. It thrashes and squirms but fails to bite you. You find a nice spot, cook it up and eat it. Afterwards you feel warm all over, like all your troubles have melted away.

drama_dialogue6090156.ch: 曾经被咬的经历让你心生敬畏，你远远离开了这些可怕的怪鱼。
drama_dialogue6090156.en: Once bitten, twice shy. You put as much distance as you can between yourself and that freakish fish.

drama_dialogue6090157.ch: 你似乎听到婴儿叫声从不远处山中传来，心想难道有人将婴儿遗弃在山中？
drama_dialogue6090157.en: You think you hear the sound of a baby crying from somewhere in the hills. Could someone have abandoned a child up here?

drama_dialogue6090158.ch: 你寻声而去，在山洞附近再次听到婴儿叫声，向洞内一望，只见洞内漆黑幽深。
drama_dialogue6090158.en: Searching for the sound, you hear it again near a Mountain Cave. Peering into the cave, all you can see is impenetrable darkness.

drama_dialogue6090159.ch: 此地偏僻修仙者都少有路过，又怎会有婴儿在此。
drama_dialogue6090159.en: This place is so remote. Cultivators hardly ever come here, so why would there be a child here?

drama_dialogue6090160.ch: 你担心婴儿，进入洞中，最终寻声找到婴儿送回城内。
drama_dialogue6090160.en: Worried for the child, you enter the cave. Eventually you find it and take it back to the town.

drama_dialogue6090161.ch: 漆黑幽深的洞穴使你心生疑虑，最终没有进去而是将此事报告城内。
drama_dialogue6090161.en: The pitch blackness of the cave freaks you out. Finally, you decide not to go in and report the matter to authorities in town.

drama_dialogue6090162.ch: 此地明显怪异，你不敢多做停留快步离去。
drama_dialogue6090162.en: This place is really weird. You decide not to hang around.

drama_dialogue6090163.ch: 你刚一进入山洞婴儿的叫声戛然而止，一只妖怪出现在洞口堵住你的去路，背后九条尾巴一晃向你扑来。
drama_dialogue6090163.en: As soon as you enter the cave the crying stops. A monster cuts off your exit and stands in the cave mouth, waving its nine tails at you.

drama_dialogue6090164.ch: 洞内皑皑白骨证明有多少无辜的人被怪物所害，你埋葬骸骨后拿走了洞内的遗物。
drama_dialogue6090164.en: The bones of the monster's victims litter the floor of the cave. You bury them, take their belongings and leave the cave.

drama_dialogue6090165.ch: 危急之时你身上玉佩一闪，一股力量将你生生从蠪侄手下救走，瞬间就回到了山林之中。
drama_dialogue6090165.en: At the critical moment, the Bagua Jade flashes. A mysterious force whisks you away from the clutches of the Long Zhi and you land in the middle of a mountain forest.

drama_dialogue6090166.ch: 沙漠中你口干舌燥头晕眼花，忽然在你前面出现了一片清澈水潭，潭边还长有椰树，你带着兴奋直接跳向潭水里。
drama_dialogue6090166.en: You are dying for water in the middle of the desert. Suddenly a pool of clear water appears before you. Coconut palms grow on the banks and you excitedly dive in.

drama_dialogue6090167.ch: 你一下子就摔在了沙堆上，之前的那片潭水和椰树全部消失，只有这片酷热是真实的。。。
drama_dialogue6090167.en: The next moment you are lying face down in a pile of sand, the water and palm trees nowhere to be seen. The only real thing is the heat...

drama_dialogue6090168.ch: 你扑通一声扎进水里，大口的喝着清水，仿佛整个人都活了过来，你惬意地在水中游泳，直到水潭干涸你才恋恋不舍的离开了这里。
drama_dialogue6090168.en: You enter the water with a splash. Cool water fills your mouth and stomach, and your whole body feels refreshed. You swim around happily, only leaving when the pool dries up.

drama_dialogue6090169.ch: 你好多天没有看到水了，头顶还有一只秃鹫一直在盘旋，这让你的心情有些低落。
drama_dialogue6090169.en: You haven't seen water in many days. A vulture circles in the sky above you, which you find very demoralizing.

drama_dialogue6090170.ch: 你已在荒野中行走多日，突然你发现远处似乎躺着一人，你赶快走上前去。
drama_dialogue6090170.en: You have been trudging through the wilderness for many days. Suddenly in the distance you see someone lying prostrate on the ground. You hurry over to take a closer look.

drama_dialogue6090171.ch: 却发现已是一具骸骨，你取走了它身边的物品。毕竟这些东西它再也不会需要了，而你还想活下去。
drama_dialogue6090171.en: It turns out to be a dead body. You take the items lying on the ground beside it. After all, he won't be using them again, and you wanna live.

drama_dialogue6090172.ch: 凛冽的寒风令你浑身哆嗦，似乎压制了你体内的生机。
drama_dialogue6090172.en: The bitter wind is making you tremble uncontrollably. It feels like your lifeforce is draining away.

drama_dialogue6090173.ch: 你突然感觉前方传来一丝宝气，你上前寻找。最终发现一块千年寒冰中有一只半透明的冰蟾正在吸纳周围灵气。
drama_dialogue6090173.en: Suddenly you get a whiff of treasure and hurry towards it. Eventually you find a transparent Icy Toad locked inside a piece of ancient ice, absorbing all the surrounding Qi.

drama_dialogue6090174.ch: 你心中思量，这冰蟾这么久都没有被人取走，除了此地寒冷只怕还有别的原因吧。你收起贪念离开了这里。
drama_dialogue6090174.en: Thinking about it, no one has taken this Icy Toad for centuries. There must be a reason, besides the cold. You suppress your greed and leave this place.

drama_dialogue6090175.ch: 就在你靠近冰蟾之时，一块冰块碎裂，卷起一道寒风向你刮来。
drama_dialogue6090175.en: As you approach the Icy Toad, a piece of ice fractures, and a tendril of cold air unfurls and scrapes your skin.

drama_dialogue6090176.ch: 你取出冰蟾炼化一番一口服下，一股寒气随之沉淀于你的体内而后散发出阵阵灵气滋润你的全身。
drama_dialogue6090176.en: You extract the Icy Toad, refine it for a while, then swallow it in one gulp. A lump of cold energy lodges in your stomach and starts emitting Qi, nourishing your entire body.

drama_dialogue6090177.ch: 冰蟾有巨人守卫，你不得寸进只好离去。
drama_dialogue6090177.en: The Icy Toad has a giant guardian. You decide not to be greedy, and leave.

drama_dialogue6090178.ch: 小友，练功可是遇到瓶颈了？这里有一枚丹药可助你突破瓶颈，遇到你也是缘分就只收400灵石好了！要知道坊市里这可要800灵石！
drama_dialogue6090178.en: Has your practice reached a bottleneck? I have an Elixir here that can help you breakthrough. And I only want 400 Spirit Stones for it! You know it would cost you 800 Spirit Stones in the shop!

drama_dialogue6090179.en: You take the Elixir and leave, satisfied.

drama_dialogue6090180.ch: 你虽想要丹药，但对方的话语令你心生疑虑。你不理睬对方转身离开。
drama_dialogue6090180.en: You want the Elixir, but now you feel uneasy. You ignore the speaker, turn and leave.

drama_dialogue6090201.ch: 你听到附近好像有人在叫你的名字…
drama_dialogue6090201.en: You think you can hear someone calling your name...

drama_dialogue6090202.ch: 你环顾四周，终于寻声在一棵树下找到了一只看起来像猪却长着人脸的异兽。
drama_dialogue6090202.en: Looking around you finally find the source of the sound under a tree. It looks like a pig, but with a human face.

drama_dialogue6090203.ch: 这只异兽似乎被毒蛇咬伤，已经奄奄一息了…
drama_dialogue6090203.en: It looks like it has been bitten by a snake and is very close to death...

drama_dialogue6090204.ch: 你上前检查一番，但是此兽已然中毒太深回天无力…你叹口气脱下道袍盖在此兽身上，准备离去。
drama_dialogue6090204.en: You go over to investigate, but the creature looks too far gone... You take off your robe, and lay it over the body, before turning to leave.

drama_dialogue6090205.ch: 这只异兽似乎察觉到了你的想法，双眼含泪，发出悲伤的呜咽望着你…
drama_dialogue6090205.en: Understanding the significance of your action, the creature looks up at you and starts to weep...

drama_dialogue6090206.ch: 看着异兽悲伤的表情，你忍不住停下脚步，虽然知道这可能是徒劳的，但还是尽力救治…
drama_dialogue6090206.en: Seeing the creature's pitiful expression, you stop in your tracks. Healing it will probably be futile, but you might as well try...

drama_dialogue6090207.ch: 你运转浑身灵力，异兽体内毒素奇迹般慢慢消退，一段时间过去竟好了大半，获救后这只异兽对你表示感谢，送给你一颗灵果并向你讲述了自己的生平事迹。这段经历令你获得了一些感悟。
drama_dialogue6090207.en: You activate your energy and miraculously the poison in the creature starts to clear. After a while it appears almost fully recovered. He thanks you profusely, gives you a Spiritual Fruit, then goes on to tell you his life story. The experience grants you insight.

drama_dialogue6090208.ch: 你运转浑身灵力救治，但这终究是徒劳的，异兽已然中毒过深，慢慢地眼中最后一丝神采也消失了…你叹口气起身正要离开时，一道灵气从异兽身上溢出进入你的体内。
drama_dialogue6090208.en: You activate your healing energy, but it doesn't work. The poison is too far advanced. Finally the spark of life dies in its eyes... Disappointed, you get up. As you go to leave, a thread of Qi flows from the creature into your body.

drama_dialogue6090209.ch: 你运转灵力救治，异兽体内毒素慢慢消退，一段时间过去竟好了大半，获救后这只异兽对你表示感谢，送给你一颗灵果。你收下灵果后离去。
drama_dialogue6090209.en: You activate your healing energy and the poison in the creature starts to clear. After a while it appears almost fully recovered. He thanks you profusely and gives you a Spiritual Fruit. You take it and leave.

drama_dialogue6090210.ch: 你运转灵力救治，但异兽已然中毒过深，慢慢地眼中最后一丝神采也消失了…你叹口气起身正要离开时，一道灵气从异兽身上溢出进入你的体内。
drama_dialogue6090210.en: You activate your healing energy, but the poison is too far advanced. Finally the spark of life dies in its eyes... Disappointed, you get up. As you go to leave, a thread of Qi flows from the creature into your body.

drama_dialogue6090211.ch: 弱肉强食适者生存也许这就是大自然的法则…你转身离去。
drama_dialogue6090211.en: Survival of the fittest. It's the law of the jungle... You turn and walk away.
