drama_dialogue700512.ch: 事真多，还怕老夫骗你不成？！
drama_dialogue700512.en: Stop overthinking. Would I ever lie to you?

drama_dialogue70052.ch: 惹怒了我，今日你必将付出代价。
drama_dialogue70052.en: Piss me off and pay the price!

drama_dialogue700521.ch: 啧…你这小屁孩真是寒碜，连一个<g>四品灵果</g>都没有！
drama_dialogue700521.en: Tch, you don't even have one <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>? Poor kid.

drama_dialogue700522.ch: 算了，等你准备好了灵果，再过来找老夫吧！就是那种服用过后能够提升你们这些修仙者的资质与灵根的那种灵果，晓得了不？！
drama_dialogue700522.en: Anyway, come find me once you've got the Spiritual Fruit. You know, the type that's used to enhance your cultivator stats and Spiritual Root.

drama_dialogue700523.ch: 对了，老夫只要四品的灵果，其它的一概不收！
drama_dialogue700523.en: Oh yeah. I only accept Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit. Nothing else will do.

drama_dialogue70053.en: What are you staring at? Get over here!

drama_dialogue700531.ch: 怎么样？考虑好了就把<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>交给我，我来开启此阵。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700531.en: Well? When you're ready, bring me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70054.ch: 先离开此地，讨伐<r>三足乌</r>还得从长计议。
drama_dialogue70054.en: We should go. Taking down these <r>Three-legged Crows</r> is going to take more than one day.

drama_dialogue700541.ch: 很好，那我们就开始吧！一定要保护好老夫呀！
drama_dialogue700541.en: Very well, let's start! Protect me well!

drama_dialogue700545.ch: 毛孩子，竟然敢用残次品糊弄龟爷！老夫虽年事已高，但脑子还灵光着呢！这批灵果老夫没收了！你再重新去找过吧！
drama_dialogue700545.en: Brat! Try to dupe me with low grade product, will you? I might be old, but I'm not stupid. These Spiritual Fruit are mine now. Come back when you've got the Grade 4 ones!

drama_dialogue700551.ch: 寒碜的小屁孩，灵果找着了吗？把<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>交给我，我就会开启此阵。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700551.en: Where's my fruit, street urchin? Get me the <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g> and I'll unseal the array. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70056.ch: 惹怒了我，今日你必将付出代价。
drama_dialogue70056.en: Piss me off and pay the price!

drama_dialogue700561.en: Tch, why are you still here?

drama_dialogue70057.en: What are you staring at? Get over here!

drama_dialogue700571.ch: 哎哟…小屁孩，你到底行不行呀！这些怪物打在我身上可是很痛的！你再这样，我就不陪你玩了啊！
drama_dialogue700571.en: Useless brat! These monsters are really giving me hell! Keep this up and I'm out of here!

drama_dialogue700572.ch: 废话少说！想要再次尝试，就给我<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700572.en: You sure complain a lot. If you want to try again, give me the <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with inferior product!

drama_dialogue700573.ch: 事真多！等你准备好了再来吧！
drama_dialogue700573.en: You must be very busy! Come back when you have it.

drama_dialogue700575.ch: 怎么了？若想要再次开启此阵，就给我<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700575.en: Well? If you want me to try to open the array again, get me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70058.ch: 先离开此地，讨伐<r>三足乌</r>还得从长计议。
drama_dialogue70058.en: We should go. Taking down these <r>Three-legged Crows</r> is going to take more than one day.

drama_dialogue700581.ch: 嗷嗷嗷！！！疼疼疼…好汉饶命！！

drama_dialogue700591.ch: 小屁孩表现尚可！这些是我刚刚找到的东西，拿好了。
drama_dialogue700591.en: Well done! Look what I just found, brat. Take it!

drama_dialogue700592.ch: 小屁孩表现尚可！这些是我刚刚找到的东西，拿好了。
drama_dialogue700592.en: Well done! Look what I just found, brat. Take it!

drama_dialogue700601.ch: 咦…从没见过的小屁孩，你来到此地有何贵干呀？是迷路了吗？
drama_dialogue700601.en: Ah... a new kid. What brings you here? You lost?

drama_dialogue700602.ch: 罢了…反正老夫对你的事也没兴趣。不过，这里倒是有一桩机缘要相赠于你！
drama_dialogue700602.en: Eh, your business does not interest me. However, I do have something to offer you.

drama_dialogue700603.ch: 小屁孩，看到脚下残破的法阵了吗？里面藏着不少好东西！你若能拿出<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>，老夫就帮你打开此阵，并搜寻阵中的宝物！
drama_dialogue700603.en: Kid, see the broken array under your feet? You can find some good stuff in there! Bring me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g> and I'll unseal it and look around inside for some treasures for you!

drama_dialogue700604.ch: 当然，在这期间引起的动静估计会吸引不少怪物过来…你可一定要保护好老夫呀！
drama_dialogue700604.en: Of course, I'll likely attract a lot of monsters during the process... So you'd better protect me well!

drama_dialogue70061.ch: 道友，我们的实力与<r>三足乌</r>差距悬殊，若是正面交战，想要取胜绝非易事。
drama_dialogue70061.en: Cultivator, we are no match for these <r>Three-legged Crows</r>. If we confront them directly, we are certain to lose.

drama_dialogue700611.ch: 准备好了的话，就把<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>交给老夫吧！千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700611.en: When you're ready, bring me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue700612.ch: 事真多，还怕老夫骗你不成？！
drama_dialogue700612.en: Stop overthinking. Would I ever lie to you?

drama_dialogue70062.ch: 那依你之见，该如何是好？

drama_dialogue700621.ch: 啧…你这小屁孩真是寒碜，连一个<g>四品灵果</g>都没有！
drama_dialogue700621.en: Tch, you don't even have one <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>? Poor kid.

drama_dialogue700622.ch: 算了，等你准备好了灵果，再过来找老夫吧！就是那种服用过后能够提升你们这些修仙者的资质与灵根的那种灵果，晓得了不？！
drama_dialogue700622.en: Anyway, come find me once you've got the Spiritual Fruit. You know, the type that's used to enhance your cultivator stats and Spiritual Root.

drama_dialogue700623.ch: 对了，老夫只要四品的灵果，其它的一概不收！
drama_dialogue700623.en: Oh yeah. I only accept Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit. Nothing else will do.

drama_dialogue70063.ch: 实不相瞒，我过去云游天下，曾有幸得到一件神器的铸造之法。
drama_dialogue70063.en: On my travels I discovered a method of forging artifacts.

drama_dialogue700631.ch: 怎么样？考虑好了就把<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>交给我，我来开启此阵。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700631.en: Well? When you're ready, bring me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70064.ch: 若能成功锻造，我便有把握能够射杀<r>三足乌</r>！
drama_dialogue70064.en: If it works, I'll be able to kill those <r>Three-legged Crows</r>!

drama_dialogue700641.ch: 很好，那我们就开始吧！一定要保护好老夫呀！
drama_dialogue700641.en: Very well, let's start! Protect me well!

drama_dialogue700645.ch: 毛孩子，竟然敢用残次品糊弄龟爷！老夫虽年事已高，但脑子还灵光着呢！这批灵果老夫没收了！你再重新去找过吧！
drama_dialogue700645.en: Brat! Try to dupe me with low grade product, will you? I might be old, but I'm not stupid. These Spiritual Fruit are mine now. Come back when you've got the Grade 4 ones!

drama_dialogue70065.ch: 那你为何不从一开始便锻造神器呢？
drama_dialogue70065.en: Why didn't you make one in the first place?

drama_dialogue700651.ch: 寒碜的小屁孩，灵果找着了吗？把<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>交给我，我就会开启此阵。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700651.en: Where's my fruit, street urchin? Get me the <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g> and I'll unseal the array. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70066.ch: 你有所不知…既是神器，锻造所需的自然不是凡物。
drama_dialogue70066.en: You don't know... Being an artifact, the components required are not common.

drama_dialogue700661.en: Tch, why are you still here?

drama_dialogue70067.ch: 多年来，我已成功收集了十之八九，只是尚缺<g>扶桑树枝</g>与<r>人面鸮王</r>的<g>金羽</g>。
drama_dialogue70067.en: Over the years I've collected most of the components. I'm just missing a <g>Mulberry Branch</g> and the <g>Golden Feather</g> of a <r>Harpy Lord</r>.

drama_dialogue700671.ch: 哎哟…小屁孩，你到底行不行呀！这些怪物打在我身上可是很痛的！你再这样，我就不陪你玩了啊！
drama_dialogue700671.en: Useless brat! These monsters are really giving me hell! Keep this up and I'm out of here!

drama_dialogue700672.ch: 废话少说！想要再次尝试，就给我<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700672.en: You sure complain a lot. If you want to try again, give me the <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with inferior product!

drama_dialogue700673.ch: 事真多！等你准备好了再来吧！
drama_dialogue700673.en: You must be very busy! Come back when you have it.

drama_dialogue700675.ch: 怎么了？若想要再次开启此阵，就给我<r>5</r>个<g>四品灵果</g>。千万别用其它的残次品糊弄老夫！
drama_dialogue700675.en: Well? If you want me to try to open the array again, get me <r>5</r> <g>Grade 4 Spiritual Fruit</g>. Don't try to dupe me with anything less!

drama_dialogue70068.ch: 扶桑树乃是传说中的神树，位于八荒世界东部的十万大山之中，想要寻到十分不易。
drama_dialogue70068.en: The Mulberry referred to is a legendary Divine Tree thought to grow in the Hundred Thousand Hills to the east. Apparently it is very hard to find.

drama_dialogue700681.ch: 嗷嗷嗷！！！疼疼疼…好汉饶命！！

drama_dialogue70069.ch: 还有一位实力高深莫测的守护者常年保护着神树。我曾经去过十万大山，却连神树的模样都没有见到，便被守护者给驱逐了。
drama_dialogue70069.en: The tree is watched by a Guardian of unfathomable power. I visited the Hundred Thousand Hills once, but was chased off by the Guardian before I could get a look at the tree.

drama_dialogue700691.ch: 小屁孩表现尚可！这些是我刚刚找到的东西，拿好了。
drama_dialogue700691.en: Well done! Look what I just found, brat. Take it!

drama_dialogue700692.ch: 小屁孩表现尚可！这些是我刚刚找到的东西，拿好了。
drama_dialogue700692.en: Well done! Look what I just found, brat. Take it!

drama_dialogue70070.ch: 至于那<r>人面鸮王</r>，更是传说中的存在。迄今为止，我从未得到过它的消息。
drama_dialogue70070.en: As for the <r>Harpy Lord</r>, I think it must be a creature of legend! No leads anywhere.

drama_dialogue70071.ch: 我先到十万大山去看看，扶桑树枝便交给我吧。
drama_dialogue70071.en: I'll go to the Hundred Thousand Hills first and bring back the Mulberry Branch.

drama_dialogue70072.ch:
如此甚好！但此去十万大山路途凶险，若是没有

结晶境

的实力，恐怕会有性命之忧…还请量力而行。在此期间，我会尽量阻挡三足乌危害八荒。期待你的好消息。
drama_dialogue70072.en:
Excellent! I fear the road to Hundred Thousand Hills is very dangerous. If you can't do

Qi Condensation

I fear your life will be in danger... Know your own limits. I'll stay here and try to keep a lid on those Three-legged Crows. Good luck.

drama_dialogue70073.ch: （<r>三足乌</r>实力强大，我还是不要贸然靠近为好。）
drama_dialogue70073.en: (<r>Three-legged Crow</r> are powerful. Better not get too close.)

drama_dialogue70083.ch: 正是！你鬼鬼祟祟的在神树附近，究竟想做什么？
drama_dialogue70083.en: Yes. What are you doing, skulking around in the shadows?

drama_dialogue70084.ch: 我有要事，必须要取得扶桑的一截树枝。
drama_dialogue70084.en: I'm on an important mission. I need a branch from the tree.

drama_dialogue70085.ch: 我奉命在此守护神树，便是以防你这样的人对神树心怀不轨。有我在，你休想得逞！
drama_dialogue70085.en: I am Guardian of the tree! It is my job to keep riffraff like you away! You will never get what you want!

drama_dialogue70091.ch: 我确实是有要紧的事…眼下八荒世界正遭到<r>三足乌</r>的迫害，我等凡人并非它们的对手。还请通融一下。
drama_dialogue70091.en: It's urgent... <r>Three-legged Crows</r> are terrorizing the land. We mortals are no match for them. Please try to see it from our point of view.

drama_dialogue70093.ch: 可即便如此，我也无法将扶桑的树枝交给你。
drama_dialogue70093.en: Even if it's true, I cannot let you have the Mulberry Branch.

drama_dialogue70094.ch: 神树近年来接连收到冥山气息的侵蚀，生命力大大受损。若是强行取下树枝，神树不久后便会死去。
drama_dialogue70094.en: Every year the Divine Tree is weakened by the Nether Mountains. It is very unwell. If I let you take the branch, the shock could very well kill it.

drama_dialogue70095.ch: 不知可还有能够拯救神树的方式？
drama_dialogue70095.en: Perhaps there is another way we can save the tree?

drama_dialogue70097.ch: 南方有一处仙池，你若是能取得一些池中的<g>神水</g>，我便将<g>扶桑树枝</g>交给于你。
drama_dialogue70097.en: To the south there is a Sacred Pond. If you can bring me some <g>Divine Water</g> from there, I will give you the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>.

drama_dialogue70098.en: Okay! I'll go there right away!

drama_dialogue70099.ch: 且慢，仙池有<r>开明兽</r>坐镇，它是绝对不会让你轻易取走神水的。你此去得多加小心。
drama_dialogue70099.en: Wait. The Sacred Pond is guarded by the <r>Lydra</r>. He won't let you get the Divine Water without a fight. You will need to be careful.

drama_dialogue7010001.ch: 你拿出了双鱼佩，这双鱼佩在月光下竟发出了隐隐白光，在你的手里分成了两块，一阴一阳之间似乎存在着千丝万缕的关系，仿佛一体双生，随时又准备合二为一。你在其中感觉到了莫大的道力，这股神秘的力量将两块玉佩的存在深深地吸引在一起，但你的双手却又能轻易地将其分开。你面前的人也饶有兴味地看着你。
drama_dialogue7010001.en: You take out the Bagua Jade, which glistens under the moonlight. It splits into two parts, which seem to be spiritually connected and ready to merge anytime. You feel immense Tao Power within it, which keeps the two parts attracted to each other, but you can still part them easily. The person in front of you looks at you with great interest.

drama_dialogue7010002.ch: 这双鱼佩是早前遇过一神秘仙人所赠，妙法无穷。有起死回生之效，还能互通地利，传人体魄与千里之外。今我们行走于八荒之中，魑魅魍魉不计其数，时刻危险，希望你能收下这一半，与我一同享此平安。
drama_dialogue7010002.en: I got this Bagua Jade from a mysterious Immortal a long time ago. It can save one from death and teleport one to a thousand leagues away. It's dangerous for us to travel in this world full of phantoms and monsters. I hope you could keep this half so that we could share our risks.

drama_dialogue7010003.ch: 没想到你愿意将如此珍贵之物赠与我。既如此，我便不辜负你的一片心意。有此仙人之物相连，我们彼此有了个照应，我也喜悦在心。
drama_dialogue7010003.en: You are sharing such a treasure with me? It's such an honor. I'll keep it, and I'm sure it's reassuring for both of us to have each other's back.

drama_dialogue70101.ch: 仙池有<r>开明兽</r>坐镇，它是绝对不会让你轻易取走神水的。你此去得多加小心。
drama_dialogue70101.en: The Sacred Pond is guarded by the <r>Lydra</r>. He won't let you get the Divine Water without a fight. You will need to be careful.

drama_dialogue7010101.ch: 你拿出了双鱼佩，这双鱼佩在月光下发出了微弱的白光，你把双鱼佩轻轻分开成两块。
drama_dialogue7010101.en: You take out the Bagua Jade, which glistens under the moonlight. You gently split it into two parts.

drama_dialogue7010102.ch: 这双鱼佩是早前遇过一神秘仙人所赠，妙法无穷。有起死回生之效，还能互通地利，传人体魄与千里之外。今我们行走于八荒之中，魑魅魍魉不计其数，时刻危险，希望你能收下这一半，与我一同享此平安。
drama_dialogue7010102.en: I got this Bagua Jade from a mysterious Immortal a long time ago. It can save one from death and teleport one to a thousand leagues away. It's dangerous for us to travel in this world full of phantoms and monsters. I hope you could keep this half so that we could share our risks.

drama_dialogue7010103.ch: 若真如你所言，如此珍贵之物，你可以赠予亲近之人，我···不便接受此物。（双鱼佩只能赠予亲族关系中亲密度较高的人）
drama_dialogue7010103.en: If so, you should give this to someone close to you. I don't think I should accept it. (Bagua Jade can only be gifted to someone with high Affinity among those you have a familial relation with.)

drama_dialogue7010201.ch: 自从你赠我这双鱼佩后，我怕你有事救急，每时每刻都将其带在身旁，不敢有丝毫怠慢。你既然要拿回，一定是有了更重要的牵绊，也是一件好事，你···拿走便是。
drama_dialogue7010201.en: Since you gave me this Bagua Jade, I have always been carrying it with me. I suppose you must now have someone more important to you, and it's better for that person to have it. Here you are.

drama_dialogue7010301.ch: 既然我们已经不再是亲族关系，这双鱼佩我也不便再持有，今日便归还于你。
drama_dialogue7010301.en: Since our Familial relation is no more, I shouldn't be holding this Bagua Jade. Please take it back.

drama_dialogue7010401.ch: 幸好···有你相救，否则我···性命危矣···
drama_dialogue7010401.en: Thank you...for saving me, or I would...have been long dead...

drama_dialogue7010501.ch: 适才双鱼佩突然闪起白光，我心中便知道是你要前来。
drama_dialogue7010501.en: I knew you were coming when the Bagua Jade flashed white just now.

drama_dialogue7010601.ch: 双鱼佩无法维持所系之人受到的损伤，顷刻间爆发出一阵白光，将所系之人传送回了原处。
drama_dialogue7010601.en: The Bagua Jade can't sustain the life of its wounded holder. With a radiant white flash, it teleports the holder to the place before.

drama_dialogue70111.ch: （从这里都能感受到磅礴的灵力，仙池应该就在前方。）
drama_dialogue70111.en: (You can sense the intense energy field from here. The Sacred Pond must be up ahead.)

drama_dialogue70112.ch: 何人擅闯圣地？！给我站住！
drama_dialogue70112.en: Who defiles this sacred ground?! Stop right there!

drama_dialogue70113.ch: （这就是开明兽…看起来不好对付，我得小心。）
drama_dialogue70113.en: (So this is Lydra... He looks mean. I'd better be careful.)

drama_dialogue70114.ch: 我有要事，欲求仙池中的一缕神水，还请通融一下。
drama_dialogue70114.en: I am on urgent business. I need Divine Water from the Sacred Pond. Please be understanding.

drama_dialogue70115.ch: 放肆！仙池岂容尔等凡人玷污！纳命来！
drama_dialogue70115.en: Absurd! The Divine Water will never touch the lips of mortal! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue70121.ch: 既已取得神水，这便返回十万大山吧。
drama_dialogue70121.en: Since you got the Divine Water, you might as well head back to the Hundred Thousand Hills.

drama_dialogue70131.ch: 是你？此去仙池可有收获？
drama_dialogue70131.en: You're back! Did you get the water?

drama_dialogue70132.ch: 我已将神水带回来了，如此便能保神树无恙了吧！
drama_dialogue70132.en: Yes! Now we can make sure the Divine Tree doesn't come to any harm!

drama_dialogue70134.ch: 你且稍后，我这便去取<g>扶桑树枝</g>。
drama_dialogue70134.en: You wait. I'll get the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>.

drama_dialogue70135.ch: 这便是<g>扶桑树枝</g>了。扶桑吸取天地之力，存世已有数万年之久，若是将其炼制为法宝，其威能可弑神。但愿你能将它用于正途…
drama_dialogue70135.en: Here is the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>. The tree has been absorbing energy for many millennia. Any artifact made from it is bound to be powerful indeed. I hope you make good use of it.

drama_dialogue70136.ch: 多谢！我还有一事想要请教…不知你可听闻过<r>人面鸮王</r>？
drama_dialogue70136.en: Thank you! There is one more thing I need to ask you... Have you ever heard of the <r>Harpy Lord</r>?

drama_dialogue70137.ch: 西方有一处山谷，谷中有一个巨大的洞穴，人面鸮王便栖息在此处。
drama_dialogue70137.en: To the west is a Valley. There's a large cave in the valley where the Harpy Lord resides.

drama_dialogue70138.ch: 突然间，扶桑树的生机正在流逝，茂盛的枝叶已枯死了大半。
drama_dialogue70138.en: Suddenly the life force leaves the Divine Mulberry. Half its canopy dies on the twig.

drama_dialogue70140.ch: 这是怎么了？我已取来了神水，却为何…
drama_dialogue70140.en: What on earth? I got the Divine Water, so why would...?

drama_dialogue70141.ch: …神树遭受冥气的侵蚀已有百年之久，已经没有任何办法能够挽救神树了。
drama_dialogue70141.en: ... The Divine Tree has been subjected to the corrosive effects of dark energy for hundreds of years. Nothing can save it now.

drama_dialogue70143.ch: 我已用神水护住树枝，可保其生机不会流逝。
drama_dialogue70143.en: I used the Divine Water to preserve the branch. It won't die.

drama_dialogue70144.ch: 你明明知晓取下树枝会有什么后果，却为何还要将它交给我？
drama_dialogue70144.en: If you knew what would happen, why did you give me the branch?

drama_dialogue70145.ch: 神树走向毁灭只是时间问题，不是今日，便是明日。
drama_dialogue70145.en: It was only a matter of time before the Divine Tree died. If not today, then maybe tomorrow.

drama_dialogue70146.ch: …可是你违抗了你的使命，必然会遭天道反噬。
drama_dialogue70146.en: ... But if you fail in your mission, the Heavenly Path will be affronted.

drama_dialogue70147.ch: 我既然决定要将树枝交给你，又何惧天罚？
drama_dialogue70147.en: So I decided to give it to you. What fear does Heaven hold for me?

drama_dialogue70148.ch: 你应该还有更重要的事，快离开这里吧。
drama_dialogue70148.en: You have other business to attend to. You should leave!

drama_dialogue70151.ch: 山谷中阴风四起，空气中弥漫着一股危险的气息…
drama_dialogue70151.en: Dark winds fill the valley. A malevolent presence fills the air...

drama_dialogue70152.ch: <g>扶桑树枝</g>和<g>金羽</g>均已取得，回去吧。
drama_dialogue70152.en: The <g>Mulberry Branch</g> and <g>Golden Feather</g> are both in your possession. Better go back.

drama_dialogue70153.ch: （这一定就是人面鸮之王了，我必须击败它。）
drama_dialogue70153.en: (This is definitely the King of Harpies! I've got to defeat it.)

drama_dialogue70154.ch: （不愧是传说中的异兽，真不容易…）
drama_dialogue70154.en: (Wow, it's a tough one. It truly is a beast of legend...)

drama_dialogue70161.ch: 你回来了？此行收获如何？我已得知<r>人面鸮王</r>的下落了。
drama_dialogue70161.en: You're back! How did it go? I already heard about the <r>Harpy Lord</r>.

drama_dialogue70162.ch: <r>人面鸮王</r>的<g>金羽</g>和<g>扶桑树枝</g>我均已取得。
drama_dialogue70162.en: The <r>Harpy Lord</r>'s <g>Golden Feather</g> and <g>Mulberry Branch</g> are both in my possession.

drama_dialogue70163.ch: 这<r>三足乌</r>凶猛得很，我一人难以招架…已有许多人受难了。
drama_dialogue70163.en: The <r>Three-legged Crow</r> is ferocious! I can barely keep up... So many have already come to grief.

drama_dialogue70164.ch: 你且将树枝与<g>金羽</g>给我，我这就去锻造神箭。接下来就交给我吧。
drama_dialogue70164.en: Give me the branch and the <g>Golden Feather</g> so I can make the artifact. I can take it from here.

drama_dialogue70171.ch: 数日后，后羿成功锻造出了神器射日弓与白矢。他爬上了一座高耸的山峰。
drama_dialogue70171.en: Several days later, Hou Yi forges the magic bow Sun Shooter, a quiver of white fletched arrows, and climbs a nearby mountain.

drama_dialogue70172.ch: 他将力量汇聚于箭矢中搭在弓上，然后拉开长弓，毫不犹豫的朝着<r>三足乌</r>射去。
drama_dialogue70172.en: Focusing all his energy on the arrows, he knocks, draws, and starts releasing in the direction of the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>.

drama_dialogue70173.ch: 后羿箭无虚发，被射中的<r>三足乌</r>纷纷坠落在地面上。
drama_dialogue70173.en: Hou Yi's arrows fly unerringly towards the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>, which fall to the ground, one by one.

drama_dialogue70181.ch: 想不到使用这射日弓竟如此消耗灵力…总算是不辱使命。
drama_dialogue70181.en: Using that bow is so exhausting... At last the mission is complete.

drama_dialogue70182.ch: 我的力量还不足以将它们杀绝…之后，便由你出手驱逐它们吧。
drama_dialogue70182.en: I don't have the power to kill them all... It's up to you to chase them off.

drama_dialogue70184.ch: 你切记，万不可赶尽杀绝…这个世界还需要它们的存在。
drama_dialogue70184.en: Remember, you can't kill them all... If you do, they'll cease the exist in this world.

drama_dialogue70185.ch: 它们就躲在不远处，劳烦你跑一趟，让它们离开此地吧。
drama_dialogue70185.en: Their hideout's not far from here. Would you mind going there and chasing them off?

drama_dialogue70186.en: Uh... I'll leave the rest to you...

drama_dialogue70187.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70187.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70188.ch: 呃…以凡人之躯，想要御使神器果然过于勉强…
drama_dialogue70188.en: (Cough)... Sure enough, the artifact places too much strain on the mortal body...

drama_dialogue70189.ch: 我已油尽灯枯，接下来便只能交给你了…
drama_dialogue70189.en: I am spent. The next part is up to you...

drama_dialogue70190.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70190.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70201.ch: 你们怎能如此残忍…我的兄弟姐妹们…
drama_dialogue70201.en: How could you be so cruel...? My brothers and sisters...

drama_dialogue70202.ch: 你们为祸一方，残害无数生灵…其罪当诛！
drama_dialogue70202.en: You are a plague upon the earth! You killed countless creatures... and should be punished!

drama_dialogue70203.ch: 是你们害死了它们，我要为它们报仇！
drama_dialogue70203.en: You destroyed them! I shall avenge them!

drama_dialogue70212.ch: 凭你一人之力，还不足以与我为敌。
drama_dialogue70212.en: You're no match for me on your own.

drama_dialogue70213.ch: 回到属于你的地方吧！不要再来这里了…
drama_dialogue70213.en: Go back to your own place... and don't come back here!

drama_dialogue70215.en: The <r>Three-legged Crow</r> flies away without looking back.

drama_dialogue70216.ch: 不久后，八荒世界流传着这样一个传说。天空中曾经有十个太阳，灼热的高温使大地焦荒，生灵涂炭。
drama_dialogue70216.en: Not long after, a new legend began to circulate in the land. The story told of ten suns, which burned so hot they scorched the earth and left death in their wake.

drama_dialogue70217.ch: 这时，有一个名叫后羿的人，决心要将天空中的九个太阳全部射落。他不畏艰险，拿着红色的弓，登上了一座高耸入云的山峰，搭上白色的箭矢，一支一支的朝着太阳射去，太阳便被射去了九个。
drama_dialogue70217.en: At that time a hero named Hou Yi stepped forth, determined to shoot nine of the suns from the sky. Fearlessly, he took up his red bow and climbed to the top of a great mountain. He launched his white fletched arrows, one after another, into the suns, knocking nine from the sky.

drama_dialogue70218.ch: 从此之后，大地上气候适宜，万物得以生长。后羿的传说被世人一代又一代的流传着…
drama_dialogue70218.en: The climate stabilized and life flourished. The legend of Hou Yi was passed down from generation to generation...

drama_dialogue70231.ch: 既然如此，我便只能强取了！
drama_dialogue70231.en: In that case I will have to take it by force!

drama_dialogue70232.ch: 大胆凡人！我绝不会让你伤害神树！
drama_dialogue70232.en: Brazen mortal! I will never let you hurt the Divine Tree!

drama_dialogue70241.ch: （此人实力高深，我不是她的对手…）
drama_dialogue70241.en: (She is formidable! I'm no match for her...)

drama_dialogue70242.ch: 我不取你性命，速速离去吧！十万大山中危机四伏，你好自为之。
drama_dialogue70242.en: I won't kill you. Get out of here! The Hundred Thousand Hills are dangerous! Look after for yourself.

drama_dialogue70243.ch: 你如此锲而不舍的想要取得树枝，究竟所为何事？
drama_dialogue70243.en: You seem very determined to get that branch. Why are you here?

drama_dialogue70244.ch: 又是你！上次饶了你一回，还是这么不长记性…讨打！
drama_dialogue70244.en: You again! I spared you last time. Back for some more, huh?!

drama_dialogue70251.ch: 扶桑的树枝我便取走了。我确实是有要紧事，若有得罪之处，还请海涵。
drama_dialogue70251.en: I'll be taking the Mulberry branch now. I'm on an important mission. Apologies for any inconvenience.

drama_dialogue70253.ch: 不好！<g>扶桑树枝</g>的灵力正在不断的流逝…我必须抓紧时间！
drama_dialogue70253.en: No! The <g>Mulberry Branch</g> is losing energy... I can't wait!

drama_dialogue70261.ch: 你回来了？此行收获如何？我已得知<r>人面鸮王</r>的下落了。
drama_dialogue70261.en: You're back! How did it go? I already heard about the <r>Harpy Lord</r>.

drama_dialogue70262.ch: 我已取得了<g>扶桑树枝</g>，可树枝中的灵力正在不断的流逝。
drama_dialogue70262.en: I got the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>, but it's losing energy...

drama_dialogue70263.ch: 怎会如此…那我这便开始着手锻造射日弓，劳烦你跑一趟去将<r>人面鸮王</r>的<g>金羽</g>取来吧。
drama_dialogue70263.en: What's going on...? In that case I will start working on the bow immediately. Please go and get the <r>Harpy Lord</r>'s <g>Golden Feather</g> at once.

drama_dialogue70264.ch: 不远处有一处山谷，谷中有一个巨大的洞穴，<r>人面鸮王</r>便栖息在这个洞穴中。
drama_dialogue70264.en: Not far from here there is a Valley containing a large cave where the <r>Harpy Lord</r> resides.

drama_dialogue70265.en: Okay. I'll go and take a look.

drama_dialogue70266.en: You have the <g>Golden Feather</g> now. Better go back.

drama_dialogue70267.ch: 不远处有一处山谷，谷中有一个巨大的洞穴，<r>人面鸮王</r>便栖息在这个洞穴中。
drama_dialogue70267.en: Not far from here there is a Valley containing a large cave where the <r>Harpy Lord</r> resides.

drama_dialogue70272.ch: 好，我这就去锻造箭矢。接下来就交给我吧。
drama_dialogue70272.en: Thank you. I'll go make the arrows. I can take it from here.

drama_dialogue70273.ch: 数日后，后羿成功锻造出了神器射日弓与白矢。他爬上了一座高耸的山峰。
drama_dialogue70273.en: Several days later, Hou Yi forges the magic bow Sun Shooter, a quiver of white fletched arrows, and climbs a nearby mountain.

drama_dialogue70274.ch: 他将力量汇聚于箭矢中搭在弓上，然后拉开长弓，毫不犹豫的朝着<r>三足乌</r>射去。
drama_dialogue70274.en: Focusing all his energy on the arrows, he knocks, draws, and starts releasing in the direction of the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>.

drama_dialogue70275.ch: 后羿箭无虚发，被射中的<r>三足乌</r>纷纷坠落在地面上。
drama_dialogue70275.en: Hou Yi's arrows fly unerringly towards the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>, which fall to the ground, one by one.

drama_dialogue70281.ch: 想不到使用这射日弓竟如此消耗灵力…总算是不辱使命。
drama_dialogue70281.en: Using that bow is so exhausting... At last the mission is complete.

drama_dialogue70282.ch: 我的力量还不足以将它们杀绝…之后，便由你出手驱逐它们吧。
drama_dialogue70282.en: I don't have the power to kill them all... It's up to you to chase them off.

drama_dialogue70284.ch: 你切记，万不可赶尽杀绝…这个世界还需要它们的存在。
drama_dialogue70284.en: Remember, you can't kill them all... If you do, they'll cease the exist in this world.

drama_dialogue70285.ch: 它们就躲在不远处，劳烦你跑一趟，让它们离开此地吧。
drama_dialogue70285.en: Their hideout's not far from here. Would you mind going there and chasing them off?

drama_dialogue70286.en: Uh... I'll leave the rest to you...

drama_dialogue70287.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70287.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70288.ch: 呃…以凡人之躯，想要御使神器果然过于勉强…
drama_dialogue70288.en: (Cough)... Sure enough, the artifact places too much strain on the mortal body...

drama_dialogue70289.ch: 我已油尽灯枯，接下来便只能交给你了…
drama_dialogue70289.en: I am spent. The next part is up to you...

drama_dialogue70290.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70290.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70291.ch: 你们怎能如此残忍…我的兄弟姐妹们…
drama_dialogue70291.en: How could you be so cruel...? My brothers and sisters...

drama_dialogue70292.ch: 你们为祸一方，残害无数生灵…其罪当诛！
drama_dialogue70292.en: You are a plague upon the earth! You killed countless creatures... and should be punished!

drama_dialogue70293.ch: 是你们害死了它们，我要为它们报仇！
drama_dialogue70293.en: You destroyed them! I shall avenge them!

drama_dialogue70302.ch: 凭你一人之力，还不足以与我为敌。
drama_dialogue70302.en: You're no match for me on your own.

drama_dialogue70303.ch: 回到属于你的地方吧！不要再来这里了…
drama_dialogue70303.en: Go back to your own place... and don't come back here!

drama_dialogue70305.en: The <r>Three-legged Crow</r> flies away without looking back.

drama_dialogue70306.ch: 不久后，八荒世界流传着这样一个传说。天空中曾经有十个太阳，灼热的高温使大地焦荒，生灵涂炭。
drama_dialogue70306.en: Not long after, a new legend began to circulate in the land. The story told of ten suns, which burned so hot they scorched the earth and left death in their wake.

drama_dialogue70307.ch: 这时，有一个名叫后羿的人，决心要将天空中的九个太阳全部射落。他不畏艰险，拿着红色的弓，登上了一座高耸入云的山峰，搭上白色的箭矢，一支一支的朝着太阳射去，太阳便被射去了九个。
drama_dialogue70307.en: At that time a hero named Hou Yi stepped forth, determined to shoot nine of the suns from the sky. Fearlessly, he took up his red bow and climbed to the top of a great mountain. He launched his white fletched arrows, one after another, into the suns, knocking nine from the sky.

drama_dialogue70308.ch: 从此之后，大地上气候适宜，万物得以生长。后羿的传说被世人一代又一代的流传着…
drama_dialogue70308.en: The climate stabilized and life flourished. The legend of Hou Yi was passed down from generation to generation...

drama_dialogue70401.ch: （周围突然变得异常炎热，是何物在作祟…）
drama_dialogue70401.en: (It's become intensely hot all of a sudden. Could it be a trap...?)

drama_dialogue70402.ch: 不远处突然涌现一道黑影，此时正朝你快速奔来。
drama_dialogue70402.en: Suddenly a shadowy figure appears and comes rushing towards you.

drama_dialogue70405.ch: 有人想要射杀我和我的兄弟姐妹们！如今我落单，只怕是在劫难逃！
drama_dialogue70405.en: Someone is shooting arrows at me and my brothers and sisters! I'm all alone and have nowhere to turn!

drama_dialogue70407.ch: 那是何人？他为何要杀你们？
drama_dialogue70407.en: Who is he? Why does he want to kill you?

drama_dialogue70408.ch: 我也不知…我们兄弟姐妹在家中实在无聊，便一同前往外面的世界游玩…不料却遭人无故追杀。
drama_dialogue70408.en: I don't know... My brothers and sisters were feeling bored at home and decided to go travelling... We didn't expect to be attacked!

drama_dialogue70410.en: You go. Leave him to me.

drama_dialogue70411.ch: 好，那便有劳阁下…我必须要走了！
drama_dialogue70411.en: If you don't mind then... I'll be going!

drama_dialogue70412.ch: （那人敢在光天化日之下公然行凶，绝不是等闲之辈！）
drama_dialogue70412.en: (Brazenly attacking people in broad daylight. This is no ordinary opponent!)

drama_dialogue70413.ch: 这位道友，可曾有一位身着黑衣的女子途经此处？
drama_dialogue70413.en: Cultivator! Has a girl clad in black come through this way?

drama_dialogue70414.en: Why are you looking for her?

drama_dialogue70415.en: Because... I have to kill her!

drama_dialogue70416.ch: 我岂会让你得逞！让我来会会你！
drama_dialogue70416.en: You will not have your way! I'll show you!

drama_dialogue70418.ch: （她方才走得匆忙，似乎遗落了什么东西…）
drama_dialogue70418.en: (She is hurrying, as if she has lost something...)

drama_dialogue70422.ch: 你所见的黑衣女子，乃是<r>三足乌</r>所变。
drama_dialogue70422.en: The girl in black is a <r>Three-legged Crow</r>.

drama_dialogue70424.ch: 先停手，且听我细细道来。
drama_dialogue70424.en: Put down your weapon and listen to me!

drama_dialogue70432.ch: 你所见的黑衣女子，乃是<r>三足乌</r>所变。
drama_dialogue70432.en: The girl in black is a <r>Three-legged Crow</r>.

drama_dialogue70434.ch: 先停手，且听我细细道来。
drama_dialogue70434.en: Put down your weapon and listen to me!

drama_dialogue70441.ch: 不久前，八荒世界中突然出现了一群<r>三足乌</r>！这些怪物身上散发着恐怖的热量，它们的出现使得附近的草木枯死、河流干涸。所到之处，皆是生灵涂炭！
drama_dialogue70441.en: Not long ago, a murder of monstrous <r>Three-legged Crows</r> appeared in the world! They emit a terrible heat which causes the grass to die and the rivers to dry up. Wherever they go, death follows.

drama_dialogue70442.ch: 我立誓要铲除它们！可它们实力强大，联手起来我根本无法应对…
drama_dialogue70442.en: I have vowed to eradicate them! But they are powerful, and I don't stand a chance against them when they fight together...

drama_dialogue70443.ch: 前些时日，有其中一只不知何故落了单，我发现后便星夜追杀！却还是被它逃脱了…
drama_dialogue70443.en: A few days ago one of them fell to earth and I have been hunting her ever since! But still, she keeps evading me...

drama_dialogue70444.ch: 这么说来，是被我所耽误了…

drama_dialogue70445.ch: 天意如此，道友不必介怀。

drama_dialogue70446.ch: 那群<r>三足乌</r>现在何处？让我去教训它们一番！
drama_dialogue70446.en: Where have those <r>Three-legged Crows</r> run off to? I'm going to tell them a lesson!

drama_dialogue70447.ch: 它们就栖息在不远处…<r>三足乌</r>实力强大，以少敌多是不明智的选择。
drama_dialogue70447.en: They must be roosting not far from here... <r>Three-legged Crows</r> are powerful. There's safety in numbers.

drama_dialogue70451.ch: <r>三足乌</r>实力强大，以少敌多是不明智的选择。
drama_dialogue70451.en: <r>Three-legged Crows</r> are powerful. There's safety in numbers.

drama_dialogue70461.ch: 人类，这里是我们的地盘！还不快速速退去！
drama_dialogue70461.en: This is our place, human! Leave now!

drama_dialogue70463.ch: 好大的胆子！我看你是活得不耐烦了！！！
drama_dialogue70463.en: Tough guy, huh? You must have a death wish!

drama_dialogue70472.ch: 惹怒了我，今日你必将付出代价。
drama_dialogue70472.en: Piss me off and pay the price!

drama_dialogue70473.en: What are you staring at? Get over here!

drama_dialogue70474.ch: 先离开此地，讨伐<r>三足乌</r>还得从长计议。
drama_dialogue70474.en: We should go. Taking down these <r>Three-legged Crows</r> is going to take more than one day.

drama_dialogue70482.ch: 惹怒了我，今日你必将付出代价。
drama_dialogue70482.en: Piss me off and pay the price!

drama_dialogue70483.en: What are you staring at? Get over here!

drama_dialogue70484.ch: 先离开此地，讨伐<r>三足乌</r>还得从长计议。
drama_dialogue70484.en: We should go. Taking down these <r>Three-legged Crows</r> is going to take more than one day.

drama_dialogue70491.ch: 道友，我们的实力与<r>三足乌</r>差距悬殊，若是正面交战，想要取胜绝非易事。
drama_dialogue70491.en: Cultivator, we are no match for these <r>Three-legged Crows</r>. If we confront them directly, we are certain to lose.

drama_dialogue70492.ch: 那依你之见，该如何是好？

drama_dialogue70493.ch: 实不相瞒，我过去云游天下，曾有幸得到一件神器的铸造之法。
drama_dialogue70493.en: On my travels I discovered a method of forging artifacts.

drama_dialogue70494.ch: 若能成功锻造，我便有把握能够射杀<r>三足乌</r>！
drama_dialogue70494.en: If it works, I'll be able to kill those <r>Three-legged Crows</r>!

drama_dialogue70495.ch: 那你为何不从一开始便锻造神器呢？
drama_dialogue70495.en: Why didn't you make one in the first place?

drama_dialogue70496.ch: 你有所不知…既是神器，锻造所需的自然不是凡物。
drama_dialogue70496.en: You don't know... Being an artifact, the components required are not common.

drama_dialogue70497.ch: 多年来，我已成功收集了十之八九，只是尚缺<g>扶桑树枝</g>与<r>人面鸮王</r>的<g>金羽</g>。
drama_dialogue70497.en: Over the years I've collected most of the components. I'm just missing a <g>Mulberry Branch</g> and the <g>Golden Feather</g> of a <r>Harpy Lord</r>.

drama_dialogue70498.ch: 扶桑树乃是传说中的神树，位于八荒世界的东海附近，想要寻到十分不易。
drama_dialogue70498.en: The Mulberry referred to is a legendary Divine Tree thought to grow near the East Sea. Apparently it is very hard to find.

drama_dialogue70499.ch: 还有一位实力高深莫测的守护者常年保护着神树。我曾经去过东海，却连神树的模样都没有见到，便被守护者给驱逐了。
drama_dialogue70499.en: The tree is watched by a Guardian of unfathomable power. I visited the East Sea once, but was chased off by the Guardian before I could get a look at the tree.

drama_dialogue70500.ch: 至于那人面鸮王，更是传说中的存在。我只曾听闻它出没在一处隐蔽的山谷中，却从未寻到它的踪迹。
drama_dialogue70500.en: As for the Harpy Lord. I think it must be a creature of legend! Someone told me it haunts a secluded Valley, but I never found any trace of it.

drama_dialogue70501.ch: 我先去寻找人面鸮王，再到东海去看看，扶桑树枝和金羽便交给我吧。
drama_dialogue70501.en: I'll go and look for the Harpy Lord first, then go to the East Sea. I'll get the Mulberry Branch and Golden Feather for you.

drama_dialogue70502.ch:
如此甚好！但此去东海路途凶险，若是没有

结晶境

的实力，恐怕会有性命之忧…还请量力而行。在此期间，我会尽量阻挡三足乌危害八荒。期待你的好消息。
drama_dialogue70502.en:
Excellent! I fear the road to the East Sea is very dangerous. If you can't do

Qi Condensation

I fear your life will be in danger... Know your own limits. I'll stay here and try to keep a lid on those Three-legged Crows. Good luck.

drama_dialogue70511.ch: （<r>三足乌</r>实力强大，我还是不要贸然接近为好。）
drama_dialogue70511.en: (<r>Three-legged Crow</r> are powerful. Better not get too close.)

drama_dialogue70521.ch: 山谷中阴风四起，空气中弥漫着一股危险的气息…
drama_dialogue70521.en: Dark winds fill the valley. A malevolent presence fills the air...

drama_dialogue70522.ch: （这一定就是人面鸮之王了，我必须击败它。）
drama_dialogue70522.en: (This is definitely the King of Harpies! I've got to defeat it.)

drama_dialogue70523.ch: （不愧是传说中的异兽，真不容易…）
drama_dialogue70523.en: (Wow, it's a tough one. It truly is a beast of legend...)

drama_dialogue70524.ch:
（接下来便只差扶桑树枝了。在去东海之前，我最好先将修为提升至

结晶境

。）
drama_dialogue70524.en:
(All I need now is the Mulberry Branch. Before I go to the East Sea, I'd better upgrade to

Qi Condensation

.)

drama_dialogue70525.ch: （接下来便只差扶桑树枝了，这便开始前往东海吧！）
drama_dialogue70525.en: (All I need now is the Mulberry Branch. I'd better set off for the East Sea then!)

drama_dialogue70526.ch:
（这个山谷诡异得很…待我拥有了

筑基境

的实力再来探索吧。）
drama_dialogue70526.en:
(This Valley is very strange... I should return once I have achieved

Foundation

.)

drama_dialogue70527.ch:
（如今我已经有

筑基境

的实力了，这就出发去寻找人面鸮王吧。）
drama_dialogue70527.en:
(I've achieved

Foundation

. Time to set out and find the Harpy Lord.)

drama_dialogue70528.ch:
（如今我已经有

结晶境

的实力了，这就出发去东海寻找扶桑吧。）
drama_dialogue70528.en:
(I've achieved

Qi Condensation

. Time to set out for the East Sea and find that Mulberry tree.)

drama_dialogue70533.ch: 正是！你鬼鬼祟祟的在神树附近，究竟想做什么？
drama_dialogue70533.en: Yes. What are you doing, skulking around in the shadows?

drama_dialogue70534.ch: 我有要事，必须要取得扶桑的一截树枝。
drama_dialogue70534.en: I'm on an important mission. I need a branch from the tree.

drama_dialogue70535.ch: 我奉命在此守护扶桑，便是以防你这样的人对扶桑心怀不轨。有我在，你休想得逞！
drama_dialogue70535.en: I am Guardian of the tree! It is my job to keep riffraff like you away! You will never get what you want!

drama_dialogue70541.ch: 我确实是有要紧的事…眼下八荒世界正遭到<r>三足乌</r>的迫害，我等凡人并非它们的对手。还请通融一下。
drama_dialogue70541.en: It's urgent... <r>Three-legged Crows</r> are terrorizing the land. We mortals are no match for them. Please try to see it from our point of view.

drama_dialogue70543.ch: 可即便如此，我也无法将扶桑的枝干交给你。
drama_dialogue70543.en: Even if it's true, I cannot let you have the Mulberry Branch.

drama_dialogue70544.ch: 扶桑近年来接连收到冥山气息的侵蚀，生命力大大受损。若是强行取下一截树枝，扶桑不久后便会死去。
drama_dialogue70544.en: Every year the Divine Tree is weakened by the Nether Mountains. It is very unwell. If I let you take the branch, the shock could very well kill it.

drama_dialogue70545.ch: 不知可还有能够拯救扶桑的方式？
drama_dialogue70545.en: Perhaps there is another way we can save the tree?

drama_dialogue70547.ch: 南方有一处昆仑仙池，你若是能取得一些池中的神水，我便将扶桑树枝交给于你。
drama_dialogue70547.en: Kunlun Pond lies to the south. If you can bring me some Divine Water from there, I will give you the Mulberry Branch.

drama_dialogue70548.en: Okay! I'll go there right away!

drama_dialogue70549.ch: 且慢，昆仑仙池有开明兽坐镇，它是绝对不会让你轻易取走神水的。你此去得多加小心。
drama_dialogue70549.en: Wait. Kunlun Pond is guarded by the Lydra. He won't let you get the Divine Water without a fight. You will need to be careful.

drama_dialogue70551.ch: 昆仑仙池有开明兽坐镇，它是绝对不会让你轻易取走神水的。你此去得多加小心。
drama_dialogue70551.en: Kunlun Pond is guarded by the Lydra. He won't let you get the Divine Water without a fight. You will need to be careful.

drama_dialogue70561.ch: （从这里都能感受到磅礴的灵力，昆仑仙池应该就在前方。）
drama_dialogue70561.en: (You can sense the intense energy field from here. Kunlun Pond must be up ahead.)

drama_dialogue70562.ch: 何人擅闯圣地？！给我站住！
drama_dialogue70562.en: Who defiles this sacred ground?! Stop right there!

drama_dialogue70563.ch: （这就是<r>开明兽</r>…看起来不好对付，我得小心。）
drama_dialogue70563.en: (So this is <r>Lydra</r>... He looks mean. I'd better be careful.)

drama_dialogue70564.ch: 我有要事，欲求昆仑仙池中的一缕神水，还请通融一下。
drama_dialogue70564.en: I am on urgent business. I need Divine Water from Kunlun Pond. Please be understanding.

drama_dialogue70565.ch: 放肆！仙池岂容尔等凡人玷污！纳命来！
drama_dialogue70565.en: Absurd! The Divine Water will never touch the lips of mortal! Prepare to die!

drama_dialogue70571.ch: 既已取得神水，这便回去找扶桑吧。
drama_dialogue70571.en: Since you got the Divine Water, you might as well go back and find the Mulberry.

drama_dialogue70581.ch: 是你？此去昆仑仙池可有收获？
drama_dialogue70581.en: You're back! Did you get the water from the Kunlun Pond?

drama_dialogue70582.ch: 我已将<g>神水</g>带回来了，如此便能保扶桑无恙了吧！
drama_dialogue70582.en: Yes, I got the <g>Divine Water</g>. Now we can make sure the Divine Tree doesn't come to any harm!

drama_dialogue70584.ch: 你且稍后，我这便去取<g>扶桑树枝</g>。
drama_dialogue70584.en: You wait. I'll get the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>.

drama_dialogue70585.ch: 这便是<g>扶桑树枝</g>了。扶桑吸取天地之力，存世已有数万年之久，若是将其炼制为法宝，其威能可弑神。但愿你能将它用于正途…
drama_dialogue70585.en: Here is the <g>Mulberry Branch</g>. The tree has been absorbing energy for many millennia. Any artifact made from it is bound to be powerful indeed. I hope you make good use of it.

drama_dialogue70586.ch: 突然间，扶桑树的生机正在流逝，茂盛的枝叶已枯死了大半。
drama_dialogue70586.en: Suddenly the life force leaves the Divine Mulberry. Half its canopy dies on the twig.

drama_dialogue70588.ch: 这是怎么了？我已取来了<g>神水</g>，却为何…
drama_dialogue70588.en: What on earth? I got the <g>Divine Water</g>, so why would...?

drama_dialogue70589.ch: …扶桑遭受冥气的侵蚀已有百年之久，已经没有任何办法能够挽救神树了。
drama_dialogue70589.en: ... The Divine Tree has been subjected to the corrosive effects of dark energy for hundreds of years. Nothing can save it now.

drama_dialogue70591.ch: 我已用<g>神水</g>护住这截枝干，可暂保其生机不会流逝。
drama_dialogue70591.en: I used the <g>Divine Water</g> to preserve the branch. It won't die.

drama_dialogue70592.ch: 你明明知晓取下树枝会有什么后果，却为何还要将它交给我？
drama_dialogue70592.en: If you knew what would happen, why did you give me the branch?

drama_dialogue70593.ch: 扶桑走向毁灭只是时间问题，不是今日，便是明日。
drama_dialogue70593.en: It was only a matter of time before the Divine Tree died. If not today, then maybe tomorrow.

drama_dialogue70594.ch: …可是你违抗了你的使命，必然会遭天道反噬。
drama_dialogue70594.en: ... But if you fail in your mission, the Heavenly Path will be affronted.

drama_dialogue70595.ch: 我既然决定要将它交给你，又何惧天罚？
drama_dialogue70595.en: So I decided to give it to you. What fear does Heaven hold for me?

drama_dialogue70596.ch: 你应该还有更重要的事，快离开这里吧。
drama_dialogue70596.en: You have other business to attend to. You should leave!

drama_dialogue70601.ch: 既然如此，我便只能强取了！
drama_dialogue70601.en: In that case I will have to take it by force!

drama_dialogue70602.ch: 大胆凡人！我绝不会让你伤害神树！
drama_dialogue70602.en: Brazen mortal! I will never let you hurt the Divine Tree!

drama_dialogue70611.ch: （此人实力高深，我不是她的对手…）
drama_dialogue70611.en: (She is formidable! I'm no match for her...)

drama_dialogue70612.ch: 我不取你性命，速速离去吧！东海附近危机四伏，你好自为之。
drama_dialogue70612.en: I won't kill you. Get out of here! The road to the East Sea is dangerous! Look after for yourself.

drama_dialogue70621.ch: 又是你！上次饶了你一回，还是这么不长记性…讨打！
drama_dialogue70621.en: You again! I spared you last time. Back for some more, huh?!

drama_dialogue70623.ch: 你如此锲而不舍的想要取得树枝，究竟所为何事？
drama_dialogue70623.en: You seem very determined to get that branch. Why are you here?

drama_dialogue70624.ch: <g>扶桑树枝</g>我便取走了。我确实是有要紧事，若有得罪之处，还请海涵。
drama_dialogue70624.en: I'll be taking the <g>Mulberry Branch</g> now. I'm on an important mission. Apologies for any inconvenience.

drama_dialogue70631.ch: 不好！<g>扶桑树枝</g>的灵力正在不断的流逝…我必须抓紧时间！
drama_dialogue70631.en: No! The <g>Mulberry Branch</g> is losing energy... I can't wait!

drama_dialogue70641.ch: 你回来了？此行收获如何？
drama_dialogue70641.en: You're back! How did it go?

drama_dialogue70642.ch: <r>人面鸮王</r>的<g>金羽</g>和<g>扶桑树枝</g>我均已取得。
drama_dialogue70642.en: The <r>Harpy Lord</r>'s <g>Golden Feather</g> and <g>Mulberry Branch</g> are both in my possession.

drama_dialogue70643.ch: 这<r>三足乌</r>凶猛得很，我一人难以招架…已有许多人受难了。
drama_dialogue70643.en: The <r>Three-legged Crow</r> is ferocious! I can barely keep up... So many have already come to grief.

drama_dialogue70644.ch: 你且将<g>扶桑树枝</g>与<g>金羽</g>给我，我这就去锻造神箭。接下来就交给我吧。
drama_dialogue70644.en: Give me the <g>Mulberry Branch</g> and the <g>Golden Feather</g> so I can make the artifact. I can take it from here.

drama_dialogue70651.ch: 数日后，后羿成功锻造出了神器射日弓与白矢。他爬上了一座高耸的山峰。
drama_dialogue70651.en: Several days later, Hou Yi forges the magic bow Sun Shooter, a quiver of white fletched arrows, and climbs a nearby mountain.

drama_dialogue70652.ch: 他将力量汇聚于箭矢中搭在弓上，然后拉开长弓，毫不犹豫的朝着<r>三足乌</r>射去。
drama_dialogue70652.en: Focusing all his energy on the arrows, he knocks, draws, and starts releasing in the direction of the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>.

drama_dialogue70653.ch: 后羿箭无虚发，被射中的<r>三足乌</r>纷纷坠落在地面上。
drama_dialogue70653.en: Hou Yi's arrows fly unerringly towards the <r>Three-legged Crows</r>, which fall to the ground, one by one.

drama_dialogue70661.ch: 想不到使用这射日弓竟如此消耗灵力…总算是不辱使命。
drama_dialogue70661.en: Using that bow is so exhausting... At last the mission is complete.

drama_dialogue70662.ch: 我的力量还不足以将它们杀绝…之后，便由你出手驱逐它们吧。
drama_dialogue70662.en: I don't have the power to kill them all... It's up to you to chase them off.

drama_dialogue70664.ch: 你切记，万不可赶尽杀绝…这个世界还需要它们的存在。
drama_dialogue70664.en: Remember, you can't kill them all... If you do, they'll cease the exist in this world.

drama_dialogue70665.ch: 它们就躲在不远处，劳烦你跑一趟，让它们离开此地吧。
drama_dialogue70665.en: Their hideout's not far from here. Would you mind going there and chasing them off?

drama_dialogue70671.en: Uh... I'll leave the rest to you...

drama_dialogue70672.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70672.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70673.ch: 呃…以凡人之躯，想要御使神器果然过于勉强…
drama_dialogue70673.en: (Cough)... Sure enough, the artifact places too much strain on the mortal body...

drama_dialogue70674.ch: 我已油尽灯枯，接下来便只能交给你了…
drama_dialogue70674.en: I am spent. The next part is up to you...

drama_dialogue70675.ch: 后羿说完，身体便化作灵力消散在天地间…
drama_dialogue70675.en: As Hou Yi finishes speaking, his body turns into energy and disperses into the ether...

drama_dialogue70681.ch: 你们怎能如此残忍…我的兄弟姐妹们…
drama_dialogue70681.en: How could you be so cruel...? My brothers and sisters...

drama_dialogue70682.ch: 你们为祸一方，残害无数生灵…其罪当诛！
drama_dialogue70682.en: You are a plague upon the earth! You killed countless creatures... and should be punished!

drama_dialogue70683.ch: 是你们害死了它们，我要为它们报仇！
drama_dialogue70683.en: You destroyed them! I shall avenge them!

drama_dialogue70692.ch: 凭你一人之力，还不足以与我为敌。
drama_dialogue70692.en: You're no match for me on your own.

drama_dialogue70693.ch: 回到属于你的地方吧！不要再来这里了…
drama_dialogue70693.en: Go back to your own place... and don't come back here!

drama_dialogue70695.en: The <r>Three-legged Crow</r> flies away without looking back.

drama_dialogue70701.ch: 不久后，八荒世界流传着这样一个传说。天空中曾经有十个太阳，灼热的高温使大地焦荒，生灵涂炭。
drama_dialogue70701.en: Not long after, a new legend began to circulate in the land. The story told of ten suns, which burned so hot they scorched the earth and left death in their wake.

drama_dialogue70702.ch: 这时，有一个名叫后羿的人，决心要将天空中的九个太阳全部射落。他不畏艰险，拿着红色的弓，登上了一座高耸入云的山峰，搭上白色的箭矢，一支一支的朝着太阳射去，太阳便被射去了九个。
drama_dialogue70702.en: At that time a hero named Hou Yi stepped forth, determined to shoot nine of the suns from the sky. Fearlessly, he took up his red bow and climbed to the top of a great mountain. He launched his white fletched arrows, one after another, into the suns, knocking nine from the sky.

drama_dialogue70703.ch: 从此之后，大地上气候适宜，万物得以生长。后羿的传说被世人一代又一代的流传着…
drama_dialogue70703.en: The climate stabilized and life flourished. The legend of Hou Yi was passed down from generation to generation...

drama_dialogue710001.ch: 你在山岳之中寻到了一处极为隐蔽的洞窟…
drama_dialogue710001.en: In the mountains you come across a secluded cavern...

drama_dialogue710002.ch: 你在山岳之中寻到了一处极为隐蔽的洞窟…
drama_dialogue710002.en: In the mountains you come across a secluded cavern...

drama_dialogue71001.ch: 每隔数十年，东海的妖兽便会暴走一次，久居华封州之人都已习惯了…
drama_dialogue71001.en: Every ten years the monsters of East Sea go on a rampage. Long term residents of Hua Feng are used to it...

drama_dialogue710011.ch: 你在山岳之中寻到了一处极为隐蔽的洞窟…
drama_dialogue710011.en: In the mountains you come across a secluded cavern...

drama_dialogue710012.ch: 你在山岳之中寻到了一处极为隐蔽的洞窟…
drama_dialogue710012.en: In the mountains you come across a secluded cavern...

drama_dialogue71002.ch: 只是近年来，这动静似乎要比先前大了不少…即便相隔数百里，也能够听见海中妖兽的咆哮声！
drama_dialogue71002.en: But the situation seems to be getting worse... The roaring of sea monsters can be heard from hundreds of leagues away!

drama_dialogue71003.ch: 说起来，上回我途径海岸时，似乎在海边的巨石上方看到一个模糊的身影…
drama_dialogue71003.en: Speaking of which, last time I passed along the coast, I saw a mysterious figure on a rock...

drama_dialogue71011.ch: 最近啊…这东海中的何罗鱼脾气是越来越大了！
drama_dialogue71011.en: Ack... That Leviathan is getting worse and worse!

drama_dialogue71012.ch: 好在它无法离开海域，否则整个华封州的修仙者恐怕都不是它的对手！
drama_dialogue71012.en: Lucky it can't leave the ocean. If it could, I'm not sure all the Cultivators in Hua Feng could stand up to it!

drama_dialogue710121.ch: 前方有一名极度癫狂的修仙者…似乎沉迷于炼丹，从而走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue710121.en: There is a deranged Cultivator up ahead... Total obsession with Alchemy has triggered a severe case of Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue710141.ch: 前方有一名极度癫狂的修仙者…似乎沉迷于炼丹，从而走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue710141.en: There is a deranged Cultivator up ahead... Total obsession with Alchemy has triggered a severe case of Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue710161.ch: 前方有一名极度癫狂的修仙者…似乎沉迷于炼丹，从而走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue710161.en: There is a deranged Cultivator up ahead... Total obsession with Alchemy has triggered a severe case of Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue710181.ch: 前方有一名极度癫狂的修仙者…似乎沉迷于炼丹，从而走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue710181.en: There is a deranged Cultivator up ahead... Total obsession with Alchemy has triggered a severe case of Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue710191.ch: 前方有一名极度癫狂的修仙者…似乎沉迷于炼丹，从而走火入魔了。
drama_dialogue710191.en: There is a deranged Cultivator up ahead... Total obsession with Alchemy has triggered a severe case of Qi Deviation.

drama_dialogue71021.ch: 这位道友，近日来你可曾去过东海？
drama_dialogue71021.en: Hey Cultivator, have you been to the East Sea lately?

drama_dialogue71022.ch: 最近有个传言，有个女孩似乎一直站在海岸边的巨石上…也不知她在做什么，实在是诡异得很！
drama_dialogue71022.en: Rumor has it there is a girl who stands on a rock beside the sea... No one knows what she is doing, but it sure is strange!

drama_dialogue71023.ch: （海中的怪物来势凶猛！且先退回到华封州，寻其它办法渡过这片海域吧！）
drama_dialogue71023.en: (The sea monsters are out of control! Better go back to Hua Feng to figure out another way through this area!)

drama_dialogue71024.ch: （海中的怪物来势凶猛！且先退回到华封州，寻其它办法渡过这片海域吧！）
drama_dialogue71024.en: (The sea monsters are out of control! Better go back to Hua Feng to figure out another way through this area!)

drama_dialogue710251.ch: 一头血气冲天的怪物朝你袭来…
drama_dialogue710251.en: A ravening monster comes rushing towards you...

drama_dialogue710271.ch: 一头血气冲天的怪物朝你袭来…
drama_dialogue710271.en: A ravening monster comes rushing towards you...

drama_dialogue710291.ch: 一头血气冲天的怪物朝你袭来…
drama_dialogue710291.en: A ravening monster comes rushing towards you...

drama_dialogue710292.ch: 一头血气冲天的怪物朝你袭来…
drama_dialogue710292.en: A ravening monster comes rushing towards you...

drama_dialogue710293.ch: 一头血气冲天的怪物朝你袭来…
drama_dialogue710293.en: A ravening monster comes rushing towards you...

drama_dialogue710311.ch: 是否要往祭坛上放入贡品？
drama_dialogue710311.en: Do you want to go to the Altar and place tributes?

drama_dialogue710321.ch: 你献上的药材化作灵力消散在天地间，周围的药香味越来越浓厚…
drama_dialogue710321.en: The herbs you place as an offering transforms into energy which dissipates into the air. The pungent smell of burning aromatics fills the area...

drama_dialogue71033.ch: 在下见姑娘在此驻足已久，不知是有何烦心事？
drama_dialogue71033.en: You have been stopped there for some time. Is there something troubling you?

drama_dialogue710331.ch: 周围的药香味已经完全消散了…
drama_dialogue710331.en: The smell of burning herbs has completely dissipated...

drama_dialogue71034.en: ... I want to fill the sea.

drama_dialogue71036.ch: 你快离开吧…它又要过来了。
drama_dialogue71036.en: You'd better go... It's coming back.

drama_dialogue71042.ch: 那是何罗鱼，东海中的霸主。
drama_dialogue71042.en: The Leviathan, Lord of the East Sea.

drama_dialogue71043.ch: …千年前，这个怪物在进阶后获得了强大的修为，之后又吞噬了海域中大量的妖兽。现在的八荒中，恐怕已无人能与之为敌…
drama_dialogue71043.en: ... A thousand years ago, the Leviathan attained great power and went on a rampage, eating lots of his competitors. Today I fear there is no creature in the world that can match him...

drama_dialogue71044.ch: 那岂不是永远都无法到达云陌州了？
drama_dialogue71044.en: Does that mean Yun Mo is forever out of reach?

drama_dialogue71045.ch: 倒也不是完全没有办法…

drama_dialogue71046.ch: 若是能够得到息壤，我便能将东海夷为平地。
drama_dialogue71046.en: If I can get the Xirang, I'll be able to flatten the East Sea.

drama_dialogue71048.ch: 先前帝禹用于治水的神石。只要用神念与其勾连，催动灵力后便能使周围的土地无限增长。
drama_dialogue71048.en: It's a Divine Stone used by Yu the Great to control flood waters. By focusing and pouring your energy into it, the stone will cause the surrounding land to expand.

drama_dialogue71049.ch: 但是年代过于久远…我曾无数次让鸟儿去帮忙找寻，却一直没有任何发现。
drama_dialogue71049.en: But that was a long time ago... I've sent many bird out to look for it, but none have found it.

drama_dialogue71050.ch: 世界如此之大，这样寻找无异于大海捞针。
drama_dialogue71050.en: The world is so big. It's like looking for a needle in a haystack.

drama_dialogue71051.ch: …并非如此，在十多年前开始，我曾多次察觉到西北方传来了神石的气息。
drama_dialogue71051.en: ... Not so. Over ten years ago I sensed the stone somewhere to the northwest.

drama_dialogue71052.ch: 只是那个地方冥气十分浓郁，若无修为抵抗冥气入体，半个时辰内便会暴毙而亡…
drama_dialogue71052.en: The only thing is, that place is cloaked in dark energy. Anyone not resistant to it will drop down dead...

drama_dialogue71053.ch: 何罗鱼不多时便会再度袭来，你还是早些离开为好…
drama_dialogue71053.en: The Leviathan will be back again soon. You should get out of here...

drama_dialogue71061.ch: 何罗鱼不多时便会再度袭来，你还是早些离开为好…
drama_dialogue71061.en: The Leviathan will be back again soon. You should get out of here...

drama_dialogue71072.ch: （附近有人在呼救，要不要过去看看呢？）
drama_dialogue71072.en: (Someone is calling out. Go and take a look?)

drama_dialogue71073.ch: （似乎有不少的妖兽，要现在进去救人吗？）
drama_dialogue71073.en: (Looks like a lot of monsters. You want to go in and rescue him?)

drama_dialogue71081.ch: （这…只是一些寻常妖兽，看来呼救之人似乎没有修为。）
drama_dialogue71081.en: (They... look like pretty ordinary monsters. The person calling must not have any training.)

drama_dialogue71082.en: (Better deal with the situation at hand...)

drama_dialogue71092.ch: 看你似乎不是修行之人，为何独自在森林晃悠？
drama_dialogue71092.en: You don't look like much of an explorer. What are you doing here in a forest, all by yourself?

drama_dialogue71101.ch: 离这不远，有一个叫做双仪村的村庄，几十年来我和我的家人一直生活在双仪村中，未曾踏出村子半步…
drama_dialogue71101.en: There's a place not far from here called Duality Village. My family is from there, and we've never had any reason to leave it.

drama_dialogue71102.ch: 据说，有一只妖兽在十多年前来到了双仪村中！它不知施展了什么妖法，竟生生将人给困在了双仪村中！
drama_dialogue71102.en: Rumor has it about ten years ago a monster arrived in the village! It possessed some kind of witchcraft that trapped everyone inside the village!

drama_dialogue71103.ch: 能有如此手笔，修为恐怕不弱…它在图谋什么？
drama_dialogue71103.en: Sounds formidable. I wonder what it wants?

drama_dialogue71107.ch: 这位仙长，您本领通天，求求你帮帮双仪村吧！村中的人世世代代都无法离开村子，日子过得犹如笼中之鸟！我们不懂得修行之法，根本没有与妖兽抗衡的力量。
drama_dialogue71107.en: Oh immortal! I beg you, please help Duality Village! The villagers have been trapped for generations, like birds in a cage! We don't know the first thing about cultivation, and cannot face the monster alone!

drama_dialogue71108.ch: 这…可我来此是为了寻找一件重要的东西。
drama_dialogue71108.en: Well... I come this way in search of an important object.

drama_dialogue71109.ch: 这个好办！我们的村长知识渊博，山精水怪、天财地宝无一不晓，您若是想在附近寻找宝物，问他准没错！
drama_dialogue71109.en: That's lucky! The village chief knows a lot about creatures and treasures. If there's a treasure nearby, he will know of it!

drama_dialogue71110.ch: 既然如此，那便去双仪村看看吧。
drama_dialogue71110.en: In that case, let's go and have a look at Duality Village.

drama_dialogue71111.ch: 好嘞！双仪村就离此地不远，我来给您带路！
drama_dialogue71111.en: All right! Duality Village is not far from here. Let me show you the way!

drama_dialogue71121.ch: （这些村民…似乎对我十分警惕。）
drama_dialogue71121.en: (The villagers... seem very wary of me.)

drama_dialogue71122.ch: （且看看能打听到什么消息吧。）
drama_dialogue71122.en: (Let's see if they can tell me anything useful.)

drama_dialogue71131.ch: …你不是双仪村的人吧？不管你来此有何贵干，但我劝你还是早日离开为好。
drama_dialogue71131.en: ... You're not from around here. I don't know what you want, but I suggest you leave here immediately.

drama_dialogue71141.ch: 这位仙长，到我们一个小小的双仪村中可有指教？我们恐怕没有仙长想要的东西…
drama_dialogue71141.en: Perhaps you have come to teach us, Master? I'm afraid Duality Village can have nothing of interest to an immortal such as yourself...

drama_dialogue71151.ch: 打扰了，在下来此乃是为了寻找一种叫做息壤的神石，不知…
drama_dialogue71151.en: Sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for a Divine Stone called the Xirang. I wonder...

drama_dialogue71152.ch: 什么息壤？！没听说过！离我远点！！！
drama_dialogue71152.en: Xirang?! Never heard of it!!! Go away!

drama_dialogue71161.ch: 这位仙长，来到双仪村可是有何指教？
drama_dialogue71161.en: Immortal, have you come to Duality Village to teach us?

drama_dialogue71162.ch: 我来此是为了寻找一种名为息壤的神石，阁下可有耳闻？
drama_dialogue71162.en: I am looking for a Divine Stone called the Xirang. Have you heard of it?

drama_dialogue71163.en: Sorry... I've never heard of it.

drama_dialogue71164.ch: 仙长若是无其它要事，还是早日离开为好…村中的人并不欢迎外来者。
drama_dialogue71164.en: If you have no other business then, Master, I suggest that you leave... The villagers are not fond of outsiders.

drama_dialogue71171.ch: （看样子是没什么有用的消息…先到别处去看看吧。）
drama_dialogue71171.en: (Looks like they don't really know anything useful... Better go and look somewhere else.)

drama_dialogue71174.ch: 听说仙长在寻找一块名为息壤的神石，
drama_dialogue71174.en: Is it true you are looking for a Divine Stone called the Xirang?

drama_dialogue71175.en: It is... Do you know anything about it?

drama_dialogue71176.ch: 嘿嘿嘿，如果我猜的不错，那息壤如今便在妖兽毕方手中！
drama_dialogue71176.en: Hahaha, if I'm not mistaken, the Xirang is in the hands of the Bi Fang!

drama_dialogue71178.ch: 不错！当年，我在外游历时，偶然发现了一处墓穴。
drama_dialogue71178.en: Yes! I came across a tomb during my travels.

drama_dialogue71179.ch: 这个墓穴的主人似乎有些来头，陪葬品十分的奢华！
drama_dialogue71179.en: The tomb must have belonged to someone important—the funerary goods were so lavish!

drama_dialogue71180.ch: 就在此时，毕方突然出现，将我给拽回地面！随后，它祭出了一块石头，口中念念有词…片刻后，周围出现许多数十丈高的土块将墓穴死死封住！
drama_dialogue71180.en: Just at that moment the Bi Fang appeared and dragged me out of the grave. It pulled out a stone, muttered a few words... then giant clods of earth rose up and covered the tomb, sealing it shut!

drama_dialogue71181.ch: 唉…毕方封死了墓穴后，便将我与其他村民逐至村中。自那以后啊，双仪村中的村民便再无一人能够离开村子了。也许是我的行为冒犯到毕方了吧…
drama_dialogue71181.en: (Sigh)... After it sealed the tomb, it chased me and the other villagers back to the village. No one has left the village since that day. Perhaps I offended it somehow...

drama_dialogue71182.ch: 呵呵…事情就是这样，如若我猜得不错，毕方用于封住墓穴的石头便是仙长要找的东西。
drama_dialogue71182.en: So that's what happened. If I'm not mistaken, the stone the Bi Fang used to seal the tomb is the object you seek.

drama_dialogue71183.en: Yeah... Where is the Bi Fang now?

drama_dialogue71184.ch: 这就不是我等凡人能够知晓的了…不过一它一定会在双仪村附近。只是这息壤珍贵得很，它恐怕不会轻易将这宝贝交给仙长。
drama_dialogue71184.en: That is not something we mortals can know... but it's definitely somewhere close to the village. Its Xirang is very precious. I doubt it will surrender it to you readily.

drama_dialogue71185.ch: 仙长若是取得了息壤，可否顺手斩去毕方化了双仪村之劫？
drama_dialogue71185.en: If you get the Xirang, maybe you can help break the Bi Fang's hold on the village?

drama_dialogue71186.ch: 双仪村的村民被囚禁已有数十年之久，我们一直都无法到外面的世界去…不知有多少人因此郁郁而终…
drama_dialogue71186.en: The people of Duality Village have been held here against their will for too long... Who knows how many have died trapped in here?

drama_dialogue71187.ch: 好！若有机会，我定会为民除害！
drama_dialogue71187.en: Fine! I'll try to break the spell if I get a chance.

drama_dialogue71188.ch: 如此，在下便先谢过仙长了！

drama_dialogue71191.ch: 王承？！你怎么这么快就回来了？难道…你被毕方给逮着了？
drama_dialogue71191.en: Wang Cheng?! What are you doing back so soon? The Bi Fang didn't catch you, did he?

drama_dialogue71192.ch: 别担心，我已经找到能与毕方抗衡的高手了！
drama_dialogue71192.en: Relax. I found someone to take care of the Bi Fang!

drama_dialogue71194.ch: 毕方便是那在双仪村下禁制的妖兽的名字。
drama_dialogue71194.en: Bi Fang, the monster that cursed Duality Village.

drama_dialogue71195.ch: 村长可在？我们有事想问他。
drama_dialogue71195.en: Is the village chief here? We want to ask him something.

drama_dialogue71196.ch: 他今天一早便出门去了，这个时候也差不多该回来了。
drama_dialogue71196.en: He went out early this morning. He should be back soon.

drama_dialogue71197.ch: 唉…那也只好先等等了。仙长，这段时间您先在村中逛逛吧。
drama_dialogue71197.en: Oh, I guess we'll have to wait then. Why don't you take a look around the village, Master?

drama_dialogue71199.ch: 呵呵…仙长不必拘束，若是有想要了解的事情便去询问村中的人吧。
drama_dialogue71199.en: Make yourself at home... If you've got any questions, just go ahead and ask a villager.

drama_dialogue71201.ch: 啊…你就是救了王承的仙长吗？！
drama_dialogue71201.en: Ah... You must be the immortal who saved Wang Cheng!

drama_dialogue71202.ch: 仙长，你可一定要替我们打倒毕方啊！你是我们惟一的希望了！
drama_dialogue71202.en: Master! You must defeat the Bi Fang! You're our only hope!

drama_dialogue71211.ch: 仙长，你可千万别听他们瞎说…明明我们双仪村中的人能够存活至今，全是因为毕方的守护。
drama_dialogue71211.en: Master, don't listen to them... The Bi Fang is the only reason the people of Duality Village are still alive.

drama_dialogue71213.ch: 哼…当年，有个不长眼的家伙惊动了阴邪之物，大量的邪气从地上喷涌而出！漫天邪气笼罩了整个天空，当时所有人都吓坏了！
drama_dialogue71213.en: Well... Several years ago a careless kid disturbed some evil spirits, causing evil energy to pour out of the earth. Dark Qi filled the sky and people fled for their lives!

drama_dialogue71214.ch: 此时，若不是毕方赶来镇压那阴邪之物，恐怕双仪村在那一日便已经毁灭了。
drama_dialogue71214.en: If the Bi Fang hadn't intervened, Duality Village would have been wiped off the face of the earth that day.

drama_dialogue71215.ch: 虽然我不知道毕方为何不让我们离开双仪村，但我依然相信毕方。
drama_dialogue71215.en: I don't know why the Bi Fang won't let us leave the village, but I trust it is for a good reason.

drama_dialogue71221.ch: 这位仙长，王承的事情我都听说了。感谢你救了他一命！
drama_dialogue71221.en: Wang Cheng told me what you did. Thank you for saving his life!

drama_dialogue71223.ch: 听闻仙长此行乃是为了寻物，可否冒昧问一下，仙长所求的是何物？
drama_dialogue71223.en: I heard you're looking for something. May I ask you, what is it you are looking for?

drama_dialogue71224.ch: 一块名为息壤的神石，据说是一种能够使周围土地无限增长的宝物。
drama_dialogue71224.en: A Divine Stone called the Xirang, a magical treasure capable of expanding the earth.

drama_dialogue71225.ch: 息壤之名闻所未闻，但是能使周围土地增长…似乎与毕方所使用的法宝有些相似。
drama_dialogue71225.en: I have not heard the name Xirang before, but its special power... sounds like the artifact the Bi Fang used on that day.

drama_dialogue71226.ch: 毕方之事，村长最为了解，仙长不妨去问问他。
drama_dialogue71226.en: The village chief knows the most about the Bi Fang. You should go and ask him.

drama_dialogue71231.ch: 仙长，您且随我一同找村长吧！村长已经回来了。
drama_dialogue71231.en: Follow me, Master! The village chief has returned!

drama_dialogue71241.ch: 唔…您就是那位救了王承的仙长吗？感谢你对双仪村伸出援手！
drama_dialogue71241.en: Ah... You must be the immortal who saved Wang Cheng! Thank you for helping Duality Village!

drama_dialogue71242.ch: 我听说，您来到双仪村附近，似乎是要寻找一样宝物？
drama_dialogue71242.en: You came here in search of a treasure, is that correct?

drama_dialogue71243.ch: 不错！我要寻的是一块名为息壤的神石，据说此物在催动灵力后，可使周围的土地无限的增长。
drama_dialogue71243.en: Yes! I'm looking for a Divine Stone called the Xirang. They say it has the power to expand the earth.

drama_dialogue71244.ch: 息壤？您说的可是帝禹在治水所用的神石？
drama_dialogue71244.en: Xirang? The Divine Stone used by Yu the Great to control flood waters?

drama_dialogue71246.ch: 唔…息壤的确就在双仪村附近，但如果我猜得不错，它应该在毕方手中。
drama_dialogue71246.en: Hm... The Xirang is definitely close to Duality Village. The Bi Fang has it, if I'm not mistaken.

drama_dialogue71247.ch: 你们所说的毕方，究竟是从何而来？它到底想做什么？
drama_dialogue71247.en: Where does this Bi Fang come from, and what does it want?

drama_dialogue71248.ch: 没人知道毕方从何而来，也没人知道它究竟想要什么…
drama_dialogue71248.en: No one knows where it came from or what it wants...

drama_dialogue71250.ch: 它每隔一段时间都会出现在双仪村附近。每一次听见它飞过的破空声与尖锐的叫声，都让人不禁胆寒。
drama_dialogue71250.en: It appears every now and then not close to Duality Village. Its unearthly screeching causes everyone to run for cover.

drama_dialogue71251.ch: 唉…仙长，老朽有个不情之请。
drama_dialogue71251.en: Ah... I have a favor to ask you, Immortal.

drama_dialogue71252.ch: 双仪村的情况您应该从村民口中了解了不少…你若是寻到了毕方，能否替我们这些凡人将其铲除？
drama_dialogue71252.en: I think the villagers must have told you a lot about our situation... If you find the Bi Fang, please could you kill it? We mortals are too weak.

drama_dialogue71253.ch: …此事还我无法应允，待我寻到了毕方再作打算。
drama_dialogue71253.en: ... I can't make any promises. I'll decide when I meet the Bi Fang.

drama_dialogue71261.en: Who are you? Why do you seek me?

drama_dialogue71262.ch: 我在寻找一块名为息壤的神石，据说是一种能够使周围土地无限增长的宝物。如果我猜的不错，息壤便在你手中吧？
drama_dialogue71262.en: I seek a Divine Stone called the Xirang, a magical treasure capable of expanding the earth. If I'm not mistaken, the Xirang is in your hands, is it not?

drama_dialogue71263.ch: 不错！但我绝不可能将息壤交给一个来路不明的人。
drama_dialogue71263.en: It is! But I'm not going to give it to just anyone.

drama_dialogue71264.ch: 如果你不愿意交给我，就别怪我来硬的了！
drama_dialogue71264.en: Hand it over, if you know what's good for you!

drama_dialogue71265.ch: 大言不惭！我倒要看看你究竟有何本事！
drama_dialogue71265.en: Tough guy, huh? Let's see what you've got, then.

drama_dialogue71271.ch: 原来这就是息壤，果然不是凡物…

drama_dialogue71281.en: Who are you? Why do you seek me?

drama_dialogue71291.ch: 哦？有意思！千百年以来，你是我见过唯一一个关心凡人的修仙者！告诉你也无妨…
drama_dialogue71291.en: Oh? How curious! You're the first Cultivator I've met in a thousand years who cares about mortals! May as well tell you...

drama_dialogue71292.ch: 很久以前，曾有一个叱咤华封州的邪修！因为他所修的功法必须要通过吸食其他生灵的精血进行修炼，故此而被人称为血魔。
drama_dialogue71292.en: A long time ago there was a Qi Deviated Cultivator who terrorized the lands of Hua Feng. His peculiar form of martial arts involved absorbing the blood essence of other creatures. For that reason he was widely known as the Blood Lord.

drama_dialogue71293.ch: 后来，他的命在此地被各路正道修士给了结…可是，即便他的元神毁灭，正道的修士也无法摧毁他强大的肉身与邪气，只能将其封印在此地。
drama_dialogue71293.en: Eventually righteous Cultivators from every corner of the world converged here and ended his reign of terror... They succeeded in destroying his soul, but his flesh and evil energy had to be sealed inside a tomb.

drama_dialogue71294.ch: 多年前，双仪村中有一个村民在村子附近无意间毁去了封印。刹那间，爆发而出的邪气导致地脉结构发生改变，冥山中的冥气也从开裂的地缝中漫出。
drama_dialogue71294.en: Many years later a local villager inadvertently broke the seal. In that moment, evil energy exploded forth, twisting ley lines, and causing Dark Qi to escape from rifts in the Nether Mountains.

drama_dialogue71295.ch: 我借助了息壤之力，才能勉强将血魔压制，同时还要维持双仪村的禁制，以防村民被地缝中所漫出的冥气所侵蚀…
drama_dialogue71295.en: I used the power of the Xirang to restrain the Blood Lord and confine the people to Duality Village, so they wouldn't be contaminated by the Dark Qi pouring out from the ground.

drama_dialogue71301.ch: 呵…息壤若是落入了歹人手中，恐怕会给八荒带来浩劫。我岂能随意将它交给你？
drama_dialogue71301.en: Ah... If the Xirang ever falls into the wrong hands, great calamity could befall the world! Why would it just give it to you?

drama_dialogue71302.ch: 我若想要战胜何罗鱼，就必须要得到息壤…
drama_dialogue71302.en: But I must have the Xirang to defeat the Leviathan...

drama_dialogue71303.ch: 你想要讨伐东海中的何罗鱼？有意思！你若真办法能将其铲除，倒也不是不能将息壤给你。
drama_dialogue71303.en: You want to use it against the Leviathan of the East Sea? Interesting! If you really do plan to kill it, then I might consider lending it to you.

drama_dialogue71304.ch: 只是…压制血魔离不开息壤，这血魔一日不除，我依然不能将息壤交给你。
drama_dialogue71304.en: The thing is... the Xirang is needed to control the Blood Lord. There's no way I can give it to you, unless the Blood Lord is taken care of first.

drama_dialogue71311.ch: 如果你不愿意交给我，就别怪我来硬的了！
drama_dialogue71311.en: Hand it over, if you know what's good for you!

drama_dialogue71312.ch: 呵…大言不惭！我倒要看看你究竟有何本事！
drama_dialogue71312.en: Bah! Tough guy, huh? Let's see what you've got, then.

drama_dialogue71321.ch: 无知无畏的人类，侥幸苟活却还敢前来送死！这次我定要取你性命！
drama_dialogue71321.en: Reckless human. You must have a death wish! Well, let me grant it!

drama_dialogue71331.ch: 原来这就是息壤，果然不是凡物…

drama_dialogue71341.ch: 莫非真的没有办法能消灭血魔吗？
drama_dialogue71341.en: Is there really no way of stopping the Blood Lord?

drama_dialogue71342.ch: 他元神已灭，剩下的只有肉身与邪念…而如今他已被封印了多年，实力早已大不如前了。
drama_dialogue71342.en: The soul is extinguished. All that remains are his flesh and malice... But he has been sealed up for so long... He must be a shadow of his former self.

drama_dialogue71343.ch: 你若是有金丹境的实力，倒是可以尝试与其交锋。
drama_dialogue71343.en: If you possess the strength of the Golden Core, go ahead and confront him.

drama_dialogue71344.ch: 好！我若能将其消灭，你能否将息壤交给我？
drama_dialogue71344.en: Great! If I kill it, will you give me the Xirang?

drama_dialogue71345.ch: 你若真能消灭血魔，我将息壤送给你又何妨？
drama_dialogue71345.en: If you really do manage to kill it, then what reason do I have not to?

drama_dialogue71351.ch: 莫非真的没有办法能消灭血魔吗？
drama_dialogue71351.en: Is there really no way of stopping the Blood Lord?

drama_dialogue71352.ch: 他元神已灭，剩下的只有肉身与邪念…而如今他已被封印了多年，实力早已大不如前了。
drama_dialogue71352.en: The soul is extinguished. All that remains are his flesh and malice... But he has been sealed up for so long... He must be a shadow of his former self.

drama_dialogue71353.ch: 你若是有金丹境的实力，倒是可以尝试与其交锋。
drama_dialogue71353.en: If you possess the strength of the Golden Core, go ahead and confront him.

drama_dialogue71354.ch: 我若是铲除了血魔，你能否将息壤交给我？
drama_dialogue71354.en: If I kill the Blood Lord, will you give me the Xirang?

drama_dialogue71355.ch: 息壤若是落入了歹人手中，恐怕会给八荒带来浩劫…你为何想要得到息壤？
drama_dialogue71355.en: If the Xirang ever falls into the wrong hands, great calamity could befall the world... Why do you want the Xirang anyway?

drama_dialogue71356.ch: 我若想要战胜何罗鱼，就必须要得到息壤…
drama_dialogue71356.en: But I must have the Xirang to defeat the Leviathan...

drama_dialogue71357.ch: 你想要讨伐东海中的何罗鱼？有意思！你若真能除去血魔，我便将息壤送给你。
drama_dialogue71357.en: You want to use it against the Leviathan of the East Sea? Interesting! You can have it if you kill the Blood Lord.

drama_dialogue71361.ch: 你若真能消灭血魔，我将息壤送给你又何妨？
drama_dialogue71361.en: If you really do manage to kill it, then what reason do I have not to?

drama_dialogue71401.ch: 如果你不愿意交给我，就别怪我来硬的了！
drama_dialogue71401.en: Hand it over, if you know what's good for you!

drama_dialogue71402.ch: 大言不惭！我倒要看看你究竟有何本事！
drama_dialogue71402.en: Tough guy, huh? Let's see what you've got, then.

drama_dialogue71411.ch: 无知无畏的人类，侥幸苟活却还敢前来送死！这次我定要取你性命！
drama_dialogue71411.en: Reckless human. You must have a death wish! Well, let me grant it!

drama_dialogue71421.ch: 原来这就是息壤，果然不是凡物…

drama_dialogue71431.ch: 洞内弥漫着令人胆寒的邪气，血魔一定就在其中了…
drama_dialogue71431.en: Cold malice pervades the air inside the cave. The Blood Lord must be here...

drama_dialogue71432.ch: 你刚靠近村庄，就察觉到村中传来了极为邪恶的气息！是否要继续前进…
drama_dialogue71432.en: As you approach the village, you detect an intense aura of evil coming from within! Do you want to keep going...?

drama_dialogue71433.ch: 你刚进入村庄，便有一头凶神恶煞的魔物朝你袭来！
drama_dialogue71433.en: As you enter the village, a ferocious-looking monster charges right at you!

drama_dialogue71441.ch: 真是出人意料，想不到你真能除去血魔！
drama_dialogue71441.en: Wow! I can't believe you killed it!

drama_dialogue71442.ch: 这有何难？依照约定，能否将息壤给我？
drama_dialogue71442.en: What's the big deal? Anyway, we had an agreement...

drama_dialogue71443.ch: 这是自然，我既答应了你，就绝不会食言。
drama_dialogue71443.en: We did... and I will keep it. I never break my word.

drama_dialogue71444.ch: 既然血魔已经你铲除，我也该离开这里了…
drama_dialogue71444.en: Since you killed the Blood Lord, there's no reason for me to stay around...

drama_dialogue71445.en: Where do you plan to go now?

drama_dialogue71446.ch: 哪里需要我，我就去哪里…日后有缘再会。
drama_dialogue71446.en: Where I am needed, I will go... May we meet again.

drama_dialogue71452.ch: 你也见识过了何罗鱼的实力，为何还要来东海？
drama_dialogue71452.en: You've seen what the Leviathan can do. Why would you come to the East Sea?

drama_dialogue71453.ch: 我已经取到了息壤…你真的能用它填平东海吗？
drama_dialogue71453.en: I got the Xirang... Can it really flatten the sea?

drama_dialogue71454.ch: …我也不知道，但这是唯一的办法了。
drama_dialogue71454.en: ... I don't know, but it's the only thing I can think of.

drama_dialogue71456.ch: 滔天的巨浪随着狂暴的何罗鱼向你席卷而来！！！
drama_dialogue71456.en: Monstrous waves sweep towards you, in the Leviathan's wake!

drama_dialogue71457.ch: （那个女孩仍是独自一人在海边，要过去找她吗？）
drama_dialogue71457.en: (The girl stands alone by the shore. Do you want to go and get her?)

drama_dialogue71464.ch: 你…你且将息壤给我，现在必须抓紧时间…若是等何罗鱼缓过来，就没有机会了…
drama_dialogue71464.en: Hand me... the Xirang. We don't have long... before the Leviathan returns...

drama_dialogue71465.ch: （她的灵力与魂力受损十分严重，是否要祝他一臂之力呢…）
drama_dialogue71465.en: (Her energy and spirit are severely depleted. Do you want to try to help her...?)

drama_dialogue71471.ch: 女孩缓缓的飘向空中，吸收了本源精血的息壤散发出庞大的能量！何罗鱼见状，对女孩露出了狰狞的獠牙！
drama_dialogue71471.en: The girl rises slowly into the air, absorbing Pulsating with blood essence, the Xirang emits tremendous power! Noticing the girl, the Leviathan bares its fangs.

drama_dialogue71472.ch: 片刻后，大量的砂石从海中迸出，巨大的石块瞬间摧毁了何罗鱼庞大的身躯…
drama_dialogue71472.en: Moments later, vast amounts of rock emerge from the sea. Huge boulders crush the Leviathan's enormous body...

drama_dialogue71473.ch: 一段时间后，阻断了华封州与云陌州无数年的东海被填为了平地，吞噬了无数生灵的何罗鱼也彻底从八荒中消失了…
drama_dialogue71473.en: The East Sea that has long divided Hua Feng and Yun Mo disappears and the ravenous Leviathan is no more...

drama_dialogue71481.ch: 女孩缓缓的飘向空中，吸收了本源灵力的息壤散发出庞大的能量！何罗鱼见状，对女孩露出了狰狞的獠牙！
drama_dialogue71481.en: The girl rises slowly into the air. Pulsating with energy, the Xirang emits tremendous power! Noticing the girl, the Leviathan bares its fangs.

drama_dialogue71482.ch: 片刻后，大量的砂石从海中迸出，巨大的石块瞬间摧毁了何罗鱼庞大的身躯…

drama_dialogue71483.en: The East Sea that has long divided Hua Feng and Yun Mo disappears and the ravenous Leviathan is no more...

drama_dialogue71491.ch: 女孩缓缓的飘向空中，吸收了神念的息壤散发出庞大的能量！何罗鱼见状，对女孩露出了狰狞的獠牙！
drama_dialogue71491.en: The girl rises slowly into the air. Pulsating with divine focus, the Xirang emits tremendous power! Noticing the girl, the Leviathan bares its fangs.

drama_dialogue71492.ch: 片刻后，大量的砂石从海中迸出，巨大的石块瞬间摧毁了何罗鱼庞大的身躯…
drama_dialogue71492.en: Moments later, vast amounts of rock emerge from the sea. Huge boulders crush the Leviathan's enormous body...

drama_dialogue71493.ch: 一段时间后，阻断了华封州与云陌州无数年的东海被填为了平地，吞噬了无数生灵的何罗鱼也彻底从八荒中消失了…
drama_dialogue71493.en: The East Sea that has long divided Hua Feng and Yun Mo disappears and the ravenous Leviathan is no more...

drama_dialogue71501.ch: 女孩缓缓的飘向空中，不断的朝着息壤中注入大量的灵力与魂力！女孩的身形正在不断的消散…何罗鱼见状，对女孩露出了狰狞的獠牙！
drama_dialogue71501.en: The girl rises slowly into the air, pouring all her energy and spirit into the Xirang! The girl's body starts to fade... Noticing the girl, the Leviathan bares its fangs.

drama_dialogue71502.ch: 片刻后，女孩耗尽了最后一丝魂力，最终魂飞魄散…随后大量的砂石从海中迸出，巨大的石块瞬间摧毁了何罗鱼庞大的身躯…
drama_dialogue71502.en: Moments later, the girl expends the last ounce of her spirit and her soul disappears. Vast amounts of rock emerge from the sea. Huge boulders crush the Leviathan's enormous body...

drama_dialogue71503.ch: 一段时间后，阻断了华封州与云陌州无数年的东海被填为了平地，吞噬了无数生灵的何罗鱼也彻底从八荒中消失了…
drama_dialogue71503.en: The East Sea that has long divided Hua Feng and Yun Mo disappears and the ravenous Leviathan is no more...

drama_dialogue71512.en: Are you okay? Are you hurt?

drama_dialogue71514.ch: 女孩没有回答，只是一言不发的望着眼前新生的土地一直沉默着…许久后，女孩回过神来…
drama_dialogue71514.en: The girl doesn't answer, but stares silently at the new land that has appeared in front of her... Presently she comes back to herself...

drama_dialogue71515.ch: 我已经没事了。多亏有你相助，感激不尽。
drama_dialogue71515.en: I'm okay. Thanks to you. How can I ever thank you?

drama_dialogue71516.ch: 只是…填平东海一直是我的心愿，今日我心愿已了，却是不知何去何从了…
drama_dialogue71516.en: It's just... I've wanted to flatten the sea for so long. Now it's done, I don't know what to do with myself...

drama_dialogue71519.ch: 我有一件宝物，名为建木，其中别有洞天。你若是不嫌，可暂居于建木。
drama_dialogue71519.en: I have a treasure called the Tree Vault. It's a whole other world inside. You can stay there if you like.

drama_dialogue71521.en: Why don't you come with me?

drama_dialogue71531.ch: 这里便是建木了，你且暂居于此吧。
drama_dialogue71531.en: This is the Tree Vault. Make yourself at home.

drama_dialogue71535.ch: 嗯，我闲暇之余，一定来看你。
drama_dialogue71535.en: Sure, when I get a free moment, I'll come and see you.

drama_dialogue720001.ch: 前方凶险无比，暂时被封印起来了，道友还是不要接近为妙！
drama_dialogue720001.en: It's extremely dangerous up ahead. The area has been sealed off. I would keep clear, if I were you Cultivator!

drama_dialogue720012.ch: 此地妖兽竟如此强大，还是尽早离开。
drama_dialogue720012.en: The monsters in this area are so powerful! Better get out of here.

drama_dialogue720101.ch: 不远处似乎有一个路标…
drama_dialogue720101.en: Seems there is a road not far from here...

drama_dialogue720102.ch: 过去看看附近有哪些城镇和宗门吧。
drama_dialogue720102.en: Go and check out what towns and sects are nearby.

drama_dialogue720111.ch: 我的身体已经快撑不住了…
drama_dialogue720111.en: I can't hold on much longer...

drama_dialogue720112.ch: 不远处有个城镇…先到城镇中，将身体调养至健康的状态，再作打算吧。
drama_dialogue720112.en: There's a town not far from here... Let's recover there, then decide what to do next.

drama_dialogue720121.ch: 总感觉有些烦躁，有没有什么有意思的东西可以让我把玩一下呢…
drama_dialogue720121.en: I'm feeling a bit restless again. You got something cool I can play with...?

drama_dialogue720122.ch: 先到附近的城镇去找找看吧。
drama_dialogue720122.en: Why don't you go to town and take a look around?

drama_dialogue720131.ch: 真亏你能找到这里来。作为奖励，这个东西就送给你吧。
drama_dialogue720131.en: I'm impressed you found this place! Here, take this as a reward.

drama_dialogue720132.ch: 真亏你能找到这里来。作为奖励，这个东西就送给你吧。
drama_dialogue720132.en: I'm impressed you found this place! Here, take this as a reward.

drama_dialogue720133.ch: 真亏你能找到这里来。作为奖励，这个东西就送给你吧。
drama_dialogue720133.en: I'm impressed you found this place! Here, take this as a reward.

drama_dialogue720141.en: A Mushroom Man appears in the distance...

drama_dialogue720151.en: A Mushroom Man appears in the distance...

drama_dialogue720161.en: A Mushroom Man appears in the distance...

drama_dialogue720171.en: A Mushroom Man appears in the distance...

drama_dialogue720181.en: A Mushroom Man appears in the distance...

drama_dialogue720201.ch: 你遇到了一名杀气腾腾的修仙者！此人似乎因修炼邪术，走火入魔了…
drama_dialogue720201.en: You have encountered a murderous Cultivator! They appear to have been dabbling in dark magic, bringing on a serious case of Qi Deviation...

drama_dialogue720211.ch: 对方见势不妙，急匆匆的逃走了…对方在逃走时，似乎遗落了一件物品。
drama_dialogue720211.en: Thinking better of it, your opponent flees... dropping something as they depart.

drama_dialogue720221.ch: 你在山谷中寻到了一处极为隐蔽的洞窟…
drama_dialogue720221.en: In the valley you come across a secluded cavern...

drama_dialogue720231.ch: 到城镇中的琅琊阁去看看，是否有更强大的功法吧。
drama_dialogue720231.en: You should go to Manual Pavilion in town and see if they have even more powerful martial arts.

drama_dialogue720301.ch: 地面剧烈震动起来，一个巨型石人破土而出。
drama_dialogue720301.en: The ground shakes violently as a golem breaks through the earth.

drama_dialogue720311.ch: 地面剧烈震动起来，一个巨型石人破土而出。
drama_dialogue720311.en: The ground shakes violently as a golem breaks through the earth.

drama_dialogue720321.ch: 地面剧烈震动起来，一个巨型石人破土而出。
drama_dialogue720321.en: The ground shakes violently as a golem breaks through the earth.

drama_dialogue720331.ch: 地面剧烈震动起来，一个巨型石人破土而出。
drama_dialogue720331.en: The ground shakes violently as a golem breaks through the earth.

drama_dialogue720341.ch: 地面剧烈震动起来，一个巨型石人破土而出。
drama_dialogue720341.en: The ground shakes violently as a golem breaks through the earth.

drama_dialogue720401.ch: 四周传来一阵诡异的笑声，一个萦绕黑气的假面法宝飘浮在空中。
drama_dialogue720401.en: You hear strange laughter around you as a mask, surrounded by a black aura, floats in the air.

drama_dialogue720411.ch: 四周传来一阵诡异的笑声，一个萦绕黑气的假面法宝飘浮在空中。
drama_dialogue720411.en: You hear strange laughter around you as a mask, surrounded by a black aura, floats in the air.

drama_dialogue720421.ch: 四周传来一阵诡异的笑声，一个萦绕黑气的假面法宝飘浮在空中。
drama_dialogue720421.en: You hear strange laughter around you as a mask, surrounded by a black aura, floats in the air.

drama_dialogue720431.ch: 四周传来一阵诡异的笑声，一个萦绕黑气的假面法宝飘浮在空中。
drama_dialogue720431.en: You hear strange laughter around you as a mask, surrounded by a black aura, floats in the air.

drama_dialogue720441.ch: 四周传来一阵诡异的笑声，一个萦绕黑气的假面法宝飘浮在空中。
drama_dialogue720441.en: You hear strange laughter around you as a mask, surrounded by a black aura, floats in the air.

drama_dialogue750001.ch: 远道而来的修仙者啊…若想要进入<r>盘龙山</r>寻求机缘，必须要通过我的考验…
drama_dialogue750001.en: You have traveled a long way Cultivator... if you wish to seek your destiny on <r>Panlong Mountain</r> you must first pass my test...

drama_dialogue750011.ch: 远道而来的修仙者啊…若想要进入<r>千岩谷</r>寻求机缘，必须要通过我的考验…
drama_dialogue750011.en: You have traveled a long way Cultivator... if you wish to seek your destiny in <r>Rocky Valley</r> you must first pass my test...

drama_dialogue750021.ch: 远道而来的修仙者啊…若想要进入<r>通幽谷</r>寻求机缘，必须要通过我的考验…
drama_dialogue750021.en: You have traveled a long way Cultivator... if you wish to seek your destiny in <r>Secluded Valley</r> you must first pass my test...
