drama_dialogue8011202.ch: 本城附近有一蛙族，往年大家都相安无事。直至受河罗鱼的邪气影响，蛙族四处发狂，已造成多个村庄的覆灭。
drama_dialogue8011202.en: There is a clan of frogs near the city. In the past, we lived peacefully with them, but then, they were corrupted by the evil air from the Leviathan and went crazy. Many villages have been destroyed by them.

drama_dialogue8011203.ch: 现在它们正向着本城靠近，非常危险。特在酒馆发布委托，任何修士若能替我城解此灾难，必奉上{itemLink5081075}*1、{itemLink1011476}*1、{itemLink5031786}*2、{itemLink5031826}*2、{itemLink5081205}*1、{itemLink10001}*2000。
drama_dialogue8011203.en: Now they're approaching, and our city is threatened. Thus, we posted a task in our Tavern. For those who can save us from the frogs, we prepare {itemLink5081075}*1, {itemLink1011476}*1, {itemLink5031786}*2, {itemLink5031826}*2, {itemLink5081205}*1, and {itemLink10001}*2000 as reward.

drama_dialogue8011204.ch: 此事凶险异常，望仙师谨慎行事，切勿伤了性命！本城琅琊阁有保命能力极强的<r>风身法、土身法、刀身法</r>，您可以去看看！
drama_dialogue8011204.en: But this is a perilous challenge, and we hope you act wisely and have a safe return! In the Manual Pavilion of our city, you could find <r>Wind, Earth and Blade Motion Skills</r> to enhance your ability of dodging and parrying.

drama_dialogue8011205.ch: 这蛙族魔化后竟如此狂暴，仙师小心为上。
drama_dialogue8011205.en: These demonic frogs are so fierce. Please be careful.

drama_dialogue8011206.ch: 仙师辛苦了，我等特地在此等候，这是您的报酬！
drama_dialogue8011206.en: Well done! We're waiting you here, and please take your reward!

drama_dialogue8011301.ch: 哟，仙师好眼光！这份委托可不得了。偷偷告诉您，这可是华封州某世家的委托。
drama_dialogue8011301.en: Hey, you're so lucky! I tell you something about it - it is posted by a famous lineage in Hua Feng.

drama_dialogue8011302.ch: 虽然他们掩盖气息的术法很高明，桀桀桀，但我还是技高一筹。
drama_dialogue8011302.en: Though their technique for hiding trail is complex, it cannot escape from my senses. Xaxaxa.

drama_dialogue8011303.ch: 噢，失礼了。委托人特地指名必须得是结晶修士才可接取此任务。仙师您的实力是？
drama_dialogue8011303.en: Well, never mind. The poster requires a cultivator in the realm of Qi Condensation to finish the task. Are you the one they're looking for?

drama_dialogue8011304.ch: 噢，本次委托为保护一人的安全，直至他从东海历练回来，任务时长不超过2个月。事后给您{itemLink5021424}*1000、{itemLink10001}*2000、{itemLink5081195}*1、{itemLink5021464}*500。您看如何？
drama_dialogue8011304.en: Well. This task requires you to protect someone until the person returns from the East Sea. It will take you 2 months at most to finish. Once completed, we will provide you {itemLink5021424}*1000, {itemLink10001}*2000, {itemLink5081195}*1, and {itemLink5021464}*500 as reward. Do you find it appealing?

drama_dialogue8011305.ch: 期待您的好消息,这是会面地点！
drama_dialogue8011305.en: Waiting for your triumph! There you may meet the person for further information!

drama_dialogue8011306.ch: 多来我这看看，会有符合您的委托的。
drama_dialogue8011306.en: Come here frequently, and you will surely find tasks appealing to you.

drama_dialogue8011307.ch: 桀桀桀，仙师可不要骗我噢~~
drama_dialogue8011307.en: Xaxaxa. You said that, master cultivator!

drama_dialogue8011308.ch: 你来到了约定地点，这地方四面环山，很是隐蔽。
drama_dialogue8011308.en: You arrived at the place agreed. The location is surrounded by hills, and is difficult to access.

drama_dialogue8011309.ch: 正当你如此想时。只听一声：阵起！！！四面已被阵法封锁.....有诈？！
drama_dialogue8011309.en: You think about the terrain here. Then, you hear someone shouting: "Arrays set!" Suddenly, you find yourself enveloped in arrays. Are you lured and trapped?

drama_dialogue8011310.ch: 哈哈，大哥，你说这小子是不是脑子不好使！
drama_dialogue8011310.en: Ha! Big bro, this, such a stupid guy!

drama_dialogue8011311.ch: 阿大，你弟弟话太多了，快办事！
drama_dialogue8011311.en: Dude, your little fellow talks too much. Quick!

drama_dialogue8011312.ch: 这副身躯我太喜欢了！把他拿下！
drama_dialogue8011312.en: Just look at the physique our prey! Capture this one!

drama_dialogue8011313.ch: 住手，放过我们，我这里有{itemLink1011536}*2、{itemLink1011545}*1、{itemLink5081225}*1、{itemLink1051143}*5、{itemLink10001}*5000给你。你还不是金丹，无法复活，不然我死也要拖你下水 。
drama_dialogue8011313.en: Stop and spare us. I have {itemLink1011536}*2, {itemLink1011545}*1, {itemLink5081225}*1, {itemLink1051143}*5, and {itemLink10001}*5000 for you. You have not reached Golden Core yet, thus cannot revive. Or I will get you involved in the scheme at the cost of my life.

drama_dialogue8011314.ch: 他似乎对自己使用了某种秘法，现在周身灵力极不稳定，不像有假。
drama_dialogue8011314.en: Perhaps he applied some secret techniques on himself. Now the energy surrounding him is extremely unstable, and judged from it, his words may be true as well.

drama_dialogue8011315.en: You gain {itemLink1011536}*2, {itemLink1011545}*1, {itemLink5081225}*1, {itemLink1051143}*5, and {itemLink10001}*5000, and find the trio has fled.

drama_dialogue8011316.ch: 你一抬手就被对方发现。他狞笑着引爆了自身的灵力。威力超出了你的预计......
drama_dialogue8011316.en: Unfortunately, just at the time you start casting, your opponent knows your intention. He issues a blast of his own energy with a demonic smile, and the power from it overwhelms you...

drama_dialogue8011318.ch: 一道金光劈中了你，你失去了意识！
drama_dialogue8011318.en: A golden lightning falls upon you, and you are struck into unconsciousness.

drama_dialogue8011319.ch: 恍惚中你感觉到自己有什么东西正在慢慢被抽离，但你已没有力气去反抗了.....
drama_dialogue8011319.en: You feel something inside you is being drawn out, but your mind is blurry, and your limbs are too feeble to move...

drama_dialogue8011320.ch: 你的修为和寿命被吸食殆尽，生机尽断......
drama_dialogue8011320.en: All of your cultivation and life are seeping away into somewhere far and unknown...

drama_dialogue8011321.ch: 此次事件是我们失职了，这是您应得的，还有我们的赔罪。
drama_dialogue8011321.en: Sorry, we know you suffered a lot due to our negligence. Please take these as our apologies.

drama_dialogue8011322.ch: 非常抱歉，此次事件是我们失职了，这是您应得的，额外的是我们的赔罪，乞求您的原谅。
drama_dialogue8011322.en: Sorry to find you suffered a lot due to our negligence. Please take these as our apologies. If possible, please forgive us as well.

drama_dialogue8011323.ch: 一丝暖流从神器里流出，护住了一丝生气......
drama_dialogue8011323.en: A warm current flows out from the artifact, and shields some of your life from being drawn out...

drama_dialogue8011401.ch: 这位仙师好面善呀，是过来了解本城的委托的吗？
drama_dialogue8011401.en: Master cultivator, you look amicable. Maybe you're interested by the task of our city?

drama_dialogue8011402.ch: 本城在郊外有一私人开设的炼器坊，受此次委托雇主的委托炼制一法宝，本来前日就应该交付，却不知何因迟迟不来。
drama_dialogue8011402.en: We have a private forge workshop in the outskirts. Several days before, it received an order of forging artifact from the poster of the task. The agreed delivery date is the day before yesterday, but the poster did not receive the finished artifact on the date.

drama_dialogue8011403.ch: 昨日派人探查，发现炼器坊已被一股邪气笼罩，并出现发狂的邪魔，异常强大。现需要一人前去取回法宝。
drama_dialogue8011403.en: Yesterday we sent a team for investigation, and found the workshop was enveloped by an evil aura. Besides, we also encountered powerful evil creatures there. Now, we need a person to take the artifact back.

drama_dialogue8011404.ch: 此次任务较为危险，望仙师量力而行。拿回法宝后，可获得{itemLink5081165}*1、{itemLink5031796}*2、{itemLink5031826}*1、{itemLink5021464}*500、{itemLink5021424}*1000。您看如何？
drama_dialogue8011404.en: This will be a perilous mission, please act wisely. After we received the artifact, we will provide you {itemLink5081165}*1, {itemLink5031796}*2, {itemLink5031826}*1, {itemLink5021464}*500, and {itemLink5021424}*1000 as reward. What's your opinion?

drama_dialogue8011405.ch: 邪魔尸体消散后，留下了一件残缺的法宝，上面有一片冒着邪气的鱼鳞已融了进去。想来这就是本次灾难的根源了。<r>（残缺的法宝无法再修复使用）</r>
drama_dialogue8011405.en: The remains of the evil creatures dispersed. Then, you find a broken artifact, with a piece of ominous fish scale embedded on it. The scale must be the root of trouble. <r>(Broken Artifact cannot be repaired to use)</r>

drama_dialogue8011406.ch: 刚踏入坊内，平静的工坊瞬间爆发出两股暴戾的气息...邪魔袭来！
drama_dialogue8011406.en: Just at the time you stepped into the workshop, you are engulfed by auras of fierce evil creatures ... They are launching their attacks!

drama_dialogue8011407.ch: 仙师辛苦了，未曾想到这里竟然会有河罗鱼的鳞片，我们会彻底查清此事，这是您的报酬！告辞了！
drama_dialogue8011407.en: Thanks for your endeavor. We are also surprised to see the scale of the Leviathan appearing here, and we will investigate it soon. Here, take your reward! Goodbye!

drama_dialogue8011501.ch: 此次委托过于危险，非金丹强者不可尝试，各位仙师要量力而行！
drama_dialogue8011501.en: This task is very difficult, and we recommend only those in Golden Core realm to try. Please act wisely, cultivators.

drama_dialogue8011502.ch: 东海附近有当康族人被河罗鱼污染，到处破坏海岸，此次任务就是要消灭为祸的当康族人。
drama_dialogue8011502.en: On the shore of the East Sea, some Dangkang Members are corrupted by the Leviathan. Now they are causing troubles along the coast, and the task is posted for someone to deal with them.

drama_dialogue8011503.ch: 事成之后，奖励金丹良品心法*2、{itemLink1011555}*1、{itemLink5021465}*500、{itemLink5021424}*1000、{itemLink1051074}*5、{itemLink1051114}*5、{itemLink1051134}*5
drama_dialogue8011503.en: After you completed the task, we will prepare G4 Golden Core Mind Skill*2, {itemLink1011555}*1, {itemLink5021465}*500, {itemLink5021424}*1000, {itemLink1051074}*5, {itemLink1051114}*5, and {itemLink1051134}*5 as your reward.

drama_dialogue8011504.ch: 两只当康族人正在海岸破坏......
drama_dialogue8011504.en: Two Dangkang Members are sabotaging along the coast...

drama_dialogue8011505.ch: 仙师辛苦了，我等特地在此等候，这是您的报酬！
drama_dialogue8011505.en: Well done! We're waiting you here, and please take your reward!

drama_dialogue8011601.ch: 想了解本次委托的仙师，请移步至房内的隔音法阵。本次任务较为敏感，望各位仙师海涵！
drama_dialogue8011601.en: Anyone who wants to learn more about the task, please come into the soundproof array in the room. Sorry for any inconvenience because there are something that should be kept secret.

drama_dialogue8011602.ch: 进入法阵，周身顿时感受到法阵带来的异样感，这不是普通的隔音法阵？！
drama_dialogue8011602.en: You enter the array, but are soon enveloped by a strange feeling generated from it. Is it really an ordinary soundproof array?

drama_dialogue8011603.ch: 是在下失礼了，实在是此处任务过于敏感，不得不谨慎行事。事成之后，必定厚礼相赠。
drama_dialogue8011603.en: Pardon me for my rashness. However, there are something better not to be known to everyone in the task, and we must take some extra measures. We prepare a bountiful reward for you once you could complete it.

drama_dialogue8011604.ch: 本城附近常有宗门弟子失踪，至今未回，各大宗门均向我城施压。为此本城付出极大的人力物力，终于发现此事与最近兴起的邪教有关。
drama_dialogue8011604.en: There are many sect disciples missing around our city, and till now we do not have any clue on the whereabouts of them. Because of this, all famous Sects urge us to find them, and with a considerable cost of resources, we finally find a possible reason. That is, it may be the heresy appeared recently that attracts so many disciples away.

drama_dialogue8011605.ch: 此教非常极端，教主实力出众，我城也奈何不了，加上此教教众涵盖凡人与修士，让我城防不胜防。为此不得不借助外部力量来铲除他们。
drama_dialogue8011605.en: The tenets of the heresy are horrible, and the preacher is also a formidable opponent that our city cannot overcome. Besides, the followers include ordinary people and cultivators, and they can easily infiltrate into the crowd. Thus, we could only ask for other powerful figures to eliminate them.

drama_dialogue8011606.ch: 事成之后，金丹良品心法*2、{itemLink1011554}*1、{itemLink5021465}*500、{itemLink5021423}*1000、{itemLink1051084}*5、{itemLink1051164}*5、{itemLink1051144}*5；您看如何？
drama_dialogue8011606.en: After completed the task, we will prepare G4 Golden Core Mind Skill*2, {itemLink1011554}*1, {itemLink5021465}*500, {itemLink5021423}*1000, {itemLink1051084}*5, {itemLink1051164}*5, and {itemLink1051144}*5 as your reward. What's your opinion?

drama_dialogue8011607.ch: 这是邪教藏身地点！祝仙师武运昌隆！
drama_dialogue8011607.en: The heretics' lair is here! Wish you invincible!

drama_dialogue8011608.ch: 你偷偷潜入邪教。发现他们正在集会！
drama_dialogue8011608.en: You sneak into their lair, and find there is a gathering.

drama_dialogue8011609.ch: 邪教教主：各位兄弟姐妹！是谁让我们修仙之路断绝？是谁杀害了我们的亲人？是谁杀害了我们的好友？
drama_dialogue8011609.en: Heresy Preacher: Brothers and sisters! Who ended our career of cultivation? Who killed our beloved ones - and our friends?

drama_dialogue8011611.ch: 邪教教主：那些宗门，有着强大的秘法，丰厚的资源，却贪生怕死，只想着自己那一点利益，他们不该得到惩罚吗？
drama_dialogue8011611.en: Heresy Preacher: See those famous sects? They have powerful techniques, bountiful resources, but they are all cowards and concern only their own interests! Don't they deserve our punishment?

drama_dialogue8011615.ch: 随着教徒的阵阵声音，丝丝灵力慢慢汇聚到教主身上。这邪教教主的实力竟然在缓慢增强？！
drama_dialogue8011615.en: The followers are yelling, and you notice strands of energy are flowing into the preacher. The power of the preacher is being enhanced?!

drama_dialogue8011616.ch: 突然，邪教教主的身躯一震，一道灵力快速向四周散开.....
drama_dialogue8011616.en: Suddenly, the preacher trembles, and an aura of energy ripples away through the air...

drama_dialogue8011618.ch: 一股强大的力量向你袭来！
drama_dialogue8011618.en: A devouring power rushes toward you!

drama_dialogue8011619.ch: 邪教教主：吼！我还不能死！我还没有杀死河罗鱼！啊啊啊啊......
drama_dialogue8011619.en: Heresy Preacher: Ahhh! I won't die this day! I have not slain the Leviathan yet! AHHHH....

drama_dialogue8011621.ch: 邪教教主：兄弟姐妹们，把你们的力量交给我吧
drama_dialogue8011621.en: Heresy Preacher: Brothers and sisters! Give me your power!

drama_dialogue8011622.ch: 邪教教主身上突然冒出大量冥气，把聚集在身旁的教徒笼罩进去
drama_dialogue8011622.en: Gushes of Nether Air flows out from the preacher, and engulf the followers at the side.

drama_dialogue8011623.ch: 哮！！！！冥气中突然传来一阵异叫？！
drama_dialogue8011623.en: ROAR!!! A strange sound comes from the Nether Air?

drama_dialogue8011624.ch: 仙师辛苦了，我等特地在此等候，这是您的报酬！
drama_dialogue8011624.en: Well done! We're waiting you here, and please take your reward!

drama_dialogue8011701.ch: 此事已困扰我州已久，凶险万分，揭榜者无一回来，望仙师慎重！
drama_dialogue8011701.en: We're haunted by it for a long time, and it must be a perilous task, since till now no one could return here after accepted it. If you want to try, please think twice!

drama_dialogue8011702.ch: 有一绝地，千年前曾是人妖大战之地，百年前不知为何邪魔丛生，许多宗门天骄揭榜而上，最后连残魂都无法留下。
drama_dialogue8011702.en: There is a haunted yard, transformed from an ancient battlefield between humans and demons thousands of years ago. A century before, evil creatures spawned there, and master cultivators from famous sects came to slay them. However, all those challengers perished, and even their souls dispersed.

drama_dialogue8011703.ch: 我州受其苦已久，若仙师肯降下神通为我等留下一片安宁，我等必奉上本州最真挚的敬意：{itemLink1011556}*1、金丹极品心法*3、{itemLink5081265}*1、{itemLink1051154}*5、{itemLink1051184}*5、{itemLink1051104}*5、{itemLink5021425}*200、{itemLink10001}*1000，同时绝地内的一切事物均归仙师所有！
drama_dialogue8011703.en: They have threatened us for many years. If you could purge the yard and restore our peaceful lives, we will surely express our heartfelt gratitude with {itemLink1011556}*1, Mythic Golden Core Mind Skill*3, {itemLink5081265}*1, {itemLink1051154}*5, {itemLink1051184}*5, {itemLink1051104}*5, {itemLink5021425}*200, and {itemLink10001}*1000. Besides, all treasures you find there will be yours!

drama_dialogue8011704.ch: 你们就是这样忽悠别人去送死的？
drama_dialogue8011704.en: You just deceive others into sacrificing themselves with your eloquence?

drama_dialogue8011706.ch: 仙师人好心善，这就是我等最真挚的敬意：{itemLink1011556}*2、金丹期极品心法*3、{itemLink5081265}*1、{itemLink5081275}*1、{itemLink1051154}*8、{itemLink1051184}*8、{itemLink1051104}*8、{itemLink5021425}*1000、{itemLink10001}*5000，同时险地内一切事物均归仙师所有！这已经是我等的极限了，据我们调查，其中必有一份大机缘在那里......
drama_dialogue8011706.en: Master cultivator, you must be an amicable and warm-hearted person. We'll provide you {itemLink1011556}*2, Mythic Golden Core Mind Skill*3, {itemLink5081265}*1, {itemLink5081275}*1, {itemLink1051154}*8, {itemLink1051184}*8, {itemLink1051104}*8, {itemLink5021425}*1000, and {itemLink10001}*5000, as well as all treasures you find there! These are all we can provide, and, as we know, there is an excellent opportunity waiting for you in the yard...

drama_dialogue8011707.ch: 这地方太危险了，暂时先撤退！
drama_dialogue8011707.en: We're in a dangerous place! Withdraw now!

drama_dialogue8011708.ch: 邪气太重了，妖魔会发生狂暴的，快快撤退！
drama_dialogue8011708.en: The evil aura is too dense, and the creatures may go berserk. Withdraw quickly!

drama_dialogue8011709.ch: 仙师辛苦了，我等特地在此等候，这是您的报酬！
drama_dialogue8011709.en: Well done! We're waiting you here, and please take your reward!

drama_dialogue8011710.ch: 仙师辛苦了，我等特地在此等候，这是您的报酬！
drama_dialogue8011710.en: Well done! We're waiting you here, and please take your reward!

drama_dialogue8011711.ch: 我在绝地上方的<r>野猪窝</r>里藏了一个传送法阵，危急时<r>可打破野猪窝</r>离开。
drama_dialogue8011711.en: I hid a portal inside the <r>Boar's Lair</r> on the top of the yard. Once in danger, you could <r>break the Boar's Lair</r> and leave.

drama_dialogue8011712.ch: 进入绝地，总感觉有人在注视着你...
drama_dialogue8011712.en: You entered the deserted place, and feel someone is gazing at you...

drama_dialogue8011801.ch: 且慢！这附近有一地妖怪异常聚集，恐成大祸。
drama_dialogue8011801.en: Wait! There is a place crowded with monsters around here, and I fear they could be a bane for us.

drama_dialogue8011802.ch: 我观阁下实力非凡，若能替我解决此烦恼，老龟我珍藏的两个天材地宝也一并给予阁下。
drama_dialogue8011802.en: I have seen your extraordinary might. If you could settle the trouble for me, I will reward you with two Heaven and Earth Treasures I cherished.

drama_dialogue8011803.ch: 老龟我先替华封州的百姓给阁下道个谢了！
drama_dialogue8011803.en: And now, I'll express gratitude on behalf of people in Hua Feng!

drama_dialogue8011804.ch: 这是先前答应阁下的东西，祝君仙途风顺！
drama_dialogue8011804.en: These are the reward I promised. Wish you bon voyage!

drama_dialogue8011805.ch: 正是此处，就拜托阁下了。
drama_dialogue8011805.en: Exactly here. Please do your best, master cultivator.

drama_dialogue8011810.ch: 很好，倒要看看阁下有什么本事。兄弟们，给我上！！！
drama_dialogue8011810.en: Okay. Just show us your might. To arms, fellow lads!

drama_dialogue8011811.ch: 列阵，今日势必拿下他们，冲呀兄弟们！！！
drama_dialogue8011811.en: Set formation! We must capture them today. Fight!

drama_dialogue8012000.en: (After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

drama_dialogue8012002.ch: 只要给我足够的报酬，我便能满足你的任何心愿。
drama_dialogue8012002.en: I can make any wish come true as long as you pay the price.

drama_dialogue8012003.ch: 我憎恶言而无信，倘若你有一日也如此，那么就别怪我不择手段。
drama_dialogue8012003.en: I hate slander and dishonesty. If you should commit such a sin, I'll do whatever I can to ensure your downfall.

drama_dialogue8012004.ch: 拥有足够实力，才有拒绝的资格。
drama_dialogue8012004.en: Only those with power have the right to say no.

drama_dialogue8012005.ch: 总有些人喜欢自作聪明，以为自己的小把戏不会被我发现。
drama_dialogue8012005.en: There are always some smart alecks who think they can get away with their shabby tricks.

drama_dialogue8012006.ch: 缘分……谁说缘分是不可以买到？
drama_dialogue8012006.en: Destiny... Who said our destinies are not made for sale?

drama_dialogue8012051.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8012051.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8012052.ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
drama_dialogue8012052.en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

drama_dialogue8012101.ch: 你若是同我做交易，我倒是愿意与你聊上几句。
drama_dialogue8012101.en: If you want to trade with me, I could also chat with you for a while.

drama_dialogue8012102.en: Ten manuals for supreme Martial Arts. No bargaining.

drama_dialogue8012103.ch: 你只需要将自己的顶级功法都交予我，我便会给予你仙晶，只有仙晶可以从我这里买到东西，你们的灵石对于我而言可没有用处。希望你可以从我这里找到想要的东西。
drama_dialogue8012103.en: You only need to give all of your supreme Martial Arts to me in exchange for Heavenly Crystals. Here, I accept only those Crystals, and the Spirit Stones circulated among you are of no use to me. I hope you could find something you want in my store.

drama_dialogue8012104.ch: 这是我要的东西吗？你可别想耍手段。
drama_dialogue8012104.en: You think it is the one I want? Don't cheat me, please.

drama_dialogue8012201.ch: 不必心急，待到有缘之日仙法自是会到你面前。
drama_dialogue8012201.en: Don't be haste. The Heavenly Art will find you when your destiny allows.

drama_dialogue8012202.ch: 看在你如此照顾我的生意的份上，那便赠你一枚仙石碎片。
drama_dialogue8012202.en: I often see you patronizing my store. Here, take this Shard of Heavenly Stone as a gift.

drama_dialogue8012301.ch: 凡事都可以，但是得付些报酬。既然都活了如此之久，想必好宝贝不少吧。
drama_dialogue8012301.en: Everything is smooth once it's paid well. There must be many treasures in the hands of such a long-living person.

drama_dialogue8012401.ch: 既然是我的顾客，你想要的仙法，自然会给你。
drama_dialogue8012401.en: You are my customer, and I'll give you the Heavenly Art you want.

drama_dialogue8012402.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8012402.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8012403.ch: 我已将仙法给你了，不如去我的店里看看别的。
drama_dialogue8012403.en: I've sold you my Heavenly Arts. Perhaps there are goods you need in my store.

drama_dialogue8013000.en: (After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

drama_dialogue8013001.ch: 想要得到仙法的话，那就先击败我的三成功力吧。
drama_dialogue8013001.en: Defeat 30% of my power first if you want my Heavenly Art.

drama_dialogue8013002.ch: 热爱之事，永远不会放弃！
drama_dialogue8013002.en: It's the passion of my life!

drama_dialogue8013003.ch: 凡事都祸福相依，虽然我是玉鸾族唯一不会音律的，但这也成为了我的杀手锏。
drama_dialogue8013003.en: Every cloud has a silver lining. Though I'm the only one in the Jade Bird Clan that is tone-deaf, it has become my trump-card.

drama_dialogue8013004.ch: 任何强者，在我绝对的速度下都无法抵抗。
drama_dialogue8013004.en: No one, however strong they are, is a rival for my speed.

drama_dialogue8013005.ch: 小沐晴真可爱，与众不同的可爱！当然，你也可爱。
drama_dialogue8013005.en: Muqing is so cute! So uniquely cute! Of course you are cute too.

drama_dialogue8013006.ch: 我也曾为自己的不一样而感到自卑，但后来我想明白了，这正是我的特点。
drama_dialogue8013006.en: I used to feel inferior for being different, but I later came around and see it as my feature.

drama_dialogue8013007.ch: 这八荒界似乎有我玉鸾族人的气息。
drama_dialogue8013007.en: I feel the existence of our Jade Bird Clan member here.

drama_dialogue8013008.ch: 咦？你身上有小沐晴的气息，你为何把她藏起来了。
drama_dialogue8013008.en: Hm? I seem to find Muqing here, just around you. Do you hide her from me?

drama_dialogue8013051.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8013051.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8013052.ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
drama_dialogue8013052.en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

drama_dialogue8013053.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8013053.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8013071.ch: 想要我使出几成功力呢？
drama_dialogue8013071.en: How much power do you want me to use?

drama_dialogue8013101.ch: 战胜我的三成功力，就将仙法给你。
drama_dialogue8013101.en: I'll give you my Heavenly Art if you defeat 30% of my power.

drama_dialogue8013201.ch: 你获得仙法后，沐晴好像突然感受到了什么，向你吵着闹着非要见此人：“茗雪是我们玉鸾族最厉害的将士了！沐晴小时候听过好多关于她上阵杀敌的故事呢，就让人家见见她嘛。”
drama_dialogue8013201.en: After you obtained the Heavenly Art, Muqing seems to feel something and insists on meeting this person, "Mingxue is the best warrior in our Jade Bird Clan! I've heard so many of her war legends since I was a child! Let me meet her!"

drama_dialogue8013202.ch: 一道光后，茗雪出现在你和沐晴面前，沐晴叽叽喳喳的说了许多。她听着沐晴的话，面容也缓和了不少。
drama_dialogue8013202.en: After a flash of light, Mingxue appears before you and Muqing. Muqing chatters to her happily, and hearing the words of Muqing, Mingxue's expression softens.

drama_dialogue8013203.ch: 再跟我过两招，胜过我的话就把仙法给你~
drama_dialogue8013203.en: Fight me again, and I'll give you my Heavenly Art if you win.

drama_dialogue8013204.en: Yeah... You are not that powerless.

drama_dialogue8013205.ch: 你看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可惜实在不堪入耳。
drama_dialogue8013205.en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing, but it's too harsh to any ears.

drama_dialogue8013206.ch: 你又看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可惜依旧那么不堪入耳。
drama_dialogue8013206.en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing again, but it's still too harsh to any ears.

drama_dialogue8013207.ch: 你又看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可是这次茗雪发现了你。她嗔怒的让你快些离开，你便赶紧走了。走时余光发现她耳朵有些红红的，似乎是很不好意思。
drama_dialogue8013207.en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing again, but she sees you this time. She is a little upset and urges you to leave her alone. You take your leave and notice her red ears. She seems a little embarrassed.

drama_dialogue8013301.ch: 你要是每月都让可爱的小沐晴教我音律，一年以后我就给你仙法！
drama_dialogue8013301.en: If you allow little Muqing to teach me music, I'll give you my Heavenly Art after one year!

drama_dialogue8013302.ch: 好呢，那以后每月的月末我会过来找你和小沐晴。
drama_dialogue8013302.en: Okay. I'll visit you two at the end of every month.

drama_dialogue8013303.ch: 沐晴拿出自己最爱的陶埙，却发现茗雪完全听不懂沐晴所讲的东西，只好又从基础的音律开始。
drama_dialogue8013303.en: Muqing takes out her most cherished xun, and begins her lessons. But Mingxue finds them too hard to grasp, then Muqing could only start from the ABC of music.

drama_dialogue8013304.ch: 沐晴教习音律第一月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013304.en: It's the first month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013305.ch: 沐晴教习音律第二月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013305.en: It's the second month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013306.ch: 沐晴教习音律第三月，茗雪一无所获，但你学会了。
drama_dialogue8013306.en: It's the third month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress. But you have made some progress.

drama_dialogue8013307.ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第一月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013307.en: It's the first month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013308.ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第二月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013308.en: It's the second month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013309.ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第三月，茗雪一无所获，她决定放弃音律，想直接学习弹琴。
drama_dialogue8013309.en: It's the third month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress. Then she decides to give up learning the theory and wants to learn the guqin right away.

drama_dialogue8013310.ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第一月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013310.en: It's the first month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013311.ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第二月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013311.en: It's the second month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013312.ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第三月，茗雪一无所获。
drama_dialogue8013312.en: It's the third month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

drama_dialogue8013313.ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第四月，茗雪一无所获，但她觉得自己有些长进。
drama_dialogue8013313.en: It's the fourth month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress, but she feels she has.

drama_dialogue8013314.ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第五月，茗雪一无所获还把琴弄坏了，但她觉得自己已经学会了。
drama_dialogue8013314.en: It's the fifth month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress except for how to break the instrument up, but she feels she has mastered it.

drama_dialogue8013315.ch: 我可是很守约的哦，仙法就给你啦。
drama_dialogue8013315.en: I never go back on my words. This Heavenly Art is yours now.

drama_dialogue8013401.ch: 哦？她何时也有这般闲情逸致了。
drama_dialogue8013401.en: Well? Is she so leisurely recently?

drama_dialogue8013402.ch: 可是，我没有琴啊。小沐晴呢？她应该可以制作一把琴。
drama_dialogue8013402.en: But I don't have a guqin. Where is Muqing? She could make one.

drama_dialogue8013403.ch: 沐晴睁着圆圆的眼睛，告诉你们当然可以。不过需要7根{itemLink5301102}哦。还有奥，你找到材料以后，记得把我所待着的法宝装备着哦。
drama_dialogue8013403.en: Muqing's eyes widen. She says she could certainly make a guqin, but she needs 7 {itemLink5301102}. She also reminds you to equip yourself with the Artifact she resides in after you find the material.

drama_dialogue8013404.ch: 你把材料拿出来交到沐晴手上，沐晴东敲敲西锤锤的，折腾了许久才完成。
drama_dialogue8013404.en: You gather the materials up and hand them to Muqing. Muqing then crafts a guqin after many times of hammering and chiseling.

drama_dialogue8013405.ch: 茗雪拿着琴就冲到了沧泷面前，开始弹琴。
drama_dialogue8013405.en: Mingxue rushes to Canglong with the guqin in hands and starts playing.

drama_dialogue8013406.ch: 然而，结局如你所预料的那般，不堪入耳。沧泷一脸呆滞地看着茗雪。
drama_dialogue8013406.en: However, as you expected, the tune is too harsh to any ears. Canglong gazes at Mingxue blankly.

drama_dialogue8013407.ch: 茗雪弹了整整五个时辰，沧泷也保持整整五个时辰的一脸呆滞。
drama_dialogue8013407.en: Mingxue plays for ten full hours, and Canglong keeps being dazed during that time.

drama_dialogue8013408.ch: 哼！！！真是对牛弹琴，气煞我也！
drama_dialogue8013408.en: What!!! The tune is beyond anyone's understanding!

drama_dialogue8013409.ch: 可是，我没有琴啊。玉鸾族之人在儿时都会上一门制作乐器的课，奈何我实在没有天赋。
drama_dialogue8013409.en: But I don't have a guqin. All members in our clan should attend a course on how to make musical instruments when we were children, though I truly know nothing about music.

drama_dialogue8013410.ch: 咦？！可爱的沐晴~看来她可以帮我做把琴！
drama_dialogue8013410.en: Oh, lovely Muqing! Maybe she could make a guqin for me!

drama_dialogue8013501.ch: 你，过来。让我发泄一下怒火！
drama_dialogue8013501.en: You, come here. I'll unleash my wrath upon you.

drama_dialogue8013502.ch: 哼。这还差不多。仙法就给你了。
drama_dialogue8013502.en: Hmph. Good. The Heavenly Art is yours now.

drama_dialogue8013601.ch: 哦？正好能给我找些事做，我最近可太无聊了。
drama_dialogue8013601.en: Oh? It'll be a chance for me to kill time. I'm so bored these days.

drama_dialogue8013602.en: All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you.

drama_dialogue8013603.ch: 既然如此，那就送给你个笛子吧。没事，不用过于感谢我，我做了好几百个笛子呢。
drama_dialogue8013603.en: Thus, take this flute as my gift. No need to thank me! I have made hundreds of them.

drama_dialogue8014000.en: (After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

drama_dialogue8014001.ch: 我近些时日有些忙碌呢。
drama_dialogue8014001.en: I'm a bit busy these days.

drama_dialogue8014002.ch: 什么？你问我是什么仙。这个嘛……我还有要事，改日再告知于你。
drama_dialogue8014002.en: What? You wonder what immortal I am? Well... I'm busy dealing with a critical matter now, and I'll tell you that someday.

drama_dialogue8014003.ch: 你这人，还真是！若是让你知道了本仙子的名字，岂不是就会被你一直缠着索要仙法，本仙可不会告知于你。
drama_dialogue8014003.en: What a naughty person! If you know my name, you'll keep bothering me for my Heavenly Arts! So I certainly won't tell you that.

drama_dialogue8014004.ch: 我同你讲，有颗药灵精他满嘴谎言，你若是遇到了可千万别信他一句话。
drama_dialogue8014004.en: Mind you, there is a Mushroom Man who tells lies all the time. Don't trust anything he says.

drama_dialogue8014005.ch: 我可不是无所事事的，其实我肩负着很重要的责任！
drama_dialogue8014005.en: I'm not idling around. I have a very sacred duty to fulfill!

drama_dialogue8014006.ch: 可算有些闲暇时间了，前些时日可真是忙死本仙子了。
drama_dialogue8014006.en: Finally, all my businesses are settled. I was buried with all sorts of matters days ago.

drama_dialogue8014007.ch: 平时本仙子有诸多事务，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些许闲暇。
drama_dialogue8014007.en: I'm occupied most of the time, and I can only find time in December every year.

drama_dialogue8014008.ch: 凡人们对本仙子可是非常崇拜的呢。
drama_dialogue8014008.en: All the mortals worship me devoutly!

drama_dialogue8014009.ch: 那颗药灵精真是口无遮拦。
drama_dialogue8014009.en: That Mushroom Man is so loose-lipped.

drama_dialogue8014010.ch: 我近些时日有些忙碌呢。
drama_dialogue8014010.en: I'm a bit busy these days.

drama_dialogue8014011.ch: 咦，你这法宝总竟还有器灵的存在。如此宝物，本仙子还未曾见过呢。
drama_dialogue8014011.en: Well, there is a spirit in your Artifact. I have never seen this treasure before.

drama_dialogue8014012.ch: 本仙子事务繁多，此处只是本仙子的一介分身。若想向本仙子祈愿，等到每年十二月吧，届时我会有几缕神识寄分身之上。
drama_dialogue8014012.en: I'm a busy Immortal, and this is only one of my many clones. If you want to make a wish, come back in December every year. I will leave some of my focus on this clone then.

drama_dialogue8014014.ch: 我可不是无所事事的，其实我肩负着很重要的责任！
drama_dialogue8014014.en: I'm not idling around. I have a very sacred duty to fulfill!

drama_dialogue8014015.ch: 可算有些闲暇时间了，前些时日可真是忙死本仙子了。
drama_dialogue8014015.en: Finally, all my businesses are settled. I was buried with all sorts of matters days ago.

drama_dialogue8014016.ch: 平时本仙子有诸多事务，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些许闲暇。
drama_dialogue8014016.en: I'm occupied most of the time, and I can only find time in December every year.

drama_dialogue8014017.ch: 凡人们对本仙子可是非常崇拜的呢。
drama_dialogue8014017.en: All the mortals worship me devoutly!

drama_dialogue8014018.ch: 那颗药灵精真是口无遮拦。
drama_dialogue8014018.en: That Mushroom Man is so loose-lipped.

drama_dialogue8014020.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8014020.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8014051.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8014051.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8014052.ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
drama_dialogue8014052.en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

drama_dialogue8014101.ch: 由于你并不知道此仙的名，你只好驱动念力称呼其为上仙，但似乎仙像并无任何反应。或许可以同其他仙人闲聊时旁敲侧击一番，知道其名字时就会有回应了。
drama_dialogue8014101.en: Because you don't know her name, you could only apply your Focus to communicate with her and address her as Your Immortal. However, the statue gives no reaction. Maybe you could ask about the name when you're chatting with other immortals, and maybe the Immortal before you would respond once she hears her true name.

drama_dialogue8014102.ch: 你想起曾经在蔽日仙菌口中得知的“紫姑”之名， 你便试着呼唤了一声。
drama_dialogue8014102.en: Suddenly, a name you've heard of from the Sun Blocking Heavenly Mushroom occurs to you. You try to call her as "Zigu".

drama_dialogue8014103.ch: 你如何得知了本仙子的名号的？！！
drama_dialogue8014103.en: How did you know my name?!

drama_dialogue8014104.ch: 哼。你不必说我也知道定然是那个老头子。
drama_dialogue8014104.en: Hmph. You see? I guess it was him, and I'm true.

drama_dialogue8014105.ch: 真是糟心。本仙子平日如此繁忙，好不容易有些闲暇可以作画。
drama_dialogue8014105.en: It's so annoying. I am busy everyday and could hardly find some time for painting.

drama_dialogue8014106.ch: 行吧，既然你能机缘巧合得知本仙子的名号，不如你来当本仙子的作画模特。
drama_dialogue8014106.en: Fine. Now that you know my name by chance, you could act as my model to be painted down.

drama_dialogue8014107.ch: 嗯？那日后可就没机会得到本仙子的仙法了哦。
drama_dialogue8014107.en: Eh? If you decline, I wouldn't give you my Heavenly Art in the future.

drama_dialogue8014108.ch: 你按照紫姑仙子的要求，摆出各种姿势让她作画。
drama_dialogue8014108.en: You make a variety of postures for her according to her requirements.

drama_dialogue8014109.ch: 本仙子还要把画裱起来，你且先回去吧。仙法就给你了。
drama_dialogue8014109.en: I am going to frame up the painting. You could go back. The Heavenly Art is given to you.

drama_dialogue8014201.ch: 哦？看来你对本仙子的画技非常认可。
drama_dialogue8014201.en: Oh? You found my painting beautiful?

drama_dialogue8014202.ch: 若要本仙子帮你，也不是不可以。只是……
drama_dialogue8014202.en: Surely, I would not decline to help you. But...

drama_dialogue8014203.ch: 本仙子缺一钟颜料，需要大量的{itemLink5341201}研磨而成。
drama_dialogue8014203.en: I have run out of a kind of pigment. It is made from lots of {itemLink5341201}.

drama_dialogue8014204.ch: 如果你能带来20个{itemLink5341201}，那么本仙子可以答应你的请求。日后闲暇之余，可以帮你作画。
drama_dialogue8014204.en: If you could bring 20 {itemLink5341201} to me, I'll undertake your commission. When I'm idle, I could paint for you.

drama_dialogue8014206.ch: 只见紫姑仙子将材料收下后，一顿研磨。然后拿起画笔，唰唰就画完了。
drama_dialogue8014206.en: Immortal Zigu fills the material into the mortar and grinds them for a long time. Then, she takes her brush and finishes the painting in just a few minutes.

drama_dialogue8014207.ch: 这可不是本仙子需要的。
drama_dialogue8014207.en: That's not what I've asked for.

drama_dialogue8014208.ch: 那你可得快些哦。不然再想见到本仙子，就是明年了。
drama_dialogue8014208.en: Hurry up then. Or you could see me only in the next year.

drama_dialogue8014301.ch: 当然可以，但是本仙子只会帮你画一幅哦。
drama_dialogue8014301.en: Surely. But I will only paint for you once.

drama_dialogue8014302.ch: 需要本仙子帮你画一副与器灵的画像吗？
drama_dialogue8014302.en: Do you need a portrait of you and your Artifact Spirit?

drama_dialogue8014303.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014303.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014304.ch: 你想与谁同在一幅画内？
drama_dialogue8014304.en: Who would you like to put at your side in the painting?

drama_dialogue8014305.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014305.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014306.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014306.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014307.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014307.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014308.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014308.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014309.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014309.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014310.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014310.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014311.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014311.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014312.ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
drama_dialogue8014312.en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

drama_dialogue8014401.ch: 都行，都行。不过本仙子没时间就是了。
drama_dialogue8014401.en: All right. But you know I'm very busy.

drama_dialogue8014402.ch: 本仙子的仙法已赐予你，好不容易有些闲暇，就不要再来扰我清净了，当然闲聊的话是可以的。
drama_dialogue8014402.en: All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you. I could hardly be idle like now, why do you come here to bother me? Well, if you just want to chat, then go ahead.

drama_dialogue8021000.en: (After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

drama_dialogue8021001.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8021001.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8021002.ch: 一剑破开仙门，踏于九重云霄之上。
drama_dialogue8021002.en: I broke the gate to the Heavenly Realm with one slash and rose above the clouds.

drama_dialogue8021003.ch: 多少次面对冷眼与嘲笑，我仍未放弃剑修之路。
drama_dialogue8021003.en: I met endless sneers and contempt, but I never gave up my path of sword.

drama_dialogue8021004.ch: 我今日要练剑，有何事下次再同我讲。
drama_dialogue8021004.en: I must practice sword today. Come back another day.

drama_dialogue8021005.ch: 我生来便是凡人，但凡人亦能逆天改命！
drama_dialogue8021005.en: I was born a mortal, but a mortal can also rewrite their destiny!

drama_dialogue8021006.ch: 若我在八荒界，定要与八荒第一剑修、刀修、火修……好好打一场。
drama_dialogue8021006.en: If I were here, I would be glad to duel with all No. 1 Cultivators in this world.

drama_dialogue8021021.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8021021.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8021041.en: How much power do you want me to use?

drama_dialogue8021051.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8021051.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8021052.ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
drama_dialogue8021052.en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

drama_dialogue8021053.ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
drama_dialogue8021053.en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

drama_dialogue8021101.ch: （你试图进入此地，但被仙力拦住。）
drama_dialogue8021101.en: (You try to go inside but are stopped by Heavenly Power.)

drama_dialogue8021102.ch: （你试图进入此地，但那个一团剑气让迷雾突然散开。）
drama_dialogue8021102.en: (You try to go inside, but that aura of sword suddenly dissipates the mist.)

drama_dialogue8021111.ch: 站住，我已无法抑制心中的杀意，遇见我算你倒霉！受死吧！
drama_dialogue8021111.en: Halt. I'm gonna kill someone today! Too bad it's got to be you!

drama_dialogue8021112.ch: 前辈，{itemLink7000305}乃我最珍贵的东西，还请前辈在收下后饶我一条性命…
drama_dialogue8021112.en: I have a treasure, this {itemLink7000305}! Please take it and spare my life...

drama_dialogue8021113.en: ... In that case, I'll be going.

drama_dialogue8021121.ch: 当你翻到最后一页时，竟掉落出一块剑碎。
drama_dialogue8021121.en: You turn to the last page, from which drops a sword fragment.

drama_dialogue8021122.en: Are you going to comprehend the stele of sword?

drama_dialogue8021123.ch: 你似乎对剑的理解更深刻了。
drama_dialogue8021123.en: You seem to have acquired more understanding of sword.

drama_dialogue8021124.ch: 你似乎什么也没有感悟到，或许先前那位道友所言的一年只能参悟一次乃事实。
drama_dialogue8021124.en: You seem to have comprehended nothing. The cultivator told to you the stele could only be comprehended once a year - perhaps it's true.

drama_dialogue8021125.ch: 你似乎什么也没有感悟到，或许在{itemLink7000305}或{itemLink7000306}里有参悟剑碑的奥秘。
drama_dialogue8021125.en: You try to comprehend it, but find nothing. Perhaps you could learn about the key to understand its inscription from {itemLink7000305} or {itemLink7000306}.

drama_dialogue8021131.ch: 想不到我找了这么久的{itemLink7000305}竟然在你身上。赶紧给我交出来！
drama_dialogue8021131.en: I have been looking for this {itemLink7000305} for a long time! Give it to me!

drama_dialogue8021132.ch: 想必你很想要这{itemLink7000306}吧。赶紧放了我，否则我就把它毁掉！
drama_dialogue8021132.en: You must want this {itemLink7000306} badly. Let me go, or I'll destroy it!

drama_dialogue8021133.ch: 哼！我都还没仔细琢磨琢磨就给你抢走了，卑鄙！
drama_dialogue8021133.en: Hmph! I haven't had enough time to study it yet! You villain!

drama_dialogue8021141.en: My friend, why are you still here?

drama_dialogue8021143.ch: 仙盟附近有一剑碑，只有登仙境之人才可接近，每年可参悟一次，参悟成功能获得剑资质增长。传闻，与一上古大能有关！
drama_dialogue8021143.en: There is a stele of sword near the Alliance. Only those of the Transcendent Realm can get near it, and it can be comprehended once a year. Those who manage to comprehend it will receive a bonus on Sword. According to the legend, the stele's power comes from a master cultivator centuries ago!

drama_dialogue8021144.ch: 在下方才也去参悟了一番，奈何并无所获。你若是感兴趣，就也去试试吧。
drama_dialogue8021144.en: I tried to comprehend it just now but failed. If you are interested, you may give it a try.

drama_dialogue8021146.ch: 无妨。待你日后感兴趣了，也可以再去尝试一番。
drama_dialogue8021146.en: That's all right. You may come back again in the future.

drama_dialogue8021151.ch: 你来剑碑之处，周围人群熙熙攘攘，随着最后一人的失败，大家也都悻悻离去。
drama_dialogue8021151.en: You arrive at the stele of sword and find a crowd of people gathering around it. With the failure of the last one, they are leaving in dismay.

drama_dialogue8021152.ch: 你走至剑碑面前，探出神识想试探一下。那块剑碎竟直接飞了进去。
drama_dialogue8021152.en: You walk over to the stele of sword and activate your focus to attempt it. To your surprise, that sword fragment flies straight into it.

drama_dialogue8021153.en: Suddenly, a beam of golden light bursts out of it.

drama_dialogue8021154.ch: 你被卷入了一个莫名的空间，你向着光的方向前行。
drama_dialogue8021154.en: You are dragged into a mysterious space, and you have no choice but to walk toward the light source.

drama_dialogue8021155.ch: 两侧的墙壁上皆是一名男子练剑的幻象。
drama_dialogue8021155.en: On the walls on the two sides are the phantoms of a man practicing sword.

drama_dialogue8021156.ch: 你一路向前走，但那名男子练剑的幻象似乎不停的出现在你的脑海中。你觉得此人似乎正是之前那本书里的剑修。
drama_dialogue8021156.en: You keep walking and can't help thinking about the phantoms of the swordsman. You feel it must be the sword cultivator in that book.

drama_dialogue8021158.ch: 走到路的尽头，是一处石桌。桌上有两本略有残损的密卷，似乎是{itemLink7000305}的其他残本。
drama_dialogue8021158.en: At the end of the path is a stone table, on which sit two slightly damaged books. They seem to be the other volumes of {itemLink7000305}.

drama_dialogue8021159.ch: 你读完这四本残卷后，突然有一团剑气围绕着你。似乎这团剑气与那座被迷雾掩盖住的仙祠，气息十分相似，你内心若有所思。
drama_dialogue8021159.en: After reading the four volumes, a swordsman's aura appears around you. You find the aura is somewhat similar to the shrine shrouded in mists, and you are occupied by some inexplicable thoughts.

drama_dialogue8021160.ch: 你又一次被卷入到了这个奇异的空间里，与之前不同的是挂着那副你所寻到的画。而你没有想到的是，剑一正在此地练剑。
drama_dialogue8021160.en: You are dragged into this strange space again. But this time, the painting you are looking for is hung right here. To your surprise, Jianyi is practicing sword here.

drama_dialogue8021161.ch: 看来你已经知道了我的所有故事。
drama_dialogue8021161.en: So you have heard about all my stories.

drama_dialogue8021162.ch: 我知道你前来所为何事。拿去吧
drama_dialogue8021162.en: I know why you come here. Take it.

drama_dialogue8021163.ch: （这道剑气与似乎某个建筑有关，不如前去探探？）
drama_dialogue8021163.en: (This sword aura seems to come from a building. Go there for investigation?)

drama_dialogue8021201.ch: 你若能战斗我的一成功力，仙法便归你所有。
drama_dialogue8021201.en: If you can defeat 10% of my power, my Heavenly Art will be yours.

drama_dialogue8021203.ch: 我的仙法并非何人都能得到，你若是还未积攒够实力，可去其他仙祠看看，有些仙人无需战斗也可获得仙法的恩赐。
drama_dialogue8021203.en: My Heavenly Arts are not bestowed upon everyone. If you're not powerful enough to obtain them, you could visit other Immortal Shrines - some immortals are willing to give you their Heavenly Arts without fighting.

drama_dialogue8021301.ch: 你倒是有些意思，可否要再与我过上两招？
drama_dialogue8021301.en: You look interesting. Do you want to fight me?

drama_dialogue8021303.ch: 你认为练剑的哪个境界最强？
drama_dialogue8021303.en: Which do you think is the top realm of swordsmanship?

drama_dialogue8021304.ch: 你再回去好好琢磨一番。
drama_dialogue8021304.en: Go and take your time to think it through.

drama_dialogue8021402.ch: 想你日后定大有所为，今日我便赐你一番造化。
drama_dialogue8021402.en: One day you will achieve something extraordinary. I'll teach you something today.

drama_dialogue8021403.ch: 我已经寻觅多年，剑修之中已无敌手。
drama_dialogue8021403.en: I have been searching for a worthy opponent for many years but only in vain.

drama_dialogue8021404.ch: 想不到你还是{appellationName|101|A}，那这次挑战可不会跟之前一样轻松了。
drama_dialogue8021404.en: Oh, you are {appellationName|101|A}. This challenge won't be as easy as before.

drama_dialogue8021405.ch: 想你日后定大有所为，今日我便赐你一番造化。
drama_dialogue8021405.en: One day you will achieve something extraordinary. I'll teach you something today.

drama_dialogue8021501.ch: 想必你也自己想要保护的人，那么我就给你一场额外的挑战。
drama_dialogue8021501.en: You must have someone you want to protect. I'll give you an extra challenge.

drama_dialogue8021502.ch: 当然，会比先前的更难。你可敢挑战？
drama_dialogue8021502.en: Of course, it will be more difficult than the previous one. Do you have the courage to take it up?

drama_dialogue8021503.ch: 拿去吧。希望你可以保护你想要保护的人。
drama_dialogue8021503.en: Take this. I hope you will be able to protect those you love.

drama_dialogue8021504.ch: 想必你也自己想要保护的人，那么我就给你一场额外的挑战。
drama_dialogue8021504.en: You must have someone you want to protect. I'll give you an extra challenge.

drama_dialogue8021601.ch: 这些已是尘封的过往，已经是太遥远的事情了。
drama_dialogue8021601.en: These are all stories in the ancient past.

drama_dialogue8021603.ch: 曾几何时，我也幻想过。和月儿过着简简单单的生活，带着她见我的养爹娘。
drama_dialogue8021603.en: Once upon a time, I dreamed about it. To live a simple life with Yue'er, and take her to meet my adoptive parents.

drama_dialogue8021604.ch: 如此，也好。那就麻烦你了。
drama_dialogue8021604.en: That would be fine. Thank you.

drama_dialogue8021605.ch: 听闻琼芳仙的画技了得，你可以去问问她。
drama_dialogue8021605.en: I have heard of the extraordinary painting technique of an Immortal titled the Jade Blossom. Perhaps you could discuss the matter with her.

drama_dialogue8021606.ch: 你是来将画的给我的吗？
drama_dialogue8021606.en: You are bringing the painting to me?

drama_dialogue8021607.ch: 多谢。想必挂在剑碑之内，应该很合适。
drama_dialogue8021607.en: Thank you. It will be a good decoration for the stele of sword.

drama_dialogue8021701.ch: 正愁无人与我比剑，来吧！
drama_dialogue8021701.en: I do want a sword opponent. Come!

drama_dialogue8021801.ch: 此事不妥。但你已决意加入的话，我不会反对。
drama_dialogue8021801.en: That's not proper. But I wouldn't prevent you if you are determined.

drama_dialogue8021802.ch: 我的仙法都已赐予你了。
drama_dialogue8021802.en: All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you.

drama_dialogue8021803.ch: 甚好！那么我将曾经儿时的剑赠予你。
drama_dialogue8021803.en: Very good! Then I'll give you the sword I used when I was a child.

drama_dialogue8030001.ch: 你看到前方有一人行色匆匆，走向一个充满仙力的建筑。
drama_dialogue8030001.en: You see someone in front of you. The person is hurrying into a building full of Heavenly Power.

drama_dialogue8030002.ch: 此人从储物戒拿出什么东西，虔诚地供奉，而后有一道光闪过。
drama_dialogue8030002.en: This person takes something out from the Interspatial Ring and offers it to the Shrine devoutly. Then a beam of light flashes by.

drama_dialogue8030003.ch: 敢问道友，这是在做甚？此建筑是何物？
drama_dialogue8030003.en: My friend, would you mind telling me, what are you doing? And what is the building for?

drama_dialogue8030004.ch: 此乃仙祠，为前些时日出现的，传闻是为供奉和参拜仙人所设，八荒各州皆有。
drama_dialogue8030004.en: This is an Immortal Shrine. They appeared just several days before. It is said to be built for worshiping and sacrifice offering, and you could find them in every corner of the world.

drama_dialogue8030005.ch: 据说诚心供奉足够数量的东西时，会得到仙人的回馈。似乎不同的仙祠，回馈的东西并不相同，道友若是感兴趣也可前去试试。
drama_dialogue8030005.en: You would be repaid by the Immortal if you offered enough sacrifices and expressed your true wish. Different Immortal Shrines can grant you different rewards, and you could visit them if you want.

drama_dialogue8030101.ch: 这位道友，看来你也是为仙法所来。
drama_dialogue8030101.en: My friend, maybe you come here for the Heavenly Art too.

drama_dialogue8030102.ch: 此乃剑仙的仙祠。无论是不是剑修，都会想要得到这个神秘剑仙的仙法，道友也是为此而来的吧。
drama_dialogue8030102.en: Here is the Shrine of Sword Sage. Whether my peers are Sword Cultivators or not, they all want to obtain the Heavenly Arts of the mysterious immortal. Do you come here for them too?

drama_dialogue8030103.ch: 既然如此，那么在下先告辞了。
drama_dialogue8030103.en: I see. Thus I'll depart. Goodbye.

drama_dialogue8030104.ch: 反正这些也是稍微打探一下就能知道的消息，告知于你也无妨。
drama_dialogue8030104.en: All of these are information easily to be known once inquired. Things won't go worse if I tell them to you.

drama_dialogue8030105.ch: 据说有几本关于此仙的话本残卷，残卷中有着参悟剑碑的方法。传闻，剑碑之内有着打开此仙祠的秘法。
drama_dialogue8030105.en: It is said that there are several incomplete collections of legends regarding this Immortal Shrine. The method for comprehending the stele of sword is recorded in those books. And, the secret technique for opening the Shrine is hidden in the stele.

drama_dialogue8030106.ch: 奈何在下寻觅多年，也未曾见过残卷的影子。或许此事不过是杜撰，又或许在下并无机缘。
drama_dialogue8030106.en: However, after years of finding, I still have no clue on the whereabouts of those collections. Maybe it's just another rumor, or maybe my destiny prevents me.

drama_dialogue8030107.ch: 不必言谢。那么，在下先告辞了。
drama_dialogue8030107.en: No need to thank me. Thus I'll depart. Goodbye.

drama_dialogue8039985.ch: 你的诚意，我已经感受到了。
drama_dialogue8039985.en: I have already seen your sincerity.

drama_dialogue8039986.ch: 咦？你居然供奉了如此之多的东西。
drama_dialogue8039986.en: Hm? You presented so many offerings.

drama_dialogue8039988.ch: 你的虔诚，我已经感受到了。
drama_dialogue8039988.en: I have already seen your faith.

drama_dialogue8039990.ch: 哦？想不到你倒是个颇有诚意的。
drama_dialogue8039990.en: Oh? Your wish is much more sincere than I thought.

drama_dialogue8039991.ch: 啾啾~凡人，既然你诚心诚意地供奉了。
drama_dialogue8039991.en: (Chirps) Good day, mortal! Your wish is truly sincere!

drama_dialogue8039992.ch: 多谢小友如此为我费心。
drama_dialogue8039992.en: Thank you, my friend, for being so considerate towards me.

drama_dialogue8039993.ch: 哦？！看来你对本座颇为敬仰。
drama_dialogue8039993.en: Oh! You must see me as your idol!

drama_dialogue8039994.en: Now I know your wish, and find it not feigned.

drama_dialogue8039995.ch: 本王倒是被你的诚心所感动。
drama_dialogue8039995.en: I am really moved by your good faith.

drama_dialogue8039996.ch: 哇哦，你居然给我送了这么多东西。
drama_dialogue8039996.en: Wow, so many offerings from you.

drama_dialogue8039997.ch: 既然你如此虔诚地供奉本尊，本尊又岂会吝啬。
drama_dialogue8039997.en: I am never a miser, especially when talking to such a pious follower.

drama_dialogue8039998.en: A trustworthy person surely deserves a reward.

drama_dialogue8039999.ch: 哇哦！你供奉了这么多的嘛。

drama_dialogue8040003.ch: 那这{0}你要吗？如果你要的话，我就把这个{0}赐予你。
drama_dialogue8040003.en: Do you want this {0}? If you want, I'll give it to you.

drama_dialogue8040006.ch: 那奴家也就不吝啬了。这{0}赏你了。
drama_dialogue8040006.en: It's good to be generous. Here, the {0} is yours.

drama_dialogue8040007.ch: 那么本仙就大发慈悲的恩赐你{0}吧！
drama_dialogue8040007.en: Then I should repay you a truly sincere gift as well! Here, accept this {0}!

drama_dialogue8040008.en: I wonder if this {0} would be useful to you.

drama_dialogue8040010.en: Is {0} the one you are looking for?

drama_dialogue8040011.en: I'll give you {0}. Do you like it?

drama_dialogue8040012.en: I should give you {0} in return.

drama_dialogue8040013.ch: {0}，本尊就大发慈悲的赠予你了。

drama_dialogue8040014.en: Is {0} something you are looking for?

drama_dialogue8040015.en: Perhaps this {0} would be useful to you.

drama_dialogue8040016.ch: 本仙子念在你如此虔诚的份上，就赐你{0}吧。
drama_dialogue8040016.en: I'll repay your piety with this {0}.

drama_dialogue8100000.ch: “仙道贵生,无量度人。”天宝道人行至你面前，你有些惊讶到此人为何而来。他却笑眯眯地摇着拂尘言道：“先前道友那只小妖，窃走我两颗道心果。本真人的箱子有些许空荡，道友意下如何？”
drama_dialogue8100000.en: "The Immortal Path cherishes those who live, and all of those cherished lives can be immortal." Seeing Sage Tianbao walking toward you, you feel surprised. But the Sage seems at ease. He waves his duster and asks with a smile, "I encountered your Imp some days before, it stole two Taoist Fruits from me. Now my casket is a bit empty, what do you think about it?"

drama_dialogue8100001.ch: 天宝道人一边掏出几个道心果，一边念叨着：“道友如此赏识，本真人自不是吝啬之人。”
drama_dialogue8100001.en: Tianbao takes several Taoist Fruits out and says, "My friend, thanks for your appreciation! And you know I am generous."

drama_dialogue8100002.ch: 天宝道人摆摆手，笑着说道：“也罢也罢，本真人自是不会与一小妖计较。”
drama_dialogue8100002.en: Tianbao waves his hand and speaks with the same smile, "Alright, then. A Sage should not be distracted to punish an imp."

drama_dialogue8100003.ch: 你的言论让天宝道人脸上出现一丝迷茫，他的眉头紧锁似在思索着什么。
drama_dialogue8100003.en: Perhaps your words bewildered Sage Tianbao. You could see his confused expression and furrowed brows. He must be thinking something.

drama_dialogue8100004.ch: 你滔滔不绝地讲着诸如“兽兽如此可爱……”之类的言论。天宝道人脸上的愧色愈发严重，最后竟塞给你一把灵石，泪眼婆娑地握着你的手要你好好对待小妖。
drama_dialogue8100004.en: You talk about things like "A cute beast encountered a cruel sage..." without pause. Tianbao's face is full of remorse, and, after you finally finished your speech, he fills your hands with Spirit Stones. Then, he grasps your hands and looks at you with tearful eyes, urging you to treat the Imp kindly.

drama_dialogue8100100.ch: 这日，你刚进入城镇，突然天宝道人拦住了你。先是说着“先前被你的小妖窃取行囊”，后又问道：“近来生意有些萧条，想烦请道友为我的算命摊子吆喝吆喝。道友可否愿意？”
drama_dialogue8100100.en: Today, you want to enter the town. But Sage Tianbao appears before you. "My pack was stolen by your Imp." He says, "And recently my business is not as prosperous as before. So I wonder if you'd like to assist me? That is, to call out for my fortune-telling stall."

drama_dialogue8100101.ch: 你一手举着签筒，一手拿着罗盘，卖力地吆喝着“天宝牌算命……”。城镇中众人一见是鼎鼎有名的你，皆纷纷围过来算命。
drama_dialogue8100101.en: "Here! Tianbao's fortune-telling..." You lift a pot of lots in one hand and hold a compass in the other, trying to attract customers by calling out. People have heard of your reputation before, and seeing such a famous person here, they all come to the stall to ask for their fortune.

drama_dialogue8100102.ch: 事毕，天宝道人提着一大袋灵石，直接分了你一半。
drama_dialogue8100102.en: After the business ends, Sage Tianbao comes to you with a large bag full of Spirit Stones. He gives you half of them as a reward.

drama_dialogue8100201.ch: 原来是那只小妖的主人，可否是来参加升仙大会？
drama_dialogue8100201.en: Oh, you're the master of that imp. Do you come here for the Immortal Tournament?

drama_dialogue8100301.ch: 虽说阁下的小妖的确乖巧讨喜，但老朽也不能破例让元婴境以下的修仙者参加升仙大会。
drama_dialogue8100301.en: Well... I know your imp is cute and clever, but I couldn't break our practice and allow a cultivator below Nascent Soul to attend the Tournament.

drama_dialogue8100401.ch: 道友，你身上似乎有妖兽的气息。
drama_dialogue8100401.en: Hey, I have sensed a breath of monsters on you.

drama_dialogue8100402.ch: 我先前曾与一生出灵智的小妖兽相谈甚欢，想不到竟是你的小妖。
drama_dialogue8100402.en: Recently I had a happy chat with an intelligent monster, and it's happier for me to know it is your imp.

drama_dialogue8100403.ch: 既同修仙者，不妨交个朋友，日后也好有个照应。道友意下如何？
drama_dialogue8100403.en: We are both cultivators, then what about we make friends? We could take care of each other in the future. What's your opinion?

drama_dialogue8100502.ch: 前些时日，我与一小妖谈论剑道许久，颇有收获。不仅心中好奇，如此奇才的妖兽是何人培养出来的。今日一见，阁下果然如我所想的那般气度非凡。
drama_dialogue8100502.en: Some days before, I had a long and fruitful discussion on swords with a little demon. So I'm curious about the master of such a talented imp. Now my guess is proven - you are indeed a brilliant person.

drama_dialogue8100503.ch: 上次与你的小妖探讨剑道，我为它的理论深深折服！
drama_dialogue8100503.en: Last time I discussed the art of swords with your imp, and I am so impressed by its theory!

drama_dialogue8100504.ch: 原来是赫赫有名的{appellation|A}，难怪手下的小妖也如此精通剑道。我日后也想成为像阁下这般的剑修！
drama_dialogue8100504.en: You are that reputable {appellation|A}! No wonder your imp knows so much about swords. I also want to be a master sword cultivator like you in the future!

drama_dialogue8100601.ch: 这位客人，上次你的壶妖迷路来到了此处，此般通人性的小妖我还是第一回见。
drama_dialogue8100601.en: Dear customer, last time your imp lost its way and went into my shop. I've never seen such a clever imp before.

drama_dialogue8100602.ch: 若非它要匆忙回去，我仅来得及塞了几块玉让它带回去玩。这次既然是你亲自到来，不如就赠送你一件衣服吧。
drama_dialogue8100602.en: But it said it would like to return soon, and I could only give it some pieces of jade as toys. Now that the imp's master is here, I would like to gift to you an Outfit.

drama_dialogue8100701.ch: 许久未见到你的小妖了，还有些许思念呢。
drama_dialogue8100701.en: I haven't seen your clever imp for days. I'm expecting its next visit.

drama_dialogue8100702.ch: 上次它说喜欢我这儿的天青水玉，阁下不如带回去几枚。
drama_dialogue8100702.en: Last time it said the Azure Jades in my shop are beautiful. Perhaps you could bring some back for it.

drama_dialogue8100801.ch: 我听闻妖兽皆爱炫彩之物，你的小妖应会很喜欢幻彩水玉。
drama_dialogue8100801.en: It is said that monsters like gleaming things. I guess it would like the Opal Jades, too.

drama_dialogue8100802.ch: 我这正好有好几枚，那便送给你吧。
drama_dialogue8100802.en: I found some pieces of that jade by chance. Here, you could take them.

drama_dialogue8100901.ch: 这附近冥气环绕，也不知你那小妖先前是如何来到此地的。
drama_dialogue8100901.en: This place is surrounded by Nether Air. I wonder how could you imp find the shrine here.

drama_dialogue8101001.ch: 你那只小妖颇有灵性，本仙甚是喜爱。
drama_dialogue8101001.en: Your imp is so ingenious, and I'm fond of it.

drama_dialogue8101002.ch: 以你的聪慧程度，确实也比较适合与小妖兽们交流。
drama_dialogue8101002.en: And you are ingenious too. A clever cultivator knows how to talk with those little monsters.

drama_dialogue8101003.ch: 我与梁渠也是以兽体修炼，你若有何关于妖兽的不解之处可以问我们。
drama_dialogue8101003.en: I and Liangqu both cultivate in the form of beasts. If you have any questions about beasts and monsters, just feel free to ask us.

drama_dialogue8101004.ch: 有些种族的妖兽能够感悟到修为人形的真谛，再辅以化形的丹药，就可以化为人形了。
drama_dialogue8101004.en: Monsters of some races could grasp the essence of cultivating into human form. If assisted by some elixirs for that purpose, they could finish form-changing and appear as human.

drama_dialogue8101005.ch: 当然了，并不是所有的种族都可以化为人形。譬如我，就无论如何都无法化为人形。
drama_dialogue8101005.en: Well, not all races can do that. For example, I couldn't change into a human no matter how many times I tried.

drama_dialogue8101006.ch: 我就喜欢你现在这般模样，看着不太聪明的样子。
drama_dialogue8101006.en: You look lovely in your current form, fluffy, yet ferocious.

drama_dialogue8101007.ch: 但似乎八荒界的妖兽几乎没有化为人形的，所以为了避免纷争，妖兽化为人形后也会极力伪装掉自己的先天特征。
drama_dialogue8101007.en: But we could hardly find monsters in this world appearing as humans. To avoid trouble, those human-formed monsters are all trying to conceal their innate traits.

drama_dialogue8101008.ch: 那当然就是历练了！妖兽只有吸收天地灵气，或是参与战斗，才可以不断变强。
drama_dialogue8101008.en: Join in adventures! If a monster wants to become stronger, it should absorb the Qi in this world, or gain experience through battles.

drama_dialogue8101009.ch: 最好是安排好历练的队伍，大家一起出发，会更为稳妥。
drama_dialogue8101009.en: It would be better to organize a team for those adventurers. Their journey would be safer if they act as teammates.

drama_dialogue8101010.ch: 梁渠就是当初历练的时候，傻乎乎的走丢了被我捡回去的。
drama_dialogue8101010.en: Maybe Liangqu is an example. He lost his way during an adventure and was found by me.

drama_dialogue8101011.ch: 我寻遍天材地宝，才堪堪救活他。也许受伤后的脑子有些后遗症吧，我推测这就是他现在如此不聪明的原因。
drama_dialogue8101011.en: I tried hard to cure him, using all of the Heaven and Earth Treasures I could find. But I guess he has never had a complete recovery from head wounds, judging from his somewhat foolish acts.

drama_dialogue8101012.ch: 似乎也有些可以提升妖兽实力的丹药，若是能寻到也可以达到一定的效果。
drama_dialogue8101012.en: I've also heard that some elixirs can be used to increase monsters' power. They may be of use if you found them.

drama_dialogue8101101.ch: 先前你那只小妖，不知为何跑到了我这里。
drama_dialogue8101101.en: Your imp went here some days before, and I don't know why.

drama_dialogue8101102.ch: 倒是颇为可爱，这些妖兽用的丹药便给你吧。
drama_dialogue8101102.en: But it is really cute! Here, take these Elixirs. These are made exclusively for monsters, and your imp may need them.

drama_dialogue8101103.ch: 双双大人永远是最好的双双大人！
drama_dialogue8101103.en: Our Shuangshuang is always the best immortal!

drama_dialogue8101202.ch: 本仙上次偷偷出去溜达，竟然捡到了化形丹，可惜本仙用不着。
drama_dialogue8101202.en: I slipped away for a strolling last time and found some Form-changing Elixirs by chance. However, I don't need it.

drama_dialogue8101203.ch: 你那些小妖倒是挺多，这些化形丹便送给你吧。
drama_dialogue8101203.en: I know you have many imps. So take them as my gift.

drama_dialogue8101301.ch: 远方道人走近，那是天宝。他跟你说：你就是那个小妖精的主子对吧？
drama_dialogue8101301.en: A Taoist priest walking toward you, you see it's Tianbao. He asks, "Are you the master of that imp?"

drama_dialogue8101302.ch: 天宝没等你回话就朝你手中塞了一笔不菲的资金。他声称这些都是他和你的壶妖合作的成果。
drama_dialogue8101302.en: Tianbao puts a huge amount of money into your hands before you could answer him. He says these are the profits gained from the cooperation with your imp.

drama_dialogue8101303.ch: 天宝道人说完，笑嘻嘻的转身走了。
drama_dialogue8101303.en: Then, Tianbao turns back and walks away with his characteristic smile.

drama_dialogue8101401.ch: 你看见远方一个道人渐渐走近，那是被揍得灰头土脸的天宝道人。
drama_dialogue8101401.en: You see a Taoist priest walking toward you slowly, and recognize it's Sage Tianbao. He looks disheveled, and you know he must be beaten by someone.

drama_dialogue8101402.ch: 据天宝所说，上次他与壶妖合计为一个修仙者算命被识破，这名修仙者愤怒之下追杀天宝三日夜并将他打成重伤。
drama_dialogue8101402.en: According to Tianbao, last time he and an imp tried to cheat a cultivator by fortune-telling, but their plan was seen through. The infuriated cultivator chased Tianbao for three whole days and beat him up.

drama_dialogue8101403.ch: 而天宝此来，乃是为了通知壶妖外出历练千万小心。
drama_dialogue8101403.en: And now he comes to tell you that, you must let your imps be more careful in adventure.

drama_dialogue8101404.ch: 他说完之后便一拐一拐的离开了。你未料天宝竟如此顾及义气，那是一个你没见识过的全新的天宝道人。
drama_dialogue8101404.en: Then, he staggers away. You're much surprised to find he is so altruistic. Perhaps you have encountered a whole, brand-new Sage Tianbao you have never known before.

drama_dialogue8101501.ch: 你看见天宝道人浑身创伤倒伏地上。
drama_dialogue8101501.en: You see Sage Tianbao lying on the ground. He seems heavily wounded.

drama_dialogue8101502.ch: 你接近天宝，却见他颤颤巍巍抬起头在低声说：上回……明明你的壶妖有份跟我一起算计旁人，为什么他们只找我的茬，不公平……
drama_dialogue8101502.en: You come closer. Tianbao raises his head and speaks with a trembling low voice, "Last time... Your imp and I planned to cheat someone, but why those people only punished me... That's unfair..."

drama_dialogue8101503.ch: 天宝语讫，头一歪晕倒地上。这天底下不公之事多如牛毛，你帮不了他，于是匆匆离开了。
drama_dialogue8101503.en: His head droops. Tianbao has fallen into unconsciousness, but you know there are too many unfair things in this world, and sadly, you couldn't help him for now. You leave him in a hurry.

drama_dialogue8101601.ch: 远方一名修仙者逐渐走近，然而照面后此人却变得十分惊慌。
drama_dialogue8101601.en: You see a cultivator comes from afar. But seeing you're here, this person seems terrified.

drama_dialogue8101602.ch: 对不起，当日是我有眼不识泰山冒犯壶妖大爷了！今后不敢了，再不敢了！
drama_dialogue8101602.en: I'm sorry! I failed to recognize your imp and offended it last time, and it's my fault! I will be more careful! I won't do it again!

drama_dialogue8101603.ch: 这大概是你的壶妖捣蛋作弄的人儿，而此人边说边跑，眨眼间已经不见了人影。
drama_dialogue8101603.en: Perhaps this person is just the target of your imp's trick. Now, the cultivator flees from you, murmuring words of apology. Soon, the person is gone.

drama_dialogue8101701.ch: 远方修仙者渐渐走近，此人看见你后竟瞬间神色大变。
drama_dialogue8101701.en: A cultivator comes from afar. Seeing you're here, the person's face is saddened.

drama_dialogue8101702.ch: 你……你是那壶妖的主人？！当日我追杀壶妖，未料失手遭擒……你的壶妖怎么敢对我……对我……
drama_dialogue8101702.en: You... You're the master of that imp?! That day I chased after the imp, but my attack was missed and I got captured... Then your imp... your imp did such...

drama_dialogue8101703.ch: 你的壶妖是臭流氓，你也是！！我不活了。
drama_dialogue8101703.en: Your imp is a villain, and so are you! I'd better bury myself!

drama_dialogue8101704.ch: 该修仙者突然泪眼滂沱，边哭边跑，片刻没影了。
drama_dialogue8101704.en: Suddenly, the cultivator bursts into tears and flees from you. Soon, the person is gone.

drama_dialogue8101801.ch: 你在路上遇见一名修仙者，此人与你照面后突然怒目瞪圆。
drama_dialogue8101801.en: You encounter a cultivator on your way. Seeing you're here, the person's eyes are glaring with fury.

drama_dialogue8101802.ch: 你知道你的壶妖折磨了我十二个时辰吗？士可杀，不可辱！太过分了！
drama_dialogue8101802.en: Do you know your imp tortured me for a whole day? A cultivated person can be killed, but cannot be humiliated! You've gone too far!

drama_dialogue8101803.ch: 没、没怎样！我……我就让你记住，让那壶妖记住，不要让我再看见它！
drama_dialogue8101803.en: I want... I want nothing! I... I just want you to remember this! And, warn the imp! Don't let me see it again!

drama_dialogue8101804.ch: 此人似乎有点失措，说完急急忙忙的跑了。
drama_dialogue8101804.en: This person seems a bit awkward. You see the cultivator flees from you hurriedly after telling you all of these.

drama_dialogue8101901.ch: 一名修仙者一瘸一瘸走到你面前，然后仰起了脸。
drama_dialogue8101901.en: A cultivator comes staggering before you and raises their face.

drama_dialogue8101903.ch: 你……壶妖……害我……舌头瘫痪……全身麻痹……
drama_dialogue8101903.en: Your... Imp... My tongue... numbed... got paralyzed...

drama_dialogue8101904.ch: 你正觉疑惑，想要上前倾听，这人瞥见你身上炼妖壶，突然神色大变，立即瘸着脚跑了。
drama_dialogue8101904.en: You feel bewildered and step forward to listen. However, the cultivator glimpses at the Mythical Gourd you're carrying and seems terrified. Then, the person flees from you in awkward steps.

drama_dialogue8102001.ch: 一名修仙者自你身边经过，此人看见你后，露出愤怒的神色。
drama_dialogue8102001.en: A cultivator passes by you. Seeing you're here, this person seems infuriated.

drama_dialogue8102002.ch: 你的壶妖在我突破之际，从旁捣乱，让我分心走火，全身瘫痪，更可恨的是之后还趁我动弹不得之际，取走我的突破仙材。这笔账应该怎么算？！
drama_dialogue8102002.en: Your imp kept disturbing me when I'm making breakthrough, and I got paralyzed due to Qi Deviation triggered by distraction. What's more, after found I cannot move, it took my materials for breakthrough! How could all of these be settled?!

drama_dialogue8102003.ch: 你正打算召唤只壶妖给修仙者道歉，未料眼前之人神色大变，撒腿就跑，还高呼“你给我记着”。
drama_dialogue8102003.en: You try to summon that imp here to apologize for its conduct, but to your surprise, the cultivator's face turns pale. Then, the person escapes from you, yelling "Remember this!".

drama_dialogue8102004.ch: 壶妖究竟对此人做了什么……
drama_dialogue8102004.en: What has the Imp done to that person...

drama_dialogue8102101.ch: 前方一名修仙者急步走近，而此人似乎是冲你来的。
drama_dialogue8102101.en: You see a cultivator walks toward you with furious steps. Maybe you have done something to this person before.

drama_dialogue8102102.ch: 赔钱！一千灵石！你的壶妖故意在我突破之时从旁捣乱，害我走火入魔，吃了足足10颗九品圣阳丹才好过来！
drama_dialogue8102102.en: Compensate me! 1000 Spirit Stones! Your imp kept disturbing me when I was trying to make breakthrough, and got me Qi Deviated! I took 10 Sacred Sun Elixirs to recover!

drama_dialogue8102103.ch: 算你识相！这桩恩怨就此了结！
drama_dialogue8102103.en: Fine, you're at least sensible! Things are settled now!

drama_dialogue8102104.en: But I warn you, be careful!

drama_dialogue8102201.ch: 远处走来一名修仙者，此人看见你后突然露出愤怒的表情。
drama_dialogue8102201.en: You see a cultivator comes from afar. Suddenly, seeing you're here, this person becomes infuriated.

drama_dialogue8102202.ch: 可恶！你的壶妖让我被那个万恶的宗门扣留，我在那里面受尽非人的对待！你以后最后别放出那只壶妖，不然……不然……
drama_dialogue8102202.en: You villain! I got detained by that wretched sect due to your Imp and underwent horrible tortures! You should better never let that Imp out again, or... Or...

drama_dialogue8102203.ch: 我偷窃灵果有错，可他们怎么能逼迫我吃下一百斤灵果核！
drama_dialogue8102203.en: Yes, I stole the Spiritual Fruits, it's my fault. But how should they force me to swallow dozens of pounds of fruit kernels!

drama_dialogue8102204.ch: 此修仙者心中阴影面积不可计算，边哭边跑，早去得远了。
drama_dialogue8102204.en: That person must have experienced the most terrible thing in this world. You see the cultivator runs away with so many teardrops shedding on the ground.

drama_dialogue8102301.ch: 远处走来一名修仙者，此人看见你后突然露出愤怒的表情。
drama_dialogue8102301.en: You see a cultivator comes from afar. Suddenly, seeing you're here, this person becomes infuriated.

drama_dialogue8102302.en: Well... You know them all, yes?

drama_dialogue8102303.ch: 我盗取别人宗门的灵果遭到你的壶妖察觉结果被拿下，此事请你不要声张，这是一点心意……
drama_dialogue8102303.en: I stole some Spiritual Fruits from a sect, but your Imp discovered me, and I was captured. Please keep this a secret. Here, for your silence...

drama_dialogue8102304.ch: 这人朝你手中塞了3000灵石，你正感莫名其妙，此人便已急步跑了开去了。
drama_dialogue8102304.en: This person puts 3000 Spirit Stones into your hands. You feel bewildered, but the person has run away.

drama_dialogue8102401.ch: 一名修仙者从远处走来，此人看见你后，神色立即变得十分愤怒。
drama_dialogue8102401.en: You see a cultivator comes from afar. Seeing you're here, the cultivator becomes infuriated.

drama_dialogue8102402.ch: 哼，别以为我不晓得，你的壶妖盗走了我的资质书的！
drama_dialogue8102402.en: You! I'm not an idiot, and I know who stole my stat book - your Imp!

drama_dialogue8102403.en: Eh?! How... How could you know?

drama_dialogue8102404.ch: 这名修仙者瞬间变得十分惊慌，左右张望一下，便即急急忙忙的跑了。
drama_dialogue8102404.en: This cultivator‘s confidence is lost in a moment. You see the person looking around briefly before running away from you hastily.

drama_dialogue8102501.ch: 一名修仙者从远处走来，看见你后，神色有点不自在。
drama_dialogue8102501.en: You see a cultivator comes from afar. Seeing you're here, the cultivator is somewhat embarrassed.

drama_dialogue8102502.ch: 你……你看见一本资质书吗？那是我大意丢了。这书……好像是丢在这附近，怎么找不着了……
drama_dialogue8102502.en: Do you... find a Stat Book? I lost it because I'm forgetful. Perhaps this book... could be found around here, but why I haven't seen it...

drama_dialogue8102503.ch: 这修仙者在附近搜寻，不时疑神疑鬼的用眼神打量你，最终充满疑惑的离开了。不过此人万万没想到，这偷走的资质书，最终你的壶妖取走了吧？
drama_dialogue8102503.en: This cultivator walks around to find the book. Sometimes you could feel this person's doubting gaze. Finally, the cultivator leaves here with many unsolved questions. It must be astonishing to find that the stolen stat book has been taken by your Imp.

drama_dialogue8102601.ch: 一妖兽在你面前停了下来，嗅着鼻子似乎在寻找着什么？突然怒目瞪着你，大吼一声向你扑了过来......
drama_dialogue8102601.en: A monster stops before you. It keeps sniffing around, and you wonder what it is looking for. Then, it glares and charges at you after a furious roar...

drama_dialogue8102602.ch: 击败妖兽后，才听得你的壶妖说此妖兽是它在外出历练时招惹的。原来，壶妖们已经融入到这个世界中了，不知这对你是福还是祸。（可从炼妖壶--历练编队---右下角的历练日志中查看壶妖的历练行为）
drama_dialogue8102602.en: You defeated the monster, and your Imp admits that it provoked the monster during an adventure. Your Gourd Imps have become part of the world - is this an event worth celebrating or worrying about? (You can learn about your Imp's actions during the adventure from Mythical Gourd -- Teaming -- Adventure Log at the bottom right)

drama_dialogue8102603.ch: 道友，久仰大名。前些日子偶遇道友妖兽在行侠仗义，着实令在下佩服。今日备了一壶好酒登门拜访！不知道友可有闲暇？
drama_dialogue8102603.en: Peer cultivator, I've long heard of your name. Recently I encountered monsters upholding justice, and they told me that they were following your instructions. I think such a chivalrous cultivator will be a good friend, and I come here to visit you with a bottle of mellow liquor. Are you available now?

drama_dialogue8102604.ch: 你们找了一处谧静之处摆酒畅饮，相谈甚欢！
drama_dialogue8102604.en: You have a drink with the person in a quiet place and chat happily.

drama_dialogue8103101.ch: 嗯？你发现回来的壶妖身上有封拜帖。
drama_dialogue8103101.en: You find a visiting letter from one of your imps returned from adventure. What is this for?

drama_dialogue8103102.ch: 道友，久仰久仰，在下曾在游历时见识过道友座下妖兽的行为，不禁惊叹道友这御妖之术，今日特备薄礼来与道友结识！
drama_dialogue8103102.en: Peer cultivator, I've long heard of your reputation. I have seen your mighty monsters during my journey, and I am impressed by your brilliant commanding technique. Today, I came here to visit you with a gift.

drama_dialogue8103103.ch: 今日有个不情之请，想仔细观摩一下道友的妖兽，不知道友能否满足？
drama_dialogue8103103.en: By the way, would you like to do me a little favor? I want to inspect your monster at a closer distance.

drama_dialogue8103104.ch: 那今日就不打扰道友了。告辞。

drama_dialogue8103105.ch: 恕在下失礼了。鄙人在御妖之术上也有所探究，我炼制的蚤妖，会寄生在妖兽身上三个月，三个月后就会因寿元而死亡，在下平常就是靠它来寻找妖兽的。
drama_dialogue8103105.en: Pardon my rashness. I also know the technique of commanding monsters, and I created a flea-like minion before. The little creature will find a beast to live on them for three months before it dies, which can be used as my guide for tracking monsters.

drama_dialogue8103106.ch: 你抬手祭出炼妖壶，在丑道人面前唤出壶妖。只见丑道人神情激动，冲过来对着壶妖就是一阵探查，不时就听见其嘴里在嘟哝着“噢，有天道压制”“幻化真身时间有限制”等。是否打断他？
drama_dialogue8103106.en: You take your Mythical Gourd and summon the imps out in front of him. The Ugly Sage immediately starts his inspection in an excited manner. Occasionally, you could hear him murmuring phrases like "suppressed by the Heavenly Path" or "true form exists only in a short time". Try to stop him?

drama_dialogue8103107.ch: 道友，好久不见。在下的御兽之道已多年未得精进，非常想观摩一下道友的妖兽，特备薄礼上门拜见，不知道友能否满足？
drama_dialogue8103107.en: Long time no see, peer cultivator. My technique of commanding monsters has not been improved for many years, and now I must ask you a favor. Would you mind releasing some of your monsters for me to inspect? I prepared a gift for this.

drama_dialogue8103108.ch: 是在下激动了，此次近距离观摩实在是受益匪浅！现在脑中灵感源源不断地涌出，得尽快回去整理一番，就先告退了！
drama_dialogue8103108.en: I'm so glad to have the chance! This inspection has already granted me many insights now, and I must return home to write them down. Goodbye!

drama_dialogue8103109.ch: 只见丑道人从储物戒中取出一些似是法阵相关的器物一阵摆弄，又唤出一枚蕴含灵气的丹药悬放在空中......
drama_dialogue8103109.en: You see the Sage taking out something from his Interspatial Ring and arranging them into a pattern of an array. Then, he summons an elixir full of Qi in front of him...

drama_dialogue8103110.ch: 是在下激动了，此次近距离观摩实在是受益匪浅！现在脑中灵感源源不断地涌出，得尽快回去整理一番，就先告退了！
drama_dialogue8103110.en: I'm so glad to have the chance! This inspection has already granted me many insights now, and I must return home to write them down. Goodbye!

drama_dialogue8103111.ch: 只听得丑道人一声阵起，这周围顿时雷云密布，更有一股强大的威压从云内降下，你有种不详的预感......
drama_dialogue8103111.en: The Ugly Sage activates the array with a shout, and dark clouds soon gather above you two. Overwhelming coercion comes from the sky, and you feel something bad is going to happen...

drama_dialogue8103112.ch: 不消片刻，丑道人突然怒目圆睁，向着雷云方向吼道：我不怕你！！！一道极快的雷柱随之从天而下，直直劈向法阵中的丑道人......还好你提前收回了壶妖。
drama_dialogue8103112.en: Seconds after, the Ugly Sage glares at the clouds above him and yells, "I'm NOT afraid of you!" Then, a sudden lightning bolt strikes him at the center of the array... Fortunately, you have already ordered your imps to hide in the Gourd.

drama_dialogue8103113.ch: 哈哈哈，小小天道，不过如此。道友你没事吧，我这还有一些丹药你且拿去。
drama_dialogue8103113.en: Hahaha. Just a heavenly, petty path. Do you get injured? I have some elixirs, please take them.

drama_dialogue8103114.ch: 今日心满意足了，此次观摩实在是受益匪浅！刚刚我测试了一下天道，证明之前我的一些猜想是完全正确的，对我今后的计划特别有帮助，在此再次感谢道友的鼎力相助！
drama_dialogue8103114.en: My wish has been fulfilled! This inspection has already granted me much insight, and I have made a test on the Heavenly Path. Now some of my guesses are proven, and my next steps are clear. Thanks for your generous help again!

drama_dialogue8103115.ch: 道友可听过天佑之人？相传得天独厚者，为上苍所眷，十步化龙，百步登仙。呵呵，可笑至极，代价却是苦痛与灾难！而我，就是其中的一个可怜虫，天罡五雷道体之人。
drama_dialogue8103115.en: My friend, have you heard of the heaven-blessed persons? It is said that some people are so unique that they are blessed. They can transform into dragons and ascend into the Immortal Realm within dozens of steps - that's incredible, yes? But their blessings always come with disasters. The Thunderborn, that's what some of them are called, and I am one of those poor persons.

drama_dialogue8103116.ch: 我的丹道需要大量的灵气，道友下回多备些灵石，在下定当知无不言，言无不尽。
drama_dialogue8103116.en: My alchemical insights require a lot of Qi. You may bring more Spirit Stones the next time, and I'll tell you all I know.

drama_dialogue8103117.ch: 多谢抬爱，只是在下不希望再与他人有过深的纠葛。人还是太脆弱了，不保护好就会容易生息消散。呃，抱歉，不由自言自语了。
drama_dialogue8103117.en: Thanks for your kind proposal, but I do not want to get involved in complex personal relationships again. Humans are fragile, and mere turbulence could destroy them if they forget to be careful... Well, never mind! I am talking to myself.

drama_dialogue8103119.ch: 雷击过后，周围郁结的雷云也随之消散。法阵中央的丑道人浑身发出滋滋的电光，身上的法器似乎都被摧毁得差不多了。只见他一抖身，转头对着你，仿佛他正透过面具对你咧了一下嘴......
drama_dialogue8103119.en: The sky clears after the tremendous strike. Electric sparks emerge from the Sage's body, and you notice nearly all of the artifacts on him are destroyed. Then, he shivers and turns his head to you. You seem to see a faint smile on the face under the mask...

drama_dialogue8103201.ch: 道友，我驯化了一只筑基期的妖兽，若你的壶妖能打败我的妖兽，我可以给你一些好丹药。
drama_dialogue8103201.en: My friend, I have tamed a monster in Foundation realm. If your imp can defeat it, I will give you some excellent elixirs.

drama_dialogue8103202.ch: 此地不是我们论道的风水宝地，道友且随我来。
drama_dialogue8103202.en: This place is not a good choice for our contest. Please follow me.

drama_dialogue8103203.ch: 如此也好，在下寻得一宝地并改其大势，有利于我们论道，道友有空就过来寻我。
drama_dialogue8103203.en: Alright. I found a place and modified it into a good location for our contest. Find me there once you are available.

drama_dialogue8103204.ch: 终把道友盼来，我们开始吧，我可是对我的妖兽非常有信心的！
drama_dialogue8103204.en: Finally, you're here. Let's begin the contest! I am confident in the strength of my monster.

drama_dialogue8103205.ch: 终把道友盼来，都怪道友来得太慢，我不小心把妖兽的修为喂养到结晶境了，你可得小心了。
drama_dialogue8103205.en: Finally, you're here. You must be very busy, and my monster has grown into another realm when we're waiting for you. Tell your imp to be careful when fighting an opponent in Qi Condensation.

drama_dialogue8103206.ch: 厉害厉害，你赢了，道友的壶妖真是非比寻常，这是答应你的东西，道友且收好。在下就先告辞了。
drama_dialogue8103206.en: Good, you win! Your imp is really extraordinary. These are the things I promised. Now they're yours. Goodbye.

drama_dialogue8103207.ch: 道友的壶妖棋差一招，或许道友换一只再来和我比试比试？我这丹药想送你都送不出去了。
drama_dialogue8103207.en: Maybe your imp is not in the mood for fighting. Perhaps you could summon another imp and try again? I have prepared elixirs as your reward.

drama_dialogue8103208.ch: 道友，这地方不错吧，这里的天道被我的大阵屏蔽了，你的壶妖可以一直在此幻化真身，我称之为小灵界。
drama_dialogue8103208.en: My friend, this is a wonderful place for the contest. The Heavenly Path here is blocked by my grand array, and your imp could exist in its true form without any limitation. I call here "Spiritual Realm in Miniature".

drama_dialogue8103301.ch: 远远看到丑道人对着前方的村庄一阵发呆，连你靠近都未发现。
drama_dialogue8103301.en: You see the Ugly Sage standing in the distance, gazing at the village beyond. He is lost in thoughts and is not aware of your approach.

drama_dialogue8103302.ch: 哎呀，道友，好久不见，你也发现了此地的异样了呀。
drama_dialogue8103302.en: Hey, long time no see, my friend. Isn't there a peculiar place?

drama_dialogue8103303.ch: 这几日此村庄就会有天佑之人降世，你看村子上方这奇异的扭曲感，这是天道规则在为这孩子的降世做的准备，只要孩子出世，降生劫就会降下......然后带走附近所有的生息。
drama_dialogue8103303.en: A heaven-blessed baby will be born here after a few days. Have you noticed the twisted air above the village? The Heavenly Path is preparing for the child's birth. At the time the baby comes into our world, a trial will fall upon here... and all lives around the place will be wiped out.

drama_dialogue8103304.ch: 丑道人说完就又转过头深深地望向这个村庄，眼神看似在盯着村庄，却又像看向远方......你打算？
drama_dialogue8103304.en: The Ugly Sage falls into silence. He gazes into the distance again, but you are not certain whether he is looking at the village or at the distant horizon... What will you do?

drama_dialogue8103305.ch: 目前，我有两个选择。第一个，对孩子的母亲施术，延缓他的出生，但只能延缓三年，三年内若不能找到解决之法，这孩子的降世就阻止不了了，而我，将回来......“避免”天佑之子的降世。第二个，布阵暴力剥去此子精神志魂魄五气，让天道无法感知这孩子的降世，从而不会降下劫难；只不过这孩子将得不到任何天道的眷顾，落得一副极度贫弱不堪的身躯。唉，此阵我已布下，若是道友你会如何......
drama_dialogue8103305.en: Now I have two choices. First, I could cast a spell on the mother to halt the baby's birth, but it is effective for only three years.
