After that, if I still couldn't find a way to counter the trial, the child would be born, and I would return here... to "prevent" a heaven-blessed baby's arrival. Second, I could try to unfold an array and deprive the five spirits of the child to confuse the Heavenly Path's perception. I could keep the trial away with it, but the poor child will become weak and feeble due to the lack of heavenly blessing. Alas! I have already set the array, and I would like to know your opinion...

drama_dialogue8103307.ch: 若按照此法，我需要赚取大量的灵石才能有一丝之机，道友可否资助本人一些？
drama_dialogue8103307.en: I see. I will try my best to find the solution, but I also need a lot of Spirit Stones to achieve it. Would you like to fund me some?

drama_dialogue8103308.ch: 我且送道友离开，在下要起阵了。
drama_dialogue8103308.en: Now I'll activate the array. Let me send you to a safer place.

drama_dialogue8103309.ch: 你阻止了丑道人，并告诉他应当尊重事物发展的径向，这孩子自会有他的人生，我们不该自持修为而去剥夺别人的先天气运，改变他人的命运。
drama_dialogue8103309.en: You try to dissuade the Ugly Sage. You tell him that we should respect the way things develop and flourish, and you believe the baby will have a unique path that is not subject to alteration. You also said that any attempt to change someone's destiny is unacceptable, especially if it is made by persons more powerful than others.

drama_dialogue8103310.ch: 感谢，我这还有一张丹方赠予道友，未来道友估计能用得上，且收好！
drama_dialogue8103310.en: Thank you. I have an Elixir Recipe that may be useful to you. Here, take it!

drama_dialogue8103311.ch: 说罢，丑道人就径直向村子飞去。望着他坚毅的背影，你的内心似有所感......
drama_dialogue8103311.en: Then, the Ugly Sage flies away toward the village. Seeing the fearless figure disappearing in the distance, you feel some inexplicable thoughts...

drama_dialogue8103312.ch: 你被移至远处，只见整个村子逐渐变得模糊，伴随一阵大雾升起，凝结在村子上方的异常扭曲感也渐渐消失。
drama_dialogue8103312.en: You appear in a place far away from the spot. Then, mists gather around the village and envelop it, and you feel the twisted air above it melts away.

drama_dialogue8103313.ch: 道友勿要多言，天地之道，不存我眼。随心随性亦各有定论。吾辈修仙者本就逆天而行，莫要乱了自己的道心。若让这孩子一出生就背负生灵的性命，他的未来又该何去何从？道友，你是大智慧之人，此次事态较急，在下已无时间与道友探讨这其中的对错了，我先送你出去。
drama_dialogue8103313.en: I see, but please save your words. There are many paths in our world, and there is no definite guide about which to follow. What we must care about is following the call of our Taoist Mind, since being a cultivator is, after all, being a determined challenger against our destiny. Furthermore, if lives were sacrificed because of a baby's arrival, what would the child think when the tragedy is revealed someday? My friend, I believe in your wisdom, but we could only discuss moral matters later. I'll send you to a safer place.

drama_dialogue8103314.ch: 还未等你说话，只见你脚下一闪，你人已在远处。你望向村子方向，随着一阵大雾升起，村子渐渐被大阵隐藏，盘旋在村子上方的异常扭曲感也随之消失了。你选择？
drama_dialogue8103314.en: You try to say something, but after a flash from under your feet, you emerge in another place. Mists gather around the village as the grand array gently forms a screen above it, dispelling the twisted air there. Now, what will you do?

drama_dialogue8103315.ch: 大阵因你的攻击而微微震荡，只听得其中传来丑道人的声音：虚伪之辈，若不是你的修为高于我。我定灭你。随后整个大阵连同村子一齐从你眼前消失了，估计这又是丑道人的手笔。
drama_dialogue8103315.en: The grand array shakes a bit under your attack. You hear the Ugly Sage speaking from it, "What a hypocrite! Pity that my cultivation is lesser than yours, or I'd also wipe you out!" Then, the array, as well as the village, disappear before your eyes. Perhaps the Ugly Sage's spell takes effect.

drama_dialogue8103316.ch: 因你的修为不够，大阵并未收到影响，隐约从中传来了丑道人的嗤声。
drama_dialogue8103316.en: The grand array remains firm - your power is insufficient to break it. You hear the Ugly Sage's ironic comments from within the array.

drama_dialogue8103317.ch: 世事经年流转，天地沧海桑田，为自然所趋。然天道确有不公，仿佛于万事万物之中早已设好命运轮转之理，好似生命如草芥，孰生孰死已有定数。可......若真有天之道、地之道，人之道、妖之道，又何谓天之道、地之道，人之道、妖之道？吾辈修仙亦是逆天而行，自不会随了它的心意。
drama_dialogue8103317.en: Time elapses, and our world changes; perhaps it is the foremost principle of the universe. However, who set the Heavenly Path and arranged the fates of all living things? People live and die, and plants flourish and wither, but are their destinies fair and just? If there is a set path for everything to follow, why would there be myriad choices, crossroads, and consequences? We're cultivators; we cultivate ourselves against our fate. A tried and tested path is not for us.

drama_dialogue8103321.ch: 道友巧了不是，我刚想去找你。我把一只金丹境的于儿神骗进了我的大阵里了，你让你的壶妖来和它比试一下可以不？若能赢它，就教你壶妖修为丹的炼制方法！
drama_dialogue8103321.en: You're here, my friend! I just want to find you! I trapped a Yu'er Shen in Golden Core realm into my grand array. Now, do you want to summon some imps and have a contest with it? I will teach you how to concoct Imp EXP Elixir if your imps can win!

drama_dialogue8103322.ch: 那我多困它几日，道友若准备好则来此找我。
drama_dialogue8103322.en: I see. I'll keep it in the trap for some days, and you could return here at any time once you're prepared.

drama_dialogue8103323.ch: 道友巧了不是，我刚想去找你。我把一只金丹境的于儿神骗进了我的大阵里了，你让你的壶妖来和它比试一下可以不？若能赢它，我给你20粒极意化瘀丹，30粒极意培元丹！
drama_dialogue8103323.en: You're here, my friend! I just want to find you! I trapped a Yu'er Shen in Golden Core realm into my grand array. Now, do you want to summon some imps and have a contest with it? I will give you 20 Refined Huayu Elixirs and 30 Refined Nutrition Elixirs if your imps could win!

drama_dialogue8103324.ch: 道友的壶妖还得再修炼修炼，我在此多困它几日，道友准备好了就来找我吧。
drama_dialogue8103324.en: My friend, maybe your imps still need training. I'll keep the beast in the trap for some days, and you could return here at any time once you're prepared.

drama_dialogue8103325.en: Do you want to start the contest now?

drama_dialogue8103326.ch: 道友在御兽之道上的造诣真是令人羡慕，不，应该称呼你为道兄，以后还要多和你学习学习。道兄，这些是答应你的，收下吧。
drama_dialogue8103326.en: My friend, your technique of commanding monsters is so brilliant, and now I must call you my senior! Please take your reward, and don't forget to teach me some knacks in the future.

drama_dialogue8103331.ch: 丑道人似乎在施法布雨，你要过去打招呼吗？
drama_dialogue8103331.en: The Ugly Sage seems to be performing a ceremony of summoning rain. Step forward and greet him?

drama_dialogue8103332.en: Nice to meet you, my friend! Why do you come here?

drama_dialogue8103333.ch: 噢，我瞧这方土地的村民在求雨，就顺手帮他们一把，说不定以后这里就有未来我人族的一位天骄了呢？好了，此事已了，我也要离开了，道友后会有期！
drama_dialogue8103333.en: Well. I notice the villagers here are praying for rain and decide to help them with a ceremony. Maybe a heaven-chosen figure would be born here in the future, and that would be something to be proud of for our humans. Alright! Now my ceremony is over, and I must go. Goodbye, my friend!

drama_dialogue8103401.ch: 道友，好消息，我的御兽之技有了突破了！唤出妖兽，我们来此比试比试！
drama_dialogue8103401.en: My friend, I made breakthroughs in the technique of commanding monsters! Please summon your imps and have a contest with me there!

drama_dialogue8103402.ch: 道兄，好消息，我的御兽之技有了突破了！唤出妖兽，我们来此比试比试！
drama_dialogue8103402.en: My senior, I made breakthroughs in the technique of commanding monsters! Please summon your imps and have a contest with me there!

drama_dialogue8103403.ch: 若你的壶妖能战胜我的妖兽，我就把壶妖真气丹丹方给你。
drama_dialogue8103403.en: If your imps can defeat my monsters, I will give you the Elixir Recipe for concocting Gourd Imp's True Qi.

drama_dialogue8103404.ch: 有趣有趣，实在是有趣，这样我就有法子去得到用不完的灵石了。感谢道友多次与鄙人论这御兽之道。这是答应给你的丹方，有缘再见。
drama_dialogue8103404.en: Excellent! I can earn plenty of Spirit Stones with the method. Thanks for your effort and time in exchanging the technique of commanding monsters with me. Here, the Elixir Recipe is yours. See you.

drama_dialogue8103405.ch: 可惜了，这样看来，我的设想还不是很完善，我会在此地继续研究一段时间，你随时可以过来挑战。
drama_dialogue8103405.en: What a pity. Now I know my design still needs improvement, and I will continue my research here for some days. You can find me here at any time once you're prepared.

drama_dialogue8103501.ch: 桀桀桀，道友，是我，是我，丑道人。
drama_dialogue8103501.en: Xaxaxa. My friend, it's me, the Ugly Sage.

drama_dialogue8103502.ch: 面前出现一个简陋的木傀儡，看这丑陋的面具，应是丑道人所炼制。
drama_dialogue8103502.en: You find a rough wooden puppet before you. Its ugly mask is the same as the Ugly Sage's one, and you believe it must be his work.

drama_dialogue8103503.ch: 托道友的福，在下多年的夙愿终于有了一丝希望了。
drama_dialogue8103503.en: Thanks for your kind assistance. Now my long-cherished wish may be possible to come true.

drama_dialogue8103504.ch: 天佑之子，伴随着悲伤而出生的孩子，这不是他们的错，这是天道的错。我的夙愿就是创建一个小世界，接引那些苦命之人进去里面生活，不再被天道所伤害，而这个计划需要大量的灵石。
drama_dialogue8103504.en: I have told you about the heaven-blessed children. These lives are born amid sorrow, but they are innocent - it's the Heavenly Path that turns their arrival into a tragedy. My wish is to create a miniature world and make it open to all of those children. Therefore, they could live happily in it and will not be detected by the unjust Heavenly Path. However, I need many Spirit Stones to achieve it.

drama_dialogue8103505.ch: 在下打算在十万大山附近建立一座可容纳千名修仙者的斗妖场，名为妖戏，介时欢迎道友前去游玩。
drama_dialogue8103505.en: I am building a site for monsters to fight near the Hundred Thousand Hills. Once completed, thousands of cultivators could enter it and participate in contests. I call it Demon's Arena. Hope to see you there!

drama_dialogue8103506.ch: 这是我给你准备的化形丹丹方，若你的壶妖有化形的机缘，给它服用此丹可快速帮助它化形。
drama_dialogue8103506.en: Here, take this Elixir Recipe for Form-changing Elixir. If your imp has a chance to transform into a human, you could give the elixir to it as assistance.

drama_dialogue8103508.ch: 道友你这就涉世未深了。哪有人到处敛财还不防着挨刀的，桀桀桀，不过这傀儡的笑声确实挺傻气的。
drama_dialogue8103508.en: A wise cultivator must be careful against plots and schemes, especially when he is accumulating wealth. Xaxaxa... Well, its laughter is so silly.

drama_dialogue8103601.ch: 欢迎来到“妖戏”，各位道友今日可尽情享受妖兽乱斗带来的视觉盛宴，他日若在险地遇到同种族的妖兽，也不至于被打个措手不及，灵石充裕的道友，也可为这场好戏加个添头。
drama_dialogue8103601.en: Welcome to the Demon's Arena! Dear cultivators, now you can enjoy the thrilling battles between monsters and learn about their tactics before you encounter them on your journey. Also, if you find the contests worth watching, please bestow some Spirit Stones as your encouragement!

drama_dialogue8103602.ch: 道友似乎是囊中羞涩？可以先去历练一番再过来。
drama_dialogue8103602.en: Perhaps you're short of money now? You could come here later when you have enough Spirit Stones.

drama_dialogue8103603.ch: 对决马上就要开始了，道友开始选兽吧！道友若能在我挑选的6只妖兽里选出3只打赢剩下那3只，即可获得胜利。胜者，可获得三倍灵石奖励哦！
drama_dialogue8103603.en: The contest will soon begin. Please select your favorite monsters! I provide 6 monsters for you, and if you command 3 selected monsters to defeat 3 remaining monsters, you will be the winner. I'll pay a tripled amount of paid Spirit Stones as a reward!

drama_dialogue8103604.ch: 每人一次，童叟无欺。猜中获胜的妖兽可为你带来双倍灵石，走过路过不要错过噢！
drama_dialogue8103604.en: Hey there! Now a chance to try your luck is here. Select which team will win, and if your judgment is true, I'll pay a double amount of your paid Spirit Stones as a reward. Everyone can participate in the guessing - just seize the opportunity!

drama_dialogue8103605.ch: 欢迎各位仙师来到“妖戏”，让我们期待对决双方谁能获得胜利！
drama_dialogue8103605.en: Welcome to the Demon's Arena, dear cultivators! Let's see which team will win!

drama_dialogue8103606.ch: 近日坊间都在流传云陌州出现的名为“妖戏”的玩意儿，只需少量灵石就能看到大妖兽间的互斗，着实神奇。
drama_dialogue8103606.en: Recently you heard rumors saying a Demon's Arena appears in Yun Mo, and people can watch mythical beasts fighting after paying a small amount of Spirit Stones. That's wonderful.

drama_dialogue8103607.ch: 从这6只妖兽里选出3只，然后打赢剩下那3只，即可获得胜利。
drama_dialogue8103607.en: There are 6 monsters. Select 3 monsters from them, and the remaining 3 monsters will become your opponents. Defeat all opponents with selected monsters, and you will win.

drama_dialogue8103608.ch: 恭喜道友获得“妖戏”的胜利！不愧是道友，这是你的灵石！
drama_dialogue8103608.en: Congratulations! You're the winner of the Arena. Here are your Spirit Stones, my friend!

drama_dialogue8103609.ch: 恭喜道友获得“妖戏”的胜利！好眼力！这是你的灵石！
drama_dialogue8103609.en: Congratulations! Your judgment is correct. Here are your Spirit Stones, my friend!

drama_dialogue8103610.ch: 可惜了道友，看来我的御兽之道还是有望超越道友的！小赚一笔，小赚一笔！
drama_dialogue8103610.en: What a pity! My friend, perhaps you should hone your technique now. I'll take your paid Spirit Stones as my reward.

drama_dialogue8103611.ch: 道友不用灰心，下次一定胜利！本“妖戏”的招牌就是童叟无欺，一切全凭眼力！
drama_dialogue8103611.en: Don't be disappointed, my friend. Your fortune will turn soon! The Demon's Arena never cheats anyone, and you only need a sharp insight to earn Spirit Stones!

drama_dialogue8103612.ch: 这样不行，抱歉了道友，这“武戏”让我亏了不少灵石，我要暂时把它关停了！“文戏”暂不影响，道友可以继续去游玩！
drama_dialogue8103612.en: Sorry, my friend, that's not acceptable. I have paid so many Spirit Stones to master cultivators commanding their teams, and now I must decline requests for it! You can still try to bet who will win. Hope you good luck!

drama_dialogue8103701.ch: 抱歉......我不想再和人有过多的关系。
drama_dialogue8103701.en: I'm sorry... I don't want to get involved in any other relationships.

drama_dialogue8103702.ch: 谢谢你......但我不能接受，我不想给你带来不幸。
drama_dialogue8103702.en: Thank you, but... I can't accept it. I don't want misfortune to befall you.

drama_dialogue8103703.ch: 我还得去挣灵石，下次下次......
drama_dialogue8103703.en: I have to make more Spirit Stones. Maybe next time...

drama_dialogue8103704.ch: 这还有一个壶妖境界丹的丹方，是给你准备的，之前丢角落忘记给你了。
drama_dialogue8103704.en: Here, this is an Elixir Recipe for Imp Realm Elixir. I found it hidden in a corner and decided to give you as a gift.

drama_dialogue8103705.ch: 道友，不要冲动，在下行走修仙界，讲究的是一个稳字，今日即使你能胜我，也不能奈我何。
drama_dialogue8103705.en: My friend, don't act hastily. I always have alternative plans for my survival in the cruel world, and today you couldn't harm me even if you won.

drama_dialogue8103706.ch: 道友，莫要做这种有才无德之举。在下只是图你的御兽奇技，又真心待你，何苦要为难在下？鄙人不才，身怀百八十种活命之术！
drama_dialogue8103706.en: My friend, virtue should precede intelligence. I am just interested in your technique of commanding monsters, and I have treated you as my true friend. Why should you keep making things difficult? Do you know I have dozens of methods to survive?

drama_dialogue8103707.ch: 呵呵，道友，手挺巧的，御兽奇技都用到这里了？你想要什么可以问我要嘛！说不定我就......算了算了，来也空空，去也空空，就把此事当做浮云吧！
drama_dialogue8103707.en: Hey, my friend, your hands are so nimble! Now I know why your technique is so brilliant. If you want something, please ask me first, and maybe I... (He shakes his head with a resigned smile.) Well, never mind! We are born with nothing and die empty-handed, and such an incident matters not!

drama_dialogue8103708.ch: 道友，没想到你竟是鼠窃狗偷之辈，看我不教训教训你。
drama_dialogue8103708.en: My friend, such dirty conduct marred your reputation. Let me teach you a lesson.

drama_dialogue8103709.en: Well... Please do not make fun of me, my good lady...

drama_dialogue8103710.ch: 方才的丹方记下没？这还有一个，道友再使把劲！
drama_dialogue8103710.en: Have you got the Elixir Recipe just now? There is another one for you to learn. Keep up, my friend!

drama_dialogue8103711.ch: 此间事了，我也该离开了，道友，告辞！
drama_dialogue8103711.en: I've done my business here. It's time for me to leave. Goodbye, my friend!

drama_dialogue8103712.en: Here, this is an Elixir Recipe for Imp EXP Elixir. I found it hidden in a corner and decided to give you as a gift.

drama_dialogue8103713.en: I've done my business here. It's time for me to leave. Goodbye, my friend!

drama_dialogue8106001.ch: 起坛燃符，霎时雷云聚顶。祈天之术，收阳降雨，驱龙掣电，急急如律令！
drama_dialogue8106001.en: Raise the altar, burn the talisman, and the overwhelming clouds begin to gather. The heavenly art harnesses the sun and the rain as well as taming the dragon and the lightning. Go!

drama_dialogue8106002.ch: 天地回应了你的符箓，天气正在发生变化......
drama_dialogue8106002.en: The heaven and earth have responded to your talisman, and the weather is changing...

drama_dialogue8106003.ch: 天地回应了你的符箓，天气正在发生变化......

drama_dialogue8106050.ch: 符纸燃尽，随着一声炸响，你的法坛随之损坏，天地并未出现变化！此地灵气已然耗尽......
drama_dialogue8106050.en: The talisman burns out. With a blast, your altar is damaged and heaven and earth remain the same! The Qi of this place is running out...

drama_dialogue8107050.ch: 符纸燃尽，随着一声炸响，你的法坛随之损坏，天地并未出现变化！此地灵气已然耗尽......
drama_dialogue8107050.en: The talisman burns out. With a blast, your altar is damaged and heaven and earth remain the same! The Qi of this place is running out...

drama_dialogue8107101.ch: 你在此地设下法坛，操控着灵力使符箓缓缓飞到法坛中央。
drama_dialogue8107101.en: You set up an altar here and use your Energy to drive the charm to fly up slowly to the center of the altar.

drama_dialogue8107102.ch: 此地不宜摆下法坛，需要另寻他地！
drama_dialogue8107102.en: This is not the right place to set up an altar. I need to go somewhere else!

drama_dialogue8107103.ch: 天地一片寂静，符力正被一股残余的妖气所阻隔。你暂时无法沟通此天气！
drama_dialogue8107103.en: Nothing happened. A lingering breath of some monster blocks the charm's power. You cannot change the weather here for now.

drama_dialogue8107201.ch: 妖道，尔敢搅乱天气，今日我定要替天行道在此灭杀你。
drama_dialogue8107201.en: Demon, you've disturbed the weather! I'm going to enforce the law of heaven and kill you today.

drama_dialogue8107211.ch: 由于天气变化过快，附近的村民叫苦不迭！
drama_dialogue8107211.en: The weather is so fickle that the villagers nearby are rattled and distressed!

drama_dialogue8107221.ch: 由于天气变化过快，附近的叫苦不迭！有修仙者远远探查了此处，又急忙溜走了！
drama_dialogue8107221.en: The weather is so fickle that the villagers nearby are rattled and distressed! Deterred, some cultivators have traveled here from afar and immediately run away!

drama_dialogue8107231.ch: 你观察天气的变化，对天地的感悟加深了！但同时你也发现附近的因天气频繁更换而叫苦不迭，心中魔道的种子加深了！
drama_dialogue8107231.en: You observe the changes in the weather and your sense of heaven and earth is sharpened! But at the same time, you find that those villagers nearby are rattled and distressed by the fickle weather, which seems to contribute to your craving for a demonic way of life.

drama_dialogue8107241.ch: 感谢道友，没有你改变天气吓走妖兽，在下怕是凶多吉少，此恩没齿难忘！
drama_dialogue8107241.en: Thank you, cultivator. Had you not changed the weather to scare away the monster, I would probably have been killed already. You saved my life!

drama_dialogue8107243.ch: 若我不是修仙者，该怎么应对这多变的天气！
drama_dialogue8107243.en: If I were not a cultivator, how would I cope with the fickle weather?

drama_dialogue8107244.ch: 若我的修为能更进一步，断不会对此等行径坐视不管。
drama_dialogue8107244.en: If my cultivation could be further advanced, I wouldn't just sit by and do nothing about this evil deed.

drama_dialogue8107245.ch: 好厉害的手段，竟能操纵天气，有机会一定要学习一番！
drama_dialogue8107245.en: You can manipulate the weather? Awesome! Please enlighten me!

drama_dialogue8107246.ch: 道友举力换天，倒是威风凛凛。只是弄得生灵涂炭，不怕汝之仙途就此截断？
drama_dialogue8107246.en: Look at the person who changed the weather with one swoop. All-powerful and awe-inspiring, yet made living beings suffer. Aren't you afraid this is detrimental to your cultivation?

drama_dialogue8107247.en: I had no idea there was such a talisman in this world!

drama_dialogue8107302.ch: 仙师真是消息灵通，这新鲜玩意我也是最近才了解到的。说是在遥远的云陌州有一大能在符道上获得了巨大突破，以符法将各大宗门玩弄于鼓掌之中，端的是威风凛凛。
drama_dialogue8107302.en: The Immortal Master is very knowledgeable and I only recently learned about this news. It is said that in the distant YunMo State, there is a great talent who made a breakthrough in the way of talismans and used the talisman to stir up all kinds of sects.

drama_dialogue8107303.ch: 又言其脚踏七星，手引天谴之雷，豪言壮志说这符箓亦有偷天神~~~妙！
drama_dialogue8107303.en: It was also said that he drew seven stars and conjured the thunder of divine punishment with his hands, saying that this talisman also has the ability of the gods! Wonderful!

drama_dialogue8107304.ch: 咳咳......最后一句也是我道听途说的，因为据我所知......唔，我就不多言了，仙师要是有兴趣，可以去各大城镇的酒馆再打听打听。
drama_dialogue8107304.en: Ahem...the last sentence is also from my hearsay, because as far as I know...well, I won't say much, if the Immortal Master is interested, you can go to the taverns in the big cities and towns to inquire about it.

drama_dialogue8107305.ch: 哎呀，最近有邪修胡乱使用祈天符拨动天气，引得大批妖兽趁机化为大妖兽。正道人士正在追杀此人，仙师要小心为妙！
drama_dialogue8107305.en: Oh, recently, some evil cultivators randomly used prayer talismans to change the weather, causing large numbers of monsters to seize the opportunity to transform into big monsters. Righteous people are chasing and killing these person, Immortal Masters beware!

drama_dialogue8107306.ch: 路边茶亭处有两修士在交谈，是否侧耳旁听？
drama_dialogue8107306.en: There are two cultivators talking at the roadside tea stall, are you listening?

drama_dialogue8107307.ch: 你听说了吗？有修士使用祈天符更换天气竟然被妖兽截取得道了。
drama_dialogue8107307.en: Have you heard? Some cultivators used talismans to change the weather, but the monsters became big monsters.

drama_dialogue8107308.ch: 成...成为大妖兽了？这...这符箓真是不可思议。如何能......
drama_dialogue8107308.en: Become...become a big monsters? This... this talisman is really incredible. How can...

drama_dialogue8107309.ch: 随着女修掐指一挥，声音顿然消失！
drama_dialogue8107309.en: With a snap of the cultivator's fingers, the voice suddenly disappeared!

drama_dialogue8107310.ch: 空中飞过两名正在嬉戏的女修，好似在说一些有趣的事情，你打算？
drama_dialogue8107310.en: Flying in the air are two cultivators who are joking, as if they are talking about something interesting, what do you intend to do??

drama_dialogue8107311.ch: 你听说了吗？最近镇里酒馆来了个奇怪的修士，容貌......噗...
drama_dialogue8107311.en: Have you heard? Recently, a strange cultivator came to the city tavern. His appearance... poof...

drama_dialogue8107312.ch: 呀......会不会是我昨天看到的那个人，呵呵呵！
drama_dialogue8107312.en: Ah... is it the person I saw yesterday, hehehe!

drama_dialogue8107322.ch: 打开背包物品栏，学习所得符谱；再从技艺栏进入画符界面，进行炼制。
drama_dialogue8107322.en: Open the  inventory and learn the Charts; then enter the drawing interface from the Artisanship interface and select a charm to make.

drama_dialogue8107323.ch: 其余消息我馆也知之甚少，仙师若实力允许，也可上华封州查探一番，符箓相关的消息据我所知皆是那边所传。
drama_dialogue8107323.en: I also know very little about the rest of the news. If the Immortal Master's strength allows, he can also go to HuaFeng to investigate. As far as I know, the news about the talisman is passed down there.

drama_dialogue8107324.ch: 哦，对了，还有一点，符箓相比于其他手段，只需炼制出来并拥有足够的念力，即可使用！所以出门历练需小心那些大宗子弟，可能其手中就有长辈赠予的强大符箓，沾之形神消损！
drama_dialogue8107324.en: Oh, by the way, there is another point, compared to other means, talismans can be used as long as they are refined and have enough Focus power! So when you go out to practice, you need to be careful of those rich children, they may have powerful talismans bestowed by their elders in their hands, and their body and spirit will wear off!

drama_dialogue8108101.ch: 符纸燃碎以后，周围渐渐有妖兽被吸引过来了！（消耗10天）
drama_dialogue8108101.en: As the talisman is burnt out, monsters are drawn to the area! (costing 10 days)

drama_dialogue8109101.ch: 你祭出瞬移符标记了此处地脉！（打开小地图可查看标记）
drama_dialogue8109101.en: You've used the Teleportation Talisman to mark the land vein here! (Open the region map to see the mark.)

drama_dialogue8109102.ch: 你祭出瞬移符，但即使燃尽符纸，也未能标记此处地脉！
drama_dialogue8109102.en: You've used the Teleportation Talisman, but you fail to mark the land vein here even after the talisman burns out!

drama_dialogue8109103.ch: 你刚祭出瞬移符，却见一道灵光闪过，符纸已然化为粉末！
drama_dialogue8109103.en: A flash of Energy light flares the minute you use the Teleportation Talisman, which is immediately smashed to smithereens!

drama_dialogue8109201.ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
drama_dialogue8109201.en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

drama_dialogue8109202.ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
drama_dialogue8109202.en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

drama_dialogue8109203.ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
drama_dialogue8109203.en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

drama_dialogue8110001.ch: 你路经一条河流，一名白发苍苍的长须老者从旁走出，拦住了你的去路。
drama_dialogue8110001.en: You pass by a river and a grey-haired and long-bearded old man steps out of the way and stops you.

drama_dialogue8110002.ch: “年轻人，你是否愿意接受来自河神的考验？”
drama_dialogue8110002.en: "Young man, would you accept the test of the River God?"

drama_dialogue8110003.ch: 你转过身，不顾而去。身后之人则发出一声长叹。
drama_dialogue8110003.en: You ignore him and leave. He lets out a long sigh behind you.

drama_dialogue8110004.ch: 老者背过身去，说道：“我转过身去，你选一本最珍贵的秘籍，丢入河中。”
drama_dialogue8110004.en: The old man turns around and says: "I will turn away while you choose the most precious manual of yours and throw it into the river."

drama_dialogue8110005.ch: 你捡起脚边的一块石头，扔进水中。
drama_dialogue8110005.en: You pick up a stone next to your feet and throw it into the river.

drama_dialogue8110006.ch: 你趁老者转身之际，悄无声息离开了此地。
drama_dialogue8110006.en: Very quietly you take your leave as the old man turns away.

drama_dialogue8110007.ch: 在你丢下的物品即将落水之时，老者轻轻抬手，其化为一道金光飞入老者手中。
drama_dialogue8110007.en: As the thing you throw is about to fall into the river, the old man raises his hand slightly and that thing turns into a ray of golden light that flies into his hand.

drama_dialogue8110008.ch: 老者悠悠转身，手上拿着三本秘籍，询问道“你刚才丢掉的是这本{getUnitProp|A|0}、还是{getUnitProp|A|1}、还是这本{getUnitProp|A|2}？”
drama_dialogue8110008.en: The old man slowly turns around with three manuals in his hand and asks: "Did you just throw {getUnitProp|A|0}, {getUnitProp|A|1}, or {getUnitProp|A|2}?"

drama_dialogue8110009.ch: 老者点点头说：“很好，阁下心地光明、诚实不欺，另外两本秘籍，便一并送你吧。”
drama_dialogue8110009.en: The old man nods: "Very well. You're a person of integrity. I'll give you the other two manuals too."

drama_dialogue8110010.ch: 老者点点头说：“很好，阁下内心坚定，能面对诱惑却坚定本心，定能修成大道，你的秘籍就归还于你吧。”
drama_dialogue8110010.en: The old man nods: "Very well. You stand firm and resist the temptation. I can tell you have what it takes to achieve the great path. I'll give back this manual to you."

drama_dialogue8110011.ch: 老者怒目一张，斥道：“无耻之徒，竟然敢欺瞒老朽？！”说话间，老者挥手召来天雷一道，将你击得头昏脑涨。
drama_dialogue8110011.en: The old man glares at you and snaps: "Shame on you! You tricked me?!" He waves his hand and summons lightning, which strikes you so hard that dizziness overpowers you.

drama_dialogue8110012.ch: 待你缓过神来后，湖面之上，更无旁人。老者已然消失不见了。
drama_dialogue8110012.en: When you've recovered your senses, not a soul is on the lake anymore. The old man is nowhere to be found.

drama_dialogue8110013.ch: 老者眉头一皱“嗯？你刚才丢的是哪一本？...罢了，就把你选的这本秘籍给你吧”，说罢便离开了。
drama_dialogue8110013.en: The old man frowns: "Hmm? Which manual did you just throw into the river? Fine, I'll just give you this one you chose". Then he leaves.

drama_dialogue8110014.ch: 老者眉头一皱“嗯？你刚才丢的是哪一本？...罢了，就把你选的这本秘籍给你吧”，说罢便离开了。
drama_dialogue8110014.en: The old man frowns: "Hmm? Which manual did you just throw into the river? Fine, I'll just give you this one you chose". Then he leaves.

drama_dialogue8110015.ch: 你丢下的物品即将落水之时，老者飞快转身接住了它。
drama_dialogue8110015.en: As the thing you throw is about to fall into the river, the old man turns around immediately to catch it.

drama_dialogue8110016.ch: 老者悠悠转身，手上拿着三本秘籍，询问道“你刚才丢掉的是这本{getUnitProp|A|0}、还是{getUnitProp|A|1}、还是这本{getUnitProp|A|2}？”
drama_dialogue8110016.en: The old man slowly turns around with three manuals in his hand and asks: "Did you just throw {getUnitProp|A|0}, {getUnitProp|A|1}, or {getUnitProp|A|2}?"

drama_dialogue8110017.ch: 老者满脸慈祥，对你露出嘉许的笑意。“纯厚朴实，确是为人处世的道理，不过……”
drama_dialogue8110017.en: The old man looks exceptionally kind and smiles approvingly at you: "Blessed are the pure and simple, but..."

drama_dialogue8110018.ch: 老者摘下伪装露出山贼真容,双眼凶光毕露。“修仙一途尔虞我诈，不留点心眼，可活不到飞升成仙那天！”
drama_dialogue8110018.en: The old man takes off his disguise and reveals his mean bandit look. His eyes fixate on you fiercely: "Cultivation is not for the faint-hearted. If you don't get smart enough, you won't live to see the day you ascend!"

drama_dialogue8110019.ch: 你自知不敌，只能愤愤离去，暗下决心他日定要讨伐此贼。
drama_dialogue8110019.en: You know that you're no match for the old man, so you have no choice but to leave. Distressed and aggrieved, you vow to avenge yourself and attack him.

drama_dialogue8110020.ch: 老者眉头一皱，摘下身上伪装，大喝道：“果如所料，修仙者尽是充满机心，贪婪成性之辈！”
drama_dialogue8110020.en: The old man frowns, takes off his disguise, and yells: "I knew it! Cultivators are all designing and greedy scums!"

drama_dialogue8110021.ch: 面前老贼露出山贼本来面目，一脸狰狞的朝你扑来。
drama_dialogue8110021.en: The old man reveals his mean bandit look as he stares at you fiercely and pounces on you.

drama_dialogue8110022.ch: 你战胜了山贼，夺回了属于你的秘籍。
drama_dialogue8110022.en: You've defeated the bandit and managed to get back your manual.

drama_dialogue8110023.ch: 你战胜了山贼，拿回了自己的秘籍，并对山贼进行了一番搜刮。
drama_dialogue8110023.en: You've defeated the bandit, managed to get back your manual, and frisked him.

drama_dialogue8110024.ch: 你不敌此贼，施展遁术逃离了此地。
drama_dialogue8110024.en: You are no match for the bandit and flee with the Exit Formula.

drama_dialogue8115001.ch: 云游之时，天色渐晚，但你已经不清楚自己身处何处。忽见前方有一个小村庄，不由想去找找村中问问路
drama_dialogue8115001.en: It's getting late when you're travelling around, but you have no idea where you are. Then all of a sudden, you see a small village ahead, and you decide to go there and ask for directions.

drama_dialogue8115003.ch: 你被村民热情邀约至村中，其他村民听说有修仙者前来，前来围观。忽然一道声音从屋外传来，大家的注意力被吸引了过去。
drama_dialogue8115003.en: The friendly villagers invite you to enter the village. A crowd comes to see what you are all about when they are told a cultivator has arrived. Suddenly, a noise comes from outside the room and draws everyone's attention.

drama_dialogue8115004.ch: 你不愿停留，谢绝了对方好意，对方看你态度坚决也便不再坚持，在问过路后你便继续出发了。
drama_dialogue8115004.en: You don't want to stay any longer and decline the offer of the person, who doesn't insist on making you stay. You continue on your journey after you ask the way.

drama_dialogue8115008.ch: 啊，这... 夜半三更，共处一室...
drama_dialogue8115008.en: What? We... In the middle of the night and together in a room...

drama_dialogue8115010.ch: 一会儿， 各家前来向你们献上酒食。觥筹交错之后，你们二人对于对方有了些许了解。随后，夜已深了，该歇息了
drama_dialogue8115010.en: Shortly afterwards, villagers come to bring you alcohol and food. After a few drinks, you both get to know each other better. It's getting late and time to go to bed.

drama_dialogue8115011.ch: 你有所顾虑，最终还是谢绝了对方好意，于是村民们也不再坚持，将你送到了村口。但这座小村庄好像有什么神秘之处，不久你又迷了路，一直在村庄中兜兜转转，怎么也出不去。 折腾到了天明后，你才终于找到离开的路。
drama_dialogue8115011.en: You hesitate and finally decline the offer. The villagers don't insist and take you to the entrance of their village. But there is something odd about this place. You get lost again soon afterwards and find yourself going round and round within the village, unable to find your way out. You don't find an exit until the next morning.

drama_dialogue8115013.ch: 你与对方聊了很多，有修行的理解，也有对方过往的经历。相谈甚欢，你们之间气氛也欢快了起来。
drama_dialogue8115013.en: You two have a good talk about your understanding of cultivation and exchange your life stories. The vibe is good and you're having a great time in the room.

drama_dialogue8115014.ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
drama_dialogue8115014.en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

drama_dialogue8115016.ch: 修仙以来，你从没有如此放松过。第二天的你和村民道别，离开了小村庄。日后，你回忆起这段愉快的时光，却发现这座神秘的小村庄仿佛消失了一般，再也找不到了...
drama_dialogue8115016.en: You've never been so relaxed since you became a cultivator. The next day, you wave goodbye to the villagers and leave. However, when you recall this fond memory, the mysterious little village seems to have vanished and can no longer be found...

drama_dialogue8115017.ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
drama_dialogue8115017.en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

drama_dialogue8115023.en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

drama_dialogue8115025.ch: 你刚坐到对方身边，但立刻被对方拉住你，威胁索要给予5000灵石
drama_dialogue8115025.en: This person grabs you the minute you sit down next to him and threatens you to give him 5,000 Spirit Stones.

drama_dialogue8115026.ch: 你挣脱了对面，却遇对方反抗，在对方即将喊出来之时你指间凝结道法，攻向对面
drama_dialogue8115026.en: You manage to break free from him but are met with fierce resistance. As he's about to shout out, you gather the Tao between your fingers and attack.

drama_dialogue8115027.ch: 解决了麻烦后，你继续休息，一夜过后你离开了小村庄，继续前行
drama_dialogue8115027.en: Free from troubles, you proceed to sleep. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

drama_dialogue8115028.ch: 为了省事，你决定破财消灾，递给对方5000灵石。对方倒也信守诺言，不再为难你
drama_dialogue8115028.en: To save yourself the trouble, you decide to give him 5,000 Spirit Stones. He keeps his word and leaves you alone.

drama_dialogue8115029.ch: 但你自觉晦气，还是决定离开了这个小村庄
drama_dialogue8115029.en: But you decide to leave the village because you think this place brings bad luck.

drama_dialogue8115030.ch: 虽然你拒绝付钱，但对方也不想闹大，只能作罢，随后离去。
drama_dialogue8115030.en: You refuse to pay, but he doesn't want to make a big deal out of it. He gives up and leaves.

drama_dialogue8115031.ch: 但你自觉晦气，还是决定离开了这个小村庄
drama_dialogue8115031.en: But you decide to leave the village because you think this place brings bad luck.

drama_dialogue8115033.ch: 对方目光一冷，向你袭来！
drama_dialogue8115033.en: He's glaring at you coldly and pounces on you!

drama_dialogue8115034.ch: 解决了麻烦后，你继续休息，一夜过后你离开了小村庄，继续前行

drama_dialogue8150001.ch: 你是不是能看到......你是不是能看到......回答我......回答我......嘎嘎嘎
drama_dialogue8150001.en: Can you see it... Can you see it... Answer me... Answer me... (Clack Clack Clack)

drama_dialogue8150002.ch: 谁来帮帮我呜呜......谁来帮帮我呜呜......
drama_dialogue8150002.en: Somebody! Help! Boo-hoo... Help me! Boo-hoo...

drama_dialogue8150003.ch: 谁来帮帮我呜呜......谁来帮帮我呜呜......
drama_dialogue8150003.en: Somebody! Help! Boo-hoo... Help me! Boo-hoo...

drama_dialogue8150004.ch: 你是不是能看到......你是不是能看到......回答我......回答我......嘎嘎嘎
drama_dialogue8150004.en: Can you see it... Can you see it... Answer me... Answer me... (Clack Clack Clack)

drama_dialogue8150011.ch: 你眼前出现了一个奇特的方形物件！
drama_dialogue8150011.en: An odd square object appears before your eyes!

drama_dialogue8150021.ch: 你眼前出现了一个奇特的方形物件，突然一团黑影猛的扑向你！
drama_dialogue8150021.en: An odd square object appears before your eyes, and suddenly a black shadow pounces on you!

drama_dialogue8150031.ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。渐渐你看到周围竟有一些阴冷之气？！
drama_dialogue8150031.en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. Slowly but surely, you see the Yin aura around you!

drama_dialogue8150032.ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力从中缓缓飞入你的眼中。你好似看到一丝宝气在空中一闪而过！
drama_dialogue8150032.en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. You seem to see a ray of glory aura flash by!

drama_dialogue8150033.ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。
drama_dialogue8150033.en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes.

drama_dialogue8150034.ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。你看到周围冒着许多黑气！！！
drama_dialogue8150034.en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. You see a mass of black aura bubbling up around you!

drama_dialogue8150041.ch: 符纸缓缓烧完，也未能得到回应！
drama_dialogue8150041.en: The talisman slowly burns out, but still, there is no response!

drama_dialogue8150201.ch: 天空下起了蒙蒙细雨，一股柔和的灵气渐渐覆盖在周围！
drama_dialogue8150201.en: A puff of tender Qi gradually covers your surroundings as it's drizzling!

drama_dialogue8150301.ch: 此处好似是一座小型陵墓，是否要进去查探一番？
drama_dialogue8150301.en: Here is a tomb. Enter it and see what's inside?

drama_dialogue8150302.ch: 这坟墓周围凝固着一团怨气，还是小心为上......
drama_dialogue8150302.en: A vile aura drifts around the tomb. Be careful...

drama_dialogue8150303.ch: 你靠近了坟墓，暂时无事发生，你打算......
drama_dialogue8150303.en: You approach the tomb. Nothing happened for now. You decide to...

drama_dialogue8150304.ch: 突然坟口开裂，从中出现了一枚陈旧地符箓。
drama_dialogue8150304.en: Suddenly, the tomb splits open. A worn charm emerges from inside.

drama_dialogue8150305.ch: 你凝结法力劈中坟墓，竟惹出藏在里面的魔物。
drama_dialogue8150305.en: You cleave the tomb with condensed energy, but the evil creature inside has also been awakened.

drama_dialogue8150306.ch: 你不想打扰亡者地安宁，选择了离开。
drama_dialogue8150306.en: Let the deceased rest. You leave.

drama_dialogue8180004.ch: 招募弟子大会顺利举行，{customParam|elderName}为人义气，在场的修仙者大受感染，前来报名的人络绎不绝，宗门记名弟子人数激增{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180004.en: The assembly was held successfully. Seeing such a loyal person like {customParam|elderName}, the cultivators were moved and actively applied to join the sect. The Sect recruited {customParam|resCount} Backup Disciples from the event.

drama_dialogue8180005.ch: 招募弟子大会顺利举行，但{customParam|elderName}未能成功带动气氛，驻足围观的修仙者们表现并不踊跃，报名者的人三三两两，好在宗门仍成功招募到了{customParam|resCount}位记名弟子。
drama_dialogue8180005.en: The assembly was held successfully, but {customParam|elderName} failed to brighten up the mood, and the cultivators showed little enthusiasm for the event. The Sect still managed to recruit {customParam|resCount} Backup Disciples from the event.

drama_dialogue8180006.ch: 招募弟子大会顺利举行，宗门增加了{customParam|resCount}位记名弟子。
drama_dialogue8180006.en: The assembly was held successfully. The Sect recruited {customParam|resCount} Backup Disciples from it.

drama_dialogue8180007.ch: 招募弟子大会顺利举行，宗门增加了{customParam|resCount}位记名弟子。
drama_dialogue8180007.en: The assembly was held successfully. The Sect recruited {customParam|resCount} Backup Disciples from it.

drama_dialogue8180011.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广布善举，扶弱济困。{customParam|elderName}素来急公好义，名声在外，附近的居民欢欣鼓舞，夹道欢迎。宗门成功挽回声誉，名誉值上涨了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180011.en: The Sect set out to offer aid and supplies in its territory and nearby towns. The event was presided by {customParam|elderName}, a person with glorious deeds, and residents there expressed warm welcomes to us. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Prestige from the event.

drama_dialogue8180012.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广布善举，扶弱济困。怎奈{customParam|elderName}为人历来我行我素，致使布施并未在井然有序中进行，有部分居民未能领到物资。虽然过程不算顺利，但宗门名誉值仍增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180012.en: The Sect set out to offer aid and supplies in its territory and nearby towns, but {customParam|elderName} is such an unruly person that the event got out of control, and some residents failed to get their supplies. The Sect still managed to gain {customParam|resCount} Prestige from the event.

drama_dialogue8180013.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广布善举，扶弱济困，宗门名誉增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180013.en: The Sect set out to offer aid and supplies in its territory and nearby towns. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Prestige from it.

drama_dialogue8180014.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广布善举，扶弱济困，宗门名誉增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180014.en: The Sect set out to offer aid and supplies in its territory and nearby towns. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Prestige from it.

drama_dialogue8180018.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地兴建防御工事，增派巡查弟子。{customParam|elderName}刚毅果敢，洞烛熹微，城防工事顺利完工，巡查弟子十里一岗，五里一哨，宗门安定度增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180018.en: The Sect started to build fortifications around and send more disciples to patrol its territory. Under the direction of {customParam|elderName}, a brave and determined person, our defense was soon strengthened. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Stability from the event.

drama_dialogue8180019.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及兴建防御工事，增派巡查弟子。惜金莫教子，护短莫从师，{customParam|elderName}并未有效的调度巡查弟子，城防修筑也较为缓慢，宗门安定仅度增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180019.en: The Sect started to build fortifications around and send more disciples to patrol its territory, but {customParam|elderName} is such a protective person that the disciples were kept away from any potential risks. The Sect still managed to gain {customParam|resCount} Stability from the event.

drama_dialogue8180020.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及兴建防御工事，增派巡查弟子，宗门安定度增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180020.en: The Sect started to build fortifications around and send more disciples to patrol its territory. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Stability from it.

drama_dialogue8180021.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及兴建防御工事，增派巡查弟子，宗门安定度增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180021.en: The Sect started to build fortifications around and send more disciples to patrol its territory. The Sect gained {customParam|resCount} Stability from it.

drama_dialogue8180025.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇兜售宗门特产灵果。{customParam|elderName}素来深谙经商之道，研桑心计，带领弟子们广开门路，宗门周边领地一度商贾云集，客似云来，贩售特产灵果大获成功，为宗门赚取了{customParam|resCount}灵石。
drama_dialogue8180025.en: The Sect started to sell homegrown spiritual fruits in its territory and nearby towns. {customParam|elderName} is a person with commercial talents, and led by the clever promoter, our spiritual fruits had excellent sales. The Sect earned {customParam|resCount} Spirit Stones from the event.

drama_dialogue8180026.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇兜售宗门特产灵果。周边城镇坊市涌来许多商人采购灵果，只因{customParam|elderName}为人素来仗义疏财，不拘小节，灵果销路虽好，但仅为宗门增加了{customParam|resCount}灵石。
drama_dialogue8180026.en: The Sect started to sell homegrown spiritual fruits in its territory and nearby towns, but {customParam|elderName} is such a generous person that the spiritual fruits were all sold at the most favorable prices. The Sect still managed to earn {customParam|resCount} Spirit Stones from the event.

drama_dialogue8180027.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广寻门路，兜售宗门特产灵果，宗门灵石增加{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180027.en: The Sect started to sell homegrown spiritual fruits in its territory and nearby towns. The Sect earned {customParam|resCount} Spirit Stones from it.

drama_dialogue8180028.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇广寻门路，兜售宗门特产灵果，宗门灵石增加{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180028.en: The Sect started to sell homegrown spiritual fruits in its territory and nearby towns. The Sect earned {customParam|resCount} Spirit Stones from it.

drama_dialogue8180039.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇临时征调劳力，种植药材、开采矿材。{customParam|elderName}平日虽不善言谈，但凭借长年对药材通论和矿材通论的深入研习，种植和开采工作均硕果颇丰，为宗门增加了{customParam|resCount}矿材和药材。
drama_dialogue8180039.en: The Sect hired individuals from the neighborhood to grow herbs and mine more ores. Though {customParam|elderName} is reticent in daily life, the person's knowledge of herbs and ore still helped us a lot and brought us a good harvest. The Sect obtained {customParam|resCount} Herbs and Ores from the event.

drama_dialogue8180040.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇临时征调劳力，种植药材、开采矿材。{customParam|elderName}名声在外，应者云集，短时间内就召集来大量劳力参与开采和种植工作。但由于前来者众多，鱼龙混杂，其中不乏对采矿和草药一无所知的人员，宗门药材和矿材仅增加{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180040.en: The Sect hired individuals from the neighborhood to grow herbs and mine more ores, but {customParam|elderName} is such a reputable person that everyone was attracted by the famous cultivator's task, including many laypersons. The Sect still managed to obtain {customParam|resCount} Herbs and Ores from the event.

drama_dialogue8180041.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇临时征调劳力，种植药材、开采矿材，宗门矿材和药材增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180041.en: The Sect hired individuals from the neighborhood to grow herbs and mine more ores. The Sect obtained {customParam|resCount} Herbs and Ores from it.

drama_dialogue8180042.ch: 宗门开始在周边领地及附近城镇临时征调劳力，种植药材、开采矿材，宗门矿材和药材增加了{customParam|resCount}。
drama_dialogue8180042.en: The Sect hired individuals from the neighborhood to grow herbs and mine more ores. The Sect obtained {customParam|resCount} Herbs and Ores from it.

drama_dialogue8180101.ch: 你正欲上前询问时，只见一人忽而夺门而去，酒馆内众人拼命追赶，但此人身法了得，一骑绝尘，转眼间便跑出城去，而不知为何沿途却好似不断有雷电降下……
drama_dialogue8180101.en: Just when you're about to ask, a man suddenly bolts through the tavern doors. The patrons scramble in a frenzied attempt to catch him, but he moves with such deftness and motion skill that he quickly slips away from the town.

drama_dialogue8180201.ch: 你正欲上前询问时，只见一人忽而夺门而去，酒馆内众人拼命追赶，但此人身法了得，一骑绝尘，转眼间便跑出城去……

drama_dialogue8180501.en: Just when you're about to ask, a man suddenly bolts through the tavern doors. The patrons scramble in a frenzied attempt to catch him, but he moves with such deftness and motion skill that he quickly slips away from the town.

drama_dialogue8200001.ch: “哎哟！！！”一声惨叫伴随着树枝被折断的声音从附近传来，似乎有人从空中掉下来了。
drama_dialogue8200001.en: "Ouch!" A painful shout comes with the sounds of cracking twigs. Maybe someone has fallen from the sky.

drama_dialogue8200002.ch: 有一修仙者躺在地上，身上歪七扭八盖着一些符箓，周遭水木灵气正被符箓牵动缓缓融入此人体内，似乎正在为其疗伤？！你决定？
drama_dialogue8200002.en: A cultivator lies on the ground, covered by a pile of charms. The water and wood Qi here are being attracted by them and are flowing into his body like they are healing him! You decide to...

drama_dialogue8200011.ch: 随着你缓缓注入灵力，他的手指已可以微微攥动......
drama_dialogue8200011.en: You infuse your energy into the cultivator. Soon, his fingers begin to move...

drama_dialogue8200012.ch: 突然，一股吸力从其体内凶猛扑来，你赶忙运转灵力收紧自身，却无法阻止体力灵力念力的丢失......难道说他要恩将仇报把你吸干？！
drama_dialogue8200012.en: Suddenly, a siphoning power rushes out and engulfs you. You hastily defend yourself with your energy, but your loss of Vitality, Energy, and Focus is inevitable... Will you end up being drained by the one you saved?

drama_dialogue8200013.ch: 正当你即将陷入绝望之时，吸力猛地一消。他恢复神智了？！只见其周身灵力开始如呼吸般一张一缩，大量精纯的水木灵力汇聚在周围，缓缓补充着你的体力灵力，感觉有点飘飘然......
drama_dialogue8200013.en: Just before you are caught by desperation, the strange power fades away. Does he wake up? You see the Energy around him rising and falling like breaths. You are enveloped by dense and pure water and wood energies, and your Vitality and Energy are being restored. A feeling of satisfaction comes to you...

drama_dialogue8200014.ch: 咳咳，小友心地纯良，不趁人之危，实属难得。此番救治之恩，咱家定当没齿难忘。不过也需提醒一下小友，仙途艰难，切莫让自身置于危难之中，你与咱家境界相差过大，方才咱家的残存灵力被你引动，自主吸食你的精气神，差点酿成大祸！方才若是小友丢掉了性命，那咱家的道心恐怕也将摇摇欲坠！
drama_dialogue8200014.en: Thank you for healing me and not killing me. You're such a generous person, and I will certainly repay you. But please allow me to give you a piece of advice, that is, don't take unnecessary risks. The difference between our realms is so huge that it had my remaining Energy to siphon off yours. A fatal accident! If you die from it, my Taoist Mind will also be shaken!

drama_dialogue8200015.ch: 未待你回应，只见从其身上飞出几样物品落入你的手中......
drama_dialogue8200015.en: Something from him flies into your hands before you can make a reply...

drama_dialogue8200016.ch: 咱家这个人呢，不善交际！小友多有担待，这些物件你只管拿上，咱家身上只有符箓相关的物件，希望能对小友有所帮助。
drama_dialogue8200016.en: Alright! Pardon my clumsy expression. My friend, please take these as my gratitude. I have only talismans and charms. Hope you'll find these useful.

drama_dialogue8200017.ch: 咱家还要在此休息一些时日，小友请便吧。
drama_dialogue8200017.en: I need to take a rest here for some days. Feel free to leave if you have to.

drama_dialogue8200021.ch: 此人手掌内侧还蜷着一张符箓，身躯覆盖着微微灵光，这似乎也是某种符箓的效果。但不知何由，其身上散发着一股强烈的天道威压，仿佛受过天谴一般......你打算？
drama_dialogue8200021.en: Inside his palm is another piece of charm, and you see a faint aura glowing on the cultivator's body. You think the aura is also from some charm, but you noticed a fierce and strange coercion on him, which is similar to those caused by the wrath from Heaven... What do you want to do?

drama_dialogue8200031.ch: 此人体质奇特，你尝试多次亦无法伤其分毫！
drama_dialogue8200031.en: You can't hurt him after many tries. Maybe his constitution is too special.

drama_dialogue8200032.ch: 你趁其昏迷重伤，将其杀害.....
drama_dialogue8200032.en: You killed him as your victim is in a coma...

drama_dialogue8200033.ch: 你在此人腰间发现了一份符谱。
drama_dialogue8200033.en: You find a Talisman chart on his belt.

drama_dialogue8200041.ch: 突然，一股吸力从其体内凶猛扑来，你赶忙运转灵力收紧自身，此人灵力怪异，得小心为妙......
drama_dialogue8200041.en: Suddenly, a siphoning power rushes out and engulfs you. You hastily defend yourself with your energy, alarmed by the strange flow of energy on him...

drama_dialogue8200042.ch: 不消片刻，这人就悠悠转醒了。一瞬间从其眼中闪过一丝防备，不过随即转为释然......
drama_dialogue8200042.en: Moments after, he slowly wakes up. A trace of wariness flits in his eyes, then fades away.

drama_dialogue8200043.ch: 咳咳，感谢道友相助之恩，待咱家先自行疗伤......
drama_dialogue8200043.en: Well, thanks for helping me, and I'll heal myself now...

drama_dialogue8200044.ch: 只见他周身灵力如呼吸般一张一缩，符箓引来的大量精纯的水木灵力涌入其身躯，不消片刻竟已修复得七七八八......好强的身躯！！！你不禁称奇。世间竟还有如此体质可以承受这般猛烈的灵力入体。
drama_dialogue8200044.en: The energy in the cultivator is rising and falling like breaths. Torrents of water and wood energies are attracted by the charm and flow into his body, and soon, his wounds have been largely cured... What a mighty figure! You're surprised by the endurance of the constitution in withstanding the fierce energy.

drama_dialogue8200045.ch: 吁......感觉真不错！再次谢过道友，小小心意不成敬意！
drama_dialogue8200045.en: Ah... I'm feeling much better! Thank you again, and please take these as my gratitude.

drama_dialogue8200046.ch: 言罢，从其腰间飞来几个物件悬在你的身前，是一些符箓。
drama_dialogue8200046.en: Something flies to your front from his belt. They are some finished charms.

drama_dialogue8200047.ch: 知之为知之，不知为不知，咱家有啥说啥......
drama_dialogue8200047.en: Yes, I'll tell you all I know. What do you want to ask?

drama_dialogue8200051.ch: 上个月，咱家在云陌州改造瞬移符时发生了意外，被传去了一个奇异的地方，里面危险重重！！就算是咱家，也只能是侥幸逃出哇。
drama_dialogue8200051.en: An accident occurred when I tried to improve Teleportation Talismans in Yun Mo. I was sent to a strange place and had a narrow escape. That was scary!

drama_dialogue8200052.ch: 打开背包物品栏，学习所得符谱；再进入技艺栏进入画符界面，选择需要炼制的符箓，进入炼制界面。炼制前需要准备好需要的材料。符箓相比于其他手段，只需炼制出来并拥有足够的念力，即可使用！
drama_dialogue8200052.en: First, you need to learn the Charts from your inventory. Then go to Talismans in the Artisanship interface and select a charm to make it. Remember to prepare enough materials for them. Once a charm has been made, you can use it as long as your Focus meets its requirement, which is different from other products crafted with Artisanship.

drama_dialogue8200053.ch: 提升画符资质的道具可于那坊市间觅得，至于这符箓的图谱嘛…千金难求！！我俩也算缘分一场，待他日我二人重逢之时，有关那符箓之事，定当知无不言言无不尽！
drama_dialogue8200053.en: You may find books from markets to improve your Talismans stat, but the charts to draw talismans cannot easily be bought. Well, alright! Now that you did me a favor, I'll repay you with all the secrets behind charms if we meet again.

drama_dialogue8200061.ch: 不了不了，自从那件事以后，咱家就一直很倒霉，不想节外生枝，只想留得性命，好去专研符箓。嗯…在那之前还是先去附近的酒馆饮上几盅罢，哈啊哈啊哈啊……
drama_dialogue8200061.en: Well, no. I had many accidents since that. Now I just want to study these charms and keep myself from risks. But before it, I'd have a drink in a nearby tavern, hahaha...

drama_dialogue860001.ch: 这是一处充满冥气的池塘，其内池水如墨，阴气森然，却似乎与此地产出的引魂珠有着某种奇特的联系。池中蒸腾而出的冥雾仿佛在暗示着你，把更多的引魂珠投进池中，更多、更多……
drama_dialogue860001.en: The water is this pond is dark, full of aura from the nether. However, it feels connected to the Soul Lures produced in this area. The bubbling mist seems to be asking you to throw more Soul Lures into the pond. More... more...

drama_dialogue860011.ch: 你将一粒引魂珠投入了池中，顿时池水沸腾起来。正当你不知所措之际，那冥水竟向你席卷而来，眼看便要把你吞噬。慌忙之中，你只能决定使用何用力量抑制冥水。
drama_dialogue860011.en: You toss a Soul Lure into the pond and it immediately starts to bubble. You're caught off-guard as the water rushes at you. You only have enough time to decide what kind of power you should use to keep it at bay.

drama_dialogue860021.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水。那池水接触到这股力量，显得欢欣活泼，<r>竟朝你吐出了几颗引魂珠</r>。
drama_dialogue860021.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water seems rejuvenated by your power, <r>it spits out several Soul Lures at you</r>.

drama_dialogue860031.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水，那池水吞噬了这股能量，随后便悄然退去，<r>你投入其中的引魂珠就此消失无踪</r>。
drama_dialogue860031.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water absorbs your power and retreats quietly, <r>taking the Lures you threw into the water with it</r>.

drama_dialogue860041.ch: 你将五粒引魂珠投入了池中，顿时池水沸腾起来。正当你不知所措之际，那冥水竟向你席卷而来，眼看便要把你吞噬。慌忙之中，你只能决定使用何用力量抑制冥水。
drama_dialogue860041.en: You toss five Soul Lures into the pond and it immediately starts to bubble. You're caught off-guard as the water rushes at you. You only have enough time to decide what kind of power you should use to keep it at bay.

drama_dialogue860051.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水。那池水接触到这股力量，显得欢欣活泼，<r>竟朝你吐出了几颗引魂珠</r>。
drama_dialogue860051.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water seems rejuvenated by your power, <r>it spits out several Soul Lures at you</r>.

drama_dialogue860061.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水，那池水吞噬了这股能量，随后便悄然退去，<r>你投入其中的引魂珠就此消失无踪</r>。
drama_dialogue860061.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water absorbs your power and retreats quietly, <r>taking the Lures you threw into the water with it</r>.

drama_dialogue860071.ch: 你将十粒引魂珠投入了池中，顿时池水沸腾起来。正当你不知所措之际，那冥水竟向你席卷而来，眼看便要把你吞噬。慌忙之中，你只能决定使用何用力量抑制冥水。
drama_dialogue860071.en: You toss ten Soul Lures into the pond and it immediately starts to bubble. You're caught off-guard as the water rushes at you. You only have enough time to decide what kind of power you should use to keep it at bay.

drama_dialogue860081.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水。那池水接触到这股力量，显得欢欣活泼，<r>竟朝你吐出了几颗引魂珠</r>。
drama_dialogue860081.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water seems rejuvenated by your power, <r>it spits out several Soul Lures at you</r>.

drama_dialogue860091.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水，那池水吞噬了这股能量，随后便悄然退去，<r>你投入其中的引魂珠就此消失无踪</r>。
drama_dialogue860091.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water absorbs your power and retreats quietly, <r>taking the Lures you threw into the water with it</r>.

drama_dialogue860101.ch: 你将所有引魂珠投入了池中，顿时池水沸腾起来。正当你不知所措之际，那冥水竟向你席卷而来，眼看便要把你吞噬。慌忙之中，你只能决定使用何用力量抑制冥水。
drama_dialogue860101.en: You toss all the Soul Lures you have into the pond and it immediately starts to bubble. You're caught off-guard as the water rushes at you. You only have enough time to decide what kind of power you should use to keep it at bay.

drama_dialogue860111.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水。那池水接触到这股力量，显得欢欣活泼，<r>竟朝你吐出了几颗引魂珠</r>。
drama_dialogue860111.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water seems rejuvenated by your power, <r>it spits out several Soul Lures at you</r>.

drama_dialogue860121.ch: 你双手推出，一道流光从掌中喷薄而发，射向飞来的池水，那池水吞噬了这股能量，随后便悄然退去，<r>你投入其中的引魂珠就此消失无踪</r>。
drama_dialogue860121.en: You push out, and a beam shoots out from your palm toward the incoming water. The water absorbs your power and retreats quietly, <r>taking the Lures you threw into the water with it</r>.

drama_dialogue860201.ch: 池水干涸了，你知道自己不能久留于此。
drama_dialogue860201.en: The pond is now dry, and you know you need to leave as soon as possible.

drama_dialogue860301.ch: 踏入陨幽谷后，储物空间中的<r>冥魂之息</r>似乎传来了异动…
drama_dialogue860301.en: The <r>Nether Breath</r> in your storage becomes restless as you step into the Fallen Valley.

drama_dialogue860321.ch: 你将<r>冥魂之息</r>从储物空间中取出后，远处便有一道漆黑的身影朝你急速袭来！
drama_dialogue860321.en: You take out the <r>Nether Breath</r> and see a dark figure charging toward you!

drama_dialogue870001.ch: 你这人好不讲理！我只不过讨你一句口封，你若是不想搭理，只管离开便是，为何要为难于我？
drama_dialogue870001.en: You're a terrible person! I only asked you a question, and you could have left if you didn't want to answer. Why did you have to make it difficult?

drama_dialogue870002.ch: 哈哈哈，俗话说请神容易送神难，你既然有此一问，我便让你死个明白！
drama_dialogue870002.en: They say that it's easy to summon a god, but difficult to send it away. I guess you'll find out what it means soon!

drama_dialogue870003.ch: 前日，我家宗主于某登仙大能处偶得秘讯，说冥山近来云雾初开，似有妖灵现世，得之可获天大机缘！
drama_dialogue870003.en: My sect leader heard from a transcendent that the mists on Nether Mountains have finally cleared, and that there are fiends! Time to get cracking!

drama_dialogue870004.ch: 我看你这般模样，分明就是宗主所言之妖灵！你既然送上门来，我岂能错过？看招！
drama_dialogue870004.en: You look like a fiend, just like the sect leader said! I won't let you get away so easily!

drama_dialogue870021.ch: 哼！仗着修为高就欺负人？
drama_dialogue870021.en: Trying to bully others because you think you're so strong?

drama_dialogue870022.ch: 你可给我记好了，在下他日必报此仇！
drama_dialogue870022.en: Just remember that you will pay for this some day!

drama_dialogue870041.ch: ……多谢道友相救，在下实力不济便擅离涂山四处讨封，实在惭愧。
drama_dialogue870041.en: ...Thank you for your help. I should have reconsidered about leaving Tushan and challenging others.

drama_dialogue870043.ch: 哦，那纯属误会，我只是涂山狐族的一员，才不是什么妖灵……
drama_dialogue870043.en: Oh, I think that's a misunderstanding. I'm part of the fox clan in Tushan, not a fiend...

drama_dialogue870044.ch: 不过我倒突然想起，在我临走前，大长老总是一脸凝重，还不时望向冥山的方向，恐怕的确是有事发生。
drama_dialogue870044.en: I suddenly remembered that the Grand Elder looked very grim just before I left, and kept looking in the direction of the Nether Mountains. Something must have happened.

drama_dialogue870045.ch: 我行至华封州时，曾途径一处所在，想来离冥山不远。当时我突然有种奇异之感，似乎有股熟悉的气息萦绕周围。
drama_dialogue870045.en: I stopped by somewhere near the Nether Mountains on my way to Hua Feng, and I felt something strange, like there was a familiar aura around me.

drama_dialogue870046.ch: 没等我仔细寻觅，那气息就又散去了。
drama_dialogue870046.en: But the aura faded before I could investigate further.

drama_dialogue870047.ch: 你若有意，自行前去探查即可。我可要速回涂山去了，告辞！
drama_dialogue870047.en: If you're interested, feel free to look into it. I need to return to Tushan now. Farewell!

drama_dialogue870051.ch: 嗯？道友不必插手，在下足以了结此妖！
drama_dialogue870051.en: Hm? Please stay out of this. I alone will end this fiend.

drama_dialogue870052.ch: 就趁着修士一愣神的工夫，那狐妖变为一道流光，飞也似地逃走了。
drama_dialogue870052.en: The fiend transforms into a light while the cultivator is distracted, and escapes.

drama_dialogue870053.en: You treacherous fiend! Don't run away!

drama_dialogue870061.ch: 修士也祭出身法，跟随那道流光而去。
drama_dialogue870061.en: The cultivator casts a spell and goes after the light.

drama_dialogue870071.ch: 道友切莫动手，我观道友修为不凡，何必帮助此等小人？
drama_dialogue870071.en: Please stop. I see that you are a powerful cultivator. Why are you helping scums like these?

drama_dialogue870072.ch: 嗯？你分明早已逃离？怎会还在此处？
drama_dialogue870072.en: Didn't you escape? Why are you still here?

drama_dialogue870073.ch: 道友不必吃惊，方才我只是略施幻惑之法，让旁人以为我飞逃而去，其实我哪有那般本事……
drama_dialogue870073.en: No need to be surprised. I simply made them think that I ran away, but I definitely didn't...

drama_dialogue870074.ch: 不过多亏道友将其念力引走，我才能成功施展此法，否则必然是难逃一死。
drama_dialogue870074.en: But thank you for redirecting its focus and creating a opportunity for me to cast my spell. We would have been dead otherwise.

drama_dialogue870075.ch: 原来如此。听那人方才所言……
drama_dialogue870075.en: I see. I heard what they said...

drama_dialogue870076.ch: 哦，那纯属误会，我只是涂山狐族的一员，才不是什么妖灵……
drama_dialogue870076.en: Oh, I think that's a misunderstanding. I'm part of the fox clan in Tushan, not a fiend...

drama_dialogue870077.ch: 不过我倒突然想起，在我临走前，大长老总是一脸凝重，还不时望向冥山的方向，恐怕的确是有事发生。
drama_dialogue870077.en: I suddenly remembered that the Grand Elder looked very grim just before I left, and kept looking in the direction of the Nether Mountains. Something must have happened.

drama_dialogue870078.ch: 我行至华封州时，曾途径一处所在，想来离冥山不远。当时我突然有种奇异之感，似乎有股熟悉的气息萦绕周围。
drama_dialogue870078.en: I stopped by somewhere near the Nether Mountains on my way to Hua Feng, and I felt something strange, like there was a familiar aura around me.

drama_dialogue870079.ch: 没等我仔细寻觅，那气息就又散去了。
drama_dialogue870079.en: But the aura faded before I could investigate further.

drama_dialogue870080.ch: 你若有意，自行前去探查即可。我可要速回涂山去了，告辞！
drama_dialogue870080.en: If you're interested, feel free to look into it. I need to return to Tushan now. Farewell!

drama_dialogue870091.ch: 你并未理睬二人，匆匆离去了。
drama_dialogue870091.en: You don't pay them any attention, and leave in a hurry.

drama_dialogue871001.ch: 你给我记好了，待我脉长老得天赐机缘收获器灵，必将你全家上下刀刀斩尽、刃刃诛绝！
drama_dialogue871001.en: Remember this! When our elder gets an artifact spirit, you and your family will be dead!

drama_dialogue871002.ch: 哈哈哈，就凭那个老东西？没死在冥山边上就算万幸了，有工夫你还是多烧两柱高香吧！
drama_dialogue871002.en: Him? It would be a miracle if he doesn't die by the Nether Mountains. Why don't you pray instead?

drama_dialogue871003.ch: 放肆，竟敢对长老出言不逊！你当真以为我怕你不成？看招！
drama_dialogue871003.en: How dare you talk like this to the elder? Do you really think I'm scared of you? Eat this!

drama_dialogue871004.ch: 休说那老家伙，便是你，若有那等天大造化得器灵护体，我也必然对你生出三分忌惮，可眼下你这般着急送命，我也只能笑纳了。
drama_dialogue871004.en: Let's forget about him for a moment. If you somehow managed to get an artifact spirit to protect you, I'd be wary. But you look like you're in a hurry to die, so let me help you.

drama_dialogue871006.ch: 切，竟然有帮手……你以为我会乖乖跟你们打然后送命？哼，做梦！（修士祭起道法，转瞬便消失于无形）
drama_dialogue871006.en: Tsk, you have help? Do you really think I will stay and put myself at risk? Never! (The cultivator casts a spell and disappears.)

drama_dialogue871011.ch: 唔……今日若非阁下出手相助，在下恐怕凶多吉少。
drama_dialogue871011.en: Hmmm. I might have died today if it weren't for your help.

drama_dialogue871012.ch: 只恨我虽屡次不惜以身犯险，可终究不得器灵眷顾，无缘相获，否则此人必不是我的一合之敌！
drama_dialogue871012.en: I'm just sad that the artifact spirits never chose me, no matter how hard I try. This person wouldn't have been my enemy otherwise!

drama_dialogue871013.ch: 待我准备妥当，定然再去一试。此物便赠予阁下权当谢礼，若阁下还有需要，可在城镇购买。告辞！
drama_dialogue871013.en: I shall try again when I'm ready. Here's something for you to express my gratitude. Should you need more, you can buy them from the shops in town. Farewell!

drama_dialogue871014.ch: 噗！（修士口喷鲜血，逃遁而去）
drama_dialogue871014.en: Ugh! (The cultivator spits blood and runs away.)

drama_dialogue871021.ch: 哈哈哈，阁下慧眼识人，值得在下相交。
drama_dialogue871021.en: Hahaha! You have a keen eye. We should be friends.

drama_dialogue871022.ch: 此人整日与我过不去，还妄想得到器灵之助，实在痴人说梦。
drama_dialogue871022.en: This person has been giving me nothing but trouble all day, and even fantasized about getting artifact spirits. What a lunatic.

drama_dialogue871023.ch: 若无那等千载难逢的机缘，我等修士还是脚踏实地为好。在下有点小玩意相赠，算与阁下相识一场，若阁下还有需要，可在城镇购买。告辞！
drama_dialogue871023.en: If it weren't for the rare opportunity, cultivators like us should just do what we've always been doing. It was very nice meeting you, and here's a little something for you. If you need more, you can buy them in the town. Farewell!

drama_dialogue871031.ch: 你并未理睬二人，匆匆离去了。
drama_dialogue871031.en: You don't pay them any attention, and leave in a hurry.

drama_dialogue872001.ch: 前日我遥观两位羽化大能激战，二人甩手一挥之下，法宝漫天、器灵无数，声势当真惊人。我当时只顾看那器灵的模样，差点身中道法、小命不保！
drama_dialogue872001.en: I was watching two reborns fighting from afar the other day. They were tossing artifacts and spirits all over the place, it was very scary. I almost got hit, too!

drama_dialogue872002.ch: 哼哼，我看你是改不了这作死的性子了……
drama_dialogue872002.en: Hmmm. I guess you'll never change.

drama_dialogue872003.ch: 话说，要不咱也去冥山边那叫啥陨幽谷的地方碰碰运气吧？
drama_dialogue872003.en: Why don't we go to that valley... what was it? Fallen Valley? The one by Nether Mountains? And try our luck?

drama_dialogue872004.ch: 慢！你要是活得不耐烦，尽管自己送死去，可别搭上我！
drama_dialogue872004.en: Hold on! If you don't want to live, that's your problem. Dont pull me into it.

drama_dialogue872011.ch: 哦？你也对器灵有兴趣？哈哈哈，修仙之人憧憬天道，对器灵自当执着，万不可像他那般心无大志。
drama_dialogue872011.en: You're interested in artifact spirits too? Cultivators seek the truth, and naturally are stubborn about the spirits. Just make sure you're not carefree like him.

drama_dialogue872012.ch: 切！到时候别化作冤魂求着我给你收尸就好。
drama_dialogue872012.en: Tsk! Just don't haunt me when you're dead.

drama_dialogue872014.ch: 什么？你说你想知道器灵都长什么模样？嘿嘿，没想到阁下和我乃是同道中人啊！
drama_dialogue872014.en: What? What do artifact spirits look like? Well, now we're on the same page.

drama_dialogue872015.ch: 咳咳……这样吧，我前日窥探两位大能对决之时，也受了内伤，你若给些丹药于我，我便将那器灵的模样细细说给你听。
drama_dialogue872015.en: Ahem... how about this? I was hurt while looking at the fight, too. If you give me an elixir, I'll tell you what the artifact spirit looked like.

drama_dialogue872021.ch: 哈哈哈，够意思！我只是试探阁下之诚意，无意夺人所好。毕竟这器灵的模样乃是我不顾性命看来的，得亏是阁下，换作旁人我可绝对不说。
drama_dialogue872021.en: Ha! I was just testing your sincerity, and didn't meant to take anything from you. After all, I risked my life for this artifact spirit. I wouldn't have told anyone else.

drama_dialogue872022.ch: 只见那法宝之上，站立一人，婀娜窈窕、顾盼生姿。待我定睛细看，您猜怎么着……
drama_dialogue872022.en: I saw a slim figure standing on top of the artifact. I looked closer, and guess what...

drama_dialogue872023.ch: 竟然是一只浑身体毛的大耗子精！您说这气人不？
drama_dialogue872023.en: A hairy rat! Can you believe it?

drama_dialogue872024.ch: 唉……耗子精就耗子精吧，咱要是能有一个，也心满意足了……
drama_dialogue872024.en: Well... Having a mouse is better than none, I guess.

drama_dialogue872031.ch: 哼哼，你若自信有那般机缘，倒也不是不能亲自去那陨幽谷中一试。
drama_dialogue872031.en: If you believe your luck, I suppose you can go down to the valley and give it a try.

drama_dialogue872032.ch: 不然，可就要错过这此生唯一一次知晓器灵之模样的机会了。
drama_dialogue872032.en: You're going to miss your only chance to see an artifact spirit otherwise.

drama_dialogue872041.ch: 你并未理睬二人，匆匆离去了。
drama_dialogue872041.en: You don't pay them any attention, and leave in a hurry.

drama_dialogue873001.ch: 这天，你正欲赶路，只见沧崖不知从何处搞来一尊陶鼎，正热血沸腾地在鼎中煮着什么。
drama_dialogue873001.en: You are in a hurry, but you see Cangya boiling something in a cauldron.

drama_dialogue873011.ch: 沧崖端上了一盘丰盛精美的草料，眼中充满热切渴望地注视着你。
drama_dialogue873011.en: Cangya is holding a plate of delicious herbs, looking at you eagerly.

drama_dialogue873021.ch: 味道如何？老夫的手艺在军中可是一绝！
drama_dialogue873021.en: How is it? I'm one of the best cooks in the army!

drama_dialogue873022.ch: 你吃下菜肴，只觉得神清气爽，一股精气自小腹扩散至全身。
drama_dialogue873022.en: You eat some, and feel refreshed as a chunk of Qi radiates from your abdomen to the rest of your body.

drama_dialogue873031.ch: 如此佳肴，老夫只能独享，哼哼。
drama_dialogue873031.en: I guess I'll eat it on my own.

drama_dialogue873041.ch: 沧崖端上了一盘黑乎乎的神秘物体，一看就不是凡物。
drama_dialogue873041.en: Cangya is holding a plate of something... dark. It doesn't look ordinary.

drama_dialogue873051.ch: 味道如何？老夫的手艺在军中可是一绝！
drama_dialogue873051.en: How is it? I'm one of the best cooks in the army!

drama_dialogue873052.ch: 你吃下菜肴，只觉得腹中翻江倒海，一时呕吐出来。
drama_dialogue873052.en: You eat some and feel your stomach turning upside down. You throw up what you just ate.

drama_dialogue873061.ch: 如此佳肴，老夫只能独享，哼哼。
drama_dialogue873061.en: I guess I'll eat it on my own.

drama_dialogue880001.ch: 这日，你请求沧崖与自己进行点到为止的切磋，二人约定好不能使用灵力。
drama_dialogue880001.en: On this day, you ask Cangya to spar with you, and you agree that none of you will use energy.

drama_dialogue880002.ch: 几个时辰后，你与沧崖瘫倒在地，相视而笑。
drama_dialogue880002.en: After a few hours, you and Cangya both fall to the ground, smiling at each other.

drama_dialogue880011.ch: 你从切磋中获得启发，功法修炼出现了明显的提升。
drama_dialogue880011.en: You learned something new while sparring, and your martial arts is enhanced.

drama_dialogue880021.ch: 你觉得腰酸背痛，几天还不见好转。

drama_dialogue880031.ch: 你从切磋中领悟到修仙之道，功法修为出现巨幅的提升。
drama_dialogue880031.en: You learned more about cultivation while sparring, and your training is enhanced significantly.

drama_dialogue880101.ch: 今日，你突发奇想，让沐晴掏出宝贝陶埙，在大街上奏乐。
drama_dialogue880101.en: Today, you decide to ask Muqing to take out her instrument and playa on the street.

drama_dialogue880111.ch: 然而，四周空无一人，只留你一个孤独地享受沐晴的音乐。心满意足后，你带上沐晴悄然离去。
drama_dialogue880111.en: But there is no one around, and you're the only person listening to Muqing's music. You leave with Muqing after you thoroughly enjoyed her performance.

drama_dialogue880121.ch: 不久后，围观的人群便把你们围了里三层外三层。
drama_dialogue880121.en: Pretty soon, there is a large crowd around you.

drama_dialogue880131.ch: 闻此天籁之音，在下今生无憾矣。
drama_dialogue880131.en: Now that I've heard something so wonderful, I have no regrets.

drama_dialogue880132.ch: 雅乐当前，在下无词以赞，实在羞愧难当。
drama_dialogue880132.en: Such wonderful music... yet I'm at a loss of words. How embarrassing.

drama_dialogue880133.ch: 人言余音绕梁、三日不绝，在下若未闻此曲，必是不信。
drama_dialogue880133.en: They say that good music lingers for days. I wasn't a believer until today.

drama_dialogue880151.ch: 围观人群折服于美妙的音乐，纷纷向你投来灵石作为打赏。
drama_dialogue880151.en: After hearing the wonderful music, the crowd tosses spirit stones at you as rewards.

drama_dialogue880211.ch: 这儿人真不少，咱得瞧瞧咋回事。
drama_dialogue880211.en: That's a lot of people. I wonder what's happening.

drama_dialogue880221.ch: 好困啊，赶紧回家睡觉吧。
drama_dialogue880221.en: I need to go home and sleep.

drama_dialogue880231.ch: 你仔细观察围观者的表情，发现他们眼神呆滞木讷，原来这些人只是来凑热闹。
drama_dialogue880231.en: You look at the bystanders notice the blank looks in their eyes. They're just rubbernecking.

drama_dialogue880301.ch: 近来凝霜越发躁动，你便同意她外出捕猎散心，凝霜很快就在野外搭建了一个陷阱。
drama_dialogue880301.en: Ningshuang has been restless lately, so you go out on a hunt with her. She quickly builds a trap nearby.

drama_dialogue880311.ch: 不久后，你带着凝霜打开陷阱，发现一只妖兽已然毙命其中。
drama_dialogue880311.en: After a while, you undo the trap and see a dead fiend inside.

drama_dialogue880312.ch: 不久后，你带着凝霜打开陷阱，发现大量妖兽已然毙命其中。
drama_dialogue880312.en: After a while, you undo the trap and many dead fiends inside.

drama_dialogue880313.ch: 不久后，你带着凝霜打开陷阱，发现陷阱中空空如也。
drama_dialogue880313.en: After a while, you undo the trap and find nothing.

drama_dialogue880321.ch: 不久后，你带着凝霜打开陷阱，发现一个修士正满面怒容地坐在其中疗伤。
drama_dialogue880321.en: After a while, you undo the trap and see an angry cultivator healing their wounds in the trap.

drama_dialogue880322.ch: 你……仗着修为高就可以挖陷阱坑人吗！
drama_dialogue880322.en: Don't think you can dig traps just because you're so powerful!

drama_dialogue880331.ch: 这还差不多，如此我便原谅你了。
drama_dialogue880331.en: I suppose I can forgive you.

drama_dialogue880341.ch: 可恶！别以为你修为高就了不起，我全族都不会放过你的！
drama_dialogue880341.en: Don't think you can do whatever you want because you're further ahead. My tribe will not let you off the hook that easily!

drama_dialogue880401.ch: 这日，你好奇地询问梦衣，会不会占卜预知之术，梦衣在你额头轻轻一点，你竟然立刻就昏昏睡去。
drama_dialogue880401.en: You asked Mengyi if she knew how to see the future. She taps your forehead and you immediately fall asleep.

drama_dialogue880411.ch: 梦中，你看到一对男女甜蜜地相拥在一起，顿时感觉到一阵幸福。
drama_dialogue880411.en: In the dream, you see a man and a woman holding each other and you feel happy.

drama_dialogue880421.ch: 梦中，你感觉整个世界都扭曲了，妖兽们彼此交换了头和身体，一切都显得怪诞异常。
drama_dialogue880421.en: You feel the world warping in your dream. The fiends trade their heads and bodies, and everything looks strange.

drama_dialogue880431.ch: 梦中，你感觉一道雷劫照着面门劈下，脸颊顿时一阵酥麻，人也瞬间惊醒。
drama_dialogue880431.en: In your dream, you felt a lightning hit you. Your face goes numb and you jolt awake.

drama_dialogue880451.ch: 梦中，你看到梦衣穿着一件漂亮的衣服在你面前炫耀。
drama_dialogue880451.en: In your dream, you see Mengyi wearing something beautiful.

drama_dialogue880501.ch: 你觉得八荒险恶，想请托菱歌给予药材若干，好炼制丹药防身，正巧近日菱歌沉迷炼丹，一直在搜集药材。
drama_dialogue880501.en: You think the world is very dangerous, and want to ask Lingge for some herbs to make elixirs. As it happens, Lingge has been addicted to alchemy and has been collecting herbs.

drama_dialogue880511.ch: 菱歌愉快答应，炼制了一炉丹药。
drama_dialogue880511.en: Lingge quickly agrees and brews elixirs.

drama_dialogue880521.ch: 菱歌答应后，立刻开始炼制，可惜她心中急躁，不小心放错了药材，丹炉中一股毒气溢出。
drama_dialogue880521.en: Lingge immediately starts to brew after saying yes. But she's in a hurry and puts in the wrong ingredient. Poison comes out from the furnace.

drama_dialogue880601.ch: 你看到酒尘喜爱冶炼铁器，便想从他手上拿一点珍贵矿材，以备不时之需。
drama_dialogue880601.en: You see that Jiuchen loves to forge, so you decide to get some rare ores from him just in case.

drama_dialogue880611.ch: 虽然口头上爽快地答应了你的请求，但酒尘颤巍巍的手仍然紧紧捏着这块矿石。
drama_dialogue880611.en: Jiuchen agreed to your request quickly, but his shaky hands are still holding onto the ore firmly.

drama_dialogue880621.ch: 酒尘喜滋滋地取出一块黑乎乎的矿材，将其郑重地交给你。就在你接过来的一瞬间，这块矿材突然爆炸了。
drama_dialogue880621.en: Jiuchen happily takes out a black ore and hands it over to you carefully. It explodes as soon as it touches your hand.

drama_dialogue880701.ch: 听到你的请求，梦衣欢欣不已，她手指翻飞，熟练地为你画上了美美的妆。你顿时觉得，自己就是八荒中最靓的修士。
drama_dialogue880701.en: Mengyi is all too happy to hear your request. She quickly puts makeup on you, and you feel like the most beautiful cultivator in the world right now.

drama_dialogue880801.ch: “啊？来活了？”酒尘傻傻地看着你，眼眸里充满了少年的纯真。
drama_dialogue880801.en: "Oh, there's work to do?" Jiuchen looks at you with the naivete of a teenager.

drama_dialogue880901.ch: 只见沧崖浑身青光一闪，一道环形法阵便在其脚下成型。也许你可以用它来前往任何你想去的地方。
drama_dialogue880901.en: Cangya flashes green and a ring formation appears under his feet. Maybe you can use it to travel to where you want to go.

drama_dialogue881001.ch: 虽然人族功法对菱歌而言无法直接修炼，但万法归宗、殊途同归，修仙自有其共通之处。
drama_dialogue881001.en: Even though I can't train the human techniques, but the underlying principles are the same. Cultivation transcends races.

drama_dialogue881101.ch: 沐晴双手亮起光芒，随后一枝小树苗破土而出。你用灵力探测，发现它竟连着横亘八荒地脉的建木主干。
drama_dialogue881101.en: Muqing's hands glow, then a sprout breaks through the earth. You use your energy and realize it's connected to the main branch of the tree vault.

drama_dialogue881201.ch: 这日，你询问烛遥月，能否呼风唤雨。遥月抿嘴一笑，反问你想要怎样的风与雨？
drama_dialogue881201.en: You ask Yaoyue if she can summon wind and rain. She compresses her lips into a smile and asks you what kind of wind and rain you want?

drama_dialogue881202.ch: 只是眨下眼的一瞬间，八荒已然变得天朗气清，惠风和畅。和煦的阳光扫过你的鼻尖，你感到极为惬意。
drama_dialogue881202.en: In the twinkling of an eye, the sky clears up with a gentle breeze. The warm sunlight brushes the tip of your nose. You can't feel more pleased.

drama_dialogue881203.ch: 只是眨下眼的一瞬间，暴雨已倾盆般泼下，颗颗硕大的雨珠却未沾到半点你的衣襟。
drama_dialogue881203.en: In the twinkling of an eye, you are caught in a downpour, but strangely enough, none of the large raindrops could touch your clothes.

drama_dialogue881204.ch: 只是眨下眼的一瞬间，天色就已然灰蒙蒙一片，八荒似乎都沉寂了下来。
drama_dialogue881204.en: In the twinkling of an eye, the sky turns grey, and the whole world seems to be silenced.

drama_dialogue881205.ch: 只是眨下眼的一瞬间，雾蒙蒙的细雨便飘落下来，雨丝缠入你的手心，冰凉却温柔。
drama_dialogue881205.en: In the twinkling of an eye, light drizzle starts to fall, shrouding the sky in a mist. Droplets fall on your palm, cold yet gentle.

drama_dialogue881206.ch: 只是眨下眼的一瞬间，朔风渐起，大雪纷纷扬扬落下，你的肩头叠满了片片的雪花。
drama_dialogue881206.en: In the twinkling of an eye, a cold wind starts to blow, bringing with it a big snow. Your shoulders are soon covered with snowflakes.

drama_dialogue881207.ch: 突然，一股灼龙之息笼罩于你身，鸟兽鱼虫闻之皆四处逃窜。
drama_dialogue881207.en: Suddenly, you are shrouded in a Flaming Dragon Breath, and the animals nearby all flee for their lives.

drama_dialogue881208.ch: 突然，一股灼龙之息笼罩于你身，鸟兽鱼虫闻之皆四处逃窜。
drama_dialogue881208.en: Suddenly, you are shrouded in a Flaming Dragon Breath, and the animals nearby all flee for their lives.

drama_dialogue881209.ch: 突然，一股灼龙之息笼罩于你身，鸟兽鱼虫闻之皆四处逃窜。
drama_dialogue881209.en: Suddenly, you are shrouded in a Flaming Dragon Breath, and the animals nearby all flee for their lives.

drama_dialogue881210.ch: 突然，一股灼龙之息笼罩于你身，鸟兽鱼虫闻之皆四处逃窜。
drama_dialogue881210.en: Suddenly, you are shrouded in a Flaming Dragon Breath, and the animals nearby all flee for their lives.

drama_dialogue881211.ch: 这日，你一时兴起与遥月探讨起用人之道。遥月引经据典，向你讲述了她的帝王之学。
drama_dialogue881211.en: You start a discussion with Yaoyue about how to manage people. She uses all sorts of citations to explain her statecraft.

drama_dialogue881212.ch: 途径妖兽聚集之地时各种妖兽向玩家匍匐跪倒，瑟瑟发抖。
drama_dialogue881212.en: When you pass the habitats of monsters, they all lie prostrate and shiver in fear.

drama_dialogue881213.ch: 这日，你正在街边闲逛，只听坊市里人群议论纷纷，皆在讨论天宝真人在赤幽州再次出现之事。这次他说自己感受到了真龙现世，必有八荒之主诞生，只是不知此人究竟是谁。
drama_dialogue881213.en: You are taking a walk on the street and hear people talking about Sage Tianbao's return to Chi You. He said he felt the birth of a true dragon, and it meant a new lord of the world was going to emerge. He just didn't know who that lord would be.

drama_dialogue881301.ch: “此番行径，需以你的血为引。你切记要寻个合适的时机，以免精血枯竭之时被敌人寻仇。”惊棠望着你，眼里有几分担忧。
drama_dialogue881301.en: "It needs your blood as a trigger. Choose the right time to do it, in case your enemies should take the chance to attack you when you are bleeding." Jingtang looks at you worriedly.

drama_dialogue881302.ch: 你用神识探查了一下，果然此人已重塑肉身，只是尚未苏醒，想必过些时日便能完全恢复。
drama_dialogue881302.en: You check it with your focus. That person has indeed finished Body Reconstruction, but has not regained consciousness yet. It will only be a matter of time.

drama_dialogue881303.ch: “换个头发的样式？唔，这倒不是难事，帽子和脸饰也能一并更换。不过，你若要替旁人更换发式，还需其同意才可。”
drama_dialogue881303.en: "A new hairstyle? It won't be difficult. I can change your hat and facewear with it too. But if you want to change someone else's hairstyle, you should ask for their permission first."

drama_dialogue881304.ch: 惊棠背后的银骨鞭飞快地翻动，很快便将你的头发编成了你所想要的样子。
drama_dialogue881304.en: The silver bone whip behind Jingtang flips rapidly and braids your hair into the hairstyle you want.

drama_dialogue881305.ch: 惊棠背后的银骨鞭飞快地翻动，很快便将此人的头发编好。
drama_dialogue881305.en: The silver bone whip behind Jingtang flips rapidly and braids that person's hair into the new hairstyle.

drama_dialogue881306.ch: 惊棠把你炼丹的残渣又悄悄收起来重新炼制了一番，却意外炼制出了极品的丹药。
drama_dialogue881306.en: Jingtang has collected the dregs in your furnace and used them to make some top quality elixirs, much to your surprise.

drama_dialogue881307.ch: 惊棠把你炼丹的残渣又悄悄收起来重新炼制了一番，却意外炼制出了上好的丹药。
drama_dialogue881307.en: Jingtang has collected the dregs in your furnace and used them to make some fine elixirs, much to your surprise.

drama_dialogue881308.ch: 惊棠把你炼丹的残渣又悄悄收起来重新炼制了一番，并称这是采用全新的炼制方法。惊棠眼巴巴的望着你，想要你品尝一下。
drama_dialogue881308.en: Jingtang has collected the dregs in your furnace and concocted them again, but he claims to have used a new technique. He wants you to taste the newly concocted elixir.

drama_dialogue881309.ch: 果然，丹药刚下肚你就开始腹痛难耐，浑身不适。
drama_dialogue881309.en: Just as you thought, your stomach starts to ache shortly after you take the elixir.

drama_dialogue881310.ch: 冷惊棠在路边采了一堆花花绿绿的蘑菇，看起来十分开心，但你觉得这蘑菇必然有剧毒，吃下去分分钟暴毙。惊棠却说要在体内把各种毒素养蛊，这样他就能变强。
drama_dialogue881310.en: Leng Jingtang has collected some colorful mushrooms and looks happy. You think these mushrooms must be poisonous enough to kill whoever eats them, but Jingtang says he can blend the poisons within him to grow even stronger.

drama_dialogue881311.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881311.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881312.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881312.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881313.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881313.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881314.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881314.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881315.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881315.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881316.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881316.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881317.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881317.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881318.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881318.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881319.ch: 你看他吃的如此欢快，也跟着尝了一口，却不曾这蘑菇竟有奇效。
drama_dialogue881319.en: He is eating them happily, and you feel tempted to give it a bite too. You are quite surprised to find it has an extraordinary effect.

drama_dialogue881321.ch: 这日，惊棠兴致冲冲想要练练书法，你替他准备好了纸墨笔砚。在他一番龙飞凤舞后，自己把自己缠住了。
drama_dialogue881321.en: Jingtang wants to practice calligraphy on a whim. You help him prepare the writing utensils, and he enjoys it very much with his body almost dancing. Unsurprisingly, he ends up in a knot.

drama_dialogue881332.ch: 你休憩了半刻，却发现惊棠没了半点动静，身上也是一片冰凉。
drama_dialogue881332.en: After you wake up from a nap, you find Jingtang still and cold.

drama_dialogue881333.ch: 你不禁悲从中来，惊棠此刻却悠悠醒来，安慰你道自己只是在冬眠，不必担忧。
drama_dialogue881333.en: You begin to feel sad when Jingtang wakes up slowly, telling you that he was only hibernating.

drama_dialogue881334.ch: 有了上次的经验，你已知道他这又是冬眠了，便轻声呼唤想要叫醒他。奈何惊棠却无半点反应，你只好大力拍了一巴掌。
drama_dialogue881334.en: Now you know he must be hibernating again, you go up and try to wake him up, but he is still dead asleep. You have no choice but to give him a slap.

drama_dialogue881335.ch: 这日，你在同遥月感慨这地带的妖兽甚多，她思索片刻，而后向你捏了个法诀。
drama_dialogue881335.en: While chatting with Yaoyue, you mention the large number of monsters nearby. After thinking for a while, she casts a spell on you.

drama_dialogue881337.ch: “你的修为还太低了，灼龙之息目前还发挥不出作用。”遥月有些遗憾的说着。
